games.summary: Kambulin is a story focused game about love: be it about people, environments or even yourself. Enjoy your time meeting a lot of very different characters and explore a beautiful pixel-art world!

games.name: Black Sailors
games.summary: Command a fleet of formerly enslaved people who became pirates in Brazil’s Bay of All Saints. Challenge colonial oppression, fight for freedom, and rewrite Atlantic history in turn-based tactical naval battles.

games.name: Drowned Lake
games.summary: Dredge up the secrets hidden beneath Drowned Lake in this horror fishing adventure. Investigate the dark waters to fish out the truth. Catch evidence. Do not get caught yourself.

games.name: Toada Brava
games.summary: You’ve got busted! Save your mom and escape from Santacrúz Dungeon alongside a ragtag team of heroes in this hand-drawn JRPG.

games.name: Hivaneph: The Legend of Elles
games.summary: Hivaneph: The Legend of Elles is an action-adventure game where every character holds a unique perspective, revealing a world that is distinct to their own eyes.

games.name: Whiskers' Wish
games.summary: Discover the life of an abandoned kitten in this cute and heartwarming adventure. Explore the city park with other strays, solve puzzles, make friends, and face dangers—all while dreaming of finding a forever home.

games.name: The Ark
games.summary: Exploring the dark and atmospheric environments of The Ark.

games.name: Dolor's Dwelling
games.summary:
Uncover the story behind the Dolor family in this hand-animated metroidvania.

Explore a huge interconnected mansion searching for clues over what happend to the residents of the place. All while collecting upgrades and fighting old ghosts along the way.

games.name: Jequi's Dream
games.summary: Jequi is a little boy who needs to collect as much water as possible to help his mother Jandira and his younger brother Joel to survive the drought of Jequitinhonha valley. Anywhere Jequi passes through, that place regain health and bloom again, and little by little, the dream of a new valley grow.

games.name: Banana Party
games.summary: Get ready for lots of bananas and tons of laughter! In Banana Party, you control a bunch of curious little monkeys in wild challenges and chaotic minigames. Whether you’re hopping across moving platforms, throwing poop at your friends, or fighting over who collects the most bananas, every round is an explosion of fun.

games.name: SacriFrogos
games.summary: A roguelike strategy and survival game where ever-growing sacrifices are required to keep the mysterious Eternal Flame alive. Build a colony of Frogos and create unique builds every run.

games.name: Like Them
games.summary: A fast-paced 2D puzzle game where you play as a cheerful ghost, moving in straight lines until hitting a wall. Navigate through a haunted house, dodge traps, evil ghosts, and escape before becoming like them!

games.name: Alien Apocalypse
games.summary: Alien Apocalypse is an open-world sandbox survival game set after a devastating alien invasion. Scavenge for resources, craft, build defenses, and harness alien technology to fight back. Play solo or in co-op and reclaim what’s left of the planet.

games.name: MechaBlade Hero
games.summary: MechaBlade Hero is an indie action adventure game where you control a robot fighting your way through an army of robots to get out of a giant tower. Face enemies and gain new weapons, solve puzzles and platform challenges in this challenging hack and slash.

games.name: Cyber Haze
games.summary: Cyber Haze is a retro-style 2.5D platformer in which Haze, a delivery robot, must defend his world against a horde of viruses that have begun to take over the digital world!

games.name: Restless Rites
games.summary: Tend to a cursed chapel at the edge of town, or be swallowed by what sleeps beneath it. Clean, survive, and unravel a rotting mystery in this surreal horror game of routine, decay, and sacrifice.

games.name: Temple of Revi
games.summary: Travel through devastated lands solving color-matching sokoban puzzles to bring Nature back to life.

games.name: Gears Of Glory
games.summary:
Gears of Glory is a movement-based Tower Defense where you drive a van across the map to collect Gears, build powerful towers, and stop the robots from destroying your bases.

Developed for PC, Gears of Glory combines classic Tower Defense strategy with a unique twist: driving a stylish van through the chaos of a post-apocalyptic world.

Featuring a top-down pixel art look and fast-paced gameplay, the player takes on the role of a resistance pilot tasked with protecting the last human bases from hordes of robots that have taken over the planet and isolated humanity. To succeed, you’ll need skill behind the wheel, dodging obstacles or running enemies over. All while building towers with strategic synergies capable of turning the tide of battle.

Speed, strategy and survival collide in this game where every turn can mean the difference between extinction and the salvation of humanity.

The game’s inspiration comes from the desire to complement the Tower Defense genre and eliminate those idle moments where players would simply speed up the game after placing towers and wait. In Gears of Glory you are in constant motion driving the van to upgrade towers, collect Gears, and run enemies over.

The gameplay and art are influenced by titles such as Gemcraft, Kingdom Rush, Thronefall, Rock and Roll Racing, Biker Mice from Mars, GTA2.

games.name: The Path into the Abyss
games.summary: "The Path into the Abyss" is a hardcore first-person open-world survival shooter set in Buenos Aires with a backdrop of cosmic horror, combat mechanics, dynamic AI, and looting.

games.name: Shippin
games.summary: Embark on a journey across cozy islands, where you’ll fish and experience magical moments. Uncover the stories of an ocean, where each harbor is a welcoming place, with friendly characters waiting to help guide you back home!

games.name: Llamalandia
games.summary: In Llamalandia you play as a cute Llama that got lost in the mountains, prepare yourself to explore a new world that you have never seen before, while you embark on a magical journey across the Bolivian altiplano, facing many challenges in order to find your family and save the rest of your species.

games.name: Block Block Block
games.summary: Design your dream space! In this tiny cozy building game, stack and arrange uniquely shaped wooden blocks to craft charming dioramas. Design cozy bakeries, elegant living rooms or quirkiy studios, create beautiful spaces filled with warm and personality.

games.name: Colorbound
games.summary: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue. As Anku, an Aymara boy with a unique gift, you’ll harness the power of color to shape the environment itself, uncovering hidden paths to navigate challenging and complex puzzles.

games.name: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
games.summary: In up to four player co-op, form a group of explorers searching for treasure. In this cursed jungle, danger is everywhere and monstrous creatures alter reality. Stay clear-headed and tame the jungle before it devours you…

events.name: State of Play | February 12, 2026
events.description: Tune in live for 60+ minutes of news, gameplay updates, and announcements from game studios across the globe. February’s State of Play will spotlight eye-catching third-party and indie games headed to PS5, along with the latest from teams at PlayStation Studios.

games.name: Kena: Scars of Kosmora
games.summary: In Kena: Scars of Kosmora, Kena is older and renowned as a Spirit Guide. In hopes of finding answers to the affliction she has endured all her life, Kena travels to the mysterious island of Kosmora. Home to distinct cultures and regions, Kosmora is full of buried secrets from a tragic past.

games.name: 4:Loop
games.summary: Created by Mike Booth and the interactive storytellers at Bad Robot Games, 4:LOOP is a tactical, four-player co-op shooter crafted for endless replayability and infinite ways to build the ultimate team. Together, if you can learn from your mistakes, you might just fail to save the world.

games.name: Death Stranding 2: On the Beach
games.summary: Death Stranding 2: On the Beach is a third-person action-adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic world ravaged by otherworldly creatures. Players control Sam Porter Bridges, a retired porter, as he traverses the open worlds of Mexico and Australia to connect isolated survivors to a wireless communication network called the Chiral Network. The core gameplay revolves around delivering packages across hazardous terrain, managing cargo weight, building infrastructure like roads and monorails, and navigating natural disasters. Combat has a greater focus than its predecessor, offering lethal and non-lethal options alongside stealth approaches. The game features asynchronous online elements where players can build structures visible to others.

games.name: Ghost of Yotei: Legends
games.summary:
Ghost of Yötei Legends is an online cooperative multiplayer mode, up to four players, where players can team up with friends to challenge monstrous, supernatural enemies across three distinct game modes:
• Survival - Team up with up to three other players to take down waves of increasingly difficult enemies on one of four maps. Fight to control territory on each map. While in control, you can choose to activate a Blessing to receive an advantage in battle, but losing control can activate a Curse that puts your team at a disadvantage.
• Story - Team up with another player to tackle a series of 12 missions. Work together, combining your unique skills to overcome a range of encounters, enemies and challenges.
• Incursion - Upon completing each set of three Story missions, you’ll unlock a large-scale, four-player assault on a stronghold belonging to a member of the Yōtei Six. Each Incursion will culminate in a boss fight versus a giant, supernatural version of The Spider, The Oni, The Kitsune, or The Snake.

games.name: Resident Evil Requiem
games.summary: Resident Evil Requiem is the ninth entry in the Resident Evil series. Experience terrifying survival horror with FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, and dive into pulse-pounding action with legendary agent Leon S. Kennedy. Both of their journeys and unique gameplay styles intertwine into a heart-stopping, emotional experience that will chill you to your core.

games.name: Pragmata
games.summary: Pragmata is a sci-fi action-adventure game set in the near future. The story follows Hugh and his android companion Diana as they navigate a Lunar research station. Gameplay incorporates action elements alongside mechanics involving interaction with systems within the environment.

games.name: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered
games.summary: Play as the vampire Kain and his betrayed lieutenant Raziel. Wield legendary blades, use supernatural abilities, and battle through a world of conflict, intrigue, and prophecy as their paths collide across the dark world of Nosgoth.

games.name: Brigandine Abyss
games.summary: The king of Solginat is dead, and a new would-be emperor stands over the corpse. Confront the dark in one of six different storylines as you manage resources, rally your monsters, and stand against the empire

games.name: Dead or Alive 6 Last Round
games.summary: Fan-favorite 3D fighting game Dead or Alive 6 is back with stylish moves, striking animations, and a cast of colorful characters to go head-to-head in the fighting game world's most extreme battles!

games.name: Control Resonant
games.summary: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.

games.name: Crimson Moon
games.summary: A gothic action-adventure RPG of violent angels and dead gods.

games.name: Beast of Reincarnation
games.summary: In post-apocalyptic Japan, humanity’s last hope may rest with Emma and her loyal canine companion, Koo. Explore what it means to be human in Beast of Reincarnation, an expansive one-person, one-dog action RPG built around demanding, technical combat. What awaits at journey’s end?

games.name: Rayman: 30th Anniversary Edition
games.summary: Perform Rayman’s signature punch and helicopter hair glide through colorful worlds, from the Dream Forest and its unforgettable mosquito ride to Band Land’s musical chaos. Rescue the Electoons and save the world from Mr. Dark in a classic platforming adventure that remains as magical today as it was in the 90s.

games.name: Neva: Prologue
games.summary: Set years before the events of the main game, Neva: Prologue tells the story of how Alba and Neva first met.

games.name: Mina the Hollower
games.summary:
Mina the Hollower is a bone-chilling action-adventure game featuring classic gameplay and an 8-bit aesthetic in the style of Game Boy Color, refined for the modern era.

Quick and deliberate 60fps action combat, captivating world design, and top-down adventuring combine in a nostalgic blend. Whip foes, burrow through the ground, and explore a pixel-perfect world in Mina the Hollower, a brand new game from the developers who brought you Shovel Knight!

games.name: Yakoh: Shinobi Ops
games.summary: Four Shinobi lurking in the darkness. Silent as shadows, racing through the night. To complete their deadly mission, they master their arts—hiding, sparing lives, deceiving—as they venture toward either death or salvation. Evade the relentless pursuit of immortal Hunters, and only by returning alive will their mission be fulfilled.

games.name: Project Windless
games.summary:
Project Windless is a single-player open-world action RPG set in the universe of the acclaimed Korean fantasy novel series The Bird That Drinks Tears.

Step into a mythic age as a mighty Rekon warrior and journey across a breathtaking, war-torn world. Stand against overwhelming odds, forge alliances, and wage war across massive battlefields to unite a fractured land and give birth to a new kingdom.

games.name: Metal Gear Solid Master Collection: Volume 2
games.summary: This second installment to the collection features “Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots” and “Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version),” and also a digital soundtrack and "Metal Gear: Ghost Babel" as bonus content.

games.name: 007 First Light
games.summary: 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Players follow James Bond as a young, resourceful, and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training program and discover an origin story of the world's most famous spy.

games.name: Star Wars: Galactic Racer
games.summary: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer is a runs-based, high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.

games.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
games.summary: 1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows. Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.

games.name: Darwin's Paradox!
games.summary: Dive into the adventure with Darwin, an octopus as endearing as he is ingenious, torn from the ocean and trapped in a vast and mysterious industrial complex. Harness his unique talents and abilities to help him overcome the many dangers and traps in this captivating platformer and adventure game.

games.name: Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater
games.summary: The same gripping story and engrossing world, but now with cutting-edge graphics and 3D audio, which bring the jungle to life. Get ready for the ultimate survival, stealth and action experience.

games.name: Metal Gear Solid Master Collection: Volume 1
games.summary:
Metal Gear Solid Master Collection: Volume 1 compiles the early entries in the Metal Gear series into a single package, offering players the opportunity to experience the origins of stealth action gameplay. The collection includes the following titles: Metal Gear, Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake, Metal Gear Solid (with VR Missions/Special Missions), Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty (HD Collection version), Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater (HD Collection version), as well as the NES/Famicom version of Metal Gear and Snake’s Revenge. Regional versions of the titles are available as additional downloads.

Additional content includes the digital graphic novels Metal Gear Solid: Digital Graphic Novel and Metal Gear Solid 2: Digital Graphic Novel. A set of digital books is also provided, comprising screenplay and master books for Metal Gear, Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake, Metal Gear Solid, Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty, and Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater. These books can be accessed from the game’s main menu.

The collection also features the Metal Gear Solid: Digital Soundtrack.

games.name: Silent Hill: Townfall
games.summary:
Silent Hill: Townfall is a full-length, self-contained psychological horror set against the cold, isolated backdrop of Scotland, 1996.

Players can explore St. Amelia, where fog-soaked streets, abandoned communities, and forgotten corners tell their story through atmosphere and history. Reality and delusion subtly intertwine to lure players into the depths of St. Amelia's grounded, tangible world.

games.name: Rev. Noir
games.summary:
When Hope Sparks Catastrophe

In a world shrouded in lightfall, a natural phenomenon that brings death to those it touches,
A lonely boy who suffers from amnesia becomes acquainted with a special girl.
Together, they set out on a journey to stop this phenomenon,
Believing that the journey will save the world, and in turn, save her.

Fate, bestowed by the Gods?
Or the power of will, borne from within humankind?
Their journey ends up shaking the world.

Unravel the mandate of heaven, and weave together the threads of hope in this completely new RPG experience.

games.name: Untitled John Wick Game
games.summary: This new John Wick video game will feature an original gameplay narrative set in the John Wick timeline years before the Impossible Task and will deliver on the signature style and unique elements fans expect from a John Wick mission, including a hard-hitting gun-fu combat system, jaw-dropping camerawork, intense driving experiences, cinematic storytelling, and a bold range of atmospherically immersive environments.

games.name: Tekken: Dark Resurrection
games.summary: A port of Tekken: Dark Resurrection, originally released on the PSP (PlayStation Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

games.name: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
games.summary:
Marvel's Spider-Man 2 is an action-adventure game developed by Insomniac Games and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment. Released in October 2023 exclusively for the PlayStation 5, it is a direct sequel to Marvel's Spider-Man (2018) and Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales (2020). The game continues the story of Peter Parker and Miles Morales as they face new challenges and threats in New York City.

In Marvel's Spider-Man 2, players can switch between Peter and Miles, each with unique abilities and combat styles. The game introduces new villains, including Kraven the Hunter and Venom, while expanding the open-world environment with more detailed and interactive elements.

games.name: Marathon
games.summary: A PvP-focused extraction shooter set on the mysterious planet of Tau Ceti IV, Marathon will see players inhabit the bodies of Runners, cybernetic mercenaries who have been designed to survive the planet’s harsh environments and explore the lost colony that once inhabited Tau Ceti’s surface. Players will engage solo or in crews of three, searching for mysterious alien artifacts, as well as for valuable loot and new weapons and gear that they can add to their collection.

games.name: Time Crisis
games.summary: A port of Time Crisis, originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

games.name: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
games.summary:
Assemble your team of legendary Marvel characters in the ultimate 4v4 tag team fighter from PlayStation Studios, Arc System Works and Marvel Games.
Immerse yourself in the Marvel universe like never before with an iconic roster of heroes and villains, authentic stages, and intuitive gameplay mechanics. Experience the thrill of fast-paced over the top action with stunning anime-inspired visuals, where every battle is a unique and exciting team VS battle experience.

games.name: Saros
games.summary: Saros is an action game developed by Housemarque and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment. Players control Arjun Devraj, a Soltari Enforcer investigating a lost off-world colony on Carcosa. The game features fast-paced third-person combat, boss encounters, and progression across repeated attempts.

games.name: Big Walk
games.summary: Hang out and get lost with close friends in a big world. A cooperative online walker-talker from the creators of Untitled Goose Game.

games.name: God of War Sons of Sparta
games.summary:
Join young Kratos and Deimos, sons of Sparta, on a Greek odyssey as they discover the meaning of duty and honour.
An engaging and exciting 2D action-adventure brought to life from the talented pixel superstars at Mega Cat Studios. Experience retro classic gameplay with God of War’s signature spectacle, action, and heartfelt storytelling.

events.name: Indie Fan Fest 2026
events.description:
SAVE THE DATE: Indie Fan Fest returns on Thursday, Feb. 19!

We'll be showcasing a wide selection of the coolest upcoming indie games with demos planned for Steam Next Fest. Be sure to tune in at www.indiefanfest.com.

games.name: Denshattack!
games.summary: Flip, trick and grind your train in a fast-paced, off-the-rails ride through a colourful Japanese dystopia. Outmatch rival gangs, wreck a shady megacorp, and take back the tracks with nothing but skill, speed, and style.

games.name: Ex Sanguis
games.summary: From the creators of Othercide, Ex Sanguis delivers what the studio is known for: dynamic & epic turn-based combat in a visually striking world. Bleed the world to life; fight the agents of perfection and stillness through strategic blood baths in this evolved roguelite tactical RPG game!

games.name: Raccoin: Coin Pusher Roguelike
games.summary: A coin-pushing dopamine machine. RACCOIN is a roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins with powerful items to trigger wildly satisfying combos. Stack shiny towers, spin the lucky wheel, and shake the machine until all the coins drop.

games.name: Pro Jank Footy
games.summary: Pro Jank Footy is an over-the-top arcade comedy-sports game. Score goals to unleash game-changing power-ups, build a deck of absurd abilities, and tackle a season where no two matches are ever the same—solo or with your mates.

games.name: Fight Life: Vanguard
games.summary: Engage in strategic turn-based combat, manage and upgrade each character, and strive to reclaim harmony in a world on the brink of oblivion. Take on the mantle of leadership as you guide a mercenary squad through perilous landscapes, selecting your comrades from a diverse pool of skilled recruits.

games.name: Nutmeg!
games.summary: NUTMEG! is a nostalgic football manager game with a deckbuilding twist, set in the '80s and '90s. Relive the days when the tackles were as hard as the mullets were long and football was about football.

games.name: Wax Heads
games.summary: A cosy-punk slice-of-life narrative sim about managing a struggling record store. Chat to quirky customers with unique tastes, explore a handcrafted record collection, fall in love with bands (and their drama!), or just slack off with your colleagues – all to restore the groove!

games.name: Truckful
games.summary: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

games.name: Collector's Cove
games.summary: All aboard! Collector’s Cove is a cozy farming adventure on the high seas. Sail with your animal friend to uncharted waters, cultivate your floating farm, and discover new islands, crops and fish on your quest to become a Named Collector!

games.name: Inkonbini: One Store. Many Stories
games.summary: Inkonbini: One Store. Many Stories is a cozy slice-of-life game about running a small-town convenience store, inspired by early 1990s Japan. Meet regulars, stock shelves, and watch quiet, everyday moments turn into meaningful stories.

games.name: Hidden Around the World
games.summary: Travel the world in this cozy hidden-object adventure with decoration and discover the charm of cities like Tokyo, Paris, New York, and many more!

games.name: Thrifty Business
games.summary: Run your very own thrift shop in this laid-back management sim! Sort through boxes to find hidden treasures and arrange nostalgic displays of clothes, antiques, toys & more. Befriend the regulars, help with their requests and expand your store into a hub for the local community!

games.name: Cleaning Up!
games.summary: Turn huge messes into sparkling spaces! Feel the satisfaction of restoring them to order with your super-powered cleaning tools. The quick, cozy joy of tidying up!

games.name: Train Jumble
games.summary: Travel Europe in your self-furnished train while making sure all passengers are happy with their seats.

games.name: Cozywood Creek
games.summary: A gentle idle game with a living stream flowing quietly at the bottom of your screen. Terraform the land and watch as animals arrive to make Cozywood their home. Cultivate the surrounding area and bring this cozy ecosystem to life.

games.name: ShantyTown
games.summary: ShantyTown is a relaxing diorama-building game about finding beauty in everyday chaos. Bring new locations to life, stack your urban buildings high, and fill each little nook and cranny with your own touch. Even messiness has its own little charm.

games.name: Froggy Hates Snow
games.summary: A survival roguelike where a frog digs through freezing snow, uncovers treasures, unlocks upgrades, and battles mystical creatures. Find the escape door or defeat the final boss to survive.

games.name: Retail Hell
games.summary: A horror job simulator set in a convenience store in purgatory. Serve non human customers, fight collapsing inventory, survive curses, and uncover why your shift never ends.

games.name: Among the Trolls
games.summary: Among the Trolls is a first-person, survival, action-adventure game where the secret mysteries of Finnish forests are unraveled. Venture deep into the Finnish wilderness to uncover family truths and master the art of survival

games.name: SoulQuest
games.summary: Carve your path through hordes of enemies, defying the gods to seize the power of Morrigan, Goddess of Death, and retrieve the soul of your beloved! SoulQuest combines the evergreen Metroidvania gameplay with the unique Celtic mythology into one, action-packed mixture!

games.name: Luna Abyss
games.summary: Luna Abyss is a single player story driven action-adventure with fluid platforming and bullet hell combat. Follow the journey of Fawkes, a prisoner of Luna caught between a cryptic prophecy and their prison sentence.

games.name: Vultures: Scavengers of Death
games.summary: Face zombies and fearsome monsters in this turn-based survival-horror roguelike as you seek the path to recover a valuable artifact. Unravel the history of Salento Valley and its downfall after a bioterrorist attack led by a secret cult involved with the powerful corporation Eugenesys Tech.

games.name: Regret
games.summary: Regret is a game about dictatorship and trials. It’s a place where you and up to three friends compete in deadly elimination challenges — until only one remains. You’ll find yourself at the game table, where each round decides who stays… and who is gone for good.

games.name: Curse of Resthaven
games.summary: In this single-player narrative roguelite, govern a cursed island as you investigate your niece’s mysterious disappearance. Interrogate, trade, upgrade, and embark upon card-based expeditions to uncover dark secrets – before the next cataclysm strikes.

games.name: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth
games.summary: From the creators of Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley comes a heartwarming new adventure inspired by the beloved Moomin stories by Tove Jansson. This time, join Moomintroll himself on a charming but cold winter journey.

games.name: Call of the Elder Gods
games.summary: Journey to the far corners of the Earth and unearth ancient horrors in this Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure and sequel to 2020’s critically acclaimed Call of the Sea.

games.name: Fishbowl
games.summary: Fishbowl is a slice of life, coming of age story told over a month. Video call loved ones, work from home, sort through puzzles to rediscover childhood memories, do care tasks and get to know yourself better, one day at a time.

games.name: Planet of Lana II: Children of the Leaf
games.summary: Embark on an unforgettable cinematic puzzle journey with Lana and her loyal companion Mui. Whether you're a returning hero or a new adventurer, step into a world where a new, ancient mystery emerges from Novo's hidden depths. But as they scour these depths, a new threat will put their unbreakable bond to the ultimate test, guiding Lana to confront her destiny amidst encroaching shadows.

games.name: Coffee Talk: Tokyo
games.summary: Coffee Talk: Tokyo is the newest instalment of the beloved coffee brewing and heart-to-heart talking simulator. It brings the warmth, heart, and delicious drinks from the previous games to an all-new café in Tokyo where humans and yokai alike share their stories.

games.name: Atmosfar
games.summary: Atmosfar is a sky-high odyssey set on an alien planet of floating islands explored by flying crafts and a mobile airbase as you uncover the fate of your collapsed colony.

games.name: Fallen Tear: The Ascension
games.summary: Fallen Tear: The Ascension is an epic adventure set in a vast magical world where you’ll fight dangerous beasts, defy corrupt gods, and face many challenges, all in an attempt to bring balance back to your world.​Embark on this journey with Hira, a mysterious young boy who seeks the truth about his forgotten past. Along the way, bond with many fully-voiced characters to unlock new skills and abilities that will aid you in your battle through environments that constantly change and react to your choices - all in classic, hand-drawn animation.

games.name: Nocturnal II
games.summary: Nocturnal 2 is an action-adventure game that lets you explore and rekindle the dark depths and towering heights of the city of Ytash.

games.name: Romestead
games.summary: Rome has fallen! Rebuild civilization in this action-adventure survival game for 1-8 players. Fight, build towns and earn favor with the Roman gods! ...or just farm your crops.

games.name: Dark Cards of Candlewood
games.summary: Candlewood is a solo collectible card game with the soul of a classic JRPG. Embark on replayable dungeon runs with deceptively deep, two-choice card combat. Draft items for your backpack, master chain attacks, and even crack a few card packs...then save the world from eternal darkness!

games.name: Dungeons of Dusk
games.summary: Dungeons of DUSK is a classic turn based dungeon crawling RPG that takes place canonically between the episodes of the cult classic FPS. Are you... WORTHY?

games.name: Hand of Fate: Hordes
games.summary: Hand of Fate: Hordes is a dark-fantasy bullet heaven auto-shooter powered by your strategic deckbuilding mastery. Survive the horde, forge your build, and unleash devastating attacks to escape a netherworld beyond the 13th Gate. Thrive in chaos!

games.name: Australia Did It
games.summary: Join our mercenary team: high-risk, low-benefit positions available! Defend cargo trains in this innovative Turn-Based Tower Defense meets Reverse Bullet Hell. Deploy units, merge them to create powerful new types and variations, withstand relentless waves, deliver the goods.

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Wild Tactics
games.summary: The Wildest character-driven tactical strategy game you've ever seen! Build your team and maintain their relationships in the war against organized crime. Uncover the conspiracy in the animal-populated city of Clawville, and find the mastermind behind its downfall!

games.name: TownsFolk
games.summary: Guide your people through ruin—build, survive, and let every choice shape their fate. Rekindle the light of a forgotten world.

games.name: Esports Manager 2026
games.summary: Build and lead your own professional esports organization. Scout players, manage contracts, develop talent, hire staff, grow your brand, and compete for championship titles in a deep and realistic management simulation.

games.name: Order Automatica
games.summary: A dark tactical roguelite where positioning, synergies, and automated battles collide on a tiny 3x3 ritual grid. Like chess with demons.

games.name: Rainbow Legends
games.summary: A territory-control roguelike deck builder where the side with more tiles at round’s end deals damage. Seize ground, place structures, shield your core, and unlock builds with card shapes, factions, and relics

games.name: GridBeat!
games.summary: Dungeons! Danger! Rhythm Action! You just hacked into the biggest corporation in the world and stole an unfeasibly valuable amount of data, but getting in was the easy part. To get back out you’ll need to explore the Mainframe, solve puzzles, battle security programs… and do it all on the beat!

games.name: Airframe Ultra
games.summary:
Welcome to the violent underground world of Ultra Circuit racing.

From the cracked asphalt of San Juaro and the Ysidro edgelands to the hulking megacities of the Texicali Zego zone, Airframe riders from all across the Southlands compete for fame, fortune, and a chance at glory… three feet above or six feet below.

games.name: Awaysis
games.summary: The ultimate dungeon brawler. A revolutionary, physics-fueled throwdown where you’ll jump, slide, and collide on your adventure to restore peace to the Awaysis - an ancient floating relic under attack by forces of great darkness!

games.name: Gunboat God
games.summary: Become the all-powerful Gunboat God in this fluid shoot 'em up. Carve the waves as you stylishly fight hordes of monsters in hundreds of quick-fire missions. Transform your Gunboat and upgrade your weapons, skills and abilities to take on giant, challenging, multi-stage bosses!

games.name: Grim Trials
games.summary: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

games.name: Psychofinger
games.summary: Survive hordes of ghosts in this FPS-roguelite. Become an agent at the Department of Metaphysical Investigations and unveil the mystery of an old church. Choose Aberrant Items that will upgrade your character, fight bosses and unlock new hand gestures.

games.name: Box Knight
games.summary: A funny, silly and irreverent action RPG roguelike. A mix of ‘the Office’ and ‘Lord of the Rings’ with a comic like aesthetic.

games.name: Mexican Ninja
games.summary: A frantic fast-paced beat 'em up roguelike full of crass, brass and incredibly badass. Become THE Mexican Ninja as you slice your way through the streets of Nuevo Tokyo in this retro 2.5D arcade throwback. So what’chu waiting for? Show me your skills pinche ninja!

games.name: Voidling Bound
games.summary: Hatch, evolve, and upgrade powerful space creatures in this action-packed sci-fi 3rd person shooter that reinvents the monster taming genre!

events.name: Convergence Games Showcase 2026
events.description:
Back for its third edition, Convergence unites influencers and indie developers to champion the variety, creativity and passion for play behind every new release.

The two-hour show is hosted by indie-focused streamers who will be discussing, reacting to, and playing unreleased indie and AA games from dozens of studios.

games.name: The Royal Writ
games.summary:
In The Royal Writ, you don't just play cards - you command them on the battlefield. Place your loyal subjects strategically as they advance toward the enemy, dealing damage. But beware: any card that reaches the enemy base before victory is permanently destroyed and removed from your deck for the rest of your run.

Sacrifice isn't just a risk - it's an essential strategy that creates memorable sub-stories with each run. Will you honor the subjects who gave everything for your cause? Every fallen card tells a tale, and their glory lives on in the legacy you build.

Lead an army of diverse warriors with interesting abilities that shape your strategy. Lead an army of adorable yet battle-hardened animals. Your ranks may comprise a frail and wounded flamingo, a short sighted chicken bowman, or even a crafty lizard who cheats death by only losing its tail! From the renegade red ants to the food taster cow, every card in your deck has a personality and purpose.

As they march toward glory or death, their individual stories become part of your kingdom's legacy, and their sacrifices will never be forgotten. You may even come across some peculiar creatures on your journey, like the crazed mantis dentist, the goat tactician or the impatient boar shopkeeper - just don’t ask them where they got their credentials.

games.name: Moros Protocol
games.summary: Your mission is not just to survive, but to face yourself, your past and prepare for "a world full of darkness and monsters". A stylized pixel painted FPS roguelike game, that combines the feel of early action-adventure games, with innovative mechanics.

games.name: Shark Dentist
games.summary: Shark Dentist is a unique horror roguelike where you play as a shark dentist. Your task is to treat the teeth of giant predators in a dark clinic while avoiding their deadly aggression. Balance tactics, luck, and limited resources to heal your patient without losing your own life.

games.name: Holstin
games.summary: A psychological survival horror game set in an eerie, isolated 90s Polish town consumed by an ominous presence. You’ve come looking for answers, but everyone seems possessed by something foul. Explore the festering town, interrogate locals and fight ungodly manifestations to get to the truth.

games.name: Mandrake
games.summary: You are the last of the Mandrakes, a sorcerous line of gardeners. At long last, you’ve returned to your family's abandoned home. Make friends, tend your gardens, and put down roots. Fish, gather and delve in the wilds. Make a place for yourself, and uncover the mysteries your family left behind.

games.name: Royal Vermin
games.summary: Climb, throw, and survive in this chaotic 2-4 player physics-based party game! As your preferred critter caught in a sudden flood, you must fight in a massive trash pile to claim your crown as the true "Royal Vermin."

games.name: Demon Bluff
games.summary: The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?

games.name: Aloft
games.summary: Soar the skies in Aloft, the co-op sandbox survival game set in a world of floating islands. Build any island into a skyship, your home in the clouds. Find lost knowledge, cure the fungal corruption, and brave the hurricane to restore the ecosystem.

games.name: Swan Song
games.summary: Swan Song is a cozy and emotional puzzle game where music guides your journey. Use notes of different shapes and sizes to program a music box and solve each puzzle. Help the swan reach the exit as you uncover a touching story of family, loss and grief.

games.name: Stretchmancer
games.summary: STRETCH THE WORLD, SAVE THE GALAXY! In this smartly funny First Person Puzzler, you are THE STRETCHMANCER. Squash and stretch your environment to solve fiendish puzzles and defeat the Claustro Empire... in an epic voice-acted adventure inspired by 90s Saturday Morning Cartoons!

games.name: Below the Crown
games.summary: Explore the dungeons Below the Crown, in this love letter to Roguelikes, Dungeon Crawlers, and Chess. Prepare for strategy, game-changing spells, psychological tests, and challenges from your fellow players.

games.name: Motorslice
games.summary: Parkour through the ruins of a megastructure, climb massive bosses, and hunt down every construction equipment in this slice of life action-adventure.

games.name: The Gate Must Stand
games.summary: Fend off brutal waves of demonic hordes as a mobile hero amongst your stationary allies. As the city’s last line of defense, recruit followers, unlock upgrades, and synergize skills to hold the line against apocalyptic bosses. Remember: heroes can fall, but the gate must stand.

games.name: Scriptorium: Master of Manuscripts
games.summary: Run your manuscript workshop, receive orders to illustrate medieval books, decorate them any way you like, send them back to clients to get paid, and unlock new jobs, decorations, and items. Welcome to your very own medieval scriptorium!

games.name: Tanuki: Pon's Summer
games.summary: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

games.name: SOS Recordings
games.summary: A lone mountain in northern Japan. Two hikers rescued alive from its silent maw. In their wake, a perfect SOS made of tree trunks, built years before anyone was lost. Based on a real unsolved case. The recordings are waiting.

games.name: Rover's Tale
games.summary: A creature-collecting metroidvania, in a world where dogs live on forever amongst the stars as Space Rovers! Become a LAIKA Rover! Catch & research creatures, then use their abilities to explore a new frontier! Upgrade & customize, as you help your canine companions to unravel an ancient mystery!

games.name: GodsTV
games.summary: Smash for Fame in This Madcap 90’s Killfest. Meet a vibrant cast of characters in this frantic action game with zero chill where Gods feed off of fame... And fame is a weapon.

games.name: HeartLinks: A Puzzle Called Love
games.summary: Solve puzzles with the power of friendship! Each student you befriend gives you a unique item that lets you unlock new areas and explore a wacky anime school! To deliver a confession to your crush, can you clear every obstacle? Can you overcome your feelings? Can you solve the puzzle called love?

games.name: Stonemachia
games.summary: Stonemachia is an adventure in which you can fight and explore a world distorted by the Plague of angels, taking on the role of Zefiro, a pawn capable of transforming into other chess pieces. Venture into the lands of Medhelan and prepare to face armies of angels transformed into statues and objects inspired by Italian art, architecture, and folklore! Fight with a variety of abilities and precise timing in a parry-centric game, where the shield can truly change the outcome of every encounter! Discover the various transformations and their unique abilities to experience a Dantesque epic and uncover the secret of the chess pieces...

games.name: Infinity Sweeper
games.summary: Infinity Sweeper is similar to the classic Minesweeper, but turned into an endless rogue-lite adventure. Navigate through an ever-expanding grid filled with dangerous traps, enemies, and valuable treasures, trying to survive as long as possible.

games.name: Muri: Wildwoods
games.summary: Explore the mysterious creature-filled Wildwoods as a Muri. Find secrets, solve puzzles, befriend creatures, and clean away the corruption. Restore the world's beauty in this cozy adventure!

games.name: Inkblood
games.summary: You're an Inquisitor following a trail of death. A cult is at work, your predecessor has vanished, and the region teeters on the edge of chaos. Find the truth. Uphold the Inquisition. Do not fail.

games.name: Rivals of Aether II
games.summary: Rivals of Aether II is the sequel to the hit indie fighting game, Rivals of Aether. Play as both new and returning elemental fighters in the next generation of platform fighters.

games.name: Last Man Sitting
games.summary: A bunch of dudes sit in an office, all of them wearing black suits and white collared shirts. Everyone sits in the same lime green swivel chairs. For a video game, Last Man Sitting sounds really boring. Add shotguns and ragdoll physics, though, and you have a recipe for the only battle royale game left to make.

games.name: How Many Dudes?
games.summary: How many dudes does it take to beat up 1000 toddlers? A gorilla? Twelve bears and a horse-sized duck? A GOD? Enter the Dude Ranch and find out.

games.name: Mouse: P.I. For Hire
games.summary: Join private investigator Jack Pepper on a guns blazing, jazz-fueled adventure in MOUSE: P.I. For Hire. MOUSE combines the charm of hand-drawn rubber hose animation inspired by the classic cartoons of the 1930’s with the adrenaline and action of an explosive first person shooter.

games.name: Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes
games.summary: In Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes, take command of a fleet escaping the annihilation of the Twelve Colonies. Manage crises on board as you prepare for the next encounter with the Cylon Fleet. Times are dire, and hard choices must be made. Your only hope: rejoin the Battlestar Galactica.

games.name: Turnbound
games.summary: Turnbound is an auto battler, where you manage a hero's inventory to escape a haunted boardgame. Each run is different from the last, with unique upgrades, combos and synergies. Async PvP lets you battle the ghosts of other players at your own pace in this unique new inventory battler. Will your design outlive your ghostly opponents… or join them?

games.name: Worship
games.summary: Blindly serve a dreadful god and lead its cult in a fresh take on the roguelike genre inspired by Pikmin. Put on the robe of a cultist and ready your ceremonial dagger to serve the old god of your choosing in the grim universe of Worship.

games.name: Bloody Hell Hotel
games.summary: In Bloody Hell Hotel, you embody a vampire. You wake up from a coma that has lasted for centuries, only to find your once-grand estate is now in ruins. It's time to turn it into a prosperous hotel! It's no easy task, though, as times are tough and resources are scarce. There are shortages of food, supplies, and workforce. Being a blood-thirsty monster doesn't help with customer satisfaction either. Luckily, underneath the estate lies a crypt and a system of caves. By foraging, farming, crafting, and fighting your way through the monster-infested dungeons, you'll find the resources you need to restore greatness to your mansion and turn it into a thriving hotel business.

games.name: Fae Farm
games.summary: Escape to the fairytale life of your dreams in Fae Farm, a cozy farm-sim RPG for 1-4 players. Craft, cultivate, and decorate to grow your shared homestead—and use spellbinding magic to explore the enchanted island of Azoria.

games.name: Under Par Golf Architect
games.summary: Step into the shoes of a golf architect as you build and manage your own golfing paradise! Sharpen your strategy by designing incredible courses to challenge the most demanding golfers and watch your club flourish as you attract VIP players, hire quirky staff and hold prestigious tournaments.

games.name: Hear Tell of Hauntings
games.summary: Deep in the mountains of wild west-era Montana, former outlaw Adelaide Clancy ventures to the desolate remains of the Wraith estate in this third-person survival horror game.

games.name: Grime II
games.summary: Become the stealer of forms in GRIME II, a surreal action-adventure metroidvania. launch tendrils made of hands to absorb foes and summon molds in their shape, as you explore a bizarre lived-in-world obsessed with art.

games.name: Gimmiko
games.summary: The world is frozen in an endless night, trapped under a shadowblighted moon. Demons from the collective subconcious are leaking into reality. Save the world from the curse of the Jabberwock in this wacky dicebuilding roguelite!

games.name: Drowned Lake
games.summary: Dredge up the secrets hidden beneath Drowned Lake in this horror fishing adventure. Investigate the dark waters to fish out the truth. Catch evidence. Do not get caught yourself.

games.name: Denshattack!
games.summary: Flip, trick and grind your train in a fast-paced, off-the-rails ride through a colourful Japanese dystopia. Outmatch rival gangs, wreck a shady megacorp, and take back the tracks with nothing but skill, speed, and style.

games.name: A Fighter’s Nova: Mindara
games.summary: A Fighter’s Nova: Mindara is a narrative-driven JRPG that fuses character-focused storytelling with the intensity and precision of a true tag-team fighting game.

games.name: Teeto
games.summary: Teeto is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a tiny blob and bunny duo on an extraordinary journey. Absorb objects from the world, harnessing their powers to fight the shadow corruption and help out a cast of crazy characters in an action packed adventure!

games.name: Mayak
games.summary: Hard-sci-fi side-scrolling VN about first contact, love, and a prime-number countdown. You are a young astronomer researching a newly received signal from a distant star. Unravel an alien mystery — and fight to save the one you love.

games.name: Nutmeg!
games.summary: NUTMEG! is a nostalgic football manager game with a deckbuilding twist, set in the '80s and '90s. Relive the days when the tackles were as hard as the mullets were long and football was about football.

games.name: Nomori
games.summary: Nomori is a mind-bending puzzle game where you need to control time and space to journey through a shattered spirit world. Take shortcuts through portals, rotate your perspective, and control the flow of time to move forward, whichever way that is.

games.name: Townseek
games.summary:
Townseek is a relaxing exploration-trading game where you embark on a journey across the world of Explora and discover the lost legacy of Sir Reginald Sharkingston! Discover exotic landmarks, trade with faraway towns, fish, mine, and farm as you complete your journal and make a name for yourself!

The whole world is your sea now, so be sure to see all that it has to offer!

games.name: Burden Street Station
games.summary:
Burden Street Station is a surreal narrative game set in a liminal train station about helping a cast of unusual creatures and spirits move on with their lives.

Collect personality traits through talking and exploration, and wear them to unlock dialogue options and advance their stories.

You will come to know these spirits very well. You will learn a lot about them.

games.name: Emberville
games.summary: Help the citizens of Emberville rebuild their town, as you rescue them from the clutches of wicked forces with the aid of a mysterious and loyal friend. Learn various crafting and combat skills as you explore the treacherous corridors of a massive, ever-changing dungeon.

games.name: Lost Castle 2
games.summary: "Lost Castle 2" is a 2D Beat'em up Rogue-Lite game. Explore abundant treasures and items to enhance yourself, master various weapons to showcase your skills, and challenge powerful monsters to demonstrate your strength. A new adventure is calling for treasure hunters!

games.name: Rhell: Warped Worlds & Troubled Times
games.summary: Create unique spells by combining magical runes to solve puzzles your way. Transform objects, manipulate time, and discover the mysteries of a world where everyone has vanished, leaving only 12 people behind. Every puzzle has multiple solutions - if you can imagine it, you can probably do it.

games.name: Please, Watch the Artwork
games.summary: Night surveillance at the museum but the paintings are alive. A lonely clown roams the canvases. Watch, listen and report any changes. Paranoia-inducing. Weird. Melancholic. Relaxing? No jump scares or monsters, but the game can feel oppressive at times.

games.name: Everything Is Crab
games.summary: The Animal Evolution roguelite. Hunt, Flee, Scavenge & Thrive in a living ecosystem. Choose from over 100 mutations to evolve your creature in countless ways with every run. Adapt to survive the natural curve in order to beat carcinisation... or get Darwin'd trying!

games.name: Wax Heads
games.summary: A cosy-punk slice-of-life narrative sim about managing a struggling record store. Chat to quirky customers with unique tastes, explore a handcrafted record collection, fall in love with bands (and their drama!), or just slack off with your colleagues – all to restore the groove!

games.name: Iter-8
games.summary: Welcome to the surface, ITER employee #8. Mine the Pillar, upgrade your tools, defend your base, reach the top... or die miserably. Each expendable worker pushes the mission forward - one glorious, replaceable iteration at a time.

games.name: Gunboat God
games.summary: Become the all-powerful Gunboat God in this fluid shoot 'em up. Carve the waves as you stylishly fight hordes of monsters in hundreds of quick-fire missions. Transform your Gunboat and upgrade your weapons, skills and abilities to take on giant, challenging, multi-stage bosses!

games.name: Echoes of Mora
games.summary: Embark on a mysterious journey, filled with intriguing interactions and meaningful encounters, as you explore a sunken village and travel through time to help Mora find her lost brother. Playable in VR and non-VR on PC.

games.name: Snacktorio
games.summary: Snacktorio is a factory-cooking simulator where you must satisfy the appetites of unspeakable horrors... with food! Build and manage sprawling networks of machines & pipes to mass produce delicious meals that can satiate the endless hunger of the beasts that are invading your home. Order Up!

games.name: Rune Dice
games.summary: Throw dice, create explosive chain reactions, and defeat waves of enemies in Rune Dice! Collect ancient runes with diverse abilities, add synergies between relics, heroes, and special dice. All combined, this will give you an excellent experience in our roguelike deckbuilder.

games.name: Bonnie Bear Saves Frogtime
games.summary: Bonnie Bear Saves Frogtime is a frog-obsessed comedy adventure featuring tactical frog battles, bizarre quests, and the mother of all frogs: the motherfrogger.

games.name: Gecko Gods
games.summary: Explore a mysterious island as a tiny lizard. Complete ancient puzzles, effortlessly climb cliffs, and eat bugs as you make your way across an island civilization lost to time.

games.name: A Storied Life: Tabitha
games.summary: A wholesome narrative puzzle game about the objects we leave behind and the stories they tell. Complete a loved one's damaged memoirs by exploring their home and packing away their things.

games.name: Modulus: Factory Automation
games.summary: Build, automate, & optimize elegant production lines, in a factory made from modules you create. Whether you’re solving intricate logistics puzzles or designing aesthetically pleasing factories, Modulus is built for creative expression. Your solutions, like your factories, are uniquely your own.

games.name: Altered Alma
games.summary: Altered Alma combines the beloved classic Metroidvania formula with RPG elements, dating sim features, a slick pixel-art presentation, and a gripping story. Whether you want to beat up bad guys, find love, or just explore the beautiful cityscape, Neo-Barcelona awaits!

games.name: Far Far West
games.summary: Yee-haw, Cowboys! Team up in this chaotic 4-player co-op shooter. Journey to the Far Far West to blast monsters, sling spells, complete missions, and collect bounties. Work as a team to get in, get paid and get out (mostly) alive.

games.name: Prime Monster
games.summary: A card-based political roguelike about surviving in a parliament of literal monsters. Fight for votes, break rules, weather scandals and force through absurd laws to keep the top job in this democratic dystopia of truly monstrous proportions.

games.name: Aphelion
games.summary: Stranded on a frozen planet, astronaut Ariane must brave rugged landscapes and shifting realities to rescue her wounded partner, Thomas. This action-packed sci-fi adventure blends exploration, traversal, and tense stealth gameplay.

events.name: Black Voices in Gaming: Black History Month Showcase 2026
events.description: Celebrate with #BViG as we spotlight Black developers and creators, featuring interviews with the teams behind Relooted, Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game, Erased, and Beatdown City Survivors.

games.name: Duppy Detective Tashia
games.summary: Help Tashia unravel the case of a heinous murder and find her cell phone in this point & click, mystery adventure based on Caribbean folklore!

games.name: Aground
games.summary: As one of the last human survivors, you find yourself stranded on an uninhabited island. With a few other victims of the crash, can you craft, mine, and build your way to survival?

games.name: Space Warlord Baby Trading Simulator
games.summary: Buy low, sell high, and short an entire universe of babies in this arcade stock market sim set in the world of Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator.

games.name: Aerial_Knight's DropShot
games.summary: Aerial_Knight’s Dropshot is a high-speed, stylized FPS / Race where you play as Smoke Wallace. As a kid, he was bitten by a radioactive dragon, turning his skin purple and giving him the power to fire bullets from his fingertips. Thrown into deadly sky battles for revenge, you race rivals, fight dragons, move fast, shoot smart, and look cool when you land.

games.name: Erased
games.summary: "Erased" is an action-packed psychological whirlwind in a post-apocalyptic sci-fi world. Explore an open-world with fast combat, rail grinding, parkour, pets, and graffiti. Embrace hip hop, Afro-beats, and K-pop while following a dream based lore in single player mode or face others in online PVP.

games.name: Deadly Metropolis
games.summary: Deadly Metropolis is an intense, fast paced beat 'em up that takes the genre to brutal new heights. The deadliest era is here, a battle rages in the depths of Neo Babylos! Are you ready?!

games.name: Relooted
games.summary: Reclaim real African artifacts from Western museums in this Africanfuturist heist game. Recruit crew members, plan escape routes, acquire the precious cargo, and bounce out of the joint as fast as you can.

games.name: Clock Out At 2
games.summary: Clock Out at 2 is a roguelite visual novel in which you have to survive inside the corporate machine known as the "workplace". Eat fast food. Drink lots of espressos. Experience microaggressions. Pray they don't fire you.

games.name: Oh!Ware
games.summary: Sow the seeds of victory, forge alliances, and carve your own destiny. A spiritual Mancala roguelike where every marble shapes the board and your fate. Every pit is a choice and every marble, a desperate prayer.

games.name: Beatdown City Survivors
games.summary: Punch a car so hard it EXPLODES! Dash through flaming gas to create a fire trail burning everything. Destroy a hydrant to douse out the fire. Beatdown City Survivors is an immersive sandbox meets survive-em-up with dynamic environments & outrageous lite weapon crafting & team building.

games.name: Prism
games.summary: Prisim is an upcoming games from Creative AF Games and is a coming of age story inspired by black girlhood filled with 90's nostalgia.

games.name: Bugged Out
games.summary: Bugged Out is a fast paced indie platformer. Run, jump, and blast your way through a mutant-infested sewer system.

games.name: A Baby CEO?!
games.summary: A struggling book company has decided to hire you, a baby, to be the new CEO? All you need to do is manage the budget, keep the company brand strong and make the employees happy. You can't talk? No problem! Give a thumbs up or down and try your best.

games.name: VectaGuard
games.summary: Arcade-inspired shmup action where neon vector caverns explode with modern visuals, dynamic music, weapon upgrades and intense score chasing.

games.name: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game
games.summary: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game is a fast-paced 1v1 fighter where you battle as your favorite characters from the Avatar franchise. Featuring hand-drawn 2D animation true to the series’ roots, proprietary rollback netcode, and full cross-play for smooth, competitive gameplay.

games.name: On the Peril of Parrots
games.summary: Explore the line between machine and personhood, in this Puzzle Narrative experience. Take on the role of an AI, created by the world renowned, Dr. G. Step through a battery of cognition tests and prove your intelligence, sentience and ultimately your humanity.

games.name: SantaCorps 4
games.summary:
Armed with their merry mysticism, magical machines, and maybe a little bit of luck, it's up to YOU to make a miracle this holiday season...and beyond!

Don the fabled white and red solo or with up to 3 friends as you dash your way through this fast-paced holiday frenzy!

games.name: SantaCorps: Snow Patrol
games.summary: Don the parka and shovel of the SantaCorps' Snow Patrol elf unit in this accessible arcade puzzle frenzy!

games.name: Virtuoso Skins Game
games.summary: What the #$@& is a Skins Game?! High stakes, big bet golf gamblin' with your friends...IN SPACE! Fly out with 3 of your friends online to a futuristic world of high-rolling hi-jinx and compete in off-wall golf tournaments for bragging rights and cold hard cash in Virtuoso Skins Game!

events.name: Quebec Games Celebration Showcase 2026
events.description: For the first time ever, the annual Quebec Games Celebration Steam sale, organized by Montreal incubator/accelerator Indie Asylum in partnership with La Guilde du Jeu Vidéo du Québec, is getting its own dedicated showcase! Players can tune in to watch world premieres, gameplay reveals, and other exciting surprises from 30 Quebec-based studios, featuring industry veterans and the next generation of creators, creating co-op hack & slash games, action roguelikes, survival sandbox games and more.

games.name: A Fighter’s Nova: Mindara
games.summary: A Fighter’s Nova: Mindara is a narrative-driven JRPG that fuses character-focused storytelling with the intensity and precision of a true tag-team fighting game.

games.name: Don't Kill Them All
games.summary: Don't Kill Them All is a turn-based strategy game with base-building, where you play the Orcs, the most feared creatures of the land. In the midst of an economic crisis, your Warlord is prepared to do whatever it takes to bring glory to the clan. Something has to change, and fast!

games.name: Surfpunk
games.summary: Become a wave-shredding Raider in this intense, PvE co-op extraction ARPG. Hop on your Rushboard, loot ancient artifacts, hack n’ slash through hordes of monsters and escape in style. Surf, Shred, Scavenge, Repeat!

games.name: Croak
games.summary: Croak is a nimble -and challenging- precision platformer featuring an innovative grapple mechanic. Use the prince’s tongue to dash and bounce around through hundreds of hand-crafted rooms. Manipulate the environment as you traverse distinct biomes, each with unique gameplay mechanics and bosses.

games.name: Happy Bastards
games.summary: Happy Bastards is an open-world tactical RPG with turn-based combat in which you assemble a squad of unruly mercenaries to explore, fight, and loot. Let the bastards do the dirty work while you give the orders, reap the rewards, and enjoy the high life. Who needs XP when you're famous?

games.name: Echoes of Mystralia
games.summary: Mages of Mystralia's award-winning spellcrafting system enters a new era. Free Mystralia from the Shadows of the Past in this action-RPG roguelite. Create an infinite variety of spells to save the Memory of the World.

games.name: Tears of Metal
games.summary: Tears of Metal is a medieval hack-and-slash co-op roguelike. Carve through hordes of enemies to reclaim your island with the help of your formidable Scottish battalion. As you advance deeper into the trenches, uncover more about the mysterious Dragon Meteor and the treacherous enemy invasion.

games.name: Isles of Krom
games.summary: Isles of Krom is a top-down action roguelike that combines the visceral and demanding combat of a Souls-like games with the deep character-building and progression systems of the best roguelikes.

games.name: Royal Vermin
games.summary: Climb, throw, and survive in this chaotic 2-4 player physics-based party game! As your preferred critter caught in a sudden flood, you must fight in a massive trash pile to claim your crown as the true "Royal Vermin."

games.name: Lost & Found: A This Bed We Made Story
games.summary: Lost & Found is a standalone, short story game taking place aboard a 1960s transatlantic ship. Play as Sophie Roy in her new job as a stewardess, and help solve a curious series of thefts in this narrative-driven mystery set after the events of This Bed We Made.

games.name: Lunchbreak Tactics
games.summary: Lunchbreak Tactics is a strategic auto-battler card game set in a chaotic supermarket backstore. Draft cards, min-max your squad, build ridiculous synergies, then battle players asynchronously. Play your way to climb the ranks with quick runs, no timer, limitless combos, and endless replay.

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Puppy Love
games.summary: The 21st free update for Disney Dreamlight Valley brings new content inspired by Disney's Lady and the Tramp - including a new Realm and both titular dogs as Villagers. It also included group mode furniture editing, the end of the Magical Mementos' storyline and the Paw-fect Romance Star Path.

games.name: Rainbow Billy: The Book of Fears
games.summary: Billy is back for an investigative adventure in Summer camp. Unravel mysterious events in this colorful journey as campers’ worries manifest as Fearlings. Explore the camp, investigate its secrets, and confront those fears through clever puzzles.

games.name: Clerks & Quirks
games.summary: Run a magical shop where your appliances are alive, emotional, and doing their best to ruin your day. Win them over ♡♡♡ to unlock powerful bonuses while you craft items, serve demanding customers, and scramble through the weekly rush in this co-op roguelite, where every shift put you under pressure.

games.name: Hillthorn
games.summary: A disappearance in a secluded mountain. A village hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Hillthorn's investigation system encourages you to use logic and imagination. Combine actions, clues and characters to uncover the mystery.

games.name: Silent Planet: Elegy of a Dying World
games.summary: Silent Planet is an exploration-focused, dark action side-scroller rooted in Cosmic horror. Explore the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a dead civilization.

games.name: Join Us
games.summary: Lead a cult and prepare for the end of the world in Join Us, the upcoming co-op, open-world survival experience. Ride bears, build up your perfect base, and prepare for the apocalypse.

games.name: Outward 2
games.summary: Outward 2 is a challenging action RPG with survival elements focusing on a believable and relatable experience. There is no hand holding, no leveled encounters, no divine gift making you tower over your enemies. Eat your meal, check your map, grab your backpack: a fulfilling adventure awaits.

games.name: Dicevaders
games.summary: Build an army of alien invaders to invade the Earth in DiceVaders, the roguelike dice game set in the same universe as StarVaders!

games.name: The Melty Way
games.summary: You move, you melt. Play as a brave size-shifting slime in this colorful precision puzzle-platformer, dashing through handcrafted puzzles and perilous traps on your journey in The Melty Way.

games.name: Chef of Sherwood
games.summary: “It’s like Cooking-Mama meets the Monty Pythons in a Visual Novel!” Cook for your life as the new royal chef of Prince John Lackland and his unhinged family. Befriend Robin Hood and his rebels to get ingredients, prepare amazing meals and manage the pantry in this narrative-driven cooking game.

games.name: Scopecreep
games.summary: A whispering flame craves souls. With each offering, your resolve strengthens. Fight spirits, collect their essences, and feed a hunger that may never subside in this short active incremental.

games.name: Pirate Chips
games.summary: Pirate Chips is a chaotic multiplayer game where you and your spudmates construct a boatato and fight other pirates in legendary battles.

games.name: 33 Immortals
games.summary: 33 Immortals is a co-op action-roguelike for 33 players. Play a damned soul, and rebel against God’s final judgment. Pick-up and raid, cooperate to survive hordes of monsters, defeat massive bosses, and face the wrath of God in a fight for your eternal life.

games.name: Sisters of Solitude
games.summary: Explore a haunted convent with your EMF detector, tape recorder, and camera. Uncover the fate of four ghostly sisters and the mystery behind the murder they commited. Every room hides a clue, every shadow a warning, and the truth waits for those who dare to seek it.

games.name: Voidling Bound
games.summary: Hatch, evolve, and upgrade powerful space creatures in this action-packed sci-fi 3rd person shooter that reinvents the monster taming genre!

games.name: Arctic Drive
games.summary: First-person survival road trip in a procedurally generated frozen wasteland. Drive and upgrade your off-road vehicle alone or with up to 3 friends, scavenge for fuel, food, and parts, and survive hunger, thirst, and sub-zero temperatures.

games.name: The Caribou Trail
games.summary: The WWI story where your goal isn't to kill, but to survive. In the still trenches, three soldiers learn the harsh truth of war: reckless missions, digging trenches, collecting dog tags and ghostly whispers in the dark. Home before the leaves fall, they thought.

games.name: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon
games.summary: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon is a bike-racing party game where you and your friends build the course together. Add obstacles and dangerous traps, take the lead with power-ups, and race to the finish!

games.name: Aloft
games.summary: Soar the skies in Aloft, the co-op sandbox survival game set in a world of floating islands. Build any island into a skyship, your home in the clouds. Find lost knowledge, cure the fungal corruption, and brave the hurricane to restore the ecosystem.

events.name: Indie Pearls Awards 2025
events.description: The third edition of Indie Pearls. The Awards celebrating the independent developers recognizing the best indie games of the last year and awarding them in six categories: Best Art Direction, Best Music, Best Narrative, Best Design, Audience Award and Best Indie Game.

games.name: If Red Then Stop
games.summary: Program traffic lights, barriers, and more to solve your city’s traffic problems! Improve your coding skills by learning to control time-dependent processes with realistic state machines.

games.name: Goblin Sushi
games.summary: In this rogue-like restaurant-action-sim, you play as a goblin that has the dream of becoming a sushi chef. Upgrade the restaurant, the menu and your ingredients to feed your fellow goblins the best and most expensive sushi any goblin can find in the cave!

games.name: Deadliest Pigeon
games.summary: Equip weapons against physics-based enemies, swing through chaos with grappling hook and destroy everything in your path to avenge the little chick!

games.name: You Know The Drill
games.summary: You Know The Drill is a relaxing incremental mining game about digging underground to harvest ores. Collect resources, sell them, and upgrade your drill to go even deeper!

games.name: The Whisker Watch
games.summary: Play as your cat(s) in a co-op roguelike of night prowls, day naps, and endless mischief! Claw at haunted appliances, fight chthonic horrors, and upgrade your cozy mansion! Customize your meow, accessories, and fur; Pet your human for perks!

games.name: Case Solved: The London Files
games.summary: A cozy noir puzzle game where you must investigate the dark underbelly of London. Murders have taken place, witness statements conflict and alibis aren’t adding up. Everyone has a motive, only logic reveals the truth.

games.name: Wild City
games.summary: Shape your urban ecosystem in Wild City, a unique roguelike deckbuilder! Rule a harmonious society or indulge in the citizens' primal instincts, as you shape your own concrete jungle!

games.name: Pakinpaks
games.summary: A cozy puzzle game where you go on a journey all around the world packing and organizing all sorts of travel gear. Fulfill your client's request in any way you wish and — as long as everything fits — prepare the neatest bags that you can!

games.name: Anemorie
games.summary: Anemorie is a visually rich, story-driven adventure game that invites players to step into the life of Anna, a young woman on a journey of self-discovery, love, and resilience.

games.name: Cat Isle
games.summary:
Cat Isle is a cozy pixel art management game inspired by Japan’s famous Cat Islands. It blends light management elements with a strong focus on atmosphere and player expression. While managing different types of shop supplies and understanding cat preferences is part of the experience, the game centers more on relaxing gameplay, fishing, interacting with cats, decorating buildings, and simply observing the world you create.

Players can unlock decorations through a Gashapon machine and customize shops and surroundings to shape the island’s look and feel. As you build and decorate, the island slowly transforms into a cozy space full of cute cats.

games.name: Dragon Dinner
games.summary: Cute but chaotic restaurant simulator where you play as a dragon waiter in a fast-paced dining rush. Set tables, serve hungry dragons, deliver the right dishes, and keep the place clean! After each day, customize the layout of the restaurant and learn new abilities to improve.

games.name: Zero Stress King: Idle Defense
games.summary: A short relaxing incremental game disguised as a tower defense, but enemies can’t reach your walls. Thanks to lava.

games.name: Jelly Bubble
games.summary:
Stick together, bounce apart.
Grab soap, mess with your friends.A cute but chaotic multiplayer party game where jelly creatures compete, collide, and betray each other. Play with up to 6 players online or 4 players locally, and jump into wild matches—or build your own with the map editor.

games.name: Truth Scrapper
games.summary: You have a case to solve, your memories reset each day, and two mysterious guides are vying for your attention– who will you decide to remember, and who will you decide to push aside…?

games.name: Garden Gnome Beatmaker
games.summary: Gnome survivor meets musical roguelike. Compose your killer track. Hit play and watch the frogs burn. Buy samples and trinkets from the shop & repeat.

games.name: The Bench
games.summary: Relax on a park bench, find hidden objects, solve quirky puzzles, and fend off pesky pigeons in this charming, interactive adventure. Enjoy beautifully stylized, colorful levels keeping you entertained!

games.name: Hope in the City
games.summary: 17-year-old Hope Song returns home from school to find her parents missing. Use Hope’s observant eye as an artist to investigate, piece together clues, and uncover a dark world beneath the surface of her peaceful life in this non-linear narrative mystery game.

games.name: Mirai #167
games.summary: MIRAI #167 is a 2D pixel-art runner where you control two characters at once, rewinding time and jumping through portals. Embark on a frantic adventure to save humanity in a world where AI surpasses human control - upgrade your characters, break records and rewrite history before it’s too late!

games.name: Arms of God
games.summary: Gear up for a battle through hell in this next-gen autoshooter with Doom-inspired gore vibes, metal music, roguelite mechanics, and a satisfying combat feel. Wield five weapons at once, upgrade and merge them to forge indestructible builds, and bring divine justice to a world on the brink of chaos.

games.name: BlueLine
games.summary: A visual narrative experience about a Bangkok millennial, Blue, balancing authenticity and social media pressures in a digital age. Engage in mindful activities, engaging conversations, as well as navigate the tension between authenticity and the need to impress.

games.name: K-Pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut
games.summary: A love letter to the thrilling world of K-pop! In this life simulator, you're the manager responsible for scouting talent, organising schedules, creating budgets, planning social media, choosing music, and styling your idols. Your goal? To debut the next big K-pop idol group!

games.name: Mayak
games.summary: Hard-sci-fi side-scrolling VN about first contact, love, and a prime-number countdown. You are a young astronomer researching a newly received signal from a distant star. Unravel an alien mystery — and fight to save the one you love.

games.name: Grex
games.summary: Play as a Swarm in GREX, a fast-paced incremental auto-shooter. Our body is our weapon. We die to evolve. We evolve to become The Monolith. WE ARE ONE. WE INVADE. THEY DIE.

games.name: Anomalistic Revolution
games.summary: You stand before a pit at the city's heart, then your gaze drifts to a deeper void, one you fear even more. Wield your invention to unravel mysteries, reclaim lost memories, strengthen your skills, and battle nightmare-born horrors in this multi-ending RPG.

games.name: Quiet Express: Cabin 909
games.summary: “Do you know anything about Cabin 909?” You're a passenger on a transcontinental train. Looking for a room that's nowhere to find: Cabin 909.

games.name: Lucid Falls
games.summary: Manipulate gravity, space and time, and survive terrifying nightmares in a deeply atmospheric lucid dream. Facing terrifying creatures, and solving challenges that bend reality, every moment reveals more of the dark truth behind Lucid Falls.

games.name: Besmirch
games.summary: The town of Besmirch starves. Stave off the hunger as the latest farmhand in this survival horror farming sim, earning the trust of paranoid townsfolk under the thumb of the corrupt Baron. Tend to both your farm and the town while avoiding unholy terrors that come in the night.

games.name: Pieced Together
games.summary: Pieced Together is a cozy scrapbooking game that takes you on a heartfelt journey about friendship and getting older. Sort items, solve gentle puzzles, and decorate the scrapbook as you uncover the story piece by piece.
