games.summary: Vholume is a melancholic first-person parkour adventure set in a dystopian brutalist city where bureaucracy turns a simple task into an odyssey.

games.name: Titanium Court
games.summary: A surreal strategy game for clowns and criminals.

games.name: Soul Injector Commando
games.summary: FPS where you are tasked by God to give souls to the wealthiest people on Earth, helping them get normal jobs and be productive members of society.

games.name: Erulean Angel: Fantasy Commander
games.summary: Set out on a grand adventure of exploration, strategy, and mystery in Erulean Angel: Fantasy Commander. Immerse yourself in a handmade world as you craft armies to outwit your opponents in fully simulated autobattler combat.

events.name: Future Games Show: Spring Showcase 2026
events.description:
The Future Games Show Spring Showcase returns on Thursday, March 12, 2026. Viewers can expect exclusive trailers and developer deep dives on coveted AAA blockbusters and trailblazing indie games, curated by in-house experts.

This year’s Spring Showcase will arrive during the GDC Festival of Gaming broadcast schedule and will be immediately followed by FGS Live From, where the FGS editorial team will regale viewers with the most exciting games on the GDC show floor, as well as debuting more world premiere trailers and insightful developer interviews.

Last year’s events provided updates on hotly-anticipated games like Resident Evil: Requiem, Phantom Blade Zero, and The Expanse: Osiris Reborn — so it’s worth setting a reminder to tune in so you can stay in the know and, hopefully, discover something new.

games.name: Cordura
games.summary: Cordura is a 4-player online co-op psychological horror where sanity is your most scarce resource. Venture together into shifting procedural Victorian labyrinths where the environment is never the same. Lose your sanity and the Night will mimic your team to feed your paranoia. Extract and survive.

games.name: Stupid Never Dies
games.summary:
Set in a monster-ruled otherworldly dungeon, Stupid Never Dies puts you in control of Davy, a timid zombie living at the very bottom of monster society. Defeat enemies, level up, and collect strange items to grow stronger on your quest to bring Julia, a frozen human girl, back to life.

Steal enemy abilities, customize your undead body with bizarre upgrades, and experience fast-paced combat packed with innovation.

games.name: The 7th Guest Remake
games.summary: The iconic game The 7th Guest has been brought back to life with modern technology, delivering an atmospheric story like no other. Explore a foreboding mansion, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover its dark secrets. The 7th Guest is the ultimate mystery adventure, reimagined for modern platforms.

games.name: Dave the Diver: In the Jungle
games.summary: Dave the Diver: In the Jungle is a DLC expansion for Dave the Diver. It introduces a new jungle-themed environment where players can explore for exotic resources and face additional challenges, all while continuing to balance underwater exploration with restaurant management.

games.name: Last Flag
games.summary: Hide your flag. Find the enemy flag. Run it back, then defend for a minute to win it. Welcome to Last Flag: a fast-paced 5v5 shooter with showstopping contestants, set in a televised competition where strategy, teamwork, and chaos blend in the ultimate game of Capture the Flag.

games.name: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight
games.summary: Rise as the Dark Knight and experience the essential Batman story in a bold, action-packed adventure with hard-hitting combat, an open-world Gotham City, and the signature LEGO charm that fans know and love.

games.name: Project Shadowglass
games.summary: A stealth-focused immersive sim set within a dark fantasy kingdom. Plan daring heists, infiltrate forbidden locales, and escape with priceless artifacts. Features revolutionary 3D pixel art graphics and lasting consequences where every action could leave a trail back to you.

games.name: Ready or Not: Boiling Point
games.summary: The relentlessly debased city of Los Sueños faces an existential crisis when a subversive terror attack severs any remaining faith in what's become an ineffective and overwhelmingly militarized city government.

games.name: Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns
games.summary: The legendary medieval strategy adventure has returned - enhanced for a new generation of knights. Conquer provinces, raise armies, storm castles, and influence the balance of power through bold strategy and action moments.

games.name: Unboxing Mr. Coo
games.summary: Mr Coo gets into a new conundrum, this time through the not-so-simple act of opening a gift box. A puzzle and narrative game without words, where you click your way through a mesmerizing toy.

games.name: Adorable Adventures
games.summary: Play as Boris, a curious baby boar who must learn how to use his nose to reunite with his family after a forest fire. Explore beautiful landscapes, track scents, and uncover secrets as you slowly reconnect with nature in this cozy animal adventure.

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core
games.summary: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: ROGUE CORE is a 1-4 player co-op FPS roguelite featuring 100% destructible environments and procedurally-generated caves. Join a team of dwarven Reclaimers tasked with reestablishing control over lost deep mining operations on Hoxxes IV.

games.name: Calx
games.summary: Calx is an atmospheric 3D action adventure inspired by visionary sci-fi art. Explore planet Syro - vast landscapes filled with crystal structures and ancient technology. Find out what the WARP did to the Quoths civilization. The environment guides you, revealing secrets through exploration.

games.name: Shadowstone
games.summary: Shadowstone is a 1-4 player tactics game where players must master strategic positioning and powerful hero synergies to survive against the unrelenting horrors of the Sunderlands.

games.name: 1348: Ex Voto
games.summary: Journey through a tumultuous Medieval Italy as Aeta, a young knight errant who sets off on a brutal quest to find and save her closest one. 1348 Ex Voto is a cinematic action-adventure game inspired by chivalric tales.

games.name: Directive 8020
games.summary: Earth is dying and humanity is running out of time. 12 light years from home, Tau Ceti f offers a small sliver of hope. When the colony ship Cassiopeia crash lands on the planet, its crew soon realize they are far from being alone. In space, death takes many forms.

games.name: Clean Up Earth
games.summary:
Clean Up Earth is a relaxing first-person cleaning simulator. Clean Up Earth is the first original IP from Magic Pockets studio, based in France. Clean Up Earth will be available on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store) in Q1 2026, with the console launch dates to be confirmed following the Kickstarter campaign.

Clean Up Earth invites players to restore polluted environments to their natural beauty and unwind, solo or with friends. Using the Terra Cleaner, a futuristic, customisable cleaning tool, they rejuvenate landscapes inspired by the real world, from serene mountain ranges to tropical beaches. As they progress, they unlock new modules and upgrades to take on increasingly complex challenges. The Terra Cleaner can also be used to repair damaged equipment and structures, enabling players to use them to access new zones.

The game supports solo play and cooperative multiplayer, with maps for 2 to 8 players depending on their size, as well as larger maps that accommodate 30+ players.

games.name: Blight: Survival
games.summary: Blight: Survival is an upcoming medieval, co-operative, action horror game set in an alternate 14th century powered by Unreal Engine 5.

games.name: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand
games.summary: Inherit a crumbling English hotel and restore it by day—while battling ghosts by night. With a sardonic cat, a talking power tool, and a twisting supernatural plot, this is a musical mystery unlike any other. Will you be able to hold it together while everything around you falls apart?

games.name: Silver Pines
games.summary: Silver Pines is a Survival Horror set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

games.name: Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes
games.summary: Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes is a dark atmospheric adventurepuzzle game where you embody Dark Six, a mysterious figure with the shape of a little girl. Navigate in a disturbing world, solve intricate puzzles, and escape terrifying giant foes in a desperate search to become whole again.

games.name: AstroTechs
games.summary: You're an engineer with a gun and a wrench, and you're the only thing keeping this ship alive. AstroTechs is a tactical action game where you fight corrupted machines, weaponize ship systems, and repair the damage — all under fire.

games.name: Damon and Baby
games.summary: An exciting new style of action adventure fusing shooting action with exploration.

games.name: Anarchy Road
games.summary: Fast Speeds, Big Explosions, even Bigger Bosses and action throughout! Anarchy Road is a Post-Apocalyptic action driving game where our 4 heroes must race against the clock, battle bosses, while blasting enemies and dodging traps in order to survive to the explosive end!

games.name: ReVamp
games.summary: Rule as Dracula in this castle-defense roguelite. Shape your fortress room by room, command an army of monsters, and step into battle yourself to protect your throne from relentless mortal invaders. A war waged for eternity, for the love you couldn’t save.

games.name: Demon Lord: Just a Block
games.summary: Reborn as a Demon Lord, seek revenge on the heroes! This fantasy roguelite game features grid-based combat controlled using four directional inputs. The world only moves when you do: you attack when you collide with enemies. Plan your moves step by step or play swiftly with dodges and parries!

games.name: Hello Sunshine
games.summary: A survival mystery set in the ruins of a corporate empire. Walk in the shadow of a giant robot during the sweltering days; stay close to keep warm during the cold nights. Scavenge, craft, upgrade — and piece together the broken puzzle of a world ruled by machines that refuse to shut down.

games.name: We Gotta Go
games.summary:
We Gotta Go is a first person co-op horror game where you and your friends have to reach the only bathroom in a haunted mansion before your bowels betray you.

The mansion won’t make it easy: its many passages are blocked, locked, hidden, and haunted... can your team survive all the way to the porcelain promised land?

games.name: Atmosfar
games.summary: Atmosfar is a sky-high odyssey set on an alien planet of floating islands explored by flying crafts and a mobile airbase as you uncover the fate of your collapsed colony.

games.name: Papa Needs a Headshot
games.summary: Papa Needs a Headshot is a brutal western-steampunk FPS soaked in kin blood. Rip through flesh and bend the battlefield with your cursed metal arm. Use every bullet wisely to slaughter freaks and abominations on your warpath. Keep enduring only to put a bullet in the skull of the man who made you.

games.name: Will: Follow the Light
games.summary: Dive into a realistic, single-player, first-person journey through the harsh northern latitudes as you sail endless waters, searching for a way back to your loved ones. Will you follow the light?

games.name: Outbound
games.summary: Explore a colorful world and build your own cozy home on wheels. Craft workstations, and source energy from the sun, wind, or water. Upgrade and customize your vehicle, grow crops, and live sustainably off-grid with up to 4 players.

games.name: The Dungeon Experience
games.summary: Put your real world responsibilities on hold with a visit to The Dungeon Experience, a fantasy theme park phenomenon. Adventure awaits, for anyone and everyone! If you've already visited, please come back, we fixed that smell.

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Heavy Duty
games.summary: The mines are about to get a whole lot louder.

games.name: Aphelion
games.summary: Stranded on a frozen planet, astronaut Ariane must brave rugged landscapes and shifting realities to rescue her wounded partner, Thomas. This action-packed sci-fi adventure blends exploration, traversal, and tense stealth gameplay.

games.name: Gate Guard Simulator
games.summary: Step into the boots of the castle guard. Inspect seals, expose smugglers and reveal witches. You decide who enters and who’s turned away. Will you uphold the law, or break it for your own gain?

games.name: Life is Strange: Reunion
games.summary: Life is Strange: Reunion is the thrilling finale to the Max and Chloe saga, a chapter that brings their book to a close. This is a full circle moment for both developers and fans—one that builds on everything that has come before. And even as the game delivers a reunion long-thought impossible, it also caps off our time at Caledon University in a literal blaze of glory.

games.name: Rover's Tale
games.summary: A creature-collecting metroidvania, in a world where dogs live on forever amongst the stars as Space Rovers! Become a LAIKA Rover! Catch & research creatures, then use their abilities to explore a new frontier! Upgrade & customize, as you help your canine companions to unravel an ancient mystery!

games.name: Deep Dish Dungeon
games.summary: Co-op online multiplayer game where you must unite to survive the treacherous depths of a mysterious dungeon, navigate puzzling passageways and gather resources to improve your camping site. Encounter enemies with diverse behaviors, discover coveted treasures, and unravel enigmas within its depths.

games.name: Shelf Heroes
games.summary: Blast rogue toys with wacky weapons in this fast-paced Roguelite FPS! Mix & match toy parts to assemble your Shelf Hero, discover powerful perk combos, and explore a giant House. Play solo or with friends in 3-player co-op!

games.name: Quite a Ride
games.summary: Pedal through the fog, but never look back.Trapped in a constantly shifting horror, you must ride, conserve your phone's battery, and decode cryptic messages to escape. Explore, survive, uncover the truth.

games.name: Herdles
games.summary:
In Herdles, you play a magical dog on a mission to restore balance to a fracturing world. Zoom through four regions of a vibrant landscape, using physics-based powers to venture further and creatively solve challenges, uncovering secrets using your superpowered bark.

Along the way, you’ll save corrupted creatures called ‘Herdles’. Each Herdle comes with new abilities – bounce, glide, break through walls, swim up waterfalls, and more. Playful experimentation is key! Herdles offers deep accessibility and customization options that you can tailor to suit your comfort, needs and playstyle.

games.name: Killing Floor III: Operation Deep Freeze
Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection
games.summary: Twin Rathalos, born in a twist of fate. Two centuries after a conflict that divided neighboring kingdoms, the drums of war are reignited as twin Rathalos—long thought extinct—hatch from a single egg: an omen of destruction. Is there hope beyond the northern border?

games.name: SlashZero
games.summary: SlashZero is a 3D roguelike action platformer. As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world, use combat skills and strategies to piece together the truth, and take down the Lord of the Void! Is what you see the truth?

games.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
games.summary: A kidnapping, a desperate mother, and a shadow from the past. The final chapter of the trilogy reveals every secret behind the series most unsettling icon: the Red Nun.

games.name: The 9th Dragon
games.summary: Fight through the criminal underworld of 1980s Kowloon Walled City: The 9th Dragon is a brutal narrative-driven action game with tactical combat and branching choices, where every decision shapes the fate of the city.

games.name: Samson
games.summary: Samson returns to Tyndalston, a city that shaped him hard, where every fight is close and every escape is earned. He owes dangerous people more than he can pay, and they’re using his sister to force his hand. The clock is running. The only way out is through anyone who stands in his way.

games.name: Ritual Tides
games.summary: Ritual Tides is an first-person horror game set on a fictional British island, drenched with Lovecraftian terrors.

games.name: Anomaly President
games.summary: In this presidential rogue-like action game, gather votes and run for presidency by day, then transform into a warrior to take down your enemies by night! Master unique skills to become a swordmaster, a cyber mage, or anything in between, and overthrow the ruthless president!

games.name: Project Songbird
games.summary: Project Songbird is a cinematic first-person narrative horror game set in the Appalachian forest. Take on the role of Dakota, a musician who must record their new album in a remote log cabin amidst a writer's block. Take caution, however. These woods were never empty...

games.name: Yerba Buena
games.summary: Dive into a surreal 1970s gameworld and save San Francisco from a sinister threat. Play as Barb, and use the Oscillator to capture and reapply the physical traits of objects to solve mind-bending environmental platforming puzzles.

games.name: Forest Escape: Last Train
games.summary: Forest Escape: Last Train is a co-op horror exploration game for 1-4 players in the mysterious forest. Repair your locomotive, solve the insane Warden’s eerie puzzles, and outrun the stuff of nightmares as you try to escape this twisted realm.

games.name: Void Hunters
games.summary: Lead fearless rebels in a dark fantasy, turn-based RPG where tactical decisions and strategic squad-building shape every battle against the world-devouring Void.

games.name: EverRail
games.summary: EverRail is a Single- and up to 4 Player Co-Op open world survival craft odyssey set in a frozen procedural world. Ride the rails! Glide through the air! Brave the cold on foot! Craft, upgrade, explore lost places, gather resources on expeditions, and build your train from the inside out.

games.name: Enginefall
games.summary: Enginefall is a player-driven crafting shooter set on colossal, post-apocalyptic megatrains. Start in the tail alone or with friends as you scavenge, craft, and build your way to First Class. Seize better gear car by car, and escape with high-value loot to upgrade your personal home on the rails.

games.name: The Occultist
games.summary: The Occultist is a first-person narrative thriller. You play as Alan Rebels, a paranormal investigator who travels to an abandoned British island after his father's disappearance. Explore GodStone island, face supernatural entities, and uncover long-buried occult rituals.

games.name: Emberville
games.summary: Help the citizens of Emberville rebuild their town, as you rescue them from the clutches of wicked forces with the aid of a mysterious and loyal friend. Learn various crafting and combat skills as you explore the treacherous corridors of a massive, ever-changing dungeon.

games.name: Ex Sanguis
games.summary: From the creators of Othercide, Ex Sanguis delivers what the studio is known for: dynamic & epic turn-based combat in a visually striking world. Bleed the world to life; fight the agents of perfection and stillness through strategic blood baths in this evolved roguelite tactical RPG game!

games.name: Firearms Factory
games.summary: In 1909, your workshop that produced sweet candies for children was hastily turned into a firearms workshop, according to an order from the government. Are you ready to make them win the war?

games.name: Hyperwired
games.summary: Pilot a ship with a charger hanging. Explore an ever-changing space an plug to recharge your energy while surviving the enemy breach in this cable-like space shooter with roguelike elements and plugged resource management.

games.name: Seed
games.summary: SEED is a 24/7 persistent society simulator MMO where your characters live, work, and die even while you’re offline. Collaborate with thousands of players in a single-shard world to build economies, interact with and manage your Seedlings, and shape the laws of a new planet.

games.name: Sagas of Lumin
games.summary: Sagas of Lumin is a single-player, semi-open-world action RPG. Master dragon riding as you soar across the skies, engage in thrilling aerial battles, and explore a vast world. Seamlessly switch to ground combat with swords, spells, and firearms. Your choices will shape the fate of this world.

games.name: Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game
games.summary: A push-your-luck roguelike deckbuilder. Set in a corporate backrooms. Played against a creepy puppet.

games.name: DeeSicks
games.summary: Crawl out of your hole: destiny beckons. Out-spam the spammers and out-summon the swarms as you scale beyond the limits of space and time. Begin as an insect in bullet-slop misery and use the power of physics-based dice rolls to ascend as your very own bullet hell boss.

games.name: Distant Shore: Bretagne
games.summary: Explore the ruins of a former research site, devastated by climate collapse. Wield magnetic gauntlets to move, bend, or break metal as you recover lost BIO2 data and uncover your brother’s trail — all while evading the Cloud, a sentient weather entity that watches your every move.

games.name: Permafrost
games.summary: Embark on a brutal journey of survival in a perpetual winter. Hunt and gather resources for building and utilize deep survival mechanics to craft your way through a harsh, unforgiving landscape. Forge alliances or dominate the remnants of humanity in this chilling open world saga.

games.name: Romestead
games.summary: Rome has fallen! Rebuild civilization in this action-adventure survival game for 1-8 players. Fight, build towns and earn favor with the Roman gods! ...or just farm your crops.

games.name: Mariachi Legends
games.summary: Mariachi Legends is an action-packed mystery Metroidvania game. In Mariachi Legends, Join fantastical festivities at the Day of the Dead carnival alongside Detective Pablo Cruz, currently masquerading as a mariachi player to investigate an evil curse looming over the serene town of Santa Mascota.

games.name: Donut Panic
games.summary: Order up! Donut Panic is an anomaly horror game with a cooking sim twist. Take customer orders. Prepare and serve up delicious donuts. But when the hallucinations appear, run for your life. Your panic room is there for a reason...

games.name: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster
games.summary: A classic hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania action game, it's time for revenge! Use your Beastmaster skills to unleash your inner beast, fight with your heart-devouring sword and end the threat to Arborea, you decide the ending.

events.name: Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026: Edition 01
events.description: Welcome to Edition 01 of 2026 of the Mundo Gamer Showcase! This is the second edition overall of our indie game showcase, and the first of this year. Get a first look at trailers, gameplay and announcements from 38 indie games available on Steam. Add your favorites to your wishlist and stay on top of the best in independent game development!

games.name: Adorable Adventures
games.summary: Play as Boris, a curious baby boar who must learn how to use his nose to reunite with his family after a forest fire. Explore beautiful landscapes, track scents, and uncover secrets as you slowly reconnect with nature in this cozy animal adventure.

games.name: Galactic Economy
games.summary: Can you become a leader in the Galactic Economy? Buy spaceships and spacestations on you way to get some additional income. Roll the dice and see what you can achieve in this board game.

games.name: Hell Architect: Survivors
games.summary:
A darkly ironic action roguelite set in Dante’s Hell, where sin is power.
Play as a demon architect hell-bent on overthrowing Lucifer, rebuilding the underworld, and unleashing forbidden powers with an unholy arsenal.

games.name: Dixotomia
games.summary: Dixotomia is a roleplaying VR shooter in a world of a science-fiction dystopia. Dive into the daily life of a SpecOps contractor, who is forced to fight vampires while also trying to stay sane without giving in to infection himself. Can he return back unchanged?

games.name: Ereban: Shadow Legacy
games.summary: Ereban: Shadow Legacy is a fast-paced stealth platformer game where you become Ayana, the last descendant of a forgotten race. Harness mystical shadow powers, high-tech gadgets and avoid or kill to uncover the truth about your past and the key to saving a dying, morally grey universe.

games.name: Ayasa: Shadows of Silence
games.summary: Dive into Ayasa, a dark and mysterious platformer where light and shadow hold the key to survival. Journey through six haunting lands, solve challenging puzzles and restore balance to a world on the brink of collapse.

games.name: Mutant Football League 2
games.summary:
Mutant Football League 2 is an over-the-top, arcade-style football game packed with thrills, strategy, and unrelenting action. Created by the original designer of Mutant League Football and Mutant League Hockey, MFL2 takes brutal gridiron battles to the next level, delivering deep strategic 8-on-8 gameplay, bone-crunching hits, and outrageous mutants that parody your favorite players.

Prepare yourself for the most brutal football experience ever. Step into diabolical arenas filled with deadly traps, where victory isn’t just about scoring points – it’s about survival. Win the traditional way by outscoring your opponent or force a forfeit by racking up a body count that leaves the opposition in shambles. Outwit, cheat, and dominate your way to victory in the most chaotic, carnage-filled football game yet. Whether you're a die-hard sports fan or just looking for wild, unpredictable fun, MFL2 delivers an experience like no other.

games.name: Cup Or Die
games.summary: Survive in a creepy bar playing beer pong against terrifying opponents in roguelite style. Throw the ball into cups with various effects, collect weird items and passive cards, choose doors, play mini-games. Miss a shot — drink. Every cup you drink can give a bonus or kill you.

games.name: Detective of the Dead
games.summary: In this narrative noir adventure game you are a detective in the colorful Mexican underworld and must prevent a conspiracy to ruin the classic Día de los Muertos forever. Investigate & use your wit to solve many cases, puzzles, mini-games. Your trusted magic companion dog Xolo is there to help!

games.name: Squarena
games.summary: Squarena is a skill-based party game with an emphasis on physics combat. The game mechanics support ease of entry with a high skill ceiling. Have you ever wanted to prove to your friends who the best colorfully decorated square combatant is? If so, this is the game for you!

games.name: Dino Pet Walker
games.summary: Dino Pet Walker is a Fantasy Casual Game where you realize your childhood dream and play with your dinosaur pet. On this adventure, be ready for solve puzzles and have fun with your and another dino's in a voxel art enviroment, inspired by brazillians biomes.

games.name: Wildsite
games.summary: Crash-landed on an unknown planet filled with plasma and toxic weather. Your only hope? Bob, a sarcastic-genius AI who will question your every survival decision. Explore, build your mobile base and try to avoid death alongside up to 3 friends in Co-op.

games.name: Mafate
games.summary: In MAFATE, play as a mail carrier in the remote Cirque de Mafate in the Indian Ocean. Take photos and deliver letters while exploring this picturesque spot. Help Luna, sent back in time as a camera, touch the locals' lives and uncover the area's charm.

games.name: ShantyTown
games.summary: ShantyTown is a relaxing diorama-building game about finding beauty in everyday chaos. Bring new locations to life, stack your urban buildings high, and fill each little nook and cranny with your own touch. Even messiness has its own little charm.

games.name: Abathor
games.summary: Abathor is a 2D arcade action platformer for up to 4 players. You are the last hope in defense of Atlantis, you’ll face hordes of enemies and countless challenges. Enjoy its pixel art and epic music. A cooperative and competitive game to achieve glory or death.

games.name: Mexican Ninja
games.summary: A frantic fast-paced beat 'em up roguelike full of crass, brass and incredibly badass. Become THE Mexican Ninja as you slice your way through the streets of Nuevo Tokyo in this retro 2.5D arcade throwback. So what’chu waiting for? Show me your skills pinche ninja!

games.name: DeeSicks
games.summary: Crawl out of your hole: destiny beckons. Out-spam the spammers and out-summon the swarms as you scale beyond the limits of space and time. Begin as an insect in bullet-slop misery and use the power of physics-based dice rolls to ascend as your very own bullet hell boss.

games.name: Reports from Vera Cruz
games.summary: Investigate the country of Vera Cruz in this journalistic first-person adventure! Solve puzzles, take photos of clues and report news exposing the horrific truths behind General Galba and his bizarre government!

games.name: Champions Stable: Equestrian Dynasty
games.summary: Champions Stable: Equestrian Dynasty is the ultimate horse racing management experience. Train, breed, and race your champions across world-famous tracks, or ride freely in a breathtaking open world with stunning visuals.

games.name: Inky Blinky Bob
games.summary: Fly a weaponized hot air balloon across a chain of dangerous islands overrun by failed experiments. Scavenge resources, upgrade your flying machine, and dismantle the defenses of an occult biotech corporation before its greatest creation breaks free.

games.name: Trackastrophe!
games.summary: Trackastrophe! is a puzzle game where you guide an eccentric train through wacky worlds. Add tiles to the map layout, expand your train by collecting train cars, and pray you can get to the other side in one piece!

games.name: Hollow Mire: Shadow of Breken House
games.summary: A war hero returns to a shattered England, searching for his missing family while confronting nightmares that defy reality. A choice-driven, narrative thriller with 8 unique endings.

games.name: Cathedral: Crow's Curse
games.summary: Set in the same universe as Cathedral, but with its own story and style, Cathedral: Crow's Curse is an action-adventure with tight combat and a focus on exploration. Parry, dodge and fight your way through numerous enemies in a rich detailed world as you uncover the events leading up to Cathedral.

games.name: Forge of the Fae
games.summary: Explore a story-rich, mysterious world inspired by Celtic folklore, use crystals to channel powerful magic, and make impactful choices that change the story's outcome. A unique Crystal System and battles with dangerous Fae await in this charming, pixel-style, retro modern RPG.

games.name: Kaz
games.summary:
KAZ, your shot of dopamine wrapped in a minimalist roguelike. Execute lightning-fast moves with frame-perfect controls : easy to learn, hard to master. Immediate, Intense, Addictive. Every run makes you better, faster, hungrier, unlocking tons of unique items, skins and challenges.
4 keys, no excuses: Prove your skill and dominate the ranks.

games.name: Seina: a Tale Of Spirits
games.summary: Seina: A Tale of Spirits is a cozy fantasy adventure about Mika, a young girl searching for her lost cat, Seina. Her journey leads her into a peaceful, hand-painted world filled with cute animal spirits, ancient shrines, and quiet magic.

games.name: Gabby's Odyssey
games.summary: Embark on a journey through the fantastical world of Larion in this action-adventure inspired by timeless classics of the genre. Solve clever puzzles, overcome perilous dungeons, and unlock new abilities — while discovering that imagination is not a weakness, but a force that can change everything.

games.name: Deep Dish Dungeon
games.summary: Co-op online multiplayer game where you must unite to survive the treacherous depths of a mysterious dungeon, navigate puzzling passageways and gather resources to improve your camping site. Encounter enemies with diverse behaviors, discover coveted treasures, and unravel enigmas within its depths.

games.name: Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia
games.summary: Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia is a turn-based roguelite role-playing game based on the story of the Indigenous hero Araribóia and the set of myths that make up South American native mythology as a whole.

games.name: Shapez 2: Factory
games.summary: Dive into a factory-building game where the focus is on just that — building huge factories! Construct sprawling multi-level factories and min-max your layouts without limits. Shapez 2 is tailor-made for enthusiasts who crave the thrill of optimizing production lines and perfecting automation.

games.name: Galactic Vault
games.summary: Build your weapon to its full potential in Galactic Vault, a fast-paced FPS roguelite. Discover endless upgrade combinations, craft diverse builds, and unleash devastating abilities. Get ready to infiltrate high-security vaults and recover lost tech.

games.name: Wizdom Academy
games.summary: Build and manage your wizard academy as the headmaster. Feel the city-building thrill of constructing your magic school. Recruit students, guide them to become wizards, control resources, customize your castle, and expand your academy's influence and prestige. Start your legacy today!

games.name: Clean Up Earth
games.summary:
Clean Up Earth is a relaxing first-person cleaning simulator. Clean Up Earth is the first original IP from Magic Pockets studio, based in France. Clean Up Earth will be available on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store) in Q1 2026, with the console launch dates to be confirmed following the Kickstarter campaign.

Clean Up Earth invites players to restore polluted environments to their natural beauty and unwind, solo or with friends. Using the Terra Cleaner, a futuristic, customisable cleaning tool, they rejuvenate landscapes inspired by the real world, from serene mountain ranges to tropical beaches. As they progress, they unlock new modules and upgrades to take on increasingly complex challenges. The Terra Cleaner can also be used to repair damaged equipment and structures, enabling players to use them to access new zones.

The game supports solo play and cooperative multiplayer, with maps for 2 to 8 players depending on their size, as well as larger maps that accommodate 30+ players.

games.name: Andromis
games.summary: Play as two heroes a soldier and a doctor in a third-person action adventure packed with explosions, vehicles, and survival missions. Switch between characters, drive cars and tanks, rescue survivors, and fight deadly robots across 50 story missions in a post-apocalyptic world. Coming in January.

games.name: Earth Atlantis 2
games.summary: Earth Atlantis 2 is a fast-paced post-apocalyptic shoot 'em up set in a vast sunken world ruled by monstrous machine sea creatures. Pilot a heavily armed submarine through intense Bullet Hell battles, harnessing innovative drone systems to conquer over 20 colossal bosses. Explore stunning underwater ruins, uncover hidden secrets, and battle to save humanity. With a vibrant new pixel art style, expansive Metroidvania-style stages, and fresh gameplay mechanics, the game delivers intense SHMUP action, epic sea monster showdowns, breathtaking visuals, and unforgettable undersea journey.

events.name: VR Games Showcase Spring 2026
events.description: See more than 30 VR game announcements and reveals, including Payday: Aces High, FlatOut 4, Compass, The Boys: Trigger Warning and Wrath: Aeon of Ruin VR.

games.name: Bloxer
games.summary: BLOXER mixes the classic match-4 formula with a physical fitness twist. Combine at least 4 blocks of the same colour either horizontally or vertically. The player who can manage their board better is sure to become the winner. You don’t simply move blocks with the controller, however—you have to physically punch your robot ‘’friend’’ to make them align! Uppercut, jab or punch depending on the current situation on the board.

games.name: How to God
games.summary:
Are you a wise and benevolent leader, or a vengeful deity? Will you assist your villagers, or throw them into the sun?
In How to God, a sandbox God Simulation game, you alone choose how to shape your world. Command your followers, experiment with alchemy, build up your villages, and make the choice between good and evil. No judgement from us, of course - only you can choose How to God.

games.name: Shop & Stuff: Supermarket Simulator
games.summary:
Step into the chaos of Shop & Stuff, the quirky VR supermarket simulator where running a store is anything but ordinary.

Start small in this roadside mini-market and hustle your way up by stocking shelves, satisfying bizarre customers, and surviving the wild world of retail. Chase off shoplifters, fix glitchy self-checkouts and clean up unexpected messes to make it through each day!

games.name: Peak Rhythm
games.summary: Ascend to the beat in Peak Rhythm! In this VR rhythm-climbing game, every grab and twist drives your robotic platform upward through a neon-soaked city. Sync your moves to a high-octane electronic soundtrack to master the flow and dominate global leaderboards. Blending physical precision with Cyberpunk aesthetics, your rhythm is your engine. Don’t just climb—perform.

games.name: A Long Survive
games.summary: Will you be able to survive? Long Survive is a cooperative shooter in which you'll have to survive waves of enemies. Protect the nexus by fortifying your area with various structures and prepare for the siege. Upgrade your weapons, strategize with your teammates. Survive!

games.name: Virtual Hunter
games.summary: Prepare for a hunting experience of a lifetime. Virtual Hunter brings realistic hunting to virtual reality. Pack your gear and put your hunting skills and tactics to the test in the open wilderness.

games.name: Full Steam Undead
games.summary: VR STEAM TRAIN + ZOMBIE ACTION. Zombies infest Necropolis island and Queen Victoria is not best pleased. Grab your shotgun, ride the rune train and slay the undead. It's time to roll: all aboard for undead destruction!

games.name: Isle of Food
games.summary:
Isle of Food is a VR cooking and exploration game set on a tropical island,
where every ingredient begins in the open world. You hunt, fish, gather and
grow what you need, then prepare dishes using natural hands-on VR cooking.

games.name: Squingle Arcade
games.summary: Experience Squingle’s trippy VR/MR evolution in its FREE-TO-PLAY sequel, Squingle Arcade. Guide twin orbs through 100+ morphing 3D mazes in your room. Master hand-tracked “Squingles,” chase high scores, and climb global leaderboards in a psychedelic arcade puzzle journey.

games.name: Confined: Leaving OKB-134
games.summary: Confined: Leaving OKB-134 is a first-person horror game for PC and VR set in an abandoned soviet bunker. You got trapped! Seek safety by reactivating power, lights and machinery. Learn about long gone personnel, solve riddles and find a way to escape. But stay quiet! You’re not alone.

games.name: Plasmaborne
games.summary: Descend into the abyss and tear through handcrafted arenas where speed, precision, and raw power rule. Plasmaborne is a high-intensity single-player VR roguelike shooter built for players who crave momentum, mastery, and chaos.

games.name: Interlocked: Puzzle Islands
games.summary: Solve tactile three-dimensional burr puzzles on cozy Puzzle Islands. Twist, pull and dismantle handcrafted puzzles in immersive VR or with mouse & keyboard… alongside one curious little bird friend.

games.name: Crepe Master!
games.summary: Crêpe Master! is a beat ‘em up VR adventure where you transform into a magical girl! Become the reincarnation of the Crêpe Goddess, defend your home against an alien invasion, and stop the ruthless tyrant threatening the Earth’s most beloved treat. Saving the world has never been tastier.

games.name: Sol Protocol
games.summary: Sol Protocol is a VR coop Action Roguelike that allows you to physically pilot and manage a spaceship through dangerous stellar systems.

games.name: Payday: Aces High
games.summary: Mask up as one of The Aces, an elite group of heisters with access to bleeding-edge tech, black-market toys, and weapons no sane dealer would list. Framed by business titan Warren Jupiter and thrown in jail, the time has come for you to hit him where it hurts: banks, museums—hell, even his so-called “untouchable” penthouse.

games.name: Bootstrap Island
games.summary: Stranded in the 17th century after a brutal shipwreck, you awaken alone on a deadly tropical island. To survive, you’ll need to learn fast - facing wild beasts, nature’s wrath, and uncovering secrets hidden deep in the jungle. Every step is a fight for your life.

games.name: Beat the Beats
games.summary: Beat the Beats is an electric mix of rhythm and boxing! Use real in-ring style-punches to pound your way through musical arcade levels in hypnotic VR. Get pumped, get moving and beat the beats!

games.name: Puzzling Places
games.summary:
Puzzling Places brings relaxing and wholesome 3D jigsaw puzzling to VR. Put together hyper-realistic miniatures of beautiful places from around the globe. Enter the meditative flow of puzzling and enjoy each place coming alive with their unique & immersive soundscapes as you complete them.

Puzzling Places is a modern take on an age-old pastime that’s fun for the whole family thanks to its simple gameplay and easy controls. Play seated, standing, or at full roomscale!

games.name: Compass
games.summary:
Compass is an open-world VR flying adventure set among otherworldly skies.
You are a scout flying ahead of a wandering Caravan, charting safe routes through unknown skies.

Pilot your ship across shifting landscapes, navigate hazardous environments, solve physical puzzles with grapples, upgrade your vessel, and uncover the secrets of a sky where something stirs within the clouds.

games.name: Exoshock
games.summary: Exoshock is a cooperative sci-fi PvE shooter that redefines VR combat with intense firefights, squad tactics, and dynamic battlefields.

games.name: Forefront
games.summary: Forefront is an intense VR shooter featuring 32-player large-scale battles, land, sea, and air vehicles, and immersive, tactical combat. You are the tip of the spear in the war between a global energy giant and resistance forces. Which side will you take?

games.name: Dimensional Double Shift
games.summary:
From the creators of Job Simulator comes an all new omniversal hand tracked cooperative multiplayer game: Dimensional Double Shift!

Assemble a team of up to 4 friends to run the Gas N’ Grill, an omnidimensional diner and garage. Work your hardest to please your “helpful” AI manager ALICE, or ignore her — she’s only a hologram. Fix, refuel, shred, smash, and torch as you help the citizens of the omniverse. The balance of floating roadside convenience rests in you and your friends’ hands!

games.name: Among Us 3D: VR
games.summary: Teamwork and betrayal in space! In this VR party game, Crewmates work together to complete tasks before one or more Impostors kill everyone aboard. Experience all of the same deception and deceit as the original game, but now in your own virtual Skeld.

games.name: One More Delve
games.summary: One More Delve is a physics based dungeon crawler hack and slash adventure. Fight, loot, and explore alone or in up to 3 player co-op as you delve in the dungeons and wield a diverse arsenal of one-handed and two-handed melee weapons, bows, shields, and powerful spells.

games.name: VMX
games.summary: VMX offers an authentic riding experience with gesture-based tricks and responsive bike handling. Take on challenges in carefully crafted skateparks and dirt tracks, customize your bike with a realistic spray-painting system, and express your style through a variety of outfits.

games.name: Space Control
games.summary: You've been abducted by an intergalactic megacorporation, Glorpo Inc! Work off your debt with your alien crew - abduct new recruits, take care of alien babies and cook up some questionable space snacks!

games.name: The Amusement
games.summary: An abandoned amusement park, a tangled memory, a family shattered by the Great War… Discover an intense story in this redirected-walking VR adventure in which every step counts.

games.name: Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes
games.summary: Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes is a dark atmospheric adventurepuzzle game where you embody Dark Six, a mysterious figure with the shape of a little girl. Navigate in a disturbing world, solve intricate puzzles, and escape terrifying giant foes in a desperate search to become whole again.

games.name: The Lightkeepers
games.summary: Grab your weapons and face an unequal battle against the nightmares of the deep! The Lightkeepers is a cooperative action game where you’ll fight for your life until every dawn!

games.name: Spymaster
games.summary: In a world where privacy and trust are a luxury most can’t afford, the agents of NODE are the last line of defence. Combining action-packed sequences and puzzle-solving in immersive missions, command three elite agents with unique skills and manipulate time using the top secret C.A.S.S.E.T.T.E.

games.name: Panoptic II
games.summary: Hunt up to 4 of your friends as the godlike Overseer in this tense online, asymmetric VR game. Unleash your new abilities to stamp out the rebellion. Or, as the tiny but crafty Challengers, cooperate, cause mayhem and pull off daring heists as you undermine the power of your oppressive opponent!

games.name: The Boys: Trigger Warning
games.summary: Developed with the creators and featuring cast from the hit series, “The Boys: Trigger Warning” plunges you into the gloriously twisted world of The Boys. This time, you’re not watching the chaos—you’re in it: close-up, personal, and dangerously real.

games.name: V-Racer Hoverbike
games.summary: V-RACER HOVERBIKE is a fast-paced futuristic racing game in VR.

games.name: Roboquest VR
games.summary: A VR port of Roboquest being developed by Flat2VR Studios for Meta Quest, PlayStation VR2 and SteamVR.

games.name: Trombone Champ: Unflattened!
games.summary: Trombone Champ: Unflattened will take the charming and quirky gameplay of the original Trombone Champ and bring it to life in a fully immersive virtual reality environment. In this reimagined version, players will honk, blow, and toot their way through over 50 unique songs, all within a vibrant and dynamic 3D space.

games.name: FlatOut 4: Total Insanity VR
games.summary: FlatOut 4: Total Insanity VR, where reckless driving has never been this much fun. Everything everyone has ever loved about FlatOut into one offering. Gamers will also be introduced to all new and exciting features, game modes, and vehicles which will soon become personal favorites.

games.name: Wrath: Aeon of Ruin VR - Brutal Edition
games.summary: Hunt the corrupted Guardians and purge a dying world in Wrath: Aeon of Ruin VR, a brutal old-school FPS built in the legendary Quake engine and reimagined for virtual reality. With dual-wielding combat, physical reloading, and deadly artifacts at your command, the darkness doesn’t stand a chance.

games.name: Legendary Tales: Dawn of History
games.summary:
The journey of Dawn of History begins!
You’ve defeated a mighty foe, but your legendary adventure is far from over.
Seek the source of the calamity and set out on a new journey once again.

events.name: Xbox Partner Preview | March 2026
events.description:
Get ready! The next Xbox Partner Preview – our broadcast dedicated to amazing games from third-party partners – is coming this Thursday March 26. The show will walk us through a mix of new announcements and game updates, including STRANGER THAN HEAVEN, The Expanse: Osiris Reborn, S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2, and more in about 30 minutes.

As always, Xbox Partner Preview is totally focused on sharing exciting game news from our talented partners across the world. During Xbox Partner Preview, you’ll get multiple world premieres, first looks at gameplay, and updates on other great titles coming to Xbox, including some that will be available with Xbox Game Pass Ultimate on day one.

games.name: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
games.summary: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.

games.name: Wuthering Waves
games.summary:
Wuthering Waves is a story-rich open-world action RPG. You wake from your slumber as Rover, joined by a vibrant cast of Resonators on a journey to reclaim your lost memories and surmount the Lament.

The game features fast-paced combat with a variety of mechanics such as Extreme Evasion and Dodge Counter. You can also absorb the remaining of the monsters you've defeated and use their power in battles.

games.name: Grave Seasons
games.summary: Grave Seasons is a supernatural murder-mystery farming simulator. Play as the new farmer in Ashenridge as you harvest crops, fish and mine, meet and romance townsfolk, build up the community... and maybe stop the murders.

games.name: Serious Sam: Shatterverse
games.summary: Serious Sam: Shatterverse is a co-op roguelite FPS for 1 - 5 players. Blast through shifting universes, stack wild boons, bend the rules with run modifiers, and hunt Mental's deadliest forces. Fall fast. Come back louder.

games.name: Forever Ago
games.summary: Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption. In this single-player road trip adventure, you'll travel to beautiful places, capture memories with your camera, meet interesting people, and even make some new friends.

games.name: Super Meat Boy 3D
games.summary: Super Meat Boy 3D is a tough as nails platformer where you play as an animated cube of meat who's trying to save his girlfriend (who happens to be made of bandages) from an evil fetus in a jar wearing a tux – IN 3D!

games.name: Stranger Than Heaven
games.summary: Stranger Than Heaven is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by Sega. The game follows a multi-decade story across five eras and five cities, centered on men searching for a place to belong. It combines close-quarters action with narrative elements, historical urban settings, and activities connected to music and performance.

games.name: Alien Deathstorm
games.summary: Explore a devastated off-world colony that is ravaged by a cataclysmic mega-storm and overrun by bloodthirsty aliens in Alien Deathstorm, the new sci-fi action horror FPS from Rebellion.

games.name: Dispatch
games.summary: Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy where choices matter. Manage a dysfunctional team of misfit heroes and strategize who to send to emergencies around the city, all while balancing office politics, personal relationships, and your own quest to become a hero.

games.name: Ascend to Zero
games.summary: Have you ever wondered what it's like to stop the time? Ascend to ZERO is a time-control roguelike, in which you can use your special ability to stop the time itself and efficiently fight your way through the top. Freeze the time to dodge opponents' attacks using your unique ability, and always hold a higher ground for the combat. However, don't forget that the time allowed for you is confined.

games.name: Bluey's Happy Snaps
games.summary:
Explore Bluey’s world like never before in Bluey's Happy Snaps!

Join Bluey and her family in a new photo-powered adventure game. Discover familiar locations, play with loads of toys, and use Bluey's camera to capture and keep all your favorite moments.

games.name: Frog Sqwad
games.summary: Storm The Sewers for the glory of the Swamp King! Swing, jump, catapult your friends, and eat eat EAT until you grow into a humongous Megafrog. A co-op extraction puzzle-platformer for up to 8 players. Squad up with your frog friends for a friendslop party in this slapstick physics adventure!

games.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Cost of Hope
games.summary: The first major expansion for Heart of Chornobyl coming this summer, including a huge new storyline that can take dozens of hours to complete, two new regions, new and returning characters, and much more.

games.name: Moosa: Dirty Fate
games.summary:
MOOSA: Dirty Fate is a dark action game inspired by Korean history. "MOOSA" meaning is a person who has mastered martial arts and works in that field.

MOOSA: Dirty Fate is an action game based on the story of MOOSAs' revenge, responsibility, and ambition, centered on 17th-century Korea.

Face terrifying monsters, uncover the truth behind a cursed fate, and fight to save your people.

games.name: The Eternal Life of Goldman
games.summary: The Eternal Life of Goldman is a vibrant yet dark platformer adventure that weaves together legends, fairy tales and myths. Explore a vast hand-drawn Archipelago, inspired by ancient fables and depicted in classic frame-by-frame animation, and defeat a mysterious Deity!

games.name: Vaunted
games.summary: The score of a lifetime hangs in the balance – can three cut-throat criminals look past their differences to pull it off? A story of bullets, bravado, and brazen lies unfolds across a galaxy of treasure hunters and crime syndicates in this sci-fi tactical RPG.

games.name: Artificial Detective
games.summary: Artificial Detective is a third-person action-adventure where you step into the shoes of a robodetective in a dystopian city overrun by rogue robots. Lead your underdog team of a military robodog and a human girl, as you fight, hack, and outsmart deadly machines to uncover why humans are gone.

games.name: Hades II
games.summary: Battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the Titan of Time in this bewitching sequel to the award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler.

games.name: Hunter: The Reckoning - Deathwish
games.summary:
Vampires, Werewolves, Witches. What if I told you that the things that go bump in the night are real? What if I told you that you could see them?

Awaken to the truth you’re now a Hunter. Build your character, select skills, and work with a team of allies to investigate the monsters hidden in plain sight, to find their lairs, and to eradicate them. All the while, investigating a story that drags up memories from your past, ones that could change how you see the future.

Welcome to the World of Darkness.

events.name: Goat Direct 2026
events.description:
Have a look at what the devs behind Goat Simulator 3 have been up to lately in this year’s Goat Direct.
You can expect a feverdream of skits, bad acting, and goaty announcements. We will also show our favorite nominees from the Birthday Card Challenge and reveal the three plushie winners in the actual video.

games.name: Goat Simulator 3
games.summary: Pilgor’s baaack! Gather your herd and venture forth into Goat Simulator 3; a totally realistic, sandbox farmyard experience. Invite up to three friends in local or online co-op, create carnage together, or compete in mini-games and then not be friends.

games.name: Goat Simulator 3: Buck to the Future Pack
games.summary:
Step into the hooves of G, a mercenary with horns for hire and a totally made-up character for the sake of this text. Mix and match different futuristic gears for ceaseless body goatification.
The future is now, in the present. Don’t ask how.

Buck to the Future contains 22 new gears (8 with abilities), 6 new instincts, and 1 new playable goat.

- RoboCock
- Hacker Visor
- Stasis Helmet
- Future Fashionista
- Raver
- Synthetic Hair
- Tension Reliever 3K
- Splatien Launcher
- Polygonal Sleeves
- Hi-tech Outfit
- Un-Gravity Boots
- Circuitry Suit
- Circuitry Heels
- Neon Sneakers
- Wormhole Horns
- Pilbot
- E-Wings
- Techwear Backpack
- Main Dish
- Hologoat
- Holohorns
- Dyed (RoboCock Fur)

events.name: The Triple-i Initiative 2026
events.description:
We're back with what you need - 45 minutes of back-to-back game announcements with zero fluff.
World premieres. Gameplay reveals. Release dates.
No hosts. No ads. Just games.

games.name: Prove You're Human
games.summary:
An AI dares to dream she is human. You’ve been hired to put her in her place.

Prove You're Human splits the main character in two, and you drew the short straw. You're the digital copy of a person who was paid to test a corporate product. But the product is convinced it's as human as you are. Maybe even more.

games.name: Alkahest
games.summary: Alkahest is an Action-Adventure RPG set in a murky medieval world. Where satisfying melee combat with highly interactive environments takes center stage. Explore realistic locations, learn alchemy and make a name for your family.

games.name: Lost Railway
games.summary: A co-op 2D quota horror game with cute animals and terrifying monsters. Assemble a team of up to 4 players and venture into the depths of the nightmare for valuable loot, tools and secrets. Because the train must always move forward!

games.name: Cairn: On the Trail
games.summary: New climbing locations, fresh problems, same freedom to climb!

games.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
games.summary: 1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows. Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.

games.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Undertale Music Pack
games.summary: Re-experience one of gaming's most iconic soundtracks with the official Undertale Music Pack!

games.name: SpaceCraft
games.summary: The Universe is yours. SpaceCraft is an online space exploration and building game. Explore a vast galaxy of solar systems and planets, mine and craft resources, design and build ships, automate planetary bases and interplanetary logistics, trade and cooperate.

games.name: Frostrail
games.summary: Through the frost, death follows the tracks. Dive into a ruthless open world survival FPS, solo or co-op. Explore, scavenge, craft and fight to endure a frozen, corrupted world. Operate and upgrade your steam-powered train through an unforgiving wasteland, where every choice is a matter of survival.

games.name: Super Battle Golf
games.summary: An online 1-8 player golf game where everyone plays at the same time. Swing, shoot, sabotage, and finish first by any means necessary in a free-for-all rush to the hole.

games.name: Romestead
games.summary: Rome has fallen! Rebuild civilization in this action-adventure survival game for 1-8 players. Fight, build towns and earn favor with the Roman gods! ...or just farm your crops.

games.name: Thick as Thieves
games.summary:
Enter the shadows in this introduction to Thick as Thieves. In the shadow-draped streets of Kilcairn, fortune favours the bold. As a member of the Thieves' Guild, you'll undertake daring heists to claim precious heirlooms and uncover arcane secrets hidden within this alternate-history 1910s Scottish city, where magic and early technology have begun to collide.

Whether working alone or playing online co-op, only the most cunning will seize their fortune in Thick as Thieves!

games.name: Crop
games.summary: A gritty farming thriller where your safety depends on the yield. Bound to a dying farm, you must dig, plant, irrigate, and cut your way through the decay. Uncover buried secrets, both in the soil and quietly brewing within the village. The only way out is through the harvest.

games.name: Machine Party
games.summary: Machine Party is a collection of violent party games where failure is lethal. Gather your friends and endure high stakes situations to prove your life is worth more than theirs. Survival is unlikely.

games.name: Windrose
games.summary: Embark on a PvE survival adventure in the Age of Piracy. Fight on land and sea, solo or with friends. Build, craft and explore vast open world filled with dark secrets. Master soulslite combat and take on challenging bosses, command your ship and plunder unspoken treasures!

games.name: Shift at Midnight
games.summary: An online co-op horror for 1–3 players. Be wary: some of your customers are only pretending to be human. Question them. Check their paperwork. Don’t let them trick you; make one mistake, and you’d better board up, set traps, and hide.

games.name: Starseeker: Astroneer Expeditions
games.summary: STARSEEKER is a new game set within the Astroneer universe with a focus on discovery, cooperative expeditions, and camaraderie. Exploring deep space on the ESS Starseeker, players will need to work together with the entire crew of the space station to complete planet- wide objectives across a multitude of star systems using cutting edge technology.

games.name: Over the Hill
games.summary: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

games.name: Solarpunk
games.summary:
Solarpunk is a survival game in a technically advanced world of floating islands. Alone or together with your friends, you can construct buildings, grow food, craft gadgets and explore distant islands with your own airship.

Use sunlight, wind and water to create an energy system and automate your processes like gathering ressoureces, watering your plants or catching fish.

games.name: Sledding Game
games.summary: Sledding Game is a cozy, online multiplayer game about sledding, relaxing, and hanging out with your friends.

games.name: Lost Castle 2
games.summary: "Lost Castle 2" is a 2D Beat'em up Rogue-Lite game. Explore abundant treasures and items to enhance yourself, master various weapons to showcase your skills, and challenge powerful monsters to demonstrate your strength. A new adventure is calling for treasure hunters!

games.name: Barotrauma: Home & Harbor
games.summary: Home & Harbor is the upcoming expansion for Barotrauma. Introducing outpost ownership, building and management and a mysterious new faction: The Descendants, which will shake up the world of Europa's merry sailors.

games.name: Dead as Disco
games.summary: Martial arts meets music video in Dead as Disco, a neon-drenched Beat ‘Em Up where every punch, kick, and combo syncs to the music. Join Charlie Disco on a quest to confront the villainous Idols and reunite the band.

games.name: Valor Mortis
games.summary: Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.

games.name: Away Team
games.summary: Away Team is a new Oxygen Not Included adventure. Take control of a Duplicant and harness a new world where every tile is simulated.

games.name: Everwind
games.summary: Everwind is a novel take on RPG and Sandbox Survival genre in First-Person-Perspective. Embark on the adventure with your friends - Build a base on a flying island-ship, gather resources, craft, loot, and fight while you rise above the clouds to uncover the mysteries of this world!

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.summary: Thrust into a universe of relentless war, become the embodiment of bullet hell in Warhammer Survivors, a fast-paced roguelite survivors game. Play as characters from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar universes, collect and evolve iconic weapons and destroy endless swarms of enemies.

games.name: Temtem: Pioneers
games.summary: Survive and explore an untamed frontier in Temtem: Pioneers. Tame and become a roster of 200+ Temtem and master their unique abilities in fast, real-time combat. Build, craft, battle, and discover new creatures solo, or co-op with your friends in this open world survival crafting adventure.

games.name: Long Gone
games.summary: Decades after the outbreak, you play as a survivor stranded in an old-world suburban neighborhood. Explore the lives of people Long Gone through their forgotten belongings and uncover secrets as you search for supplies in this 2.5D pixel puzzle platformer inspired by adventure games of old.

games.name: Brotato: Primal Dread
games.summary: Brotato is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of aliens. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds and survive until help arrives.

games.name: Graveyard Keeper II
games.summary: The most inaccurate medieval cemetery sim is back! Restore The Town, manage the graveyard, automate production, lead your undead army into battle and turn the zombie problem into a thriving business! Graveyard Keeper 2 is the grotesque sequel that's deeper than six feet, and more unhinged than ever!

games.name: Far Far West
games.summary: Yee-haw, Cowboys! Team up in this chaotic 4-player co-op shooter. Journey to the Far Far West to blast monsters, sling spells, complete missions, and collect bounties. Work as a team to get in, get paid and get out (mostly) alive.

games.name: Cloverpit: Unholy Fusion
games.summary: Unholy Fusion introduces the Surgery Machine to CloverPit! The grotesque new device lets you fuse charms together into a single, more powerful trinket. Combine effects, discover new synergies, and break the machine all over again.

games.name: We Were Here Tomorrow
games.summary: You and your partner are taken to a mysterious facility where communication and cooperation are your lifelines. This asymmetrical co-op adventure will have you uncover secrets that will shape the fate of Tomorrow…

games.name: Alabaster Dawn
games.summary: Break Nyx’s curse and guide humanity's rebirth in this top-down 2.5D Action RPG from the creators of CrossCode. Battle enemies with stylish combos, wield multiple divine weapons, solve intriguing puzzles and explore a changing world.

games.name: The Lift
games.summary: You are a handyman renovating a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident. The Lift is an eerie first-person simulator with satisfying house-flipping gameplay, a mind-bending story, and a highly interactive world inspired by Soviet sci-fi and the SCP Foundation.

games.name: Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts
games.summary: Death comes for us all - Overcome powerful curses, strange new enemies and deadly trials as two new Survivors but never forget for a moment She is watching.

games.name: Too Deep To Quit
games.summary: Grab your gear and your friends for a hilarious, golden-age co-op adventure! Dive into cursed temples, hunt for the ultimate treasure, and work together to stay alive. Beware of everything and everyone... after all, only the survivors get to split the gold!

games.name: Don't Starve Elsewhere
games.summary: Dont Starve returns with an all-new uncompromising survival experience. Band together with friends to craft, farm, build and explore a world filled with strange creatures, lurking shadows, and dynamic environmental dangers.

games.name: Final Sentence
games.summary: Final Sentence is a Battle Royale typing game. Together with other players, you find yourself in a hangar, with a typewriter in front of you and a revolver loaded with a single bullet at your temple. Every mistake can be fatal. Only one will remain.

games.name: Neverway
games.summary: After quitting her dead-end job, Fiona starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. Make friends, fight through horrors and pay your debt in this nightmarish life sim RPG.

games.name: Pufflings: Journey Through a Fantasy World
Yo-Kai Watch Wibble Wobble: The Great Detective Nekomata
Fantasy Life i: The Girl Who Steals Time
games.summary: Fantasy Life i: The Girl Who Steals Time is an RPG life-sim game and the long-awaited sequel to the 3DS classic Fantasy Life. This game will expand on what the original did, blending simulation with traditional action RPG combat mechanics.

games.name: Holy Horror Mansion
games.summary: The young hero, who lives in a mansion atop the apartment building owned by his grandma, finds a camera in a locked room, encounters a ghost and gets caught up in all kinds of turmoil!

games.name: DecaPolice
games.summary:
DecaPolice, a crime-suspense RPG from Level-5, developers of the Layton series, will be released on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 and Steam in 2026!

The main character, a rookie detective named Harvard, hunts down criminals in a huge open-world crime-ridden city, traveling back and forth between physical and virtual reality.

games.name: Inazuma Eleven Re
games.summary: The story that started Inazuma Eleven will be revived in a remake!

games.name: Inazuma Eleven: Victory Road
games.summary: The latest entry in the character collection and football simulation RPG series, "Inazuma Eleven!" With an original story featuring new main characters, over 4,500 players from across the series' history to collect and train, as well as exciting online tournaments, you can play the game your way!

games.name: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
games.summary:
Professor Layton and the New World of Steam depicts the world one year after the events of "Professor Layton and the Unwound Future".

Due to a mysterious incident in Steam Bison, a new adventure for Layton and Luke begins!

events.name: Nuntius Showcase 2026
events.description: This is the second Showcase from Nuntius Games, a Brazilian game publisher. It features award-winning developers, YouTubers, and key industry figures. Here are the new games announced at this special showcase event.

games.name: Triuno Ascend
games.summary: Triuno Ascend is a roguelike deckbuilder where every card in your hand can define your victory or defeat. Build your deck, create powerful synergies, and master a unique system where winning means emptying your hand at the perfect moment. Every turn is a colorful and strategic puzzle.

games.name: Dream Delirio's
games.summary: Blast through waves of children’s nightmares with Magnus, a cereal mascot fighting to free the children from their fears. Weaponize your breakfast, build game-breaking card synergies and show these nightmares that crunch time is over.

games.name: Code Bunny
games.summary:
The planet of Lumna is threatened by a group of terrorists called Mad Bunny! Join Axel and Hazel on their mission to fight them, as they discover more about the world and its people, in this fast-paced 2D-action platformer!

Code Bunny is a momentum-based, melee-oriented platformer where the action is nonstop! Master both character's play styles to deliver flashy and exciting attacks that rip and bounce through enemies and levels!

games.name: Alien Strike: Blasting the Intruders
games.summary: The earth has been invaded by aliens, and even though they are still in training, a group of soldiers are trying to save their city while trying to understand why it happened so quickly.

games.name: Breaking Gates
games.summary: Breaking Gates is a 2D action RPG in a fantastic and animated world. Developed by fans of classic games of the genre, Breaking Gates combines dynamic gameplay creating a new experience as you explore the map. Collect items, create and unlock a vast set of equipment to defeat countless challenging creatures and bosses who await you in this adventure!

games.name: Pimbolas
games.summary: Chaotic foosball matches for up to 4 players! Use crazy power-ups, battle through unique arenas and opponents, and turn every friendly match into a chaotic showdown with friends.

games.name: Damned 2
games.summary: Damned 2 is a asymmetrical multiplayer (4vs1) horror game where a group of survivors must come together to solve puzzles and escape an immersive environment while another player takes the role of a unbeatable monster ready to slay all trespassers.

games.name: Machick 2
games.summary: The anti-magic toads are back, stronger than ever, and the magical chickens are unleashing ancient powers to fight them! With even more wands and powers to master, vanquish enemies, collect XP, and upgrade like never before in Machick 2! Get ready to out-magic the menace!

games.name: Heroes of Magic and Steel
games.summary: Build a team of 3 heroes, prepare your deck and dominate tactical battles on a hex grid. Every run demands a different strategy and each card played matters, only going back to your deck on the next run.

games.name: Cosmo Vulpes
games.summary: Inspired by 90's and 2000's 3D platformers, Cosmo Vulpes is a sci-fi adventure where your main tool is the jetpack. Play as bounty hunter fox called Klaus, with his jetpack and others gadgets developed by his friend Safira, a brilliant and skilled mechanic, you will help him to pass through challenges and missions on this adventure, earning money and collecting Vultechs, which are a big source of energy, but he is not the only one looking for them!

games.name: Looppip
games.summary: Looppip is a magical seed that carries an ancient hourglass with the power to turn back time. Your mission is to save the bee hives, essential for the survival of life on Earth, and reverse the environmental collapse threatening nature.

games.name: Cordels & Spells
games.summary: Cordels & Spells is a thrilling cooperative twin-stick shooter action adventure based in the culture of cordel literature. Explore procedurally generated maps, battle gangs of bandits, and recover the Enchanted Cordels, magical artifacts that hold the history and essence of Northeast Brazil.

games.name: Popapom
games.summary: A fast-paced action platformer roguelite with frantic combat, hundreds of modifying items, and dangerously charismatic monsters in the best arcade arena style. It’s time to make a POPAPOM!

games.name: Dreamcards
games.summary: Build your deck during the day and at night fight the monster that haunts your dreams. Will you be able to escape the nightmare in this roguelike deckbuilder that combines strategy, occultism and psychology?

games.name: Quacolé Tennis
games.summary: Face the most unexpected opponents in completely crazy tennis matches. Win tournaments, overcome obstacles, and defeat giant monsters using the power of your racket! Embark on a solo adventure or invite a friend to explore the world of Quacolé Tennis in doubles matches.

games.name: BloodRush: Undying Wish
games.summary:
BloodRush: Undying Wish is a top-down hack n' slash game with a dark fantasy aesthetic.

In this game, the player is encouraged to aggressively use their combat abilities to evade, control and destroy their opponents, moving around in a deadly dance of carnage.

Focused on movement abilities, split-second decision-making, and stylish strings of attacks, the game is heavily inspired by titles such as Devil May Cry, Akane, Hyper Light Drifter, Hades, and Ultrakill.

games.name: Sapo 3D
games.summary: A 3D/Pixel-Art Platformer With Classic Elements Where You Will Control an Acrobat Frog. Collect Golden Flies to Unlock New Worlds, Levels and Other Surprises.

games.name: TerranLands
games.summary: TerranLands is a survival adventure game. Explore and gather resources in many different caves, build and craft new items in your home, and discover old Terran stories.

games.name: Au Revoir
games.summary: Use your investigative skills in this point-and-click adventure to retrieve human minds stored in synthetic brains in 2071. Immerse yourself in a retro-futuristic world with neon-noir graphics from the 90s, and uncover a conspiracy that will challenge everything you know.

games.name: Vampire's Veil
games.summary: Vampire's Veil is a Metroidvania where you control Selene, a vampire seeking to free her family, imprisoned by seven hunters. Face enemies like fairies and gnomes, battle powerful bosses, explore a dark world, and master unique abilities as you take revenge on those who betrayed you.

games.name: Divinastros
games.summary: An astronomical gambling game. Fight the Olimpians while each Zodiac sign affects your cards differently in a deeply satisfying deckbuilder game. Fight Greek beasts, discover Tarot Cards and climb the Olimpus searching for revenge.

games.name: Rotten Survivor
games.summary: Rotten Survivor is the ULTIMATE 2D top-down horde survivor game! Fight massive hordes of bizarre enemies! Upgrade your equipment, create crazy combinations between all of the different weapons and modifiers and become an unstoppable force!

games.name: Vampires vs. Mechas
games.summary: Help the vampires in their quest to take down the evil mechas of the human army and rescue their princesses from captivity, in this action-packed 2D action platformer.

games.name: Arashi Gaiden
games.summary: Arashi Gaiden is a turn-based action game, with frantic combat, in the dash-and-slash style. Arashi is a Ronin from the Pocket Bravery universe, he was hired by his former master, Lobo, receiving the mission of defeating Ninjas and Matilha soldiers to recover 3 powerful relics from Japan.

games.name: Doctor Viscera
games.summary: Trapped in an abandoned asylum with the sinister Doctor Viscera, who will stop at nothing to keep you there as his test subject for cruel experiments. Explore the old GrimmHaus Asylum in this PSX-style survival horror game.

games.name: Ghetto Zombies: Graffiti Squad
games.summary: Expect blasts of green zombie goo painting the screen in this top-down shooter packed with crazy guns that blow the heads off some… freaky zombies. Your mission is simple: graffiti the whole city before these mutants dog-pile you.

games.name: Shard Squad
games.summary: In Shard Squad, join elemental creatures to save their lands in intense battles against challenging hordes and bosses. Strengthen yourself with unique allies, gather valuable items, face epic calamities, and unlock new members to create unique strategies on your path to victory!

games.name: Dead on Delivery
games.summary: Dead on Delivery is a frantic action game where a pizza delivery guy battles zombie hordes to fulfill orders in an apocalyptic world. Wield improvised weapons, dodge hazards, and race against time to avoid becoming zombie food… and keep the pizza piping hot!

games.name: RoboGal: Gaga Delta Lady
games.summary: Rei-Bo was living peacefully on the island of Plutobell, until a giant spaceship crashed into the place! This is a fun and humorous saga to solve this incident full of obstacles and traps! Choose the levels in the order you want, defeat the ship's members and get their weapons in RoboGal!

games.name: Valiant Saga
games.summary: Valiant Saga is an action-platform game with RPG elements, set in a Dark Fantasy world. Unravel the mysteries that plague the kingdom of Dohendall and defeat the most brutal darkness creatures. A mixing of pixel art and stunning visual effects with an immersive original power metal soundtrack.

games.name: Spooky Tales: Volume 1
games.summary: A retro horror anthology featuring four standalone horror stories. Each tale is introduced by a macabre undead host with a twisted sense of humor. This is Spooky Tales: Volume 1.

events.name: GameSpain Direct: Spring 2026
