games.summary: A farming & restaurant management sim with base building elements. Grow in backyard to cook & serve! Discover new recipes by exploring ingredients on the island; gather, fish, raise animals & produce with machines. Manage resources, hire staff & grow your organic business into a 5-star restaurant!

games.name: Welcome to Elderfield
games.summary: Welcome to Elderfield is a spooky farming RPG. You can farm, fish, mine, cook, craft, befriend townsfolk, beseech the old gods, investigate mysteries, watch unsettling news programs, get lost in the dead mall, die in your sleep and more. There's lots to do in Elderfield!

games.name: Trees Hate You
games.summary: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

games.name: Sprawl Zero
games.summary: Sprawl Zero is a fast-paced shooter inspired by the Golden Age of 2000s FPS. Survive a brutal cyberpunk city collapsing under military rule and cult fanaticism. Use your Gravity-Gloves, augments, and an arsenal of over 40 weapons to crush those who stand in your way.

games.name: Afterbeat
games.summary: A musical bullet-hell where all things beautiful are deadly. Dodge well little nanobot, you don't have much time.

games.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
games.summary:
Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

TCG Card Shop Simulator is a trading card shop simulation where you sell card booster packs to earn money and build your card shop business.

games.name: Save My Human
games.summary: This is the story about a little girl who is taken to an evil world inside a video game, and her dog embarks on an adventure to save her. The dog will not be alone, he will encounter other pets who are also searching for their owners.

games.name: Shepherd Knight
games.summary: Shepherd Knight is an adventure game where you must guide your flock of sheep, with your faithful dog by your side, through a world infested with dragons, wolves, and other dangers.

games.name: Big Dig
games.summary: Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog win the election! Recover artifacts, grow your museum, and upgrade your tools while building a highway spanning the entire Animal Republic!

games.name: Puppergeist
games.summary:
Play as Claire, a witch who journeys into the mysterious Doggie Underworld with one simple goal: Finding her lost Pup!

As you travel through Doggie Underworld, you'll encounter countless souls, each with a story to tell. Share moments with them, play together, and listen to their heartfelt tales. Use your sense of rhythm to lift their spirits and ease their troubles, bringing you one beat closer to reuniting with your own lost Pup.

games.name: DogPunk
games.summary: DogPunk is a high-octane FPS where you play as a prototype dog soldier, fighting to escape confinement and uncover the mystery of your creation.

games.name: Astro Amigo
games.summary: Astro Amigo is a story-driven sci-fi adventure game where you explore a strange Wisconsin town, investigate its secrets, play mini-games, and make story-shaping choices as young Austin searches for his missing dog, Amigo.

games.name: A Short Quest
games.summary: Explore a hand-crafted world, overcome brutally challenging combat, and restore order to a broken kingdom. Discover unique weapons, tools, spells, and secrets in this short game inspired by old school action RPGs.

games.name: Remote Control
games.summary: Remote-control human proxies to explore a derelict spaceship. Type your commands, manage risk and decide how disposable a life really is.

events.name: INDIE Live Expo 2026.4.25
events.description:
INDIE Live Expo an information filled program for all the indie gamers around the world!
In this program, we will be introducing the hottest news of more than 150 indie games!
You WILL find the best game for you!

games.name: P.I.S.
games.summary: This is a steampunk puzzle game where you click or drag with your left mouse button to solve puzzles and free the protagonist from difficult situations. There's no text in the game.

games.name: Jötunnslayer: Hordes of Hel
games.summary: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel is a gripping roguelike horde-survivor game set in the dark realms of Norse Mythology. Fight waves of enemies to earn divine blessings of ancient Norse Gods, explore hostile worlds and face powerful bosses. Become a god-like warrior in this ultimate showdown.

games.name: Schematic Void
games.summary: Point-and-click, an anti-horror adventure with a mashed fourth wall, stylish minimalistic graphics, a relaxing plot and other advantages.

games.name: Gunma's Ambition: You and me are Gunma - Reiwa 2nd National Census Edition
games.summary: Let's change Japan to Gunma. Everyone Gunma.Let's change all of Japan to Gunma.The definitive edition of the Gunma simulation game.Everyone can play!

games.name: 30XX
games.summary: Jump, shoot, and slash your way through 30XX, the roguelike action platformer you can play with a friend! Explore lush, ever-changing worlds that mix precise platforming with fevered combat. Destroy fearsome Guardians. Master unique Powers. Rediscover the thousand years we've lost.

games.name: Hachishaku-sama
games.summary: The "Hachishakusama" legend at a massive scale! A student visits his grandparents and encounters "Hyakushaku-sama"—a 100ft tall entity. A 30-minute comedy-horror playable with just a mouse. Can you survive this BIG night?

games.name: Cat Cottage
games.summary: Cat Cottage is a cozy, relaxing idle game where players decorate a cottage, take photos of cats, and manage pet care tasks to unlock items.

games.name: Olga: Episode 1
games.summary: Relive Olga's childhood memories as she visits her grandparents' home in Belovodica, a secluded mountain village where some discoveries last a lifetime.

games.name: Pritto Prisoner
games.summary: Get ready for chaotic 4v2 party game action in Pritto Prisoner! Play as mischievous animal inmates using strategically messy peepee/poopie tactics to outwit highly customizable robot wardens. Break out, or get put to "deep sleep" in this asymmetrical escape game. Easy to learn, hilarious to master.

games.name: Isle of Food
games.summary:
Isle of Food is a VR cooking and exploration game set on a tropical island,
where every ingredient begins in the open world. You hunt, fish, gather and
grow what you need, then prepare dishes using natural hands-on VR cooking.

games.name: Dark Grid
games.summary: You wake up with only a luminous tower beside you, its warm light enveloping you. Besides, looking around, there is only endless darkness. Survival, exploration, utilizing all resources around to survive, searching for the reasons why the world is plunged into darkness.

games.name: Keplerian Space Discovery
games.summary: Travel through the solar system in your own spaceship! The motion of each celestial body is accurately reproduced by the Kepler equation.

games.name: Low Value Job
games.summary: LOW VALUE JOB is a dystopian job-simulation game where you sort scattered bolts, nuts, and washers by type. Pick up each part, examine it, and classify it accurately. Play solo to steadily raise your score, or compete online with players around the world to test your sorting skills.

games.name: NeNeKoNeKo
games.summary: NeNeKoNeKo is a puzzle game where you use three boxes to fit sprawling, oddly-shaped sleeping cats into place. Don't let the cute looks fool you — under a time limit, you need to quickly figure out the best combinations, making it a surprisingly challenging brain teaser. When time runs out, you get a revival chance with limited moves instead of a time limit, letting you think carefully and discover solutions that seemed impossible. Feel the rush when everything clicks into place!

games.name: Gong Go Girl
games.summary: A gentle visual novel that has fun with beautiful girls and no one needs to get hurt.

games.name: Skewer Squad
games.summary: Become the ULTIMATE Grill Master! Pick your favorite foods and seasonings to build your Skewer Squad. Drag, shoot, and bounce to keep those sneaky critters away from your precious grill!

games.name: P4st3l
games.summary: Pastel is an FPS horror game where you experience a beautiful liminal space and sub-mechanophobia towards underwater and above-water objects.

games.name: Golemworks
games.summary: Assemble a factory, manufacture golems, and defend yourself from ruin.

games.name: Iephosama: Digital Curse
games.summary: Iephosama: Digital Curse is a retro-style horror adventure game set in the summer of 2000. Players investigate the disappearance of a friend linked to a disturbing digital summoning game. With pixel art graphics and a narrative focus, you navigate through atmospheric environments and solve puzzles while uncovering chilling secrets. The game challenges you further by lacking a save feature, intensifying the experience.

games.name: My Card Is Better Than Your Card!
games.summary: Become the coolest kid of the playground in this playful roguelike deckbuilder. Craft every card yourself with adorable stickers and wow your rivals in tug-of-war card battles full of wonder!

games.name: Sakura-iro Tetra Prism
games.summary: Sakurairo Tetra Prism is a visual novel set in the summer of 2000, following a photography club from Kirigamine High School during their six-month study abroad in Akita. After a disappointing contest, they seek new creative opportunities while navigating new encounters and themes of distorted love. With fully voiced characters and an emotional soundtrack, the game immerses players in a richly woven story that evolves based on their choices.

games.name: Tower O-ven
games.summary: Tower O-ven is a simple platformer. Whether chicken escapes from tower of oven or not depends on you (and your luck).

games.name: Heartreasure: Stellar Journey
games.summary: Solve puzzles and search for hearts in a pop-up book-like universe! Hand-drawn illustrations, cute animations, and gentle piano melodies create a soothing moment.

games.name: Fugitive Free Rider
games.summary: The chairman’s daughter ran away without doing her assignment. Join the group project, take down the troublemakers, and capture the chairman’s runaway daughter. A thrilling hack-and-slash “musou” action adventure with a cast of colorful, distinctive characters.

games.name: Omelet You Cook
games.summary: The cozy chaotic cooking roguelike. Assemble omelets for quirky students using ingredients from a conveyor belt. Discover wacky combinations to satisfy the ever-demanding Principal Clucker.

games.name: Extreme Forklifting 3
games.summary: Live the dream as a forklift operator! Experience the thrilling life of a warehouse giraffe! Use your trusty forklifts to solve problems and deliver pallets. Pick pallets up, put them down, the only limit is your imagination!

games.name: Go! Go! Mister Chickums
games.summary: GO! GO! MISTER CHICKUMS is a fun, classic single-screen platformer, inspired by arcade hits of the 80s. The game can be played either in single player mode, or in local couch co-op with 2 players simultaneously.

games.name: Yume Roof
games.summary: Yume Roof is a sandbox slow-life game where you customize a voxel-style Japanese rooftop with furniture, colors, crafting, and dress-up. Gather materials, trade items, and improve your Cozy and Nature values to unlock new recipes through the dreams you see at night.

games.name: Bills Must Be Paid
games.summary: A short active incremental game where you smash piggy banks to pay your bills. Collect coins, upgrade, and get debt free!

games.name: Funimal: Fusion Animal
games.summary: Funimal is a turn-based sliding puzzle that you can always clear in 5 moves or fewer! The purpose is to move the ground and lead the unknown creature “Funimal” to the goal. Set on a mild planet drawn in pixel art, go to various fields and catch Funimal at your own pace!

games.name: Anlife: Motion-Learning Life Evolution
games.summary: Intervene in the evolution of virtual lifeforms that learn to move in a world powered by a physics engine. This world already features built-in mechanisms like heredity and natural selection. The player acts as a creator, manipulating these natural processes to help lifeforms learn and evolve.

games.name: Home
games.summary: A game about the short journey of a boy who left home. Experience a dense story within 2 hours, along with rhythm gameplay and music puzzles. Enjoy live acoustic sounds and a story that feels like a musical film!

games.name: Bug!Ban!Break!
games.summary:
Four-Zone Rhythm Game!
Feel the beat with simple controls!

games.name: Pratfall
games.summary: A co-op game where you fall, dig, and explode your way down a dangerous cave system to find your lost dog. Catch your friends and watch your step on this journey full of traps, hazards, and the most deadly force of all: gravity. Will you jump into the unknown to rescue your dog?

games.name: Duck's Island
games.summary: Ducks Island is a casual action game that combines short-session gameplay with light strategy elements. Players guide a group of ducks across an island, engaging in simple combat encounters and selecting upgrades that shape progression.

games.name: Stellar Wanderer
games.summary: Stellar Wanderer is a beautiful old-school space opera set in a vast open-world universe. Explore the galaxy and become a FIGHTER, TRADER, TANK or ENGINEER while following the main story line or choosing your favorite side missions.

games.name: Hamstory
games.summary: is a 2D pixel platformer with heartfelt emotion and thrilling challenge. Time your jumps to leap forward—falling is okay. Find your route through the paths ahead. Journey to Haessi Star with warm encouragement from animal townsfolk, experiencing a world that transforms with every season.

games.name: Caromble!
games.summary: This is not just another brick breaker game. This is Caromble!, a fresh new take on the brick break game! Free the corrupted world and fight evil with physics-based destruction, puzzles, explosions, skill-levels, power-ups, mayhem, more explosions, further puzzles, speedruns, superscore medals, unlockable challenges and some surprises you would't expect in a brick breaker game. Brick break your way to glory and discover a world of nostalgic wonder. Let’s get ready to Caromble!

games.name: Silent Castle
games.summary: “My dad was killed by the hero.” A short push-puzzle game about a boy cleaning up the deserted Demon Castle all by himself.

games.name: Toy Smash Kaboom!
games.summary: Toy Warfare, Physics Collisions, Auto Chess, Space Management, Item Crafting, Trap Setting, Countless Playstyles—Every Combo is a Brand-New Adventure!​

games.name: Dungeon Antiqua
games.summary: Dungeon Antiqua is a simple RPG inspired by the Wizardry and Final Fantasy games of the 1980s and 1990s, in which players traverse dungeons by repeatedly exploring and developing their characters.

games.name: Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together
games.summary: Cooking Simulator is back – bigger, better, and with optional multiplayer! Create your own recipes and take advantage of new and improved controls to become the best restaurant cook in the city! Or just have fun and enjoy cooking at your own pace. You’re the chef here!

games.name: Rollick N' Roll
games.summary: Marvelous marble runs, with a modern twist. Rollick N' Roll combines fun physics with intuitive controls to deliver a joyful puzzle experience for all ages. Expand your collection by unlocking fun vehicles and playsets, but be prepared for things to get a bit chaotic.

games.name: Blaze of Storm
games.summary: Blaze of Storm is a vertical scrolling shmup in which you use explosions from a variety of sub weapons to destroy enemies in cyberspace.

games.name: Butler Guillotine
games.summary: Flesh filled puppets in a mishapen hotel. No windows, no exterior. Follow different characters' intertiwining paths and unearth forgotten events from a time long gone. Bring the ceremony to a halt.

games.name: Stolen Realm Survivors
games.summary: Stolen Realm Survivors is an online co-op survivor-like auto-shooter. Battle hordes of fierce enemies, discover ancient artifacts, merge unique skill trees, and unlock powerful upgrades to survive. Wield the full power of the Stolen Realm. Play solo or with friends against relentless minions!

games.name: Cupiclaw
games.summary:
Cupiclaw is a cute & frantic claw machine roguelike deckbuilder.
Grab unique prizes, build powerful combos, face chaotic machines… and claw back your relationship!

games.name: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
games.summary: Live the double life of a fearless adventurer and a crafty merchant! Dive into vibrant dimensions brimming with shiny loot and pesky enemies. Grow your shop, tinker with weapons and gadgets, as well as make your mark among a ragtag community of castaways.

games.name: Stardust: Wish of Witch
games.summary: STARDUST: Wish of Witch is a single-player SRPG beautifully crafted in pixel art. Follow the secret of the wish-granting star and join the adventure of the girl “Star” and the mage “Yu”.

games.name: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth
games.summary: From the creators of Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley comes a heartwarming new adventure inspired by the beloved Moomin stories by Tove Jansson. This time, join Moomintroll himself on a charming but cold winter journey.

games.name: Dungeon Raze
games.summary: Here’s a fast-paced dungeon destruction shooter you can clear in as little as 30 minutes! Break walls for shortcuts, detours, or direct paths. Double ammo, halve reload time, and power up to smash through even the toughest walls!

games.name: Burgle Supply Company
games.summary: A co-op horror comedy game for you and your friends about burglarizing a nightmarish neighborhood full of mutated pets. No one said this would be easy, but maybe you can make it out of there with a sweet wood paneled video cassette recorder.

games.name: Smells Like Fear Blossoms
games.summary: Misaki moves into her grandmother’s old home and takes part in the annual “Flower Festival” held in the town. What she thought was just an ordinary festival soon turns out to be something else entirely… Flight and exploration, choices and discovery—by collecting hidden items and fragments of memory scattered around the town, she forges ahead through a world steeped in fear and mystery.

games.name: Nomori
games.summary: Nomori is a mind-bending puzzle game where you need to control time and space to journey through a shattered spirit world. Take shortcuts through portals, rotate your perspective, and control the flow of time to move forward, whichever way that is.

games.name: Path of Gear: Blacksmith’s Legend
games.summary:
Path of Gear: Blacksmith’s Legend is a tactical roguelite RPG that combines timeline-based turn-based combat with dynamic weapon forging.
Play as a legendary blacksmith who forges powerful weapons and supports adventurers in wielding them effectively.
Explore procedurally generated maps, face unpredictable events, and battle formidable foes in a journey filled with strategic challenges and surprises.

games.name: Hakoniwa Electric
games.summary: "Hakoniwa Electric" is a cute relaxing puzzle game. Explore adorable isometric stages, solve puzzles, and light them up. Why not spend a leisurely year as Akari, who's taken over grandpa's electronics shop, helping with the monthly troubles from the townsfolk?

games.name: Everything Is Crab
games.summary: The Animal Evolution roguelite. Hunt, Flee, Scavenge & Thrive in a living ecosystem. Choose from over 100 mutations to evolve your creature in countless ways with every run. Adapt to survive the natural curve in order to beat carcinisation... or get Darwin'd trying!

games.name: Don't Drop The Cake
games.summary: Let's deliver a cake to our customer. To reach them, you must traverse a space filled with monstrous creatures. If fear makes you tremble or you drop the cake in panic, you'll face the customer's wrath. This challenge isn't for cowards. Only the brave and composed will succeed. Are you up for it?

games.name: Bylina
games.summary: Embark on an epic journey to the Far Far Kingdom and challenge Koschei the Deathless to save your immortal soul and become a true hero in Bylina, an Action RPG rooted in Slavic folklore and myths. Take on the role of Falconet, a young bogatyr born without hero's powers, shunned and underestimated by almost everyone. Conquer numerous ordeals, overcome insurmountable odds, and become a legendary hero whose tales will be told for ages to come.

games.name: Lunarium
games.summary: Lunarium is an atmospheric fantasy A-RPG. Play as Ave, a light-armored knight, who teams up with Lune, a mysterious Starfarer. Together, they journey to save a dying world, engaging in challenging battles to retrieve the lost glow of the stars and forsaken memories, unveiling cosmic secrets.

games.name: Low Battery
games.summary: A sokoban game with power restrictions. Plan your route carefully to find your way out.

games.name: Stonemachia
games.summary: Stonemachia is an adventure in which you can fight and explore a world distorted by the Plague of angels, taking on the role of Zefiro, a pawn capable of transforming into other chess pieces. Venture into the lands of Medhelan and prepare to face armies of angels transformed into statues and objects inspired by Italian art, architecture, and folklore! Fight with a variety of abilities and precise timing in a parry-centric game, where the shield can truly change the outcome of every encounter! Discover the various transformations and their unique abilities to experience a Dantesque epic and uncover the secret of the chess pieces...

games.name: Commentator
games.summary: "Commentator" is a novel game where you become a commentator for a popular news program. By selecting the news to comment on and your critique stance, you will experience a manipulation of public opinion and a changing a world.

games.name: An Eggstremely Hard Game
games.summary: Two geese. One fragile egg. Infinite chaos. Work together to carry it through unpredictable challenges without breaking it, every crack makes it harder, every mistake more hilarious. A co-op physics game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of honking.

games.name: 1234 Connect Puzzle
games.summary: Blending the simple rule of sequentially tracing numbers with the trendy concept of 'physics puzzles' makes this game an irresistibly addictive experience!

games.name: Cat Isle
games.summary:
Cat Isle is a cozy pixel art management game inspired by Japan’s famous Cat Islands. It blends light management elements with a strong focus on atmosphere and player expression. While managing different types of shop supplies and understanding cat preferences is part of the experience, the game centers more on relaxing gameplay, fishing, interacting with cats, decorating buildings, and simply observing the world you create.

Players can unlock decorations through a Gashapon machine and customize shops and surroundings to shape the island’s look and feel. As you build and decorate, the island slowly transforms into a cozy space full of cute cats.

games.name: Pojangmacha: Korean Street Food Management Simulator
games.summary:
Under a snowy overpass, people gather around warm lights.
In this cozy management simulation game, run your own POJANGMACHA and serve Korean street foods like tteokbokki and ramyun.
Handle quirky events and grow your tiny stall into a street food success!

games.name: BBS (Bulletin Board System) Magica
games.summary: Magical Girl Programming ✖︎ auto-battle! An office worker is assigned to manage a fan exchange bulletin board when she was once a magical girl, Become a magical girl in cyberspace and protect the message board.

games.name: Pizzapocalypse 2
games.summary: A 3D platformer with a pizza moveset that's accessible & engaging to all skill levels! Explore different countries, and put a stop to the evil corporation ruining Pizza!

games.name: Box or Void
games.summary: Box or Void is a puzzle game about reversing positive and negative space. The obstacles in one space become pathways for the other. Move the characters and push boxes to change the layout of the levels. Master this duality and explore worlds with new mechanics that build on this core idea.

games.name: Robot Hospice
games.summary: "Robot Hospice" is a 2D pixel art adventure game where beloved robots spend their final days in a hospice. As a new staff member, you will gently yet painfully bid farewell to these cherished machines that once lived alongside humans.

games.name: Maseylia: Echoes of the Past
games.summary: Maseylia : Echoes of the Past is a 3d metroidvania that aims to reproduce the experience of a 2d metroidvania in 3d. It features a labyrinthine world in which you'll need to collect upgrades to unlock new passages and make your way out of the labyrinth.

games.name: Monsterest
games.summary: Manage a monster-friendly inn. Every day, a new monster guest visits. Chop down trees to make furniture and decorate the rooms. You'll need to catch fish, hunt, and prepare meals. Satisfied guests will return to your inn next time.

games.name: Mightreya
games.summary: Join schoolgirl superhero Reya and her manager Nio as they embark on their journey as Hero Content Creators, fighting monstrous beings that emerge daily from a dimension beyond. Anime-inspired, heart-pounding hero action is waiting for you!

games.name: Silver Blade of Gods' End
games.summary: A region-conquest simulation RPG where bonds with your allies shape fate. —The choices you make, and the battles you fight, will determine how the story unfolds. Fast-paced tactical battles. A strategic map mode where your decisions shift the tide of war. Preparation and growth that change destiny.

games.name: Akatori
games.summary: A colorful action platformer with metroidvania elements and a staff that unlocks unique combat techniques and new ways to overcome obstacles. Explore beautiful worlds, fight monsters, and help Mako stop the amber storms that poison all living things.

games.name: Forest Escape: Last Train
games.summary: Forest Escape: Last Train is a co-op horror exploration game for 1-4 players in the mysterious forest. Repair your locomotive, solve the insane Warden’s eerie puzzles, and outrun the stuff of nightmares as you try to escape this twisted realm.

events.name: InterfaceX26 Showcase
events.description:
It's time to celebrate over 30 new and upcoming FakeOS games with the InterfaceX26 Showcase!
Gamespot's Kurt & Lucy are joined by a panel of ‪Jesse Cox, Dodger, ‪Stormfall33‬ and ‪Nookrium‬ to present an assortment of upcoming games with fake operating systems.

games.name: Sprkls.exe
games.summary: sprkls.exe is a cute, melancholic story-driven adventure that unfolds entirely on your desktop.

games.name: Alawon: Life of a Game Composer
games.summary: Alawon is a life sim where you manage a game composer career. Rise from game jams to AAA, balancing life and work. Make money, make friends, make love, and make music in Alawon's Digital Audio Workstation — then export and share your creations to make your mother very proud.

games.name: Database Detective: Minor Crimes Division
games.summary: Solve criminal cases through the power of SQL queries! Help out the city of Los Zorangeles by becoming a Database Detective in this new (unpaid) work from home opportunity.

games.name: New Folder
games.summary: You log on to a computer having no clue of what lies within. Explore its files, solve puzzles to recover missing pieces, and decipher passwords to enter otherwise prohibited folders. As you delve deeper into its content, you’ll find that there is a greater mystery to be solved.

games.name: Lost Wiki: Kozlovka
games.summary: Explore a wikipedia-like database and solve a small town mystery in Eastern Europe. Step into the shoes of a journalist in the 90s as you sprawl through articles and uncover the secrets that have been laid in front of you.

games.name: Murder Meet Cute
games.summary: Look, just because I’m paid to fix computers, doesn’t mean I’ll sit here and listen to your life story. So what there’s been murders? Do I look like a detective?

games.name: Directory Dungeon
games.summary: A tiny dungeon crawler played right in the Windows File Explorer. Explore a monster and loot-filled dungeon by dragging and dropping your player folder into new rooms, equip powerful files, defeat terrible monsters, and banish evil once and for all.

games.name: Omi Oh My AI
games.summary: Go on a captchavating adventure with Omi, a friendly (if a bit quirky) artificial intelligence! Learn to see the world the way Omi does as you solve image, word, and number puzzles inspired by the CAPTCHAs we’ve all had to do to prove we’re not a robot. Go outside the game and explore websites chronicling Omi’s development and learn how to solve the game’s stranger puzzles in this game inspired by AI, I Love Bees, the 90’s, and the constant need to prove you’re not a robot.

games.name: Deep Fog Signals
games.summary: Stuck in an outpost deep in a sea of toxic fog, your crew has been decimated, you're cut off from the outside world, and oxygen is running out. Use limited bandwidth to coordinate unstable crewmates, conduct esoteric research that could change the world, and interpret strange signals from the deep.

games.name: MobOS
games.summary: mobOS is a game that updates in real time and takes place exploring an alternate universe's operating system and its internet in the year 2005.

games.name: MyDear.exe
games.summary: Celebrate love with Ellie and Lucien in MyDear.exe. A short and cute game that takes place in the folders of an old DIY PC. In the shoes of Ellie, play the game offered by Lucien after a long life together. Humor, memories and love are on the menu of this short 2 hour experience.

games.name: Plobania 47/B
games.summary: Immortality is not a blessing, it is a burden. As Milton Clarke, you work at the 47/B Mandatory Sleep Hospital, review documents, surf the internet, and decide who will no longer exist. You don’t kill anyone. You only “put them to sleep.” The rules are clear. Every decision has consequences.

games.name: Forbidden Solitaire
games.summary: Forbidden Solitaire is a card-slashing horror game about unearthing the contents of a cryptic 1995 CD-ROM that should have never existed. From the creators of Ancient Enemy and Home Safety Hotline.

games.name: Desktop Explorer
games.summary:
Desktop Explorer is an eerie point-n-click mystery game through the abandoned profiles of an old PC.

Rummage through the abandoned profiles of an old PC to unravel an inherited mystery. What secrets hide in this eerie adventure of cryptic games and outdated software? Who was using this computer? And what happened to them?

games.name: Heaven Does Not Respond
games.summary: Heaven Does Not Respond is a psychological and analog horror simulation game set in an alternate 2005 timeline. Play as intelligence agent, exploring a retro computer interface to decrypt hidden files, watch mysterious videos, and uncover dark secrets behind a young man’s sudden death.

games.name: Homepage
games.summary: A horror anomaly finder where you are contracted to observe websites and report errors and changes. But there is more to your clients than meets the eye.

games.name: Shutter Story
games.summary: Your friend is convinced his house is haunted. Examine his family's photo album to reveal signs of the paranormal, as the horror unfolds in the house around you. Their fate is in your hands.

games.name: My Helpers
games.summary: My Helpers is an experimental horror game that hides a group of virtual… "assistants" inside your machine. Find them by combing through your real files, exploring weird applications, and using your computer in ways you may have never expected - and remember: this is just a game.

games.name: I.T Never Ends
games.summary: The printer is bleeding, the Wi-Fi is haunted, and Ticket #666 just came in. As the latest hire for a company run by cosmic horrors, your job is simple: Swipe to survive. Make binary decisions to survive the night shift in this dark comedy desktop simulator. I.T truly never ends.

games.name: Lovebyte.exe
games.summary: A parasocial VTuber dating chatsim where you join a friendly degen discord group to chat about your oshis together, but is your kamioshi actually one of your new friends? Chat, uncover irl identities, & romance a fellow fan - or maybe a VTuber. Inspired by Mystic Messenger, online communities, and internet spam

games.name: Short Short Fictions
games.summary: A short short mix tape of one story that connects three shorter stories. On the NewWave, a magical game console that is retro but new, enjoy DON'T SAY YES, TO:NORTH, and a secret tale nobody yet knows. Welcome to a slightly fantastical and nostalgic world of painful, toilful, and beautiful stories!

games.name: Syntaxia
games.summary: SYNTAXIA is a dream-dark adventure game that allows you to rewrite reality itself by changing the words that describe it. Use your creativity and intuition to escape. Which path will you choose?

games.name: Super Real AI
games.summary: Welcome to Super Real AI, the ultimate AI Simulator where you are the intelligence. Judge, classify, and share your advice—but be careful, your answers for simple requests have super real consequences. Log in today and bring back the intelligence where it belongs: to humans.

games.name: ZeroPrompt
games.summary: The internet is dying. You're a verification operator. Filter out AI impostors from humanity's last clean network. Interrogate live LLM agents that think, lie, and bribe in real-time. Use investigation tools to detect deception. Every verdict shapes the internet.

games.name: Imprinted
games.summary: Looking for a forensic specialist to restore damaged audio tapes (late 1970s). Warning: The artist was involved in the occult; she disappeared under suspicious circumstances. The nature of the recordings may be distressing. Mental clarity and resilience are a must. QUOTE REQUESTED.

games.name: Void Future: Hacking Protocol
games.summary: In Void Future: Hacking Protocol, you play as a hacker in a cyberpunk world ruled by corporations. Hack, solve puzzles, and uncover a global conspiracy. Hunted by a system that never sleeps, you’ll need to stay hidden, outsmart surveillance, and fight to survive.

games.name: Dolos: Your Best Future
games.summary: A sci-fi political thriller. Live the life of an operator of DOLOS, a social regulation system predicting everyone's future. Analyze applicants' profiles and decide about their lifetime career. Apply DOLOS' logic or find how to counter it ... but don't get fired!

games.name: The Outer Frame
games.summary: Discover the truth. Bury it better. Decide how before the masses turn on you. A choice-driven mystery where witnesses and evidence are in your hands.

games.name: Digital Processing
games.summary: You're the new hire in a weird office where they just want you to sort numbers in to buckets. Sort numbers, earn employee merits, and manage your own team to prove you have what it takes to reach the top in a mysterious corporate workplace. A short narrative-driven incremental management sim.

games.name: Author Sim
games.summary: Have you ever dreamed of becoming a world-renowned author? Now's your chance! Study masterpieces from other authors, craft breathtaking stories, and maintain a public profile in pursuit of your dream.

games.name: The Games You Make
games.summary: “Quit your job, take out a loan and make a top seller game” sounded like a great idea two months ago. Now, you’re chasing bizarre bugs, combining features that should never go together, and striving to capture that mysterious thing called “fun”. Every decision is yours—and so are the consequences.

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Cocoboy
games.summary: COCOBOY is a 2D puzzle platformer within a 3D retro gaming simulation. Hack an ’80s cult classic with modded abilities, decorate your bedroom with rare collectibles, and scour a 2005 gaming forum where a peculiar fandom takes root.

games.name: Please, Watch the Artwork
games.summary: Night surveillance at the museum but the paintings are alive. A lonely clown roams the canvases. Watch, listen and report any changes. Paranoia-inducing. Weird. Melancholic. Relaxing? No jump scares or monsters, but the game can feel oppressive at times.

games.name: Bedrotting Simulator
games.summary: A high-intensity survival horror/resource-management game about late-night calls, desperate defenses, and a collapsing relationship. Argue, comfort, and compromise to keep your e-girlfriend from leaving—then barricade doors, set traps, and fend off demons.

games.name: Cold Case: The Red Dress Murder
games.summary: A point-and-click mystery where you’re tasked with investigating an unsolved murder. Scour case files and periodicals to piece together a thrilling story of deception and drama. Learn about the victim and the people closest to them, and uncover their secrets to discover what really happened.

games.name: Danchi Days
games.summary:
Help Hoshino bring her hometown back together in a comedic-yet-bittersweet story set in 2000s Japan! She'll face malevolent forces, uncover truths about her town, all while reconnecting with neighbors and her grandma living with dementia.

By gingham games - that's sandy powder, mogumu, and Melos Han-Tani (of Analgesic Productions)!

games.name: DarkwebStreamer
games.summary: You? An occult streamer on an alternate 90s internet. Your goal? Become #1. The problem? The supernatural is REAL. Manage your stream, do weird rituals, make weird friends and experience a different story every time in this procedurally-generated psycho-horror RPG streaming sim.

games.name: Execute
games.summary: Kill everyone in the world with a guillotine… on a cursed Win98 desktop.

games.name: Frutiger Space
games.summary: Frutiger Space is a social multiplayer game about the future we were promised.

games.name: Game Settings
games.summary:
A journalist receives a mysterious package. A console. And a game. No combat, no score, no objectives, only movement, and a menu full of cryptic settings you’re meant to adjust.
What are you really configuring? The more the mystery unfolds the more you wonder who’s really in control.

games.name: Heroes For Hire
games.summary: You've joined a guild before, right? So, where's the trouble in managing a guild of your own, too? Guide your heroes, raid some dungeons, and grow your guild to rise from the bottom of the ranks right up to the top in Heroes for Hire!

games.name: I Hate My Waifu Streamer
games.summary: Draw the attention of the streamer at any cost, before someone else does it. Write comments, chat, make donations to your waifu, but do not dare to hate her!

games.name: Neuron Activation
games.summary: A frantic rhythm-puzzle game filled with micro-challenges. Push buttons, flip switches, shoot targets and more in search of high scores to appease your overlords.

games.name: Your Forever Friend
games.summary: Your Forever Friend is the solution to never feeling alone again! Play video games, listen to music together, reminisce about buried memories... And there's absolutely nothing wrong with it. NOTHING ! <3

games.name: Worming from Home
games.summary: Be the Worm of Wall Street in this silly simulation game about working a remote finance job. Throw your spineless body around the keyboard to invest in the stock market and earn obscene amounts of money. Buy upgrades, train skills, and worm your way up to the promotion you've always dreamed of!

games.name: ProTax 98
games.summary: A short 90s bureaucratic horror game where you process impossible tax forms for the living, the dead, and the unborn.

events.name: Creature Feature Showcase 2026
events.description:
The Creature Feature returns at 9:30am PT, May 6! Tune in for new VR game announcements, big updates and some mind-blowing surprises.

You can expect updates from games such as Deadly Delivery, Compass, and Wordbound, plus new announcements.

This is Creature's annual celebration of all the incredible studios published under their label. Expect brand new game announcements, new content for some of your favorite games, new platforms for existing games and this time Creature is not alone, we invited some incredible friends we made along the way to present their cool game as well. All from a wide assortment of genres with a focus on quality, art, and fun.

games.name: Laser Dance
games.summary:
From the creator of Cubism comes LASER DANCE, a mixed reality game that turns your living room into a laser obstacle course straight from a spy film!

Players move between two buttons on opposite ends of their living room, traversing a sequence of laser patterns which adapt to the room’s size and layout. Different laser patterns will have them move in different ways, as they dance, dodge, and crawl their way to the finish line.

Easy to learn but hard to master - Laser Dance’s deceptively simple gameplay makes for a perfect party game to get both newcomers and seasoned VR players moving in mixed reality!

games.name: Compass
games.summary:
Compass is an open-world VR flying adventure set among otherworldly skies.
You are a scout flying ahead of a wandering Caravan, charting safe routes through unknown skies.

Pilot your ship across shifting landscapes, navigate hazardous environments, solve physical puzzles with grapples, upgrade your vessel, and uncover the secrets of a sky where something stirs within the clouds.

games.name: Crime Shop Simulator
games.summary: Crime Shop Simulator: A Prison Boss Game is a VR crafting game where you play as a shop owner smuggling prohibited stuff. Produce and sell beers, erotic magazines, cigarettes, and more! But watch out, the police are cracking down on contraband!

games.name: Crossings
games.summary: Explore and Fight your way through an ever-changing world in a quest for vengeance and survival in an epic Adventure through the Norse afterlife. Meet fellow lost souls in seamless and wordless VR Co-op as you Block, Dodge, Strike and Power your way through Trolls, Draugr and other dark beings.

games.name: Wordbound
games.summary: Wordbound is a mixed reality puzzle game where the world is made of words. Take a journey to unscramble the world, solve daily challenges, and craft your own puzzles to share with friends!

games.name: Porta Nubi
games.summary: Your goal is simple: guide a beam from its source to its destination. But each level introduces unique obstacles and interactive elements that require thoughtful problem-solving. Use portals, blockers, mirrors, and environmental mechanics to shape the path and overcome each challenge.

games.name: Sweet Surrender
games.summary: Sweet Surrender is a roguelite VR shooter in a dystopian megatower. Explore levels. Discover secrets. Maneuver through treacherous environments. Collect an arsenal of guns, upgrades and explosives to mount a major assault on the machine overlords. Fight your way to the summit!

games.name: Forefront
games.summary: Forefront is an intense VR shooter featuring 32-player large-scale battles, land, sea, and air vehicles, and immersive, tactical combat. You are the tip of the spear in the war between a global energy giant and resistance forces. Which side will you take?

games.name: Spymaster
games.summary: In a world where privacy and trust are a luxury most can’t afford, the agents of NODE are the last line of defence. Combining action-packed sequences and puzzle-solving in immersive missions, command three elite agents with unique skills and manipulate time using the top secret C.A.S.S.E.T.T.E.

games.name: Janet's Planets
games.summary: Come on up to Janet’s Planets, the friendliest terraforming service in the Milky Way! Fix up faraway worlds, meet the aliens who live there, and make yourself at home among the stars.

games.name: Beat the Beats
games.summary: Beat the Beats is an electric mix of rhythm and boxing! Use real in-ring style-punches to pound your way through musical arcade levels in hypnotic VR. Get pumped, get moving and beat the beats!

games.name: Crepe Master!
games.summary: Crêpe Master! is a beat ‘em up VR adventure where you transform into a magical girl! Become the reincarnation of the Crêpe Goddess, defend your home against an alien invasion, and stop the ruthless tyrant threatening the Earth’s most beloved treat. Saving the world has never been tastier.

games.name: R.A.I.D
games.summary: A co-op VR sci-fi shooter where you inspect interstellar cargo ships, hunt smugglers, and raid hostile spacecraft. Scan trucks, board enemy ships, upgrade outrageous weapons, and choose between protocol or profit in solo or 4-player co-op action.

games.name: Wrath: Aeon of Ruin VR - Brutal Edition
games.summary: Hunt the corrupted Guardians and purge a dying world in Wrath: Aeon of Ruin VR, a brutal old-school FPS built in the legendary Quake engine and reimagined for virtual reality. With dual-wielding combat, physical reloading, and deadly artifacts at your command, the darkness doesn’t stand a chance.

games.name: Roboquest VR
games.summary: A VR port of Roboquest being developed by Flat2VR Studios for Meta Quest, PlayStation VR2 and SteamVR.

games.name: Trombone Champ: Unflattened!
games.summary: Trombone Champ: Unflattened will take the charming and quirky gameplay of the original Trombone Champ and bring it to life in a fully immersive virtual reality environment. In this reimagined version, players will honk, blow, and toot their way through over 50 unique songs, all within a vibrant and dynamic 3D space.

games.name: Bomb the Hill
games.summary: BOMB THE HILL is a cinematic VR downhill skateboarding experience inspired by the outlaw spirit of 70s freeride culture. Race through dangerous mountain roads, slide through traffic at insane speeds, discover hidden shortcuts, and survive brutal crashes

games.name: Sock Puppet Superstar
games.summary: Control a singing sock puppet with your hand in VR. Perform solos or two-handed duets, unlock ridiculous voices and accessories, and put on the greatest sock concert of all time.

games.name: Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades 2
games.summary: Shoot, loot, and scoot as a sentient hot dog in the sequel to Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades (H3VR), the award-winning, best-selling Immersive FPS. Master an arsenal of the best guns in VR. Fight your way through an endless proc-gen megastructure. Chill out and plink on the range. Wonderful!

events.name: Star Fox Direct 5.6.2026
events.description: The Star Fox Direct will begin at 3pm PT on May 6, 2026. The presentation will be roughly 15 minutes.

games.name: Star Fox
games.summary: Star Fox is an action-packed adventure based on Star Fox 64, featuring newly overhauled character designs, freshly revamped looks for each stage, plus detailed cutscenes, fully voiced dialogue and a sweeping orchestral soundtrack. The game also includes Joy-Con 2 mouse controls and a brand-new GameChat feature that puts you in the cockpit as your favorite characters from the Star Fox universe.

events.name: Nacon Connect 2026
events.description: Nacon Connect returns for its 2026 edition! Get ready for exciting updates on our biggest games, brand-new announcements, and exclusive surprises. Don’t miss out on what’s next!

games.name: Dracula: The Disciple
games.summary: To cheat death, you must uncover the secrets hidden within Count Draculas castle. Only by mastering the occult arts and solving mystical puzzles can you save yourself. Eternal life comes at a price!

games.name: Hunter: The Reckoning - Deathwish
games.summary:
Vampires, Werewolves, Witches. What if I told you that the things that go bump in the night are real? What if I told you that you could see them?

Awaken to the truth you’re now a Hunter. Build your character, select skills, and work with a team of allies to investigate the monsters hidden in plain sight, to find their lairs, and to eradicate them. All the while, investigating a story that drags up memories from your past, ones that could change how you see the future.

Welcome to the World of Darkness.

games.name: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss
games.summary: A mining station in the Pacific abyss is no longer responding. As an investigator of the occult, unravel the mysteries of the deep. Test your wits and sanity in this thriller inspired by the master of Providence.

games.name: Dragonkin: The Banished
games.summary: The draconic threat is once again upon us. Legendary heroes rise up to face the legions from the depths. Tame your wyrmlings, create unique power builds with the Ancestral Grid, expand your city and destroy the Dragons!

games.name: Gear.Club Unlimited 3
games.summary: The Gear.Club series is back! Customize and set up your favourite cars to race at top speed along the roads of the French Mediterranean coast and Japan. Don't just win – show off your style!

games.name: Edge of Memories
games.summary: The Corrosion, a plague of unparalleled proportions, has already ravaged the Astryan continent. On the other side of the world, the continent of Avaris and its nomadic peoples—so far spared from the horrors spawned by this abomination—now stand on the brink of extinction. Eline, an itinerant Soul Whisperer, relentlessly battles the force that turns the once-thriving fauna, flora and humans of this lush land into grotesque abominations. Following a mysterious encounter, a dark power awakens within her, one that may hold the key to ending this apocalypse: the ability to control the Corrosion within her own body.

games.name: Hell is Us
games.summary: If war is the closest we get to hell on earth, it's because Earth harbours the worst of demons: humankind. In an isolated country ravaged by infighting, discover the secrets of your past and deal with the repercussions of a mysterious calamity.

games.name: Curse of the Crimson Stag
games.summary: Curse of the Crimson Stag is a story-driven mystery thriller in which you explore a blurred line between supernatural occurrences and past tragedy. Uncover what led to the abandoning of the once luxurious Whiteroot Hotel. Local myth tells of a wrathful spirit known as the Crimson Stag…

games.name: Ravenswatch
games.summary: Fallen heroes of old folk tales and legends: you are on the verge of a crucial battle against the Nightmare invading and corrupting your world. A roguelike action game from the creators of Curse of the Dead Gods, playable solo or in online co-op.

games.name: Tour de France 2026
games.summary: Take on the best international cyclists with one goal in mind: winning the 2026 Tour de France. Conquer legendary mountain passes, launch your sprints at the perfect moment and emerge triumphant on the Champs-Élysées wearing the Yellow Jersey.

games.name: GreedFall: The Dying World - Peren's Black Mass
The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
games.summary: In up to four player co-op, form a group of explorers searching for treasure. In this cursed jungle, danger is everywhere and monstrous creatures alter reality. Stay clear-headed and tame the jungle before it devours you…

games.name: Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Rageborn
games.summary: Set in the World of Darkness, Rageborn sees Taylor rise as a pack leader to become Gaia’s fiercest warrior. Master three forms of the Garou, explore the wilds of Alaska, and confront the Wyrm in this visceral action-adventure metroidvania.

games.name: Hunting Simulator 3
games.summary: This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog or fellow hunters by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.

games.name: Endurance Motorsport Series
games.summary: Manage the race from the stands, drive legendary cars and enjoy a genuine endurance race experience. As both driver and engineer, in this unique simulation victory can only come through teamwork.

events.name: The ANZ Indie Showcase 2026
events.description: The ANZ Indie Showcase premieres THIS FRIDAY at 7:30pm AEST followed by ANZ Indiefest on Steam.

games.name: Huedini
games.summary: Huedini is a top-down action roguelike game. Play as Huedini, a powerful wizard with the ability to change his colour. By matching your colour, to that of the enemies you can absorb their colour essence. By combining these colour essences into the correct combination, you can cast custom spells.

games.name: Up ' N ' Up: Mountain Express
games.summary:
Deliver mail up the side of a mountain upgrading your 4WD as you go.
Like an arcade Mudrunners with a roguelike twist.

games.name: L8r Sk8r
games.summary: L8R SK8R is a 3D platformer inspired by the classics of the fifth generation but with a unique twist that will make you feel like a speedrunner.

games.name: Ligmanauts
games.summary: Classic platforming action brought kicking and screaming into the voice chat era. Roll, bounce, grab, swing, and boost through compact challenge based worlds with friends online or locally, backed by an original liquid dnb soundtrack.

games.name: Drift Market
games.summary: Destroy supermarkets, fight absurd bosses, and turn your trolley into a weapon of mass destruction! Drift through chaotic stores as a furious mutant fruit and unleash over-the-top, physics-driven mayhem in this ridiculous smash ‘em up.

games.name: Doomsday Diner
games.summary: Chaos! Cooking! Combat! In a post-apocalyptic world where hot dogs are cheap and life is cheaper, you manage the last functioning hot dog diner. Cook hot dogs, brew coffee and serve bizarre orders. Upgrade your diner and shoot down raiders who want your hard-earned cash.

games.name: Castle Cab
games.summary: Castle Cab is a hilariously chaotic action sandbox game that puts you in the horseshoes of a majestic, yet slightly unhinged, steed. Hitched to your trusty cart, you’ll gallop, drift, and crash your way through a bustling medieval world where rules are more of a suggestion.

games.name: Middle Management
games.summary: Middle Management is a satirical office building and management game. Design an office. Hire the right talent. Spread your tentacles. Keep your rebellious workers productive. Delve into brains to design the perfect employees. DON'T YOU DARE cross your boss or his INFLUENTIAL clients.

games.name: Davy Jones' Deckhand
games.summary: Unleash outrageous counter-attack chains in this swashbuckling adventure where every voyage is a brutal roguelike deckbuilder. Will you break free from Davy Jones’ Locker?

games.name: Trading Card Inspector
games.summary: Inspect your way through dozens of unique, hilarious cards in this chilled-out papers-please-em-up! Identify and appraise cards from The World's Most Coolest TCG! Start your new job as an official Habubis Trading Card Inspector and uncover a tale of friendship, corporate espionage and murder?!

games.name: Zodiac Mountain
games.summary: "Zodiac Mountain" is a roguelike deckbuilder following the journey of a Panda as they adventure to become a Chinese Zodiac. Utilise dual hands of Yin & Yang, encounter fierce mythical characters, outskill your enemies in battle, and climb Zodiac Mountain.

games.name: Night Shift: 1999
games.summary: Balance work, vampirism and socialising as you explore Kings Cross, Sydney during the last year of the millennium. Keep a lid on your darkest desires and be rewarded with a deeper understanding of what it means to live again. Or don’t — no one will stop you. You’re a vampire, after all.

games.name: The Recipe for Life. A Journey Through Silent Apocalypses
games.summary: You are a traveler with a cracked soul and a house on wheels. Your mission is to listen to those standing on the edge and find the right words before strangers fall silent forever.

games.name: Haunted Bloodlines
games.summary: Haunted Bloodlines is a first person survival, psychological horror game. In the dark rooms of an expanding mansion, a terrifying story unfolds. As the mansion breathes, hidden secrets lay within its walls. Survival depends on your own sanity. Always remember time can either be a friend or an enemy.

games.name: Blighten
games.summary: Blighten is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

games.name: Night Plane
games.summary: Night Plane is a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed plane. Check tickets, serve passengers, and decide who stays onboard as demons hide among innocent souls. Naturally, management says it’s your problem.

games.name: After Hell Freezes Over
games.summary: Venture into the desolate frozen wasteland in this open-world survival horror. Struggle to survive in the cold, where strange creatures roam in the darkness. Build a shelter, collect supplies, fend off unimaginable threats, and fight for survival After Hell Freezes Over.

games.name: Hawker
games.summary: Hawker is a Roguelite Action-RPG where you must pay or evade a debt to Death in a procedurally-generated grimdark world. Scavenge, barter and fight for ichor, life, and truth. Thirty days, an impossible debt. Pay, or Fall.

games.name: ShatterRush
games.summary: ShatterRush is a multiplayer FPS where fluid parkour movement and massive mechs meet fully destructible environments to create flow-state movement combat you’ve been waiting years for!

games.name: Anticitizen: Red
games.summary: Use bullet time, a variety of movement mechanics and an improvised arsenal to outwit and outgun biker gangs and corporate police in an American-occupied cyberpunk Australia. Meet a unique cast of Aussie battlers, delve into the lore of the new American empire, and stay for the larrikin charm.

games.name: Blood Reaver
games.summary: A Dark-fantasy, Round-based FPS. Become the Blood Reaver in solo or 4-player co-op. Harness forbidden magic and weaponry to shoot, blast and slice your way through endless hordes of demons. Upgrade your arsenal and survive long enough to discover the ancient secrets of the gods of hell.

games.name: Skelemental: Monk's Fury
games.summary: Reborn as the Skeleton Monk after a deadly betrayal, you scour a ravaged and corrupted land to find your captured lover and exact revenge on the one who killed you. Master impactful martial arts combos imbued with elemental power to avenge your own death and bring balance to the land of Mortis.

games.name: Ground Zero Hero
games.summary: Kill mutants. Absorb their remains. Mutate into something stronger every run. Stack insane power combos and survive overwhelming hordes in this fast, chaotic, highly replayable action roguelite bullet hell.

games.name: Roomspeed
games.summary: Challenge yourself and other players in a daily gauntlet! Put your platforming skills to the test and come out on top against in this addictive daily platforming challenge!

games.name: Rhythm Hotel
games.summary: Rhythm Hotel is open! Grab your camera and capture Einstein’s secret identity! Next door, Socrates is in a heated debate with a stubborn donkey. Don’t panic! It’s our special rhythm challenge — fall behind the beat and you might get kicked into a dimensional rift by the donkey!

games.name: Box Knight
games.summary: A funny, silly and irreverent action RPG roguelike. A mix of ‘the Office’ and ‘Lord of the Rings’ with a comic like aesthetic.

games.name: Canvas City
games.summary: Canvas City is a turn-based tactics RPG of rebellion on rollerblades. Lead a crew of skaters and street artists rising up against an oppressive regime. Each map is a battleground and a canvas, where your actions shift control, leave your mark, and shape the city’s future.

games.name: Ten Thousand Coins: The Golden Merchant
games.summary: Ten Thousand Coins: The Golden Merchant is a story-driven merchant adventure that will test your sense of strategy and empathy as you make tough decisions for a fox merchant girl aiming to save the life of a loved one.

games.name: Gateworlds
games.summary: Gateworlds is a survival colony sim set in a wilderness shaped by five fickle gods. You begin with a small band of villagers, stranded on a hostile world. Lead your people as they survive, build, craft, hunt, explore, and vie for the favour of the gods. Journey across floating worlds connected by mystical portals, each world bearing the influence of a god’s power.

games.name: Forage Wizard
games.summary: An incremental crafting game where you click your way to alchemical mastery. Progress through a branching skill tree and explore the forbidden woods. Collect resources and build machines of magic. Slay monsters, farm crops and automate your production to become the all-powerful Forage Wizard!

games.name: Management in Space
games.summary: Management In Space is a gritty sci-fi strategy roguelite where you find yourself in debt. Build, mine, trade, and defend using stations across the galaxy, all while wars swells, aliens devastate sectors, and cults rip the galaxy apart & release interdimensional demons upon the universe.

games.name: Beyond These Stars
games.summary: Journey on the back of the space whale Kewa, building a city for your people as you travel across the galaxy seeking purpose and answers, and developing deep relationships with the universe around you.

games.name: Dungeon Pizza
games.summary: A cooking game with a fantasy twist! Knead the dough, spread the sauce, and prepare… the rat chunks?! Open your own pizzeria deep inside a dungeon, serving weary adventurers who come to rest and refuel between their quests and bounties.

games.name: Batography
games.summary: Play as a curious bat on his mission to take a full fledged photo of the moon. Run, Climb, Glide and Snap your way through an array of obstacles while interacting with the cheeky characters in the neighborhood. Can you collect all ten moon cakes?

games.name: Bravest Coconut
games.summary: Bravest Coconut is a silly game about solving story-driven puzzles, meeting a cast of quirky characters, and exploring a world littered with secrets... and you’re a cat.

games.name: BraveCart
games.summary: A narrative turn-based puzzle adventure about an abandoned shopping cart who defies two empires and sparks a revolution!

games.name: Hand of Fate: Hordes
games.summary: Hand of Fate: Hordes is a dark-fantasy bullet heaven auto-shooter powered by your strategic deckbuilding mastery. Survive the horde, forge your build, and unleash devastating attacks to escape a netherworld beyond the 13th Gate. Thrive in chaos!

games.name: Mingle
games.summary: Find your perfect match in the crowd. Match and merge minglers. Repeat until they're all joined together. 50 unique playable characters.

games.name: Bashful Adoration
games.summary: Fight for your love with 2-4 friends locally or online in easy-to-learn, hard-to-master combat. Soar the skies on your broom, and dash and smash props and opponents until they're a twinkling dot on the horizon! Secure powerups, land devastating blows, and win the adoration of your crush!

games.name: Slumbering Woods
games.summary: Explore a wild fungal forest and cultivate it by planting mushrooms that spread and transform the land. Open new paths and help a remote village thrive.

games.name: Lone Pine
games.summary: Lone Pine is a single-player, 2D adventure set in the fictional Lone Pine National Park. You play as Izzie, who has come to Lone Pine to try to photograph some of its mysterious, undiscovered 'cryptids'.

games.name: Loftia
games.summary: Welcome to Loftia, a cozy, multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! Connect with friends both old and new, to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and create a meaningful impact - together.

games.name: Enter the Chronosphere
games.summary: A psychedelic roguelike that blurs the line between real-time action and turn-based tactics. Play as misfit aliens, craft wild combinations between hundreds of weapons, items and abilities, and disable uncharted chronospheres: Colossal structures that consume time and distort reality.

events.name: PLAYISM GAME SHOW 2026.5.10
events.description: We'll be bringing you announcements on 11 indie game titles, including some titles being shown for the very first time, so don't miss it!

games.name: No Case Should Remain Unsolved
games.summary: Twelve years after Senior Inspector Jeon Gyeong's retirement, she is visited by a young police officer: a woman who pleads with her to reexamine Seowon's case. But with each uncovered memory, only one thing becomes clear: everyone in Seowon's vicinity was lying.

games.name: Dungeon Sweeper Plus
games.summary: Expand the world map by uncovering surrounding tiles, aiming to complete your in-game Encyclopedia. Just be careful not to step on dungeon tiles (landmines)!

games.name: Midnight Train: New Moon
games.summary: A 2D exploration-based horror adventure game set in a creepy train and mysterious buildings.

games.name: There’s Something Wrong With the Hero’s Choices
games.summary:
It's supposed to be a simple novel game, but the "choices" are just plain weird!?
A wildly unconventional text adventure game where twists beyond your imagination await!
Guide the hero's party to the Dark Lord by making one bizarre choice after another!

games.name: A Passing in the Night
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a third-person adventure game in which you take a timed, one hour-long night walk. Explore a reactive and surreal neighborhood where reality bends and spirits lurk in the shadows. Converse with other lost wanderers and reclaim hope in a bleak world.

games.name: DevilConnection
games.summary: "Shall we do something immoral?" A demon-teasing adventure where you summon unique kemono and gather magical powers to restore the naughty demon "Debirun's" form!

games.name: The Dream Of A Cockspur
games.summary: Stranded on a desolate island with Earth's final researchers, you investigate a mysterious celestial body. The day before departure, the return boat is damaged, forcing an extended stay. Is someone playing tricks, or does the island want to kill all of you?

games.name: Samurai Bringer: Rampage
games.summary: Samurai Bringer: Rampage is a deck-building auto battler where you strategically form your squad by arranging samurai units and combining weapons and abilities to suit your tactics. Build your own unique formation and unite the land under your rule!

games.name: Iron Bramble
games.summary: Momentum-based platforming built around expressive movement and tight gunplay. Master your elastic grappling hook to explore a vast, cyber-gothic megastructure, where robots piloted by the souls of the dead do penance for their sins.

games.name: Idol Manager: Virtual Venture
games.summary: The management simulation game Idol Manager depicted the good and bad sides of the idol industry... another entry in the series is here! This time, the focus is on virtual streamers! Manage a new streaming agency and raise your staff to become the best agency in the industry.

games.name: Rose & Camellia Collection
games.summary: The graceful, beautiful, and elegant slap battle of the historied Tsubakikoji ladies has emerged. Your swipe becomes the face slap to your foes!

events.name: Start Your Engine Festival Showcase
events.description: Celebration of engines in games! Whether you want to drift through mountain passes, haul cargo across a post-apocalyptic wasteland, run a transcontinental rail empire, or sail an open sea with the wind at your back, there's an engine here for you.

games.name: Exo Rally Championship
games.summary: Exo Rally Championship is the galaxy’s most dangerous off-road racing event - remote, unexplored, extreme exoplanetary rally. Master a brutally realistic racing simulation and fight for every second gained on your quest to become a champion.

games.name: RoadOut
games.summary:
The world is dominated by an A.I. and rebel groups take refuge in a desert area known as the DeadZone.

Claire survives by executing delivery, sabotage and murder contracts for local leaders, while discovering about her past, revealing strange evidence that links her existence with the origin of the A.I.

games.name: Project: Aurora
games.summary: Project: Aurora is an exploration game combining elements of RTS, survival and adventure games. You are the captain of the research mission, which lands on the surface of the newly discovered planet.

games.name: Aether & Iron
games.summary: Immerse yourself in this narrative RPG set in an alternate 1930s where anti-gravitational technology has taken cars, roads, and even New York City into the sky. Muster a crew, master tactical, turn-based combat, and unravel the dark secrets lurking beneath the floating metropolis.

games.name: Fruitbus
games.summary: Fruitbus is a cute culinary adventure, set in an open world where taste is everything. Upgrade your trusty truck and visit a whole world of new destinations together.

games.name: Deep Space Exploitation
games.summary: Deep Space Exploitation is a space mining game featuring 2D physics, fully destructible asteroids, and a story of survival under an exploitative corporation. Use your equipment wisely, upgrade your ship, and make difficult decisions to secure your future!

games.name: Oh Baby! Kart
games.summary: Kart Racing. Ultimate abilities. Over 100+ Karts. 100+ Challenges. Unique racing modes including Race Royale and Grand Prix Duo.

games.name: Outbound
games.summary: Explore a colorful world and build your own cozy home on wheels. Craft workstations, and source energy from the sun, wind, or water. Upgrade and customize your vehicle, grow crops, and live sustainably off-grid with up to 4 players.

games.name: Aloft
games.summary: Soar the skies in Aloft, the co-op sandbox survival game set in a world of floating islands. Build any island into a skyship, your home in the clouds. Find lost knowledge, cure the fungal corruption, and brave the hurricane to restore the ecosystem.

games.name: Road Truckers: New Beginning
games.summary:
Live a trucker’s life in the first trucking sim RPG. Explore villages, cities and wilderness in a fully customizable truck. Get on-foot to eat, sleep, and help people along the way. Your goal: to bring back prosperity in your region. Drive, grow, and inspire!

Experience trucking on a new level: by driving and interacting with the world around you. Make your truck unique by customizing it mechanically and visually, inside and outside. Meet people and decide how to approach them. Enjoy the beautiful scenery in different weather conditions. But most of all, see the change you’re making by supporting the economy.

games.name: Breaking Armor
games.summary: Operate a super-heavy tank alone on a post-apocalyptic Earth. Face enemy tanks and alien beasts across deadly missions, and upgrade your tank to survive the escalating threats.

games.name: Driving Life
games.summary: Driving Life is a hardcore driving survival game set in rural America. Earn money by driving manual cars, vans, and trucks, transport tourists, pay rent, buy fuel, and survive on a tight budget. Every dollar counts - spend wisely or go broke!

games.name: Nomad Drive
games.summary: Repair your rundown RV and hit the road in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, customize your RV, and survive as long as you can. Every journey offers a unique experience!

games.name: Far: Lone Sails
games.summary: Far: Lone Sails is a vehicle adventure game. The player needs to maintain and upgrade their unique vessel to traverse a dried-out sea, with the remains of a decaying civilization scattered out on the seabed. Keep your unique vessel going, overcome numerous obstacles and withstand the hazardous weather conditions.

games.name: Bus World
games.summary: Bus World is a game about passenger transportations in various conditions, starting from standard days of a bus driver and ending with rescuing people who suffered from disasters.

games.name: Node: The Last Favor of the Antarii
games.summary: NODE: The Last Favor of the Antarii is a 2.5D puzzle platformer about a robot navigating a Cold War nuclear complex. Execute timeline-based commands to control NODE. Unravel mysteries, explore the unknown. Your commands decide the outcome.

games.name: Iron Roads
games.summary: Lay tracks, buy trains, and set their routes using board game-inspired mechanics to optimise your network. Run your enterprise efficiently while avoiding backlogs, jams, or angry passengers, and you'll be recognised for the unsung train hero you know you are.

games.name: Deliver At All Costs
games.summary: Deliver At All Costs is a thrilling action game where destruction, absurdity and intrigue collide! Step into the shoes of Winston Green — a down-on-his-luck courier with a fiery temper and a mysterious past — as he delivers highly unconventional cargo, leaving a trail of havoc and chaos behind him.

games.name: Lost Host
games.summary:
Lost Host is a story-driven adventure puzzle game about a small toy car searching for its missing owner.
When the boy mysteriously disappears, the toy car begins a journey through the house and beyond, exploring dark rooms, hallways, foggy streets, and abandoned places while following clues to uncover what happened.

Players control the toy car as it navigates dangerous environments, solves physics-based puzzles, and interacts with objects to progress. The world is full of hazards for a tiny toy car - heights, fire, water - as well as enemies such as dogs, robotic vacuums, and hostile toy creatures.

The game combines atmospheric exploration, light horror elements, and emotional storytelling, creating a family-friendly adventure centered on mystery, discovery, and survival in a large, human-sized world.

games.name: Silent Road
games.summary: Drive through Japan’s suicide ring in your night-shift taxi. Pick up strange passengers, fulfill their unsettling requests and follow the silent road as their stories make each ride darker than the last.

games.name: Frostrail
games.summary: Through the frost, death follows the tracks. Dive into a ruthless open world survival FPS, solo or co-op. Explore, scavenge, craft and fight to endure a frozen, corrupted world. Operate and upgrade your steam-powered train through an unforgiving wasteland, where every choice is a matter of survival.

games.name: Over the Hill
games.summary: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

games.name: Arctic Drive
games.summary: First-person survival road trip in a procedurally generated frozen wasteland. Drive and upgrade your off-road vehicle alone or with up to 3 friends, scavenge for fuel, food, and parts, and survive hunger, thirst, and sub-zero temperatures.

games.name: Sledders
games.summary: Rev' up your sled & dive into fresh powder in Sledders! Realistic, physics-based snowmobile simulator in backcountries full of deep snow. Ride with and against your friends in online multiplayer. Can you reach the peak before others? Show off your sled-skills now on Sledders.

games.name: Iron Nest: Heavy Turret Simulator
games.summary: Iron Nest is a brutal dieselpunk heavy-artillery game where you dominate the battlefield through a colossal war machine. Take map measurements based on the received coordinates, strain the hydraulics, and gunlay the cannons to unleash devastating blows ⟹ Will you obey High Command, Operator?

games.name: Lou's Lagoon
games.summary: A cozy exploration-and-crafting adventure: fly your seaplane between tropical islands, collect resources with the Swirler 2000, rebuild storm damaged communities, and unravel the mystery surrounding Uncle Lou’s disappearance.

games.name: Make Way
games.summary: Speed around loops, dart through train crossings, drift around helter skelters, and unleash wacky weaponry in this modern take on classic top-down multiplayer racing games. The twist? You build the track.

games.name: PACS: Post Apocalypse Courier Service
games.summary: Can you build delivery vehicles to survive the post apocalypse? Go it alone or with up to 4 friends as you navigate treacherous environments, make deliveries, customise vehicles, scavenge for parts, and grow your delivery business!

games.name: Taxi Life: A City Driving Simulator
games.summary: Climb into the driver's seat of your car and your business, transport passengers across Barcelona and grow your company! Can you help relieve the transportation challenges of a city that never sleeps?

games.name: Truckful
games.summary: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

games.name: Hot Lap Racing
games.summary: Awaken Your Inner Champion! Hot Lap Racing is a simcade racing game where you will discover the history of motorsport from GT Cross to Formula 1 and race against your friends or compete against players online!

games.name: Parking Garage Rally Circuit: European Tour
games.summary: 8 all-new courses across Europe!

games.name: Heading Out
games.summary: Hop into a muscle car and drive through the American West in a game inspired by 1970s road movies. Enjoy the ride in this narrative-driven racing experience with a comic book aesthetic. Choose your own route across the USA in a game where every run is a personalized, unique experience.

games.name: Petal Runner
games.summary: Hop on your bike and join Cali & Kira as they explore the sun-soaked city of Sapphire Valley and train to become Petal Runners! Make deliveries, meet new friends, play minigames, and discover a wholesome slice-of-life story about growing up and letting go.

games.name: Railborn
games.summary: Railborn is a survival game where you build your train piece by piece. Navigate a world entangled by branching tracks. Find rare plants to cultivate on your farms. Upgrade your train - manage its power systems, direct resource flow, and distribute water. Designed for 1 to 4 players.

games.name: Apocalypse Express
games.summary: Conduct, upgrade and repair your train through endless waves of enemies in a post-apocalyptic setting. In this action management roguelike, the player decides to embark on a journey through the wasteland looking to fulfill the dream of seeing the remains of the outside world.

games.name: Trail Out
games.summary: Welcome to the Trail Out festival! Reckless races in different parts of the planet await you! Explosions of cars, shouts of departing drivers, hype from fans, all this awaits you here!

games.name: Adrift
games.summary: Drift away in the serenity of the desert. Untwine a labyrinth abyss and find oasis’s to unwind. Unveil a forgotten land sand swallowed. But remember, once you finally get lost, ADRIFT, just you, a truck and nothingness, it marks the arrival to the beginning, from here, you start to find your way.

games.name: Without A Hitch
