games.summary: Without A Hitch is a co-op delivery game where you transport cargo across an apocalyptic landscape. Whether driving solo or in a convoy of 2 to 4 players, you must navigate chaotic hazards, scavenge vital parts, and escape from THEM. Can you survive Without A Hitch?

games.name: Schrott
games.summary: SCHROTT - the roguelite driving game: Pull off insane stunts, collect valuable loot, and customize your absurd vehicle.

games.name: Sail Forth
games.summary: Heave! Fake the bull rope and stay the mizzen royal! Command a fleet of custom-rigged sailing ships on a procedurally crafted adventure over an unending ocean whose ancient depths have swallowed the key to a planet’s mysterious past. The Deepblue calls with the bellow of High Adventure! Sail Forth!

games.name: Victory Heat Rally
games.summary: An intense, retro arcade-style racer that embodies the spirit of classic 90's racing games. Experience high-speed action, vibrant retro aesthetics, and non-stop drifting thrills as you challenge friends-turned-rivals. Get ready for an exhilarating ride!

games.name: Windpunk
games.summary: Recycle The Apocalyptic Wasteland, with a moving waste disposal plant. Craft, Refine, Survive. Restore the environment to a balanced ecosystem and recruit help by finding survivors.

games.name: Steam to Electric
games.summary: Build and optimize your railway network in this elegant voxel rail tycoon. Transport passengers and goods, unlock crazy-but-real historical train inventions, and evolve from steam to electric. Easy to start, deep to master. From the creators of Station to Station and Town to City.

games.name: On Donuts and Holes
games.summary: A psychological adventure through a dreamy landscape. Face unanswerable questions to reach the ultimate enigmas: Who are you? Who am I?

games.name: Green Light
games.summary: A forgotten mining town. Peaceful by day, mysterious by night. Enter the dream and unravel the town's secrets.

games.name: Short Short Fictions
games.summary: A short short mix tape of one story that connects three shorter stories. On the NewWave, a magical game console that is retro but new, enjoy DON'T SAY YES, TO:NORTH, and a secret tale nobody yet knows. Welcome to a slightly fantastical and nostalgic world of painful, toilful, and beautiful stories!

games.name: Mindhack
games.summary: "Mindhack" is a text adventure game that turns the villain's head into a flower garden.

games.name: :(Blues Clean
games.summary: :(Blues Clean is a lawn-mowing research action-adventure game. It is currently under development by the indie game development team MOKUREN, with pixel artists APO+ and hako, creator of Unreal Life.

games.name: Detective Nekko
games.summary: Mystery adventure where no one dies. Use your “ability to see too much” to uncover an inconvenient truth.

games.name: In:Dark Recall
games.summary: "I'm sure you'll find me." IN:DARK RECALL is a deep sea diving action game. You wake up at the bottom of the sea, as the target you'd been hired to eliminate.

games.name: Piano at 5 am
games.summary: "Piano at 5 am." is a short text adventure game. A girl who is the main character wanders in a fog forest while adjusting the four factors of "drowsiness," "thirst," "madness," and "recharge," which increase or decrease depending on the choices she makes.

games.name: Platonica Space
games.summary:
Open the door and step into someone's memories.
Platonica Space is a psychological exploration adventure where you search countless rooms to recover lost memories.

games.name: Everything Will Be Fine!
games.summary: A dark conversation with a girl during a nightly car trip. A short multi-ending novel game where you try to understand this girl and her pain.

games.name: Ghostpia Season Two
games.summary: The second Ghostpia game.

games.name: GenEi AP: Empty Heart
games.summary:
Travel through the world of Harumakigohan in a quest for music.

”What are you listening to, Mikage?”
Spica is looking for something to listen to, and Mikage, the protagonist, goes on a journey in a mysterious world to search for songs that will please her friend.

What’s behind that last door? What is that heartbeat you can hear?

games.name: Moonless Moon
games.summary: When night falls, she wanders into another world... Moonless Moon is a text-based adventure game following a girl as she travels through a variety of different worlds.

games.name: Recolit
games.summary: Recolit is a pixel art mystery adventure game where you explore a strange town by following the trails of "light". Help out the mysterious residents of the town by using items illuminated by the "light" to progress through the story.

games.name: Ou
games.summary:
"Between somewhere and someone."
U-chronia is a mysterious world constantly changing like a book whose pages are flipped out of order. You will wear the shoes of OU, the protagonist, to live through this game-shaped experience—without knowing what it really is.

games.name: World for Two
games.summary: A sudden catastrophe has led life on Earth to the verge of extinction. The Professor, the only survivor, spent years performing research in an underground laboratory trying to recreate life. The energy he needs to do this can only be harvested outdoors, where he himself cannot go. He therefore created an android to help him. Plants are the only living things left in this world where human civilization is no more. It is cruel, but beautiful. The Professor and the android embark on a quest to bring animals back to the planet. This is a tale of creating life on a dead planet. World for Two is coming to Nintendo Switch! The animations for all creatures have been redrawn, to help them come alive even better. Once you complete the main story, you will be able to enjoy “Chapter 0”, a new special story that includes new art and music and will tell you more about the Professors’s past. And as an added bonus, once you complete the game, you will unlock the option to change the main story’s soundtrack to a fascinating new version played by a piano quintet (piano, two violins, viola and violoncello)

games.name: Unreal Life
games.summary:
After losing her memories, the girl could only remember one name—"Miss Sakura".
She set out to find Miss Sakura, aided by a talking traffic light, and by the power to read the memories of the things she touched.

"Unreal Life" is the story of her journey.
Compare memories of the past with the present, solve mysteries, and follow the girl and the traffic light in this atmospheric puzzle adventure game.

Follow the memories, follow the path, and what you will find is...

games.name: From_.
games.summary:
Mr. Postman sails his small boat through watery Aquaria, delivering letters day in and day out.

One day, he awakes to find something strange and unbelievable following him, just as a dark rumor begins to spread through Aquaria.

As the letters he delivers bring writer and reader together, the truth begins to come into focus.

games.name: Machina of the Farthest
games.summary: "Wouldn't it be awesome to fly?" Travel to the world's end in this warping-boomerang adventure with its beautiful pixel art.

games.name: Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino
games.summary: "Where will their light lead them?" Kitsune is a fox girl who finds herself on Adashino Island and starts travelling with her Frog friend. Neon signs give light and color to the island with a Japanese-inspired atmosphere. Something is lurking in the shadows, inching ever closer...

games.name: Chikaro
games.summary: A boy and an android girl wake up without their memories in a world where deadly robots roam the streets. With the boy's powers, they can leave their bodies to walk through walls or possess enemies. The two follow the trail of the intentions left behind by those who once perished above the ground.

games.name: Piggy One Super Spark
games.summary: PIGGY ONE SUPER SPARK is a single-player action game starring Xiamy, Yuez, and a lost newborn baby they happen to find. Follow the trio in their chaotic but heart-warming adventure!

events.name: Six One Indie Showcase - May 21st, 2026
events.description:
Join us on May 21st, 2026 at 11:50 AM ET / 8:50 AM PT for 61 indie games in 93 minutes! 

We’ve got world premieres, debut trailers, and a bunch of awesome indie games from all over the world; some you’ve been waiting for, and plenty you haven’t even heard of yet. 

The Six One Indie Showcase was created to give indie developers a platform, especially those who might not have the resources to break into the traditional showcase scene. What started as a scrappy passion project has grown into a professionally produced event, and seven showcases later, our mission hasn’t changed. No paywalls, no barriers: just a spotlight for indie devs to take center stage and shine.

Zero barriers. Zero ad spots. Zero nonsense. Just games.

games.name: The Big Con
games.summary: Flex your inner teenager in The Big Con, an adventure game where you hustle across the country as a teen trying to save your family video store. In classic 90s con movie style, you'll get to persuade and pilfer your way to greatness using a whack of potential grifts.

games.name: Well Keeper
games.summary: Well Keeper is a bullet hell roguelite where you move by flapping. Battle waves of enemies, upgrade unique and unexpected abilities and become immensely powerful!

games.name: Hypnos
games.summary: Hypnos is a first-person adventure and exploration game, set in a lovecraftian megastructure fever dream. Enter the Nameless City at the edge of Dreams. Follow the trail into the shadow of the Holy Mountain. Embrace your destiny.

games.name: Wax Heads
games.summary: A cosy-punk slice-of-life narrative sim about managing a struggling record store. Chat to quirky customers with unique tastes, explore a handcrafted record collection, fall in love with bands (and their drama!), or just slack off with your colleagues – all to restore the groove!

games.name: Spirit Swap: Lofi Beats to Match-3 To
games.summary: Spirit Swap: Lofi Beats to Match-3 To is an action-puzzle game set in a lush, narrative-driven world of witchy demons. Cast spells, be queer, & crash the biggest concert of the year!

games.name: Blue Ridge Hunting
games.summary: Blue Ridge Hunting is a co-op horror game where you and your friends investigate, document, and hunt cryptids in the Appalachian Mountains.

games.name: SacriFire
games.summary: A modern JRPG-inspired game with a unique battle system, rich story, fantastic visuals and music by Motoi Sakuraba.

games.name: Feather's Edge
games.summary: Dash and slash through an innovative kinetic metroidvania. The Tower of Time awaits – a rich, handcrafted world fractured by the collapse of time. Slice through foes in tough-as-talons bite-sized battles, and master the way of the bird warrior.

games.name: Aikyam
games.summary: Dazzle the hearts of disgruntled villagers with extravagant turn-based battles and rally them against demons in this Bollywood-inspired fantasy RPG!

games.name: Twins of Olus
games.summary: Twins of Olus is a vibrant action-adventure game that follows a young Uthran who is inexplicably tied to the spirit of an ancient warrior. Together they must defeat an unknown nefarious force that has invaded, corrupted and possessed everything in his once utopic world.

games.name: Sonnet
games.summary: Transport a magical flower across scenic lands, encounter strange travelers, and uncover the kingdom’s secrets in this sprawling medieval roadtrip.

games.name: The Well's Blessing
games.summary: Explore the mystical sanctuary of the Old Well and reconnect with your childhood friends while solving environmental puzzles. Meet quirky animals, unravel forgotten tales and immerse yourself in an interactive soundscape as you piece together your place in the world.

games.name: Abide
games.summary: ABIDE is a psychological first person horror game using prosthetic gore effects, stop motion and dolls scanned into 3D models. A peaceful retreat where people go to get better. A place for people to air their demons.

games.name: Vale's Echo
games.summary:
2D cozy horror adventure that blends dark comedy, psychological storytelling, and surreal art.

In Vale’s Echo, death isn’t the end — it’s your last chance. Players take on the role of Vale, a sarcastic and troubled soul who wakes up on a mysterious train to nowhere. No pulse. No past. No clue. Her only company? Echo — a floating skull full of secrets, charm, and just the right amount of mischief.

As Vale and Echo journey through the underworld to confront Death and uncover Vale’s past, players will meet a bizarre and unforgettable cast of characters — from chatty fish-human hybrids to leech merchants and morally dubious spirits. Each encounter challenges not just Vale’s choices, but also the player’s empathy, humor, and sense of right and wrong.

Gameplay in Vale’s Echo revolves around dialogue choices, unsettling puzzles, and branching narratives that shape Vale’s relationships, memories, and ultimate fate.

Beneath its eerie charm lies a deeply emotional story connecting the surreal with the human — all wrapped in cinematic visuals, melancholic music, and darkly witty writing.

games.name: Midnight Horde
games.summary: Midnight Horde is a gothic horror casual action game with rogue-lite elements where you battle thousands of enemies and upgrade the castle. Discover the secrets of the castle and upgrade weapons and fortifications to keep darkness at bay.

games.name: Death Pong
games.summary:
A brutal beer pong game where losers are getting electrocuted.

A skill-based challenge set in an underground bar full of illegal, deadly matches.

games.name: RollerGirl
games.summary: A narrative adventure about a summer spent rollerblading in the mid-2000s. Explore a quiet town as Naomi, a teenage girl looking for an escape. Your in-game MP3 player isn't just for music; its playlist shapes the world & story as you run errands for quirky neighbours / get entangled in local drama.

games.name: Hips N Noses
games.summary: HIPS N' NOSES is a café management simulation! In a sleepless world, Mela is the only one who dreams. She runs a café that restores lost memories. Serve guests by day, battle in nightmares by night to collect the memory flower, customize your café, and become the most renowned owner!

games.name: Forklift Flowerpot: Botanical Investigator
games.summary: Change between three seasons on a strange archipelago to solve puzzles, quiet-quit your forklift job, and dismantle the potato-dominated shipping industry. When you're done exploring, kick back and play a deckbuilding card game in a wild attempt to dethrone your local Gods.

games.name: Go North
games.summary: Wander a world filled with cleverly-crafted mazes. Whoever can solve them all gets their wish granted by the Maze God. Explore beautiful mazes, discover unique items and help other maze explorers complete unusual side quests in this cozy and immersive maze adventure!

games.name: Treetopians
games.summary: Treetopians is a cozy colony simulator where players build vertical villages in the treetops and care for a growing community of villagers with unique needs and personalities.

games.name: Ourlands
games.summary: Ourlands is a cozy island builder where you handcraft and play around in bespoke little lands and truly explore your creativity. No goals, no management, just vibes.

games.name: Kaz
games.summary:
KAZ, your shot of dopamine wrapped in a minimalist roguelike. Execute lightning-fast moves with frame-perfect controls : easy to learn, hard to master. Immediate, Intense, Addictive. Every run makes you better, faster, hungrier, unlocking tons of unique items, skins and challenges.
4 keys, no excuses: Prove your skill and dominate the ranks.

games.name: Blocks for Babies
games.summary: Blocks for Babies is the puzzle-shooter mashup of your dreams. Clear falling blocks by forming complete lines, or go in guns blazing to clean up the board the messy way. Hard and soft drops aren't your only tools anymore—now you have a shotgun.

games.name: Black Jacket
games.summary: Gamble your way out of hell in this blackjack-inspired rogue-lite deckbuilder. Play powerful card combos or cheat to outwit your opponents and earn your freedom. Win their Soul coins! Bribe the ferryman! And uncover the story of those who stand in your way.

games.name: Mörk Borg Heresy Supreme
games.summary: Mörk Borg Heresy Supreme is a doom-metal action RPG set in the world of Mörk Borg. Wretched antiheroes explore a side-scrolling, semi-procedural grimdark fantasy world, searching for a way to prevent the apocalypse or make the suffering worse.

games.name: Rain98
games.summary: Tokyo, 1998. A rain that never ends and a girl who wants everything to end. Two lonely youths will change the world with their choices.

games.name: Deep Pixel Melancholy
games.summary: Deep Pixel Melancholy is a visual novel about being stuck in a time loop inside a gray, soulless city. Unravel the mystery, and decide whether escaping is really worth it.

games.name: Mayak
games.summary: Hard-sci-fi side-scrolling VN about first contact, love, and a prime-number countdown. You are a young astronomer researching a newly received signal from a distant star. Unravel an alien mystery — and fight to save the one you love.

games.name: Sucker for Love: Crush Landing
games.summary: Put the ‘love’ in 'Lovecraftian horror!' When a captivating comet named Hheily crashes into your apartment, you are drawn into an interplanetary conflict between light and dark. Feed Hheily's fire to save the world in this horror-comedy visual novel… and maybe even win a smooch!

games.name: Painted Kingdoms
games.summary: Painted Kingdoms is a minimalist strategy game where you paint, build, and defend your Kingdom of paper. Harness the power of paint to protect it from relentless flames and enemy hordes. Will your Painted Kingdom survive the next wave?

games.name: Prison of Husks
games.summary: A nostalgic souls-like set in a painted afterlife. Awaken as a doll and seek your beloved. From parries to pistols, tune your build to overcome adversity. Explore dense, interconnected levels full of secrets and shortcuts as you battle pigment-hoarding bosses and seek your lost love.

games.name: Lunr.Rdio.Taxi
games.summary: lunr.rdio.taxi blends drifting and rhythm into an exhilarating spacetime 'Drifthm' adventure! Slide and boost your way through the solar system to the beat of Brazil's best DJs and earn big as an interplanetary taxi pilot trying to pay an infinite debt in this hypercapitalistic BrazaFunk future.

games.name: Please Insert Disc
games.summary: Please Insert Disc is a puzzle horror game about navigating the underbelly of a 2000's era gaming console in an attempt to restore its functionality. From the creators of Home Safety Hotline.

games.name: Isle of Reveries
games.summary: Make a pilgrimage skybound to the Isle of Reveries, where any wish can be granted. Conquer mysterious dungeons, solve head-scratching puzzles, and fight dangerous enemies in this retro-inspired action adventure.

games.name: Graytail
games.summary: Graytail is a Zelda-like action-adventure game with interactive puzzles and combat set on a small island in the Pacific. Find the missing best female pilot and uncover the secrets hidden on the island.

games.name: Mouseward
games.summary: 3D retro styled collectathon meets souls-like. Play as a tiny mouse warrior solving the mysteries of the fallen stars,

games.name: Fraymakers
games.summary: Fraymakers is a full-featured modular platform fighter from McLeodGaming, the creators of Super Smash Flash 2, the most popular Smash Bros. fan game on PC. It features a main cast of beautifully sprited and hand-animated characters, detailed stages from their worlds, and a massive selection of assists from a broad selection of indie titles!

games.name: Re:Rite
games.summary: Transform from a tiny, scrappy survivor into a skyscraper-sized Kaiju, as you fight through swarms of enemies in this chaotic PvE game. Hack-and-slash through hordes of spider-bots, clear through crowds with bullet-hell ranged weapons, and even team up with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

games.name: Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter
games.summary: Jump, dash, and brawl your way through beautifully animated 2D platforming levels, then shift perspectives into dynamic top-down 3D street zones to gather rare ingredients in chaotic, GTA2 - style street battles! Every fight feeds your menu. Every level is a recipe for madness.

games.name: Kaiju Cleanup
games.summary: Relax and unwind by cleaning up the world’s biggest corpses. In a Cleaning Sim like no other, your job is to slice up and tidy away Kaiju carcasses, leaving the city clean and serene. Until the next Kaiju attack, obviously.

games.name: Gang of Frogs
games.summary: Sail through the galaxy as a fearless outlaw frog. Plunder loot, upgrade weapons, eat flies and fight through hordes of monstrous bugs in an intense 1-4 player co-op shooter.

games.name: Cutout Village
games.summary: Cutout Village is a narrative, cozy, city-builder game in which you will have to build villages using simple and unique mechanics: cutting, folding and gluing. Restore the family home, revive your village and create spaces filled with fruit trees and histories to live!

games.name: Cards & Cannons
games.summary: Build epic worlds, collect shiny loot and upgrade your defenses in this roguelite tower defense deckbuilder! Crush endless enemy hordes with mighty spells and crazy builds in unique runs. Defeat powerful bosses and conquer world after world in this colorful medieval madness!

games.name: Pirofauna
games.summary: Burn, little Flame, burn... Light up the misty forest, dispel the darkness... Let tiny bugs emerge from the nooks and crannies, gazing at your spark.

games.name: B-e-e-t-l-e: Be right back!
games.summary: The sequel to b-e-e-t-l-e, b-e-e-t-l-e: be right back! is a short, cozy keyboardventure where you can type casually and take your time. Explore strange lands, solve unique puzzles and discover whimsical new ways to use your keyboard as you embark on a journey to find your lost beetle.

games.name: Muri: Wildwoods
games.summary: Explore the mysterious creature-filled Wildwoods as a Muri. Find secrets, solve puzzles, befriend creatures, and clean away the corruption. Restore the world's beauty in this cozy adventure!

games.name: Walk The Frog
games.summary: Guide Froggo through a world on sticky notes and relax while solving the puzzle of his journey home. Make new quirky friends, help each other out and overcome many obstacles. It’s a cozy and heartwarming point&click adventure with a unique and easy drag&drop puzzle style.

games.name: Sloppy Forgeries
games.summary: Sloppy Forgeries is a fast-paced, two-player local multiplayer painting game. Each player is given a mouse, a blank canvas, and a few simple paint tools. Each round, a famous painting from art history is revealed. Players race to copy the painting as quickly and accurately as possible.

games.name: Jupiter Junkworks
games.summary: Fast paced arcade puzzle action awaits you in Jupiter Junkworks! Complete arcade puzzle contracts to earn resources while rebuilding and upgrading a ruined spaceship junkyard. All set in a sci-fi narrative campaign mode where you'll join an unlikely trio of travellers as they overcome challenges.

games.name: Necrowave
games.summary: Necrowave is a game about the emotional life of a zombie stuck in a microwave. It's a 2D platformer with critical based combat where each different enemy feels like a puzzle you need to solve instead of relying on brute hack & slash tactics.

games.name: Being Food
games.summary: Being Food is a third-person, Bird Game. In this puzzle-platformer, you play as a cute bird named Oolahla in what starts seemingly like a normal bird day. Something is different about today, though... Do you know what it takes to be a bird? Will you survive the bird day?

games.name: Flip-Flop Fury
games.summary: Smack deserving targets with flying footwear in this fast, projectile-steering arcade game. Short, replayable runs with tons of challenges, instant restart, bullet time, unlockable footwear, and juicy, reactive physics.

games.name: Bad Badger
games.summary: You're a bad Honey Badger. Smash out of your enclosure and wreak havoc across an Open-Zoo sandbox. Break, escape, sneak, smash, steal, ride, trick & taunt. BE BAD!

games.name: RMF's Ragdoll Physics Experiments
games.summary: Build absurd contraptions, launch wooden ragdolls, and trigger chaotic chain reactions inside a mysterious testing facility. Switch between first-person building and free-cam mayhem. Complete challenges, unlock gadgets, and discover hidden areas.

games.name: The Marvelous Raincaster of Yell Holler
games.summary: A time-looping puzzle ballad of Ozark folk superstition. Reorder events in time to unravel the legend of a weather-making rooster.

games.name: Anomalith
games.summary: “ANOMALITH” is a survival third-person shooter set in Japan, steeped in the atmosphere of liminal spaces and Showa-era retro aesthetics. To search for her missing friend, a girl steps into a world writhing with anomalies.

games.name: The Florist
games.summary: A classic survival horror experience, set in a town overgrown with deadly yet beautiful flowers.

games.name: After Hell Freezes Over
games.summary: Venture into the desolate frozen wasteland in this open-world survival horror. Struggle to survive in the cold, where strange creatures roam in the darkness. Build a shelter, collect supplies, fend off unimaginable threats, and fight for survival After Hell Freezes Over.

games.name: Agni: Village of Calamity
games.summary: Agni, a determined investigator from a covert Indonesian police unit who defied orders and ventures into a remote village despite ominous warnings. What begins as an unauthorized investigation quickly plunges Agni into a horrifying reality

games.name: Grave Seasons
games.summary: Grave Seasons is a supernatural murder-mystery farming simulator. Play as the new farmer in Ashenridge as you harvest crops, fish and mine, meet and romance townsfolk, build up the community... and maybe stop the murders.

events.name: Warhammer Skulls 2026
events.description:
Warhammer Skulls is back! Expect World Premieres and big updates across Warhammer Video Games.

Tune in on https://twitch.tv/warhammer and watch live on Thursday 21st May at 5pm UK / 6pm CEST / 9am US Pacific time.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks
games.summary:
Blaze into the high-Orktane mayhem of clashing Speedmobs, in adrenaline-fueled combat racing through the brutal Warhammer 40,000 universe! Drive scrappy vehicles loaded with bombastic weapons and powerful abilities to krump the opposing team!

Assemble your mob of dakka-spitting wagons, pushing their team to victory across multiple maps in this explosively unique take on the combat racing and shooter genres. Obliterate your Ork foes with kunnin’ strategies and brute force as your team speeds towards ultimate glory.

Are you looking for more speed and more dakka in your life? Look no further YA GITS!

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - The Infinite Museion
games.summary: Delve into a secret vault curated by Trazyn the Infinite himself. Discover Trazyn’s obsession with the Von Valancius dynasty, and choose whether to disrupt or fulfill his plans.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
games.summary: Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
games.summary: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with more enemies, more weapons, and new ways to purge!

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.summary: Thrust into a universe of relentless war, become the embodiment of bullet hell in Warhammer Survivors, a fast-paced roguelite survivors game. Play as characters from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar universes, collect and evolve iconic weapons and destroy endless swarms of enemies.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus II
games.summary: Fast-paced tactical combat meets strategic management in this sequel to the acclaimed Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus. Take control of either the ancient and deathless Necron legions or the techno-religious acolytes of the Omnissiah, with the fate of a world in your hands.

games.name: Warhammer Combat Cards
games.summary: Warhammer Combat Cards is a digital card game made by Well Played Games in conjunction with Games Workshop.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector - Ultramarines
games.summary: The Ultramarines have arrived in Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector. This legendary Chapter brings a massive roster of eighteen new units to the battlefield, embodying tactical perfection and unwavering discipline.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector
games.summary: In the grim darkness of the far future, there is only war. Experience every bone-rattling explosion and soul-crushing charge in Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector, the definitve battle-scale game of turn-based strategy and fast-paced combat that takes you to the battlefields of the 41st Millenium.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War II
games.summary: With a focus on fast-action RTS gameplay, Dawn of War II brings to life the science fiction universe of Warhammer 40,000 like never before. Experience the intimate brutality of battle as you play through your chosen race's epic campaign.

games.name: Warhammer: Mark of Chaos - Gold Edition (Classic)
games.summary: Command the armies of the Empire, the Hordes of Chaos, Orcs & Goblins, and other iconic Warhammer Fantasy factions in massive real-time battles. Warhammer: Mark of Chaos is a classic RTS celebrated for its unprecedented scale and detail for its time.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War
games.summary:
Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War is a revolutionary science fiction real-time strategy (RTS) game set in the violent, post-apocalyptic universe of the 41st Millennium. Utilizing the exceptional game design skills of Relic Entertainment, Dawn of War provides an immersive entertainment experience of epic proportions. Command hardened troops, deadly vehicles and high-tech weaponry with one goal in mind, the complete extermination of the opposition.

Whether you lead Humanity's finest - the Space Marines, - the masters of mechanized warfare and billions-strong human army of the Imperial Guard, the diabolic and villainous traitors of man - the Chaos Space Marines, the brutal and savage beasts - the Orks, or the psychic and technologically advanced alien warriors - the Eldar, you control the action and the fate of your race!

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Fire Warrior (Classic)
games.summary: Become an elite Fire Warrior and fight the forces of the Imperium of Man in an action-packed classic FPS. Experience Warhammer 40,000 from a unique T'au perspective with a story full of twists and betrayal.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Rites of War
games.summary:
Inspired by the board and figurine games made popular by Games Workshop, the universe of Warhammer 40,000 is a vast and violent one, rife with strange, alien races, including the Eldar.
Rites of War features a tightly crafted storyline composed of 24 missions and varied victory conditions as you lead the Eldar in their fight for survival. Additional scenarios allow for control of Tyrannid and Imperial armies and a glory point system lets you build and customize your own army, with 8 distinct troop classes ranging from War Machines to Assault Troops to Devastator Squads. A level-based experience system enhances the game's RPG (Role-Playing Game) element, allowing you to upgrade and customize units, enhance warrior skills and employ "psyker" (psychic) abilities.

games.name: Warhammer: Dark Omen
games.summary: This sequel to Warhammer: Shadow Of The Horned Rat is an overhead role playing game in which you play Morgan Bernhardt. The game consists of a series of battles where you view the battle from overhead via a rotatable view. You go through the game managing your army, deciding whether to fight in optional battles, and advancing through a deep and engrossing storyline via a series of conversations played out by talking portraits.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate (Classic)
games.summary: Command a squad of up to 20 Space Marines and battle the forces of Chaos led by Chaos Lord Zymran. Chaos Gate is a squad-level, turn-based tactical strategy game set in the grim Warhammer 40,000 world.

games.name: Final Liberation: Warhammer Epic 40,000
games.summary: SSI, the masterminds behind the Five Star General Series’, bring their Midas touch to the Warhammer 40,000 world in the first ever video-game adaption of the Epic table-top game. With over 85 unit types, this addition to the 40k franchise brings the vastness and depth of an Epic-style battle to your PC, allowing you greater selection and customisation over your army. This, along with the multiple scenarios and battlefronts to fight from, will keep your strategic mind on edge for hours on end.

games.name: Warhammer: Shadow of the Horned Rat (Classic)
games.summary: Halt the tide of evil threatening the Empire in Warhammer: Shadow of the Horned Rat, a classic real-time strategy game where you command a mercenary army against the servants of the Horned Rat.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus
games.summary: At the heart of Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus lies a richly detailed tactical game, played out as intense fast-paced skirmishes in PVE campaigns and tightly competitive PVP battles, as well as massively collaborative guild boss fights. With a deep and ever-expanding story penned by renowned Warhammer writer Matt Forbeck, Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus will tell stories across factions, as players build and customize their armies with epic and legendary units from the Ultramarines, Necrons, Adepta Sororitas, Black Legion, and many more to be revealed. Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus has something for every type of player.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
games.summary: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

games.name: Helldivers 2
games.summary: Helldivers 2 is a cooperative third-person shooter in which squads of up to four players are deployed from orbit onto hostile planets to complete strategic missions. Players select loadouts of weapons, armor, and stratagems that allow them to call in orbital strikes, supply drops, vehicles, and turrets during combat. Friendly fire is always active, requiring coordination between teammates. The game features a persistent galactic war where community-wide performance determines which planets are liberated or lost.

games.name: Warhammer Underworlds: Online
games.summary: Warhammer Underworlds: Online offers high-stakes, turn-based strategy that pits mighty warbands against one another in an eternal battle for Glory in the realms of the Age of Sigmar. The streamlined fighter count of Warhammer Underworlds: Online makes it both easy to grasp and quick to play, while its dice-and-cards mechanics offer boundless strategic depth. Choose a warband, build your power and objective decks, roll the dice and carve a path to victory.

games.name: Dark Future: Blood Red States
games.summary: Command a team of ruthless highway warriors on the gang-infested highways of North America’s wastelands in this RealTimeShift Vehicular Action Strategy reboot of the cult-classic Games Workshop car combat game. An alternative America 2023: too wild to be true, too close for comfort.

games.name: Talisman: Origins
games.summary: This new adaptation of the Talisman board game focuses on solo play as you adventure through many epic quests using the full rule-set of the Revised 4th Edition.

games.name: Space Hulk: Tactics
games.summary:
"Bringing a unique twist to the classic gameplay of the cult board game, engage in bloody battles through an immense Space Hulk - a twisted mass of asteroids, wrecked ships and debris – as either a squad of Terminator Space Marines or the deadly alien Genestealers. Which side will you choose?

Battle through two distinct, narrative-driven campaigns, from the points of view of two different factions: one campaign puts you in control of a Blood Angels squad, which you will customise and upgrade as you progress, while the other puts you in control of the Genestealers for the first time in a Space Hulk game!

Space Hulk: Tactics is based on the rules of the popular board game, given a fresh new spin in the form of the unique Card system. Cards give more ways to customize your squad before a match, and allow you to turn the tides of battle with abilities that trigger game-changing effects when used at the right moment.

Test your skills against other players in the expansive online competitive multiplayer, letting you command a swarm of Genestealers or a custom squad of different unit types from one of four Space Marine Chapters – the Blood Angels, the Space Wolves, the Ultramarines, and the Dark Angels. Multiplayer modes and tools offer a rich and deep online experience, and include an intuitive map creation tool, which gives players everything they need to create original maps with custom objective, and share them with other players to play either online or against the AI, all from within the game!"

games.name: Warhammer Quest 2: The End Times
games.summary:
Dungeon adventures in the Warhammer World are back!

In Warhammer Quest 2: The End Times, you will lead your warriors across a war torn land and into dungeons for wealth and glory! Swing swords, fire arrows and cast spells as you fight through the denizens of Chaos. Success in battle is rewarded with new weapons, armours, skills and treasure.

Experience all the peril and danger as you battle your enemies through beautiful, full 3D dungeons. Encounters come to life as your warriors enter the fray with a vast array of weapons and skills. Hold your enemies back with fire, use ice to freeze them to the spot. Attack with magic staffs, explosive pistols and flaming hammers. If all else fails use legendary armour or mystical robes to deflect attacks.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Sanctus Reach
games.summary: Warhammer 40,000: Sanctus Reach is a 3D turn-based strategy game like you've never seen before: fast, immediate, deep, impressive to look at and incredibly fun! Fight through a dark era of carnage and endless war and lead the Space Wolves in a struggle to defend the last bastion of mankind.

games.name: Battlefleet Gothic: Armada
games.summary:
Battlefleet Gothic: Armada is the RTS videogame adaptation of Games Workshop's classic tabletop game, pitting the Chaos, Imperium, Eldar, and Orks against each other in visceral space-battles.

Additionally an extensive multiplayer mode with persistent fleets where up to 4 players can battle simultaneously, Battlefleet Gothic: Armada also features a big story campaign, taking place during the 12th Black Crusade and putting players in the middle of the Gothic War that raged between the Imperium and Abaddon the Despoiler. Players will be at the centre of every fight, commanding fleets of gigantic ships as the Chaos unleash a sequential chain of surprise attacks on Imperium worlds at the start of 20 years of warring in the sector.

games.name: Man O' War: Corsair - Warhammer Naval Battles
games.summary: Man O' War: Corsair is a video game of high adventure, naval combat and exploration based on the Games Workshop classic Man O' War table top game. Play as a rogue Captain of the Empire or Champion of Chaos, personally navigating your vessel in third person across the Great Western Ocean while plundering enemy ships, visiting ports, trading and making legends of your deeds across the land and sea! Engage in boarding actions, with direct control over your Captain and take the fight to the enemy.

games.name: Talisman: The Horus Heresy
games.summary:
Talisman: The Horus Heresy is a digital board game based on the Talisman rule system and set in the Warhammer 40,000 universe, during the cataclysmic events of the Horus Heresy.
Up to four players will be able to take control of one or more of the galaxy's greatest heroes or most notorious villains. Taking the side of either traitor or loyalist, these Warlords will form vast companies of Space Marines, battalions of tanks and battlefleets of Spacecraft. They are the most powerful beings in the Galaxy and their followers are legion.

games.name: Chainsaw Warrior: Lords of the Night
games.summary:
Chainsaw Warrior: Lords of the Night is a new chapter for Games Workshop's cult classic! Based on the original Chainsaw Warrior board game, this sequel adds new layers of intensity to the game's unique formula.

Chainsaw Warrior: Lords of the Night sees the player fighting against hordes of Aztec Zombies, and the clock, to save reality from Darkness. Lords of the Night introduces an upgraded combat system, new weapons, powers, equipment and unique mini bosses that require careful tactics to defeat. It adds three new zones to fight through, an even tougher confrontation with the enigmatic Darkness and plenty of new opportunities to die!

Chainsaw Warrior was first published as a solo board game in 1987, is expanded in this new adventure. An epic battle that offers new gameplay, weapons, equipment, enemies and much more. Can you prevail where all others have failed? You only have 60 minutes to save the world!

games.name: Blood Bowl 2
games.summary: Blood Bowl 2 smashes Warhammer and American football together, in an explosive cocktail of turn-based strategy, humor and brutality, adapted from Games Workshop’s famous board game.

games.name: Legacy of Dorn: Herald of Oblivion
games.summary: A vast choice-based digital gamebook set within the Warhammer 40,000 universe where you are a Space Marine!

games.name: Talisman: Digital Edition
games.summary:
Talisman Digital Edition - The Magical Quest Game for 1 to 4 players.

The officially licensed multiplayer version of the classic fantasy adventure board game, Talisman.

In Talisman Digital Edition, there are 14 characters a player can control, from the heroic Warrior to the powerful Sorceress. In this perilous adventure, players battle it out to journey across a dangerous land and be the first to claim the Crown of Command, a magical artefact with the power to destroy all rivals and make the bearer the true ruler of the kingdom. On your travels, you will need strength, courage and some good dice rolls to survive the dangers you face and beat your opponents to the centre of the board.

games.name: Space Hulk: Ascension
games.summary: Space Hulk: Ascension is a 3D, digital, turn based, strategy game, which re-interprets the classic board game experience, and adds new RPG style mechanics, new weapons and missions, new enemy types, 3 playable chapters and loads of other new features to the single player experience.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Armageddon
games.summary: In this hex-based, turn-based strategy game, players will lead the Imperial forces of the Armageddon Steel Legion and Space Marines from a variety of Chapters against the Ork invasion through over 30 scenarios, on the hostile terrain of the planet and its gigantic Hive Cities.

games.name: Chainsaw Warrior
games.summary: Chainsaw Warrior is a classic nail-biting game for one strong-nerved player, based off the single-player board game of the same name. The player has sixty minutes to navigate a labyrinth composed of an abandoned urban slum in New York, represented by two decks of cards, locate the entity Darkness attempting to destroy the city and kill it.

games.name: Space Hulk
games.summary: Based on the best-selling board game and set in the Warhammer 40,000 universe, Space Hulk is a 3D digital turn based strategy game that recreates the classic claustrophobic board game experience for single player and multiplayer cross-platform play between PC, Mac and on iOS. Space Hulk is set in the isolated corridors and tomb-like chambers of an ancient vessel lost in the graveyard of space. Players lead a small army of fearless Space Marine Terminators to battle in a ferocious fight for survival against hordes of predatory alien Genestealers.

games.name: Blood Bowl
games.summary:
Blood Bowl is a combination of a tactical and sports game. The basics are extremely simple: two teams, one ball. The team that carries the ball into the opponent's end zone scores a touchdown, the team with the most touchdowns at the end of the game is the winner. However, it’s how you decide to do this that makes things interesting, the ends justify the means! It’s not just the players you have at your disposal either. You can bribe the referee to look the other way as you cripple or trample annoying opponents and hire illegal wizards to give you a hand directly from the crowd… Blood Bowl severely tests the finest tacticians' strategies.

There are many races to accommodate every player’s profile (23 in the Chaos Edition, 20 in the Legendary Edition, 9 in the Standard Edition) and even more strategies for experimenting. Winning a game requires a strong game-sense and a lot of self-control.

For the player's enjoyment, omnipresent humour and the use of spells, weapons, and other non-regulatory actions place Blood Bowl outside of the classic sport simulation genre.

games.name: Total War: Warhammer III - Bhashiva
games.summary: The Bhashiva Character Pack introduces Bhashiva, The White Tiger, as a new playable Legendary Lord alongside a deadly company of mercenary Tiger Warrior units for the armies of Grand Cathay.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine II - Purgation Update
Total War: Warhammer 40,000
games.summary: Experience the brutal fusion of galactic strategy and grimdark warfare in Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000. Take command of iconic factions, customise your war machine, and engage in devastating battles as you carve a bloody warpath across the stars.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine VR - Defenders of Avarax
Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Skitarii
games.summary: The Adeptus Mechanicus will not see the secrets of Hive Tertium fall into the hands of heretics, the Skitarii Alpha Primus are elite operatives devoted to serving the will of the Omnissiah. They will annihilate all who stand in their way.

games.name: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster
games.summary: Play a sneaky & brutal Skaven Assassin in this new, refreshing but gritty take on the 2D Action platformer genre.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate - Deathwatch
games.summary: Command the Imperium’s most elite alien-hunters in a brutal, turn-based tactical RPG. As an Inquisitor of the Deathwatch, every squad you build and every decision you make shapes the fate of a sector under siege from Genestealer Hivecults, Orks, T’au, and the forces of Chaos.

events.name: BitSummit PUNCH
events.description: Japan’s Industry-Leading Independent Game Development Festival in Kyoto!

games.name: Starseeker: Astroneer Expeditions
games.summary: STARSEEKER is a new game set within the Astroneer universe with a focus on discovery, cooperative expeditions, and camaraderie. Exploring deep space on the ESS Starseeker, players will need to work together with the entire crew of the space station to complete planet- wide objectives across a multitude of star systems using cutting edge technology.

games.name: The Battle Cats
games.summary: The Battle Cats is a tower defense mobile game. The cats must face fearsome enemies, such as Doge the dog, Gory the Gorilla, and H. Nah the Hyena.

games.name: Schrödinger's Call
games.summary: I am Mary. The last person in the world you'll ever talk to. Schrodinger's Call" is an adventure game that uses a mysterious phone to connect with souls who cannot die. The main character, Mary, wakes up in a strange room with no memory. The player, along with the bewildered Mary, will save souls.

games.name: Chronoscript: The Endless End
games.summary: Chronoscript: The Endless End is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, an editor trapped within a manuscript, must unravel a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its endacross 2D pages and a 3D manor.

games.name: UN:Me
games.summary: UN:Me is an adventure game where you guide a girl harboring multiple souls within her body through an unsettling mental labyrinth, engaging in dialogue with each soul while making the harrowing choice of which to keep and which to erase in your escape attempt.

games.name: KochiKame: Ryo-san's Billion-yen Beat
games.summary: KochiKame comes to life as a simulation game! Ryo-san runs wild to save the shopping district! Build an anything-goes shopping street and aim to become a billionaire!

games.name: Bakudo
games.summary: Bakudo is a sci‑fi boss‑rush action game fusing high‑octane ball‑sport mechanics with exhilarating combat. Enroll at an elite Bakudo academy and clash with formidable opponents as you uncover a major conspiracy. When determination is put to the ultimate test, you must tip the scales of destiny.

games.name: Yakoh: Shinobi Ops
games.summary: Four Shinobi lurking in the darkness. Silent as shadows, racing through the night. To complete their deadly mission, they master their arts—hiding, sparing lives, deceiving—as they venture toward either death or salvation. Evade the relentless pursuit of immortal Hunters, and only by returning alive will their mission be fulfilled.

games.name: Capy Castaway
games.summary: Embark on a whimsical adventure with a capybara pup and a clever crow as they set off to find their way home! Sniff, dig, and fly as you explore a vibrant world brimming with wonder, challenges, and heartwarming friendships at every turn.

games.name: Cento
games.summary: CENTO is a game where you enter commands in time with music and activate skills to fight. Collect gifts while reinforcing your skills and fight on stages with a wide variety of songs!

games.name: City of None
games.summary: A metropolis crumbles into ruin as powerful Barons satisfy their greed upon souls lost in time. You are but one spirit, with a wooden body left to rot in the wild…

games.name: Cogito: Requiem
games.summary:
Cogito: Requiem is a 2D action game where you dash freely through a harmony of music and sound effects.

The setting: a world where humanity has migrated into the digital realm and vanished, leaving behind only the SI—artificial intelligences who once had humans as their masters. As Cogito, you race through this world where their remnants linger, set on "ending" the SI that have fallen into error.

games.name: Compensated Girl
games.summary: “Compensated Girl” is a deck-building roguelike card battle adventure game.It aims to defeat monsters in card battles and try to escape from a nightmare world.However, the deck you use is the girl herself.Using cards affects the girl directly, changing elements like the UI, story, and more.

games.name: Conductus
games.summary: A rhythm game where you conduct the world with dynamic hand movements! Using a specialized controller and advanced tracking technology, you become the conductor of the world

games.name: Corebreaker
games.summary: Corebreaker is a fast-paced action-platformer game with rogue-like elements. Play as Nova, a robot designed to awaken when humanity is extinct by the machines. Unlock abilities, upgrades and powerful weapons as you fight your way through supreme robots to find out your purpose!

games.name: Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown
games.summary: Get ready to blast into retro-racing madness with Cosmic Race! Our game reignites the arcade racing thrill, hurling you through mind-bending tracks, intense combat, and eye-popping visuals. It's like the 80s and 90s racing games on turbo steroids—strap in and relive the glory days!

games.name: Crabmeat
games.summary: A short first-person-point-and-click-survival-horror game set in a future Antarctic fisheries region where you are a prisoner tasked with crabbing for the priceless southern King Crab.

games.name: Culture House
games.summary: Culture House is a nurturing + adventure game based on biological cultivation experiments. Set in a building influenced by 20th-century modernist houses, the game portrays serene and strange days, unravels the mysteries hidden behind the experiments, and culminates in the arrival of the apocalypse.

games.name: Cyclia Journey
games.summary: This title, CYCLIA JOURNEY, is a 2D puzzle action game set in a geometric world where everything is governed by the “The Law of Replication & Re-creation”

games.name: Dancing with Ghosts
games.summary: A cozy wholesome narrative about a young teen girl who befriends a ghost that only she can see. Weighed down by the death of her parents, the girl finds healing through friendship, dance, and helping others. Created to share the message of joy and appreciation for the gift of life.

games.name: Dearend
games.summary: Dearend is a cinematic action-adventure set in a post-apocalyptic world ruled by AI. A former soldier haunted by his past and a humanoid girl with a human heart cross paths in a story of loss, connection, and redemption.

games.name: Death a Live
games.summary: Pack the house in 15 daysbefore your "Yandere Fan" stabs you. Survive a live stage swirling with love and madness in this rhythm-action RPG. Manipulate "Sound" and "Emotion" through rhythm inputs, where your performance and your choices dictate the "Girl Voltage"!

games.name: Delve Survivors
games.summary: An old-school roguelike game with modern survivors-like action! Delve into multiple retro pixelated dungeons where you control the pace with fast, reactive turn based movement and ever expanding skills which enable you to plow through hordes of enemies before escaping with the loot

games.name: Die Deep
games.summary: Die Deep delivers a pure and focused combat experience - it’s all about reading your foes and mastering your timing to strike back. Nothing stands in your way but combat! Dive into a constantly changing abyss, take down every enemy in your way, and enjoy the ultimate head-to-head battle experience.

games.name: Dreadmoor
games.summary: DREADMOOR is a Lovecraftian fishing adventure set in a post-nuclear apocalypse world. Sell your yield, upgrade your boat, build equipment and battle monsters lurking in water and on land. Explore forgotten lands and discover ancient secrets.

games.name: Dungeon Clawler
games.summary: Dungeon Clawler is a roguelike claw machine deckbuilder. Players can build their unique deck, fight enemies by grabbing weapons and items from a claw machine and find special artifacts that help them on their quest to reclaim something they lost.

games.name: Dyping Escape
games.summary: Escape from a dying-typing game where the words you type become reality and turn against you.

games.name: Endless Samurai
games.summary: "Endless Samurai" is a roguelite that overcomes death and becomes stronger. You can experience a new battle system aiming at "fusion of turn-based and speedy action".

games.name: Enter the Chronosphere
games.summary: A psychedelic roguelike that blurs the line between real-time action and turn-based tactics. Play as misfit aliens, craft wild combinations between hundreds of weapons, items and abilities, and disable uncharted chronospheres: Colossal structures that consume time and distort reality.

games.name: Fear FA 98
games.summary: FEAR FA 98: Silent Hill mixed with FIFA 98. Use your enemies' heads as the ball, use knives, and summon demons! the very first survival horror soccer simulator!. Play against the computer, or the classic local mode to enjoy with your friends on a terrifying afternoon worthy of the '90s.

games.name: Finding Polka
games.summary: Set off on a playful search to track down the wandering pup Polka in this game of exploration and serendipity. Meet charming characters, lend them a hand to make new friends, and explore a cozy world sketched in ballpoint pen. You don't need words on this adventure, just smiles and high-fives!

games.name: Fishbowl
games.summary: Fishbowl is a slice of life, coming of age story told over a month. Video call loved ones, work from home, sort through puzzles to rediscover childhood memories, do care tasks and get to know yourself better, one day at a time.

games.name: Sheol no Mori: Tasogare no Majuuzukai
games.summary: Inspired by “Kodoku Poison,” an ancient Chinese sorcery, this game combines “Kodoku Poison, Beast Alchemy, and Match-3 Puzzles.” Select a few beasts from the herd to turn into familiars, pit your familiars against the beasts, and fuse familiars together to create giant beasts.

games.name: Gambonanza
games.summary: Gambonanza is a mind-bending roguelike where every move counts. Unlock over 100 innovative Gambits and harness powerful synergy with your chess pieces to transform your board into a festival of explosive combos and tactical twists!

games.name: Ghost Vanguard
games.summary: Ghost Vanguard is a Beat'em Up game that combines stylish action with roguelike elements. Grab your sword and step into treacherous evil dungeons, using stylish and magnificent combos to defeat the sinister forces from the darkness!

games.name: Gutsy Grid
games.summary: An Action Deck-builder. Battle through enemy encounters with your trusty Gutsy Bit console. Collect abilities through Carts and Console Mods. Wield the power of the Gutsy-Bit to stop a sinister plot threatening two worlds and have the raddest summer vacation ever.

games.name: Handlime
games.summary:
Forget the keyboard! All you need are your hands.

Meet the protagonist of our 2D action-puzzle game "Handlime"—a quirky, hand-shaped slime! Using a webcam, the game tracks your hand movements in real-time, perfectly syncing them with the slime on the screen.

The controls are completely intuitive. Walk by wiggling your fingers as if "tickling" the ground, tilt your hand to move, or make a fist to punch and blast objects away!

games.name: Heartreasure: Stellar Journey
games.summary: Solve puzzles and search for hearts in a pop-up book-like universe! Hand-drawn illustrations, cute animations, and gentle piano melodies create a soothing moment.

games.name: HellHeart Breaker
games.summary: HellHeart Breaker - the monster girls you date grant you newfound powers, and the girls you don't... are the bosses you fight! In this dungeon-crawler roguelite, you are locked away at the bottom of the Underworld, fighting your way out. If all is fair in love and war - what will you do?

games.name: HellPunk: Purgatorium
games.summary: HellPunk is a 2D action gore roguelite game. You play as the main character Asher Drake, who must help Leviathan conquer the Tower and solve the mystery of his family's vanishing.

games.name: Hermit Computer
games.summary: Hermit Computer is a horror-puzzle game set in 2001. Deep within the Hermit Kingdom, you play as an outsider tasked with extracting critical intelligence using a secretive state-controlled computer operating system.

games.name: High Fructose
games.summary: "High Fructose" is a first-person shooter roguelite. As a prophesied hero, wield up to five weapons against monstrous fruit. Use various traits and items to create builds and endure the relentless onslaught.

games.name: I Won’t Let You Level up in My Goblin Town
games.summary: Interfere in a turn based fight! When adventurers come to your goblin town to level up, your strongest warrior goblin meets them in Active Time Battle. Run around town gathering the equipment and potions he needs to defeat any adventurer party.

games.name: Inkonbini: One Store. Many Stories
games.summary: Inkonbini: One Store. Many Stories is a cozy slice-of-life game about running a small-town convenience store, inspired by early 1990s Japan. Meet regulars, stock shelves, and watch quiet, everyday moments turn into meaningful stories.

games.name: Jigenro
games.summary:
"JIGENRO" is a 3D color-matching puzzle game.

Click to grab and move panels on the field.

If you can connect all panels of the same color, you clear the stage.
Some stages feature fields with side walls or fields with elevation changes.

games.name: Jinro Burger
games.summary: Jinro Burger is a social deduction game of cooperation and betrayal where friendships are built, or completely shattered, over burgers. Can you see through the lies and sabotage of the Spy hidden in your kitchen and satisfy your customers?

games.name: Jump into the New Year
games.summary: Jump into the New Year! But if you don't keep jumping for three seconds straight, you'll get swallowed up by another world!?

games.name: Kaguya
games.summary: High-School Heroines Take to the Skies!A fully-voiced bullet hell shoot-'em-up that's friendly to newcomers!Wipe out the AI robot army and save the day!

games.name: Karate Rogue
games.summary: A stance-driven, turn-based combo roguelike—turn defense into offense and fight your way out of the abyss.

games.name: Katuba's Poacher
games.summary: ''Wanted!!'' Chatch the Adoarble 'Sharp' for Reward! "Katuba's Poacher" is Boss-Battle action game with a cartoon and animation style.

games.name: Kidbash: Super Legend
games.summary: Kidbash: Super Legend is an exciting 2D platformer that blends classic gaming with a modern touch. You'll go on a thrilling adventure through two different phases - the Mountain and the Village. Your goal is to defeat Tao Shen Long, and begin the journey to becoming a Super Legendary Hero.

games.name: Knights of Fiona
games.summary: Fierce dragons have emerged in the land of Gallia. Join Fiona and her sworn knights to protect the kingdom! Embark on quests solo or with friends as you fight against the darkness.

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Light Odyssey
games.summary: Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.

games.name: Line Forge BlackSmith
games.summary: A blacksmith shop with a "line" of unique adventurers! Use your memory and timing mini-games to quickly identify each customer's preferred weapon and forge it. In the Battle Phase, your armed customers fight. Power up your regulars (MVPs) and defeat the bosses. Become the busiest blacksmith!

games.name: Little Cheese Works
games.summary: This is a cooperative action game where you have to carry cheese to the goal without being found by cats. You can have a conversation with voice chat, but the slightest noise will wake up the cat. Let's carry the cheese quietly by breathing quietly so that the cat won't find it!

games.name: Lost and Found Co.
games.summary: Lost & Found Co. is a hidden object adventure in a cozy and immersive world. Join a cast of quirky characters on their epic journey across countless magical locations. Find lost items, solve puzzles, and help a tiny dragon regain her power!

games.name: Mad King Redemption
games.summary: Mad King Redemption is a unique blend of a traditional beat'em'up game with strong roguelite progression, mixed in a pixelated graphic style in a 2.5D world. Relieve the king from his madness while beating up corrupted enemies, in a fresh way at every run!

games.name: Magical Blush
games.summary: Magical Blush is a top-down action-adventure where fast-paced elemental combat meets Metroidvania-style exploration. Chain spell combos, exploit elemental weaknesses, rescue survivors, and team up in local co-op as you battle the powerful Elemental Lords and explore the wondrous world of Wyn.

games.name: MAPS (My Apocalyptic Plan for Survival)
games.summary: Rendered in breathtaking cinematic pixel art, MAPS blends the intimate tension of classic survival games with the strategic depth of a sidescrolling colony builder. A deeply diegetic world keeping you immersed in every moment with its tragic beauty.

games.name: Max Gentlemen: Escape From Moriarty Mansion
games.summary: Join nine absurd Victorian characters invited to a mysterious and remote mansion. Solve devious puzzles, explore the mansion and try to keep everyone alive. Friends or Foes: it's up to all of you to discover Professor Moriarty's secrets and defy his murderous game.

games.name: Mekururi: Dizzying Witch
games.summary: A mysterious adventure game where you spin the witch's eyes round and round to unlock secrets. Escort her without hesitation through fantastical puzzles and action.

games.name: Midnight Horde
games.summary: Midnight Horde is a gothic horror casual action game with rogue-lite elements where you battle thousands of enemies and upgrade the castle. Discover the secrets of the castle and upgrade weapons and fortifications to keep darkness at bay.

games.name: Miniature Land: Four Seasons
games.summary: An escape room game made by hand-building and photographing miniature scenes. Explore a miniature world in live-action and enjoy feeling like you're really there.

games.name: Moldwasher
games.summary: Clean moldy messes as a brave food hero! Equip your high-pressure spray, choose the right nozzle, and clear away sticky messes in this cozy, arcade-style fridge-cleaning adventure.

games.name: Mop'n Spark
games.summary: "MOP'N SPARK" is a 2D puzzle platformer where a street cleaner and an electrician—an unlikely duo—team up to tackle challenging stages.

games.name: Mount Lomyst
games.summary: Mount Lomyst is a 2D action game about climbing to the summit of Mount Lomyst, using a grappling hook and wall climbing — without jumping.

games.name: Nexus Code
games.summary: NEXUS CODE is a 3D programming battle game that reimagines the excitement of the "hobby anime" and "competitive toys" that captivated many children in the 90s and 2000s, using modern programming elements. Build your own unique character and challenge rivals with logical thinking as your weapon.

games.name: Nightmare Operator
games.summary: NIGHTMARE OPERATOR is an action horror shooter about hunting Youkai in the haunted ruins of Tokyo. Combat fuses the tense, shooting gameplay of classic survival horror, with the skill-based mechanics and execution of fighting games and spectacle fighters.

games.name: Ninja or Die 2 Die
games.summary: In a nutshell, it's a high-speed game where you defeat enemies by jumping. The goal is to defeat as many enemies as possible while your soul inhabits another person's body for a limited time, during which the body gradually decays even if you do nothing.

games.name: On Air! Taxi Detective Casebook
games.summary: On Air! Taxi Detective Casebook is a pixel-art, dialogue-driven mystery game. You’re an AI in a taxi, teaming up with a talkative driver on late-night runs to hear bizarre passenger stories, solve cases in secret, and let him play the “great detective.”

games.name: Onikura
games.summary: A fast-paced and challenging boss-rush with options to customize your playstyle as you progress. Defeat all enemies in your path with unique attacks, specials, parries, and abilities.

games.name: Own Time Own Target
games.summary: Own Time Own Target drops two players into a divided battlefield in a pure 2D 1v1 where reading the environment is just as important as outgunning your opponent. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down. Friendships not guaranteed.

games.name: Pinball Garden
games.summary: Set in the charming world of “Garden,” where tiny creatures and playful spirits gather, this pinball game features two modes: CLASSIC, a single-player challenge for high scores, and VERSUS, a multiplayer race to fill the honey gauge first.

games.name: Pritto Prisoner
games.summary: Get ready for chaotic 4v2 party game action in Pritto Prisoner! Play as mischievous animal inmates using strategically messy peepee/poopie tactics to outwit highly customizable robot wardens. Break out, or get put to "deep sleep" in this asymmetrical escape game. Easy to learn, hilarious to master.

games.name: Pro Jank Footy
games.summary: Pro Jank Footy is an over-the-top arcade comedy-sports game. Score goals to unleash game-changing power-ups, build a deck of absurd abilities, and tackle a season where no two matches are ever the same—solo or with your mates.

games.name: Project Solaris
games.summary: A rogue-lite RPG about the 100-day challenge of Solaris, a Less magic power witch, and her sidekick Homu, with beautifully animated combat, quick-time events, and charming characters to interact with!

games.name: Quiet Express: Cabin 909
games.summary: “Do you know anything about Cabin 909?” You're a passenger on a transcontinental train. Looking for a room that's nowhere to find: Cabin 909.

games.name: Reggie, His Cousin, Two Scientists and Most Likely the End of the World
games.summary: Control the direction of gravity as you run, jump and explore in an outrageous time-traveling adventure as Reggie, an unlikely hero from the 16,000th century on a mission to save science and ultimately the entire universe!

games.name: Rhythm Hotel
games.summary: Rhythm Hotel is open! Grab your camera and capture Einstein’s secret identity! Next door, Socrates is in a heated debate with a stubborn donkey. Don’t panic! It’s our special rhythm challenge — fall behind the beat and you might get kicked into a dimensional rift by the donkey!

games.name: Room 502
games.summary: A cynical high schooler, Hae-eun's mundane life takes a colorful turn as she and her dorm roommates in Room 502 unravel mysterious incidents on campus. This game blends academy life, mystery, and youth in a captivating detective adventure.

games.name: Rope-Kun Adventure
games.summary: A very unique rope action game in which the main character "Rope-kun", who wields a rope, overcomes various gimmicks! The possibilities for ropes are endless, from carrying objects, to bouncing balls, to tying up and defeating enemies! Overcome with him the many difficulties that await you!

games.name: Satoyama Note: Spring Walk
games.summary: Satoyama note Spring walk is a point-and-click visual novel in which you aim to reach your destination while identifying plants in a satoyama in spring. Listen to the animals, observe and identify the plants as you make your way through the forest, and have lunch under the cherry blossom trees!

games.name: Seraphine's Skyward Journey
games.summary: This game is an adventure game where you explore a steampunk-inspired world with 2.5D hand-drawn graphics aboard an airship. Manage resources like coal, food, and water while operating your airship, defeat sky pirates, engage in trade, and handle cargo transport as you venture into uncharted skies.

games.name: Servant of the Lake
games.summary: Servant of the Lake is the new premium point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series from the creators of the Cube Escape series, The Past Within and Underground Blossom.

games.name: Sloppy Forgeries
games.summary: Sloppy Forgeries is a fast-paced, two-player local multiplayer painting game. Each player is given a mouse, a blank canvas, and a few simple paint tools. Each round, a famous painting from art history is revealed. Players race to copy the painting as quickly and accurately as possible.

games.name: Smile Muscle Trainer
games.summary:
Smile, and jump.

A game where your face becomes the controller.

games.name: Spellbrush’s Tactical Game
games.summary:
You are a fallen god.

Trapped as a jet-black crow, you wander through a stark diorama of white marble to uncover the lost colors of seasons past.

Walk through memory and time to rekindle the stone cold hearts of mortal heroes.

A tactical SRPG told through beautiful pixel art. Use the environment, combine the abilities of different vessels…

...and reclaim your Glory.

games.name: Starless Umbra
games.summary: Starless Umbra is a couch co-op action RPG. Join Amalia as she searches for her friend in a land afflicted by a noxious fog. The deeper she ventures, the further she unravels a force that threatens far more than just one life.

games.name: StarVaders
games.summary: Defend the Earth from an alien invasion in the ULTIMATE fusion of deckbuilding and grid-based tactics. Pilot a mech, discover game-breaking combos, and protect the future of humanity in this endlessly replayable roguelike.

games.name: Sunset Game Shop Shayou
games.summary: Manage your dream game shop through gaming history starting from 1985. From the Famicom boom to digital distribution—can you survive this management simulation through Japan's biggest gaming shifts?

games.name: Surface Labyrinth Kurumabu
games.summary: Neo-2D Action Puzzle Game !

games.name: Surfpunk
games.summary: Become a wave-shredding Raider in this intense, PvE co-op extraction ARPG. Hop on your Rushboard, loot ancient artifacts, hack n’ slash through hordes of monsters and escape in style. Surf, Shred, Scavenge, Repeat!

games.name: Sushi Lick
games.summary: One lick away from a lifetime ban. Sushi Lick is a licking and chaos simulator about trading your dignity for viral views. Upset the customers and lick the sushi while dodging the chef’s sharp eyes. Be fast, because being caught means your fame ends in an instant.

games.name: Syndream
games.summary:
The game consists of an ADV section where you advance the story by choosing dialogue options, and an action section where you explore a dream world.

As the story progresses in the ADV segment, new dream worlds are unlocked.

By exploring the dream world and utilizing action mechanics, players uncover the truth behind the dreams, which reflect the inner lives of each chara

games.name: Tammuz: Blood & Sand
games.summary: A mythic VR puzzle-box adventure where ancient mechanisms come alive beneath your hands. Solve over 20 unique trials inside a divine cube prison and uncover Mesopotamian secrets that blur the line between reality and legend.

games.name: The 60 Second Syndrome
games.summary: You will die in 60 seconds. This is a single-player horror escape game in which a man trapped within a 60-second time loop must escape from a sealed room. Inside the locked room, time resets every time you die. Observe repeating phenomena, remember the changes, and break free from the loop.

games.name: The Little Tomb: The Maholova Club and the Search for a Dead Body
games.summary: "Is there a dead body who'd like to be buried in me?" This is a coming-of-age adventure of a young boy who believes he's an ancient tomb! As Kofun, interact with all sorts of characters and objects. Gain points and spend them on new skills and hints to show Kofun a world of new experiences!

games.name: The Posthumous Investigation
games.summary: Travel to a noir Rio de Janeiro in 1937 and investigate the mystery behind the murder of Bras Cubas, the famed character created by Machado de Assis. Until the truth is out, you'll be trapped in a time loop, amidst a plot full of conspiracy and treason.

games.name: The Remake of the End of the Greatest RPG of All Time
games.summary: The Remake of the End of the Greatest RPG of All Time is the last hour of a lost (nonexistent) JRPG, "remade” in 3D pixel art complete with director’s commentary, the digital manual, and archival footage.

games.name: The Void Between
games.summary: When one man's dream holiday turns into a nightmare, it's up to you save him from himself... VOID is an FMV style puzzle game that leads you through a labyrinth of mysterious challenges and puzzling obstacles. Can you uncover the keys that will unlock your freedom, or seal your fate...

games.name: Thumbylina
games.summary: Thumbylina is a fingertip-sized life simulation game device designed to be your daily companion. When you set a timer during study or exercise, your in-game character joins you in self-improvement—unlocking new outfits and hairstyles as you progress. Unlike smartphone or PC timer apps, Thumbylina is completely offline, allowing you to focus without any distracting notifications.

games.name: Type & Magic
games.summary: Type words to shape your path, solve puzzles, and explore the ruins of a dead wizard's castle. Find artifacts to uncover the castle's dark mysteries. Report everything you saw to your master. Or… don't.

games.name: Vikings on Trampolines
games.summary: It's all about trampolines! Stay on the trampolines and push your opponents off to win. Brawl against your friends or work together to save the kingdom. Big bosses, big minigames and evil balloons..? Play solo or local multiplayer for up to 4 players! Accessible controls: Only one hand needed.

games.name: Voyage Router
games.summary: Voyage Router is a "navigation-based roguelike" where you explore procedurally generated terrain guided by your map. Adapt your route as the environment and conditions change, and visit as many target points as possible.

games.name: Weatherium
games.summary:
You play as a little god who can control weather elements such as temperature and wind.
Warm the air, and convection will begin, eventually giving birth to clouds.
Carry rain clouds on the wind, and new water sources may spread across the land.

games.name: Yaoyoro Zoo
games.summary:
Remote-control bats, toolbox hippos, clock owls... familiar items have transformed into adorable yet strange animals called ""Fanimals,"" living freely and happily!

Your mission as a caretaker is to deliver food to these Fanimals.

Navigate through 2D stages created within rooms, solve puzzles, and reach the food box.

games.name: Zurarararush!!!
games.summary: Zurararush!!! is a twin-stick shooter that you can play easily! Wear a wig as a weapon and defeat the virus that mutated inside your body! Power up your character and wig and become stronger! Defeat a lot of enemies and feel good! It's an arcade-style casual game that you'll want to play every day.

games.name: Ninja Game
games.summary: Immersive stealth action ninja simulation! Act like a ninja. Sneak up on a ninja. Strangle a ninja. Dropkick a ninja off a cliff. Throw a ninja out the window. Kidnap a ninja. Make friends with a ninja in real life and play splitscreen coop together!

games.name: Am I Nima
games.summary: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

games.name: Near the Sun: Chapter 1
games.summary: God's punishment burns the earth to ashes, and eventually consumes the underground world as well. A stylish 2D stealth action game where how you explore determines your fate. A boy carries his sister on his back and races through the underground world.

games.name: One Song, One Life
games.summary: “One Song, One Life” is a rhythm adventure game where the music and story change based on the notes you hit. Take control of Sumire Kirishima, a girl striving to become the ultimate net artist and perform alongside her idol. Your performance will shape her destiny—one song, one life.

games.name: Threat: Scream and Escape
