games.summary: "Dive into a prehistoric world of adventure where the power of primal seeds changes everything. Unlock abilities, attach them to your weapons, and face challenges in a vibrant land full of action, and surprises."

games.name: Welcome to Mars 9
games.summary: Welcome to Mars 9: The Tale of River is an old-school graphic adventure about a person adrift in space, rescued by a luxurious space station orbiting Mars. Playing as River, you will be drawn into a world of comfort and pleasure, only to soon discover that the station hides a dark secret.

events.name: Thinky Direct 2026
events.description: Join our hosts Rachel and Joe for the second ever Thinky Direct, featuring over 40 exclusive trailers and announcements for the most exciting upcoming thinky games.

games.name: Colorbound
games.summary: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue. As Anku, an Aymara boy with a unique gift, you’ll harness the power of color to shape the environment itself, uncovering hidden paths to navigate challenging and complex puzzles.

games.name: Servant of the Lake
games.summary: Servant of the Lake is the new premium point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series from the creators of the Cube Escape series, The Past Within and Underground Blossom.

games.name: Stretchmancer
games.summary: STRETCH THE WORLD, SAVE THE GALAXY! In this smartly funny First Person Puzzler, you are THE STRETCHMANCER. Squash and stretch your environment to solve fiendish puzzles and defeat the Claustro Empire... in an epic voice-acted adventure inspired by 90s Saturday Morning Cartoons!

games.name: UvsU: You vs. You
games.summary: Outsmart your past self in a battle of cause and effect. Explore an interconnected clay world, discover its hidden rules, and uncover the secrets it would rather keep buried.

games.name: From Ruins
games.summary: A new-gen detective adventure combining deduction gameplay with a gripping story full of twists and turns. Gather clues, establish connections, and solve a series of increasingly challenging cases. Will you uncover the feud that began at the end of the world?

games.name: Trifoil
games.summary: Trifoil is a minimalist, cerebral line drawing puzzle game, that explores how lines can interact with themselves. It has multiple puzzle mechanics, secrets to discover and mysteries to solve.

games.name: Monomoon
games.summary: In MONOMOON, the way forward is reserved for the knowing and the daring. Guided by moonlight, you’ll uncover hidden truths and wander through a tiny and mysterious open world.

games.name: The Granny Detective Society
games.summary: A cozy and quirky detective game where Madeline, a retired little mouse, watches her street and dives into thrilling investigations… until the Granny Detective Society contacts her and she discovers that the whole neighborhood is living a double life… especially the grannies.

games.name: Outpour
games.summary: Outpour is a puzzle game where you redirect flowing water across dreamy cathedral rooftops. Manipulate your surroundings to guide a dynamic water system, traverse high places, and restore harmony to sacred structures.

games.name: Memory's Reach
games.summary: Memory’s Reach is a first person puzzle-adventure metroidvania. Explore labyrinthian megastructures, solve mind-bending puzzles, and wield fantastic alien technology in a quest to reveal the legacy of a doomed civilization.

games.name: Timebound
games.summary: An exploration puzzle metroidbrainia set in mystical ruins. Solve timeloop puzzles, explore the open world, learn the rules and break them.

games.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
games.summary: Class is (back) in session with Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School! Play in solo or co-op and explore an all-new campus, escape life-threatening puzzle rooms, and unravel a conspiracy as old as the school itself — all before the bell rings.

games.name: Cosmic Express
games.summary: All aboard the Cosmic Express, a delightfully brain-melting game where the puzzles are out of this world! Your job is to lay down the train tracks across a series of tiny space stations. Each alien has a home of their own, and there’s only room for one extraterrestrial at a time in the passenger car. It's cute, harder than it looks, and guaranteed to give you hours of challenging fun across hundreds of levels.

games.name: A Good Snowman is Hard to Build
games.summary:
A puzzle game about being a monster and making snowmen.
Lovingly crafted by the mind of Alan Hazelden and the hands of Benjamin Davis.
With enchanting soundscapes from the heart of Priscilla Snow.

games.name: Sokobond Express
games.summary: A beautifully minimalist puzzle game combining chemical bonds and puzzling pathfinding.

games.name: Sokobond
games.summary: Sokobond is an elegantly designed puzzle game about chemistry. It's logical, minimalist, and crafted with love and science.

games.name: Lok Digital
games.summary: Lok are a fresh new kind of living beings that spawned in the middle of a vast, incomprehensible world. Help them through mind-bending word-search puzzles and guide them towards expansion of their civilisation.

games.name: Bonfire Peaks
games.summary: A difficult open world puzzle game about climbing mysterious ruins and setting fire to your belongings.

games.name: Dittori
games.summary: Deep beneath the world, an ancient god stirs. Master the forbidden power of Dittori, discover its secrets, and use it to bend reality to your will. Herald the end of all things.

games.name: He Who Watches
games.summary: Manipulate gravity, walk on walls, and use your magical arrow to solve mind-bending puzzles in this grid-based dungeon puzzler. Decipher secrets of the canvas and search for the mythos known as He Who Watches in this continuation of the Dungeon Crawler Jam 2022 winning entry.

games.name: 868-Back
games.summary:
The Hacker was known as the best of the best, delving into dark servers no one else could penetrate and returning with glittering data to sell on the black market.

Nobody knows why they quit. Some say their will was broken by the dark secrets at the heart of the Mainframe. Some say they simply retired to a penthouse suite in Low Earth Orbit.

But when you leave the world of high-stakes cybercrime, it's hard to stay gone. With a call from an old enemy in need of help..

868-HACK is 868-BACK.

games.name: Phonopolis
games.summary: The story of Phonopolis tackles relatable, real-world themes and topics, focusing on manipulation and individualism, but still keeping the overall experience playful and light-hearted. Players will take on the role of Felix, a thoughtful young man who, along with his fellow citizens, faces the imminent threat of falling under the control of the city’s authoritarian Leader once and for all, effectively losing their humanity. Accidentally becoming the only person who consciously recognizes the threat, young Felix must try to stop the Leader from playing the Absolute tone...

games.name: Secrets of Velendar Castle: Escape Room
games.summary: Find your way out of Velendar Castle. Discover why everything was taken from you. In this fantasy Escape room, you will have to solve puzzles to escape the wrath of the king… and find out what he wants from you.

games.name: BarrelBots
games.summary: A multilayered grid-based puzzle game featuring small robots that carry and stack Barrels of nuclear waste.

games.name: E9uations
games.summary: You are the equal sign(=). Rearrange the numbers and operators to form equation and solve the puzzle.

games.name: Paklyx
games.summary: PAKLYX is a turn-based puzzle game about finding the correct sequence of moves. Use special buttons to manipulate timers, delay them, and collect all keys in the level.

games.name: What's the Password?
games.summary: "What's the Password?" is a minimalistic puzzle game where you decode 4-digit passwords. Featuring over 100 puzzles!

games.name: Frogblock
games.summary: A Perspective Puzzle Game where you move blocks around as a tiny Frog to collect Ancient Artifacts to solve puzzles.

games.name: Trackastrophe!
games.summary: Trackastrophe! is a puzzle game where you guide an eccentric train through wacky worlds. Add tiles to the map layout, expand your train by collecting train cars, and pray you can get to the other side in one piece!

games.name: Lost in Cheese
games.summary: Cheese is blocking your way. Push cheese and clear the path to the big red button. A cozy puzzle adventure about cheese. Can you outsmart the cheese?

games.name: One Move Away
games.summary: One Move Away is a cozy, first-person puzzle game where you pack your belongings for another move and embark on a new chapter in life. With each move, you step into the lives of three unique characters, uncovering their personal stories through the items they take with them—or leave behind.

games.name: Schrodinger's Cat Burglar
games.summary: A puzzle heist adventure with a quantum flavour! The player controls Mittens the cat as she stumbles into a quantum experiment and gains incredible new powers - the ability to be in two places at once. Explore, solve logic puzzles and evade capture by pest control robots to ultimately save the day!

games.name: Compress(Space)
games.summary: A mind and space-bending puzzle game where you fold space to cheat your way through puzzles. Master space manipulation and reach beyond the stars to uncover the mystery at the end of the universe.

games.name: Burn With Me
games.summary: Burn With Me is a story-centric deckbuilder filled with cozy dread and occultic mysteries. In order to summon a Personal Demon you'll master inventive gameplay with position-based synergies, and permanently burn your cards and your soul.

games.name: Echo Weaver
games.summary: A fast-paced metroidBRAINia that tells the tale of a ruined society trapped in a fatal time loop. Uncover their story - and your own - as you explore what remains. Use each loop to chip away at the mystery, unlocking powerful knowledge to reshape the timeline and master the loop.

games.name: Hello Again
games.summary: Welcome to the world's coziest time loop! Hello Again is a puzzling adventure game set on an island filled with ancient ruins. Explore strange structures, solve clockwork puzzles, and befriend cute characters to uncover the island's secrets and break the loop.

games.name: Cat Squeeze
games.summary: Cat Squeeze is a cozy, brain-teasing cat puzzle game. Playing as an explosive kitten, use the extrusion of the pipeline, and navigate a maze to collect fish treats! Solve puzzles with precise blasts to escape, or get trapped by the soft maze.

games.name: Backpack Boy
games.summary: Backpack Boy is off on one of his treks when he discovers a peculiar flashlight that changes the world around him. Explore a seemingly abandoned structure in this puzzle platformer built around mode-swapping.

games.name: Trifolium: The Adventures of Gary Pretzelneck
games.summary: Discover hidden truths about the world in this 3D adventure about a giraffe with an unreasonably long neck. Figure out the rules, solve strange mysteries, and stumble upon unexpected twists. Choose your own path.

games.name: Bulbo's Belief System
games.summary:
Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told—learning allows him to see, move, and interact, but forgetting is just as important.

Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity to walk across gaps, and manage conflicting beliefs to solve mind-bending challenges. Experiment with what Bulbo knows (or doesn't) to navigate a world where perception shapes reality.

Can you control what Bulbo learns and unlearns to reach the goal?

games.name: Clover's Quadrants
games.summary: A moderately challenging puzzle game where you are what you eat - and you have four stomachs. Your four directions of movement are also inventory slots, and items in those slots will affect only that direction of movement.

games.name: Light of Atlantis
games.summary: In this 2D-Puzzle-Metroidvania you dive into the ruins of Atlantis. As a small robot you control the water level in various rooms to solve puzzles and discover the mysteries of an ancient society.

games.name: Rita
games.summary: Rita is a cozy adventure where a little chicklet solves word-based puzzles to transform the world around her. Follow her story across generations, meet her grandchicklet, and be a part of her legacy.

games.name: Red Frame
games.summary: A first-person exploration puzzle game in which you navigate the sprawling rooms of a hyperreal mansion buried beneath the earth. Solve intricate puzzles shaped by those who once lived there, and discover the mechanism preserving a family's legacy.

games.name: Prophet Margin
games.summary: Turn humble villages into a thriving network of trade and prosperity to satisfy the gods. Inspired by Euro board games, Prophet Margin is a thinky city-building puzzler where every road, resource, and connection creates new opportunities. Can you maximize the profits and please the gods?

games.name: Deg
games.summary: A non-linear pure puzzle game where you solve various puzzles using logical reasoning. Explore unknown puzzles in the game world.

games.name: Looking For Fael
games.summary:
Upon receiving a cryptic voicemail from your missing roommate, the ordinary confines of your apartment transform into a surreal labyrinth. Guided by his voice and a custom retro console in hand, embark on a journey to decipher the mysteries that have twisted your home into an enigmatic maze.

But beware. The further you venture into other realities, the harder it will be to find your way back.

games.name: Deductopia
games.summary: Explore the scenes, find clues, and sort out people, pets, and belongings in this cozy slice-of-life detective puzzle game. Fans of Duck Detective, Little Problems, and The Case of the Worst Day Ever will enjoy this new deduction game for all ages.

games.name: Pikku Adventure
games.summary: A challenging puzzle adventure about learning an alien language. Explore a strange world and meet its cute inhabitants. Decipher the language and earn their trust. With every word learned, you will uncover more secrets. Can you solve the mystery of this world and decide the fate of the Pikku?

games.name: Funeral for the Sun
games.summary: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 500 years of love, death and revolutions. A non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the complex history of a community cursed by supernatural forces.

games.name: Lock In
games.summary: An escape-the-room puzzle game. Solve locks to unlock locks. Unlock locks to unlock more locks. Lock in.

games.name: Trooops!
games.summary: Command a bizarre crew across a tiny, ever-changing archipelago. Give precise orders, outwit unshapely monsters, and survive the journey one squad at a time.

games.name: Mimic Meadows
games.summary: Mimic Meadows is a puzzle game about transforming into animals by mimicking their movement. Discover creative ways to wield this power while solving mind-bending puzzles. And attempt to unearth the many secrets of the meadows.

games.name: The Land Forgotten
games.summary: A hand-painted adventure puzzle game where language is magic. Explore a mysterious land, decipher ancient scripts, and solve language-based puzzles to uncover the secrets of a lost civilization.

games.name: Some Puzzles
games.summary: A surreal, FMV puzzle adventure. "It's got some puzzles."

games.name: Map Map: A Game About Maps
games.summary: Embark on a cozy treasure hunt as cartographer of an adventure crew. Use your sense of direction to make maps, help your companions and explore idyllic islands.

games.name: Emuurom
games.summary: Emuurom ("eh-moo rom") is a nonviolent creature-scanning exploration platformer, where you document an ancient paradise before it's lost forever. Emuurom is a rule-discovery game ("metroidbrainia") in the vein of Animal Well, Void Stranger and Tunic: knowledge opens new paths. Equipped with a unique scanner beam, you reveal hidden pathways and study the Emuurom creatures to gain knowledge and create new paths forward. The environmental puzzles range from obvious to obscure, with a plethora of secrets hidden in plain sight: this creates a multi-layered experience for many kinds of players. As you gain a better understanding on the world around you, the machinations of the Emuurom creatures begin to unfold...

games.name: A Monster's Expedition
games.summary:
A Monster’s Expedition (Through Puzzling Exhibitions) is a brand new adventure tour for monsters who love to learn about humans! Learn the ancient art of pushing trees over* and fashion your own pathways with our easy-build bridges. Then immerse yourself in human culture with all-new exhibits from our "Human Englandland" dig site, each accompanied with expert insights**!

*Trees have been pre-weakened by our experts for your convenience.

**Insights is not a legally binding term and may or may not include idle speculation, rumour and hearsay.

games.name: Spooky Express
games.summary: Plan the train route for the world’s spookiest theme park! Transport monsters to their destinations — but don’t let them bite the passengers or you’ll have a grave problem.

events.name: Cozy Game Awards 2026
events.description:
This year on May 28th (7pm CEST / 10am PDT), we are holding the first Cozy Game Awards, an award dedicated to celebrate our beloved cozy games! 

Experience a high-end awards show packed with world premieres and exclusive announcements. This event is officially featured by Valve, as part of the Cozy & Family Friendly Games Celebration, which is already in it's 4th year! 

The Cozy Game Awards Showcase, is co-hosted by wonderful content creators from the cozy gaming scene and is the best proof of just how far this community has come. 

Don't miss the biggest night in cozy gaming on May28th!

games.name: Fables of Dwale
games.summary: Forage, barter and explore a world that lives on after fairy tales end. Harvest fruits of the forest and engage with peculiar fairy folk and characters of folklore, as you uncover the secrets behind a dreadful illness that's fallen over the enchanted lands.

games.name: Rural Cat Trails
games.summary: Explore Nanoha Town, in the Japanese countryside, during the cherry blossom season as a cat. Use unique cat actions like Wall Jump, Dig, Paw Swat and Wiggle Butt Dash to make your way to Sakurana Shrine, a place of memories with your late Grandpa.

games.name: Loftia
games.summary: Welcome to Loftia, a cozy, multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! Connect with friends both old and new, to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and create a meaningful impact - together.

games.name: Winter Whiskers
games.summary: In this cozy snow-cleaning adventure, help bring Winterlight Harbor back to life after a sudden blizzard! Vacuum up snow, turn it into steam, and power the town. Melt icy paths, help your neighbors, and prepare for the Winter Festival!

games.name: Wild N Chill
games.summary: Wild n Chill is a laid-back wilderness escape where ya forage, hunt, and craft the off-grid cabin of your dreams. Far from the noise and nonsense, its just you, your trusty companion, and a pal or two.

games.name: Map Map: A Game About Maps
games.summary: Embark on a cozy treasure hunt as cartographer of an adventure crew. Use your sense of direction to make maps, help your companions and explore idyllic islands.

games.name: Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker
games.summary: Welcome Tavernkeep! In this D&D-inspired visual novel you will run a cozy seaside tavern, meet adventurers, gather rumours and mix fate-altering drinks to stop dreams from twisting into nightmares.

games.name: Ova Magica
games.summary: Experience a colorful farm game inspired by the classics! Train cute blob creatures, take care of your farm and make friends with the people of Clover Town.

games.name: The Witch's Bakery
games.summary:
The Witch’s Bakery is a 2D Adventure Puzzle game where you play as a joyful witch who opens a bakery in modern Paris.

She has a special power: she can heal emotions with her bread.

games.name: Cloudscrapers
games.summary:
Cloudscrapers is a minimalist strategy game with a relaxing atmosphere.

Start with simple tools and build the tallest tower you can. With each climb, you’ll improve, unlock upgrades, and reach new heights. As your tower rises, you’ll discover ancient relics and uncover secrets hidden deep within the clouds.

Designed for players who enjoy thoughtful gameplay without unnecessary complexity, the game blends replayable puzzle-strategy, meaningful progression, and a hand-drawn world you can get lost in.

games.name: Wish Upon a Llama
games.summary: Embark on a delightful journey of breeding and raising adorable animals like llamas, bunnies, and capybaras while building meaningful relationships with the residents of Llama Town. What unique animal breeds will you discover and whom among the townsfolk will you befriend? Adventure awaits!

games.name: Lou's Lagoon
games.summary: A cozy exploration-and-crafting adventure: fly your seaplane between tropical islands, collect resources with the Swirler 2000, rebuild storm damaged communities, and unravel the mystery surrounding Uncle Lou’s disappearance.

games.name: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth
games.summary: From the creators of Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley comes a heartwarming new adventure inspired by the beloved Moomin stories by Tove Jansson. This time, join Moomintroll himself on a charming but cold winter journey.

games.name: Kabuto Park
games.summary: Enjoy summer in Kabuto Park! Capture the cutest bugs, train them and win the Summer Beetle Battles Championship in this little bug collection game! Upgrade your equipment to find rarer, stronger and shinier beetles, butterflies, bees or dragonflies.

games.name: Drawquarium
games.summary: Draw your own fish and unlock new ways to decorate your aquarium. If you feed them well, they will gain a metallic shimmer as they age. Will you be the one to raise a golden fish in this relaxing sandbox experience?

games.name: Pottering
games.summary: Casual multiplayer gardening game. Invite friends to restore a garden to its former glory. Unlock more areas as you go and uncover secrets along the way, or just play the trumpet and hit each other with spades. Its up to you.

games.name: Solarpunk
games.summary:
Solarpunk is a survival game in a technically advanced world of floating islands. Alone or together with your friends, you can construct buildings, grow food, craft gadgets and explore distant islands with your own airship.

Use sunlight, wind and water to create an energy system and automate your processes like gathering ressoureces, watering your plants or catching fish.

events.name: shovel direct 2026
events.description: welcome to shovel direct 2026, a showcase for SHORT and FREE indie experiences.

games.name: Mingo's Boring Room
games.summary: Walk around your room over and over and over.

games.name: Gabha
games.summary: The town is under siege and it's up to this little smith to keep the guards armed!

games.name: Rodent Rooms
games.summary:
Rodent Rooms is a game about memories. And cheese! You are a rodent: small enough to slip through tiny gaps, sharp-toothed and stubborn enough to chew through anything.

Explore a series of giant dioramas—reconstructions of times past. Find pieces of cheese along the way to unlock special upgrades that aid your exploration.

games.name: Bargoer
games.summary:
Head to the bar, get a drink, make some friends, have interesting conversations, meet someone special.

Exit at the door when you are ready to leave.

Announced as part of the 5/28/2026 Shovel Direct.

games.name: Fossara
games.summary: A short collectathon. Collect creatures in a red lake.

games.name: Pigeon's Untitled Screenplay
games.summary: Pigeon is screwed! The studio is expecting the screenplay, but it's still not done. Find inspiration in the cafe and finish the screenplay before eternity ends.

games.name: Maitoläikky
games.summary: Maitoläikky is a milk-preservation unclimber descent platformer type dairy experience. Made for The Fainting Room Game Jam 003 in 4 hours.

games.name: They Can't Hear You
games.summary:
This dying star may kill you.

Something went wrong and your capsule was shot into the void of space during a Supernova blast. Now, your only hope of survival are your drones. Can you triangulate a rescue signal through the surrounding debris before your oxygen runs out? It's the only chance you've got.

games.name: FPBI Test Program
games.summary: A personality test. As seen on Shovel Direct 2026. By keV.

games.name: Magic Beans
games.summary: You've found a jar of magic beans seemingly dropped along the forest path, and feel it's time to revive your disheveled garden to see if the tales are true. A submission for The Fainting Room Jam #3. Also released as part of Shovel Direct 2026.

games.name: Lavender's
games.summary: A small cutesy game where you provide magical potions to a variety of strange characters.

games.name: Ham Hole
games.summary:
a peculiar and repulsive puzzle.

an elemental meat mystery.

an irritating insect infestation.

events.name: Insider Gaming May 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars, the Insider Gaming Showcase starts on May 28th at 3PM ET / 8PM BST.

- 55 Games
- 12 World Premieres
- No fluff

games.name: Where the Chips Fall
games.summary: Balatro Meets Blackjack with a Cuphead aesthetic in this casino rogue-lite where you gamble with you abilities. Every chip you bet can turn the tide in your favor, but you could also lose it all in a bad hand. Think you can beat the house?

games.name: Unyverse
games.summary: Unyverse is a sci-fi, action role-playing game (ARPG) created by Afrime Studios. Unyverse delivers an immersive, story-driven gameplay experience for single and co-op players enriched by a deep Afro-Futuristic aesthetic.

games.name: Alea
games.summary:
Alea is a fast-paced hero arena brawler where skill, timing and strategy collide in explosive multiplayer combat. Players choose from a diverse lineup of unique heroes. Each with signature abilities, distinct roles and skills. Battle across dynamic arenas designed to reward creativity and precision.

Matches are intense and fast-flowing, encouraging clutch plays, coordinated team tactics and high-impact duels. Fight for the core objective and increase your damage, health and regeneration.

Whether jumping into quick skirmishes or mastering high-level competitive play, Alea delivers an action-packed experience where adapting on the fly is the key to victory and every fight is a chance to forge your legend.

games.name: Mithra
games.summary: A cryptic puzzle/adventure game that blurs the line between fiction and reality. A tale of cultish affairs that sweeps through the nighttime streets of London, weaves through the back alleys of Beijing and beyond. Come with us.

games.name: Cursed Blood
games.summary: Play as vengeful Samurai Apes fueled by blood in a lightning-fast mix of stealth and action. Spill blood, cut limbs and claim vengeance.

games.name: Becoming Pablo
games.summary: Becoming Pablo is a turn-based grand-strategy game where you build and lead a cartel empire. Conquer territories, manage your operation, and outsmart rivals in the gritty 70s-90s drug trade era. Every choice impacts your rise to power, or your downfall. Can you dominate the underworld?

games.name: Smash 'N Grab
games.summary: Smash ‘N Grab is a destructive, speedrunning beat ’em up starring Smash and Grab - a robot and raccoon duo pulling off explosive heists. Tethered by a rope, they race against the clock for the perfect score!

games.name: Take That Mainstage!
games.summary: It's 1992 in Emerald City. The world screams for change. You made the leap, now fulfill your destiny and change the world. Build your band, write real music you perform, manage relationships, and reach the top of the charts. In this hybrid life sim, be the one to Take That Mainstage!

games.name: RollerGirl
games.summary: A narrative adventure about a summer spent rollerblading in the mid-2000s. Explore a quiet town as Naomi, a teenage girl looking for an escape. Your in-game MP3 player isn't just for music; its playlist shapes the world & story as you run errands for quirky neighbours / get entangled in local drama.

games.name: My Pet Hooligan
games.summary: Rebel against the evil overlord Metazuckbot by wreaking havoc on Hooliland City. Fight each other, destroy stuff, skateboard like a pro-skater, graffiti the buildings, or just hang out with friends. Playing the way you want is what it means to be a Hooligan.

games.name: Brimvahl Crown
games.summary: Brimvahl Crown is a narrative driven action RPG that follows the story of princess Kazmiel, a legendary seraph that was exiled from her kingdom. Now that the dark rises, Kazmiel must return to action. Dodge, Parry, and strike enemies down and save the world from the might of the Deathless King!

games.name: DekaDuck
games.summary: DekaDuck is a 2D action platformer, featuring fully hand-drawn art and animation. Fight enemies using their own abilities and quirks to solve puzzles and defeat bosses, in a sci-fi world full of conspiracies!

games.name: Carrier Cuties: Pets in Mechs!
games.summary: Carrier Cuties fast-paced 3D arena fighting game where Pets in Hu-Mechs battle in highly interactive and destructible environments using the surroundings to fight. Battle with a partner against two opponents to win all the glory and treats!

games.name: Ungaland!
games.summary: "Dive into a prehistoric world of adventure where the power of primal seeds changes everything. Unlock abilities, attach them to your weapons, and face challenges in a vibrant land full of action, and surprises."

games.name: Hexrite
games.summary: You are a sorcerer part of a group of mysterious characters embarking on an adventure to fulfil an ancient magical ritual. Fight, quest and explore in this stylized action-adventure indie title!

games.name: Zoominoes
games.summary: Build the ultimate Zoo in this number-go-up roguelike deckbuilder. Find powerful mythical animals, boost them with snacks, and even manipulate the board itself. Break the game by scoring millions (and more) with insane combos.

games.name: Dicetris
games.summary: Dicetris is a falling-block puzzler with depth. Stack dice in columns, sum to hit the target, combo colors to clear overloaded stacks. Twist your strategy around special dice and rule-bending map conditions. Easy to learn. Built to master.

games.name: Good News
games.summary: You've been hired as a chief editor to make this newspaper grow, but your writers are awful. Correct their drafts, set the tone of the news to fit your audience, make readership grow; and form a relationship with the shady politicians that will push you to give them good press in an electoral year

games.name: Trickshotterz
games.summary: SCORE IN THE TOP OF THE CUP. Pick abilities, grab wild powerups, and pull off absurd trickshots that hit harder the crazier they are. Play with up to 4 players locally, online, or hop into public matchmaking.

games.name: Ward 107: Silence
games.summary: Ward 107: Silence is a first-person psychological horror game. The microphone is the key: use your voice to solve puzzles and uncover the horrific experiments of Project H.O.P.E. Speak to progress, but silence is your only defense when the victims are hunting you. If you scream, it's over.

games.name: Malice in Wonderland
games.summary: Tear through Wonderland and break free of The Hatter's control in this fast-paced action roguelike. Augment your abilities to destroy your foes and escape before you're out of time!

games.name: Valorborn
games.summary: Dive into a living medieval fantasy sandbox RPG. Whether you lead a group or walk alone, carve your own identity. Hunt, steal, trade, build, or wander freely. Explore a vast open world and shape your journey through immersive roleplay and boundless freedom.

games.name: Monster Mercs
games.summary: Transform into the monsters you slay and unleash new spells and abilities. Team up with up to 3 friends, take on unique contracts to get paid, upgrade your character and gear, and unlock powerful transformations in this fast-paced co-op action RPG.

games.name: Grimps
games.summary: GRIMPS is an exciting first-person shooter where you fight adorable, yet dangerous enemies in a series of increasingly insane battles. Shoot a fish like a gun, throw stools, and rip your fluffy foes to shreds!

games.name: Rusthaven
games.summary: Rusthaven is a cosy management game about rebooting the world in the anti-apocalypse. Journey across an abandoned planet on a solar skyship, salvaging broken-down bots in need of rescue. Clean up the world, upcycle retro technology, and build a peaceful sanctuary where all can thrive and belong.

games.name: Don't Lose Aggro
games.summary: Experience the thrill of MMORPG tanking in this single-player roguelite that lets you perfect your tanking skills without guild drama or 4-hour raid nights!

games.name: Everything Is Gun!
games.summary: Dominate in a brutal, lightning-fast old-school FPS. Modify yourself into the perfect weapon, unleash mass destruction, conquer runs, invade others, and ascend to global supremacy. Prisoner #11 18 1978, you now belong to A1KTRZ. Your survival is broadcast to billions. What will remain of your soul?

games.name: End of Ember
games.summary: Explore a gory Hell in this twin-stick shooter that pays homage to badass horror franchises. Kill demons, upgrade items, and fight weird and gross bosses until they explode in piles of gore. Who is Ember? What is reality?

games.name: Blind Descent
games.summary: Blind Descent is a multiplayer open-world survival adventure game with up to 4 players set in the Martian underground.

games.name: Terminal War
games.summary: Terminal War is a grounded, team-based third-person shooter set in a fractured America during the late 1990s. Engage in intense combat across war-torn cities, forgotten towns, and contested territory where every bullet, every strike, and every decision counts.

games.name: Combo Devils
games.summary: Combo Devils is an evolution of the platform-fighting genre. Stylish combat, and a cooperative roguelite mode offers content for all player skill levels. An experience that balances accessibility with a high execution ceiling for a dedicated core player base to grow around.

games.name: The Stinky Adventures of DungDung
games.summary: DungDung, a martial arts dung beetle, sets out to defend the kingdom from Princess Petunias creeping corruption...only to discover that he's inside a glitching videogame! He must master poojitsu. Hell harness glitch powers. Can you save the realm and the game in this love letter to the classics?

games.name: Etre
games.summary: Enter an ancient alien mind spiraling toward collapse. Explore shifting inner worlds, unlock new abilities, and battle hostile anomalies in a 3D third-person action adventure. Stabilize the mind to forge a new world or let it awaken as something far more terrifying.

games.name: Crete
games.summary: Fight against the Ancestors and other biopunk creatures. Use their DNA to build your procedural weapons, find a friend and combine your skills to be even more powerful. The further you go, the better rewards you will get for the next run. It is up to you to reveal what is up there in the north.

games.name: Brave New Wonders
games.summary: Command automatons with customized instructions to build Brave New Wonders in this factory automation game. You can deploy your automatons to explore a post-apocalypse world, discover ruins from the past, battle, collect resources and make your automated factories thrive!

games.name: Hope in the City
games.summary: 17-year-old Hope Song returns home from school to find her parents missing. Use Hope’s observant eye as an artist to investigate, piece together clues, and uncover a dark world beneath the surface of her peaceful life in this non-linear narrative mystery game.

games.name: ZeroSpace
games.summary: ZeroSpace is a hybrid sci-fi RTS / RPG game that allows you to play as the commander of The Protectorate, a galactic force dedicated to securing humanity’s place in the galaxy. The Orion sector is locked in a vicious power struggle between many alien factions, ready to fight to the death.

games.name: Island of Winds
games.summary:
Island of Winds takes you to 17th century Iceland, plunging them into a magical world teeming with trolls, giant spiders, and mythical creatures. Experience all of this through the eyes of the magic-wielding Brynhild, a member of the Balance Keepers who draws her magical power from the natural world.

Brynhild's journey has her on a quest to find her mentor, Hrymja, that will take her through nine incredible landscapes that draw on Iceland's stunning natural beauty. These locations range from the fiery Lava of Skjól to the treacherous Jökla lagoon and gleaming Obsidian Shore. Brynhild will face legendary creatures on her journey, such as the powerful and majestic Bear King, Hafgúfa - Guardian of the Sea and the majestic elven lady Vör of the Oasis.

games.name: Eggstinct!
games.summary: Eggstinct! is a cooperative, physics-driven dinosaur adventure where you and your friends must work together to rescue fragile eggs and survive chaotic prehistoric hazards.

games.name: Hawthorn
games.summary: Former developers from Bethesda, BioWare, and Naughty Dog bring you a sandbox RPG realm of anthropomorphic animals and fairy creatures. Play co-op or solo as you build a village of memorable NPCs, farm, craft, explore, and celebrate the seasons in an ever-changing world bigger than you.

games.name: Project Madras
games.summary:
Project Madras, is a semi-linear open-world game, being developed in Chennai, India, by a small team and led by developer leader Royston.

Explore and experience the vibe of namma chennai through "PROJECT MADRAS". The game which lets you roam around the shores of Marina ,streets of mount road , monuments of chennai covering all the highlights of this city ,with a mission to accomplish!.

The flavour of this open world game is rich in content and language, as it takes place in the capital city of the state, where the world's oldest language "TAMIL" is still surviving and embraced over centuries. Get involved with the natives of the city, where a rooted love and affection is served with some spicy madras delicacy.

games.name: Lunar Strike
games.summary: Lunar Strike blends speculative fiction with a game world grounded in hard science. The game focuses on compelling survival and character-driven storytelling over combat. A race against time to preserve the evidence of humanity’s presence on the Moon before its inevitable collapse and destruction.

games.name: Paddler
games.summary: A rhythm-typing bartending game set at a sizzling swim-up bar! Your goal? Serve up tropical drinks by typing their ingredients in rhythm to the music.

games.name: Waters of Ragnarok
games.summary: Waters of Ragnarök is a tactical naval survival game set after the Norse apocalypse. Navigate cursed seas, explore the lands, scavenge the massive corpses of Jötunns, and lead your crew through tactical battles against survivors and monsters in this Norse survival exploration game.

games.name: Bassai-Dai
games.summary: A stylized action-adventure game that blends fast-paced combat with creative, ink brush-based gameplay

games.name: Toypunk
games.summary: A comedic third-person shooter roguelite where you control customizable puppets armed with an infinite toybox of absurd weaponry. Fight hordes of cotton-stuffed baddies across fantastical biomes with your friends or on your own. Experience crazy synergies and unlock more toys between runs!

games.name: Hounded
games.summary: You are Duke, a determined young Border Collie who is searching for their lost master, the leader of The Rebellion. Hounded by a cunning hunter, can you track the scent, unearth the power of The Tide and find your way home?

games.name: Azur
games.summary: Azur is a fast-paced PvP survival FPS set on the French island of Belmas. Every time you respawn, complete missions, explore, and survive as long as possible to secure the best gear, with the risk of losing everything.

games.name: Cubex
games.summary: Cubex is a horror escape room game in first person, collaborative (or not) for up to 4 players, where your objective will be to find the exit of a giant cube.

games.name: Meowstery Wisp
games.summary: A multiplayer social deduction and investigation game where players gather clues, debate, and manipulate trust to resolve a mystery; with no elimination until the big finale.

games.name: AGX GP
games.summary: AGX is a heart thumpingly fast, Anti-Gravity racing game. It's lightning‑fast action and Xtreme ability‑based gameplay, will push your reactions and skills to the limit! Welcome To AGX!

games.name: Eclipse 2: Invasion of Darkness
games.summary: Eclipse 2: Invasion of Darkness – is an isometric, story-driven game in the Action RPG genre, combining the mechanics of metroidvania exploration and the dynamics of modern slashers. Lead the medieval resistance against the alien invasion on Earth!

events.name: Indie Quest 2026
events.description:
Indie Quest returns May 28 with new looks at the most exciting upcoming Indie JRPGs, including 6 world premiere game reveals! 

Tune in live at 5PM Pacific, 8PM Eastern so you don't miss a single announcement.

games.name: Full Circle
games.summary: Full Circle is a JRPG set in a dystopian future where humanity has ruined the planet and is now living in flying cities while a certain part is locked out and has to gather ressources for the wealthy ones.

games.name: Robot Rhapsody
games.summary: A futurist fairytale exploring AI themes, technology, existentialism, and strange transformations in a suffering world. A retro-inspired JRPG presentation of a modernist, character-driven drama.

games.name: Emery Hearts
games.summary: Immerse yourself in this thrilling action JRPG and uncover the secrets of Emery crystals as you face challenging enemies that will demand all your skill and ingenuity to defeat them.

games.name: Stratagem Lost
games.summary: Brave perilous turn-based strategy encounters and uncover dark conspiracies in a broken world. Draft your team of unique characters and have them learn skills from each other.

games.name: Infinite Alliance
games.summary: Heroes and villains from 13+ Indie JRPGs collide, in this story rich Crossover Event! Chained Echoes, Jack Move, 8-Bit Adventures 2, Beloved Rapture, Quartet, and more unite for a totally FREE adventure!

games.name: Edge of Memories
games.summary: The Corrosion, a plague of unparalleled proportions, has already ravaged the Astryan continent. On the other side of the world, the continent of Avaris and its nomadic peoples—so far spared from the horrors spawned by this abomination—now stand on the brink of extinction. Eline, an itinerant Soul Whisperer, relentlessly battles the force that turns the once-thriving fauna, flora and humans of this lush land into grotesque abominations. Following a mysterious encounter, a dark power awakens within her, one that may hold the key to ending this apocalypse: the ability to control the Corrosion within her own body.

games.name: Alarial's Blessing
games.summary: Experience the tragic tale of three wandering mercenaries and the lonely goddess who wouldn't let them die. Fight challenging, turn-based battles and explore a continent of forgotten mysteries in this fresh twist on the JRPG genre.

games.name: Crystal Project II
games.summary: Crystal Project II is a non-linear JRPG with a seamless open world and telegraphed tactical combat. Find new classes, learn new abilities, and collect powerful equipment to customize your party and uncover the mysteries of the land. No random encounters and no permanent missables.

games.name: D-Beat Heroes
games.summary: D-Beat Heroes is a grid-based tag-team action RPG! Choose powerful abilities to take with you into combat and fight against your enemies on the grid! Protect Daylight City from the forces of evil and maintain order. Do it before it's too late!

games.name: Diorama Break
games.summary: The tactics JRPG where you can talk directly to the Hero (whether he wants it or not). Fight through turn-based battles and awkward conversations alike.

games.name: Alabaster Dawn
games.summary: Break Nyx’s curse and guide humanity's rebirth in this top-down 2.5D Action RPG from the creators of CrossCode. Battle enemies with stylish combos, wield multiple divine weapons, solve intriguing puzzles and explore a changing world.

games.name: Axe Cop
games.summary: Fight all of the bad guys! Axe Cop and his team of colorful characters must go on an epic adventure, that covers his ten-year comic book history, to rid the world of all bad guys once and for all!

games.name: A Fighter’s Nova: Mindara
games.summary: A Fighter’s Nova: Mindara is a narrative-driven JRPG that fuses character-focused storytelling with the intensity and precision of a true tag-team fighting game.

games.name: The Remake of the End of the Greatest RPG of All Time
games.summary: The Remake of the End of the Greatest RPG of All Time is the last hour of a lost (nonexistent) JRPG, "remade” in 3D pixel art complete with director’s commentary, the digital manual, and archival footage.

games.name: The Grey Elegy: Under the Cursed Wings
games.summary: On a land where light and shadow intertwine, a boy and a girl embark on a journey of destiny. With storybook-inspired art and an epic tale of bonds and choices, experience a timeless RPG adventure.

games.name: Stories of Somnia
games.summary: Unravel a story-rich adventure blending a turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics. Use spells to grapple across gaps, uncover hidden routes, and combine abilities with powerful Dreamkin companions to overcome a world consumed by Gloam.

games.name: Saveseeker
games.summary:
Saveseeker is a turn-based RPG adventure that follows a tenacious time-traveling girl who must save the world from her father.

Play as Emmer Edette, a cheerful and carefree child who discovers she inherited her famous father's ability to 'save' moments in time at specific points worldwide. Alongside her grumpy dragon toy sidekick, Tippleton, she embarks on a journey to overwrite all of the world’s save points (“Save Stops”) and confront her father, a once-great Hero using his power for nefarious means.

Explore six vibrant lands, recruit the Hero’s former foes, and save the world from an untimely end!

games.name: Thermocline
games.summary: A BLIZZARD RAGES. Lone survivor, you are STRANDED upon a FRIGID CORPSE-PLANET. THEY seek your warmth, sucking Soul from the shadows. AND TONIGHT, THE WIND IS YOUR CLOSEST SEMBLANCE OF A FRIEND.

games.name: Codex: Eternal Eclipse
games.summary: Embark on a quirky adventure with four unique main characters as they seek their truth, battling gods, colossal corporations, and bizarre foes along the way. Unravel the mystery of the Eternal Eclipse and uncover the ancient secrets of the world!

games.name: Canvas City
games.summary: Canvas City is a turn-based tactics RPG of rebellion on rollerblades. Lead a crew of skaters and street artists rising up against an oppressive regime. Each map is a battleground and a canvas, where your actions shift control, leave your mark, and shape the city’s future.

games.name: Bestiario
games.summary: Bestiario is an exciting turn-based combat JRPG based on Spanish mythology and folklore, full of surprises. Should we call it an ÑRPG?

games.name: Anima: Song from the Abyss
games.summary: Song from the Abyss is the new Action RPG set in the world of Gaïa, from the renowned roleplaying book franchise Anima Beyond Fantasy. The game allows you to control two different characters and explore a world full of mysteries. Experience a fluid combat system and a deep story with unforgettable characters.

games.name: Llewl and the Lyre of Two Worlds
games.summary: Retro Styled jRPG heavily inspired by the classics of the 90s.

games.name: Godless Avalon
games.summary: An RPG adventure with guns! Explore unique settings and discover secrets. A fantasy comedy with high-stakes and fast pacing.

games.name: Colossus: Eternal Blight
games.summary: Colossus is a story-driven action RPG with precision combat, a hand-crafted pixel art world, and choices that leave real scars. The Blight will test you. How you answer is up to you.

games.name: Nocturne
games.summary: The afterlife is now digital. Discover that eternal life comes with sacrifice in a genre-defying RPG with unique rhythm combat.

games.name: One Fenix Down
games.summary: A retro-inspired, classic turn-based RPG for those with nostalgia for the '90s golden era. Explore a vast world with 14 playable characters, fight hundreds of unique enemies, and delve into an epic story of war, betrayal, and redemption.

games.name: Toada Brava
games.summary: You’ve got busted! Save your mom and escape from Santacrúz Dungeon alongside a ragtag team of heroes in this hand-drawn JRPG.

games.name: People of Note
games.summary: In this turn-based RPG musical, join Cadence as she recruits an ensemble of musicians on her quest for stardom. Experience turn-based combat like never before, where each battle is a musical performance with evolving combat conditions and genre-bending mashup attacks!

games.name: Hermit and Pig
games.summary: Hermit and Pig is a turn-based, adventure RPG about a reclusive hermit and his truffle-hunting pig. These unlikely heroes must explore, forage, fight, and overcome unfortunate personal shortcomings to solve the mystery of a sinister corporate plot.

games.name: Dobbel Dungeon
games.summary: Gather your party, roll your dice and embark on a quest to discover why the local wildlife has suddenly turned evil! No two adventures are the same in this dice-powered tactical RPG!

games.name: Escape from Ever After
games.summary: When a greedy megacorp with the power to enter storybooks takes over Flynt Buckler’s fairytale world, he must get a job to sabotage them from within! Climb the corporate ladder, fight in stylish, snappy combat, and dive into storybook worlds from Lovecraft to sci-fi in this genre-bending RPG!

games.name: Under the Island
games.summary: A 2D Action RPG set in a fantasy world inspired by the 1990s. Explore an island, fight monsters, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery of an ancient civilization. Help the inhabitants and interact with the plants and animals of the island.

games.name: Stardust: Wish of Witch
games.summary: STARDUST: Wish of Witch is a single-player SRPG beautifully crafted in pixel art. Follow the secret of the wish-granting star and join the adventure of the girl “Star” and the mage “Yu”.

games.name: Seed of God
games.summary: Seed of God is a epic scale turnbased Battle 2D/3d JRPG with a characterdriven story that will take you on a unforgettable journey in the style of FinalFantasy. Face choices that define your morale (Good/Bad) and change events as you explore a fantasy world and unfold this epic saga

games.name: Infinity Knights: Xross
games.summary: A King and his Infinity Knights wield The Armaments - weapons capable of reviving slain enemies. Xross, the newest Infinity Knight, will embark on a life-changing adventure as he experiences both the thrill and dark reality of what it means to be eternal.

games.name: My Familiar
games.summary: In this RPG, wake up as a fresh familiar on the mean streets of Wish City, where the denizens are dark and corruption is king. Fight, flee, and aggressively rap your way through a vibrant inner city gauntlet, chock full of dysfunctional demons, in flashy, over the top, turn-based battles.

games.name: Lie of Caelum: Spirit
games.summary: Bound by secrets and divided by class, a group of unlikely allies are swept into a global conspiracy. As they peel back the layers of history, they discover a reality that defies explanation: A Truth that challenges the very fabric of their existence.

games.name: RuneSmith
games.summary: Grab your beer and join Durgrim into his quest to get his money back from a summoner that is trying to end all creation. Runesmith is a humorous RPG where a grudge-holding dwarf runesmith engraves powerful runes, talks to other dwarves and kills everything else!

games.name: Starless Umbra
games.summary: Starless Umbra is a couch co-op action RPG. Join Amalia as she searches for her friend in a land afflicted by a noxious fog. The deeper she ventures, the further she unravels a force that threatens far more than just one life.

games.name: Yami Kids
games.summary: Play as "The Yami Twins" and uncover the mystery behind your family's killers. Yami Kids is a tale of tragedy, familial bonds, and revenge. Face off against trainers in "Shadow Duels", and make contracts with Oni to aid you on your quest.

games.name: Wicked Night: Holy Knights
games.summary: Lead your army, shape their bonds, and watch those connections come alive on the battlefield as you fight to prevent the Wicked Night from spreading across Solance.

games.name: Sunny Trails
games.summary: It was supposed to be a great party, but when Amaterasu and her sisters arrive, they find everything abandoned and all guests turned into stone. Go on an adventure in this cozy turn-based RPG to solve this mystery and save your friends!

games.name: Ironwing Valiant: Record of Astera
games.summary: Ironwing Valiant is a fast-paced Mecha action-JRPG set in the fantasy world of Euridia! Taking the guise of a young mecha pilot named Reinhardt, you will battle through sleepy villages, imposing fortress cities, and war-scarred industrial centers!

games.name: Cardaire: Eternal Aces
games.summary: Get ready to crack packs and throw cards in Cardaire: Eternal Aces, a single-player collectible card RPG! Explore a unique world, hunt down powerful cards, and build the deck that'll make you a Cardaire legend.

games.name: Seed of Nostalgia
games.summary: Seed of Nostalgia is a beautiful pixel art JRPG which follows the tale of Atilla and a cast of intriguing characters on a quest to save their dying world. Explore a mystical land, unravel dark secrets, and confront ancient forces in a tale of magic, sacrifice, and unexpected revelations.

games.name: Gravastar
games.summary: Gravastar is a sci-fi fantasy JRPG (Japanese-style Role Playing Game) for PC and consoles that combines a traditional JRPG aesthetic with a unique and fast-paced, turn-based battle system inspired by 2D arcade fighting games. The battle system in Gravastar is set apart from traditional turn-based JRPGs by its real-time button-combo input system. Alter the flow of battle, master your character's movesets, build enormous combos, and string together chains to dispatch your foes.

games.name: SacriFire
games.summary: A modern JRPG-inspired game with a unique battle system, rich story, fantastic visuals and music by Motoi Sakuraba.

events.name: The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
events.description: Evento listado na agenda oficial do Summer Game Fest.

games.name: Lifted
games.summary:
Step into the Anytime Elevator and get LIFTED — a cinematic single-player 2.5D puzzle-platform adventure from a former Disney ride designer.

Slacker Ari Buktu only pokes his head into Professor Raventhorpe’s lab for extra credit; seconds later he’s hurtling through history on a reckless mission to steal a legendary tiara and fix the professor’s love-life. Each stop opens a new era, a bigger puzzle, and the shadow of a rival tomb-raider who’s always one jump behind…

games.name: Entropy
games.summary: Entropy is a tactical turn-based RPG inspired by classic JRPGs. Assemble your party of mercenaries and forge your own path towards an expedition into hell to stop the demonic incursion. Choices you make along the way will determine the fate of your world.

games.name: Signy & Mino: Against All Gods
games.summary: Signy & Mino: Against All Gods is a new kind of combo RPG where you and your pup piece together flashy combos to dismantle a plethora of enemies! Discover your hidden powers as you find yourself hurtled into a conflict amongst the gods.

games.name: Edenfall: Legacy of the First Wardens
games.summary: Unveil a mystical action-adventure where you shift between human, wolf, raccoon, and raven. Weave fluid combos across forms, purge corruption, and awaken the land’s lost beauty. Together with your spirit fox companion, embark on a soulbound journey of transformation, memory, and inner peace.

games.name: R.override
games.summary: Explore an alien planet as a fierce little rover on a run-based mission to rescue a lost crew and uncover their secrets.

games.name: Ground Zero Hero
games.summary: Kill mutants. Absorb their remains. Mutate into something stronger every run. Stack insane power combos and survive overwhelming hordes in this fast, chaotic, highly replayable action roguelite bullet hell.

games.name: Curse of Resthaven
games.summary: In this single-player narrative roguelite, govern a cursed island as you investigate your niece’s mysterious disappearance. Interrogate, trade, upgrade, and embark upon card-based expeditions to uncover dark secrets – before the next cataclysm strikes.

games.name: Shade Protocol
games.summary: Shade Protocol is a 2D cyber-fantasy Metroidvania where music, code, and combat collide. Swap between DAWN and SHADE forms to unleash devastating abilities, wield Instruments as weapons, and rewrite reality itself in a world on the brink of annihilation by the Shade Protocol.

games.name: Lucid
games.summary: Discover your own legend in Lucid. Platform through a crystalline world torn apart by calamity, absorb powerful abilities that expand movement and enhance combat against a diverse cast of enemies and bosses, all in gorgeous pixel art inspired by the golden age of 2D sidescrollers.

games.name: Animal Game
games.summary: A 2-4 player rogue-lite party brawler where dying makes you evolve. Pick a cute animal. Grab a weapon. Wreck your friends. The catch? Last place gets the wildest upgrades. No lead is ever safe.

games.name: Sonzai
games.summary: Sonzai is a 2d, action-brawler platforming RPG. The town of Kumotoshi holds secrets. A new life, new people, new spirits. What are the threads that bind people together? What is the nature of magic? All presented in a beautiful, inky art style - with every single frame of animation hand drawn.

games.name: Well Dweller
games.summary: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer- a tiny bird armed with a matchstick- who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.

games.name: Ballgame
games.summary: Smash, bounce, and grind your way through Ballgame, a ballsy physics platformer where you are the ball. Compete in high-stakes tournaments, physics-bending parlor games, and pinball-inspired courses that are anything but golf!

games.name: Zozo and the Lost Dreams
games.summary: Help Zozo find his way home in this cartoon-inspired Metroidvania platformer. Pillow-fight sentient pastries, train under an octopus master, and brave a cybernetic jungle as you explore the vibrant landscapes of Zozo's dreams.

games.name: Kidbash: Super Legend
games.summary: Kidbash: Super Legend is an exciting 2D platformer that blends classic gaming with a modern touch. You'll go on a thrilling adventure through two different phases - the Mountain and the Village. Your goal is to defeat Tao Shen Long, and begin the journey to becoming a Super Legendary Hero.

games.name: Neighborhoods
games.summary: Neighborhoods is a cozy city sim where you shape streets to help people thrive, gather, and develop strong opinions about a particular bench. We're reimagining the city builder as a city fixer.

games.name: Pale Tide
games.summary: A top-down zombie extraction survival game where you and your dog scavenge resources from deadly infected zones. Rescue survivors, and return to a hidden bunker to upgrade your gear, grow your crew, and prepare your escape before the largest horde ever witnessed floods the region, the Pale Tide.

games.name: Bracer
games.summary: Grab a buddy and brace for chaos in this 3D Fantasy Shoot Em Up (SHMUP). Face off against a twisted necromancer fueled by a cursed bracer and a bloodlust for destruction. Blast enemies, dodge projectiles, unlock upgrades, and customize your hero with unique weapons, skills, and skins.

games.name: Canvas City
games.summary: Canvas City is a turn-based tactics RPG of rebellion on rollerblades. Lead a crew of skaters and street artists rising up against an oppressive regime. Each map is a battleground and a canvas, where your actions shift control, leave your mark, and shape the city’s future.

games.name: Duskfade
games.summary: Duskfade is a colorful adventure in a world where the torments of the past haunt you. Battle against your memories in a dizzying dance to fade the shadows of the dusk.

games.name: MegaGum
games.summary: Play as Uja in this 3D bubble-punk platformer blending action and adventure. Jump, glide, fight, and walk on walls using your Gum-powered abilities. Outsmart the traps of the mysterious Mister Gum and climb floor by floor through a factory filled with secrets, puzzles, and surprises.

games.name: Wild Blue Skies
games.summary: Wild Blue Skies reimagines the classic on-rail adventures of the '90s. Join Bowie Stray and the Blue Bombers as they soar through the skies on a mission to save the world in this action-packed, nostalgic journey!

games.name: Raji: Kaliyuga
games.summary: Six years after the great war, destiny bleeds into prophecy as gods and mortals blur. Raji, the warrior of faith, and Darsh, the dreamwalker, face Mahabalasuras wrath as he tears open heavens gates, unleashing Kaliyuga-an age where every choice can unmake the universe.

games.name: Monsters Are Coming!
games.summary: Beware, monsters are coming! In this Tower-Survivor rogue-lite, you protect an ever-moving city from unrelenting hordes. Gather resources, fortify defenses, and boost potential through enhanced player progression. Will you reach the Arch?

games.name: Breathedge 2
games.summary: Sent on a reckless mission, you find yourself in outer space filled with numerous dangers and things to explore. Build, craft, manage your crew, look after the chicken, and defeat the evil space corporation in this new breathtaking survival game.

games.name: Theos: Cities of Myth
games.summary: A modern take on classic city-builders, Theos: Cities of Myth lets you develop a thriving metropolis dedicated to one of 7 Greek Deities. Raise an imposing sanctuary, meet your citizens needs, and found a city worthy of the Gods.

games.name: Twinkle’s Galactic Tour
games.summary: Travel the galaxy and bash enemies to the beat in this 90's anime styled, low-poly, musical platforming adventure! Jump from planet-to-planet, collect 'em all in classic platforming-style zones, and meet the locals in big, open city hubs full of activities, side-quests, and mysteries.

games.name: Isle Goblin
games.summary: Isle Goblin has been invaded by destructive humans, and complete annihilation of the delicate ecosystem is inevitable. Armed with only your monster friends and the resources available, do you have what it takes to revert the island to its former glory?

games.name: Meadgard
games.summary: Run your own viking pub in a chaotic co-op management adventure! Grab your friends, axes and tankards, and work together to both serve and fight your hot-headed customers. It’s time to show the world what viking hospitality looks like!

games.name: Chivalware
games.summary: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

games.name: Husk Protocol
games.summary: ATTENTION! HUSK PROTOCOL INITIATED! Prepare to engage in a challenging deck-driven mecha game. Synergise between powerful Husks, utilise a dynamic deck and avoid detection from the city’s mainframe as you infiltrate the machine-driven brutopolis of Aeterna.

games.name: Ornélia
games.summary: A cozy village-builder and benevolent god game where you build freely, guide the Kinous, and spread kindness to bring your valley back to life.

games.name: The Dark West
games.summary: The Dark West is a grim ARPG reimagining the genre with deep player agency, innovative systems, and and a fresh take on player progression. We're crafting an experience that blends cutting-edge gameplay within an engaging and immersive world.

games.name: Canyons
games.summary: Canyons is a third-person extraction shooter set in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Fight for your existence in 4 player co-op or solo, control massive Crawlers, build a settlement for survivors, and conquer this savage world!

games.name: Blades of Mirage
games.summary: Embark on an epic isometric action RPG set in a Southeast Asian-inspired world. As Mira, use your ability to create water-based weapons and explore ancient ruins scattered across unique islands. Confront corrupted, powerful creatures and solve intricate puzzles to secure the ancient relics.

games.name: Poly Fighter
games.summary: Poly Fighter is a single-player roguelike fighting game. Learn new moves from every opponent you defeat to build your fighter’s unique style. Battle through tense retro-arcade duels with a choice of simple or motion inputs to master your moveset and claim your title!

games.name: Kirk Mephisto
games.summary: Follow Kirk on his quest to stop the ongoing battle between birds and wormkind in this sci-fantasy, hack n slash, action game. Fighting alongside Kirk are his childhood friends Halice the worm warrior princess and Carper the secret agent bee.

games.name: Infamous Keepers
games.summary: Defend your dungeon AND your job! Tower Defense meets Roguelite in Infamous Keepers. Use strategy and some clever trickery to defeat waves of enemies: set up towers and deadly traps, send your employees into the line of fire, and slaughter any intruders left standing yourself.

games.name: Exark
games.summary: Exark is an engine builder about building a city aboard a gigantic ark-ship. Construct buildings, staff them with crew members, and maximise your ark's resource production by exploiting powerful synergies. Lead your Great House to safety at the rim of the world.

games.name: Pixel Washer
games.summary: Pixel Washer is a cozy, zen-like game where you play as a cute piggy power washing beautiful pixelated worlds. Wash sprites, upgrade your power washer, and find hidden secrets.

games.name: Greedy Greedy Gnomes
games.summary: A short incremental game set in a sleepy RPG town. Smash pots, recruit gnomes, raid mines, unlock upgrades, and optimize everything until you’re FILTHY STINKING RICH!

games.name: Memoria Wake
games.summary: Battle nightmares in the dream world as you unravel reflections of the past in Memoria Wake, an isometric souls-like action-adventure game.

games.name: Hands Over
games.summary: HANDS OVER is a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends, play dirty, and stay at the table longer than anyone else.

games.name: Feed It
games.summary: A first-person, PSX-style horror game about living with a monster. Do as you're told... or don't. Just be ready for the consequences.

games.name: BrokenLore: Don't Lie
games.summary: BrokenLore: DON'T LIE is psychological horror spin-off of DON’T WATCH, where lies, medication and fragile bonds blur the line between reality and nightmare.

games.name: Agni: Village of Calamity
games.summary: Agni, a determined investigator from a covert Indonesian police unit who defied orders and ventures into a remote village despite ominous warnings. What begins as an unauthorized investigation quickly plunges Agni into a horrifying reality

games.name: Lucid Falls
games.summary: Manipulate gravity, space and time, and survive terrifying nightmares in a deeply atmospheric lucid dream. Facing terrifying creatures, and solving challenges that bend reality, every moment reveals more of the dark truth behind Lucid Falls.

games.name: Paperhead
games.summary:
PAPERHEAD is a fast-paced FPS game set in a world where everything is made out of cardboard and paper but is infested with horror!
Use a pencil as a weapon and explore what exactly went wrong in the secret research facility and why suddenly papercut people were able to...bleed.
Paperhead's Main Features

- Cardboard cute style with a horror twist. Cute but horrifying!

- Brutal and fast-paced combat. Slide to throw enemies in the air, kick explosive barrels into them (or enemies themselves!), and jump onto them Mario-style.

- Use a Pencil as a weapon. Draw a bomb to explode enemies!

- Use a Pencil as a reality-warping puzzle-solving tool. Not sure how to get through? Try to draw a door on the wall!

WHY WOULD PAPER...BLEED?

games.name: Cordura
games.summary: Cordura is a 4-player online co-op psychological horror where sanity is your most scarce resource. Venture together into shifting procedural Victorian labyrinths where the environment is never the same. Lose your sanity and the Night will mimic your team to feed your paranoia. Extract and survive.

games.name: 13Z
games.summary: Embark on a quest to become the 13th Zodiac in this frantic hack-and-slash roguelike action adventure. Take on a celestial trial of grit, speed and power, and rise stronger after each fall as you upgrade your skills. Your trial awaits!

games.name: Erosion
games.summary: Your daughter's been kidnapped. Every death costs you a decade. Explore a roguelike open world where your actions reshape the timeline. Join a cult, steal a ride, gamble Cheddar. Collect 100+ weapons and abilities, demolish destructible voxel dungeons. Can you save her before time steals her away?

games.name: Reka
games.summary: Start your life as an apprentice witch to the legendary Baba Jaga and venture across a mysterious, natural landscape with your companion, chicken-legged cottage. Develop your magical powers, customise your home, craft potions, help or hinder villagers find your way in the world.

games.name: Sealbreakers
games.summary: A top-down 3D roguelite brawler where a disgraced warrior fights immortal tyrants in a collapsing reality. Break the world back with nothing but fists.

games.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
games.summary: "Eternal Palace Sakura" is a rogue-lite 3D action game where you power up your character and take on thrilling dungeon challenges packed with flashy combat. Step into the shoes of Retla, a brown-skinned, cat-eared dual-wielder, and explore the ever-shifting dream labyrinth!

games.name: Echograph
games.summary: Photograph ghosts, crack environmental puzzles, manage limited resources, and unravel the mystery behind a generational family curse in this classic survival horror experience.

games.name: UN:Me
games.summary: UN:Me is an adventure game where you guide a girl harboring multiple souls within her body through an unsettling mental labyrinth, engaging in dialogue with each soul while making the harrowing choice of which to keep and which to erase in your escape attempt.

games.name: Out Fishing
games.summary: Out Fishing is a first-person horror fishing game set around a remote, decaying lake. Players take on the role of a lone angler trying to make a living while unsettling memories and supernatural events gradually surface. Combining slow-paced exploration, psychological horror, and a minimalist survival loop, the game blurs the line between peaceful solitude and creeping dread.

games.name: Kumarn: The Wandering Spirit
games.summary: A haunting Thai horror adventure. Play as Kumarn, a wandering spirit lost in a world of terrifying folklore and vengeful ghosts. With only his courage and loyal spirit steed, he must face his fears and search for a place called home.

games.name: My Otter Friends
games.summary: Explore a flooded island as a small otter. Meet stranded animals, restore nature, and bring warmth back to a world that has grown quiet.

games.name: Wonderfall
games.summary: A third-person adventure game in a dystopian 1920s Paris consumed by Entropy. As buildings crumble into sand, Léon, a young orphan with the ability to manipulate this sand embark on a quest for truth and confront the remains of a city collapsing beneath his feet.

games.name: Dungeon Lurker
games.summary: Fight your way into the depths of a cursed dungeon in Dungeon Lurker, a retro action roguelike with a dark twist. Uncover a sinister secret connected to your past as you plunge into a world of dark horror and brutal combat.

games.name: Dioxide
games.summary: Dioxide is a high-stakes, tactical FPS with soulslike elements set in a dystopian world ravaged by industrial decay. Shatter neo-antique nightmares, scavenge the scraps of a gasping civilization, and forge the last sanctuary. You will die. You will be reprinted. Will you remain human?

games.name: Tenebris Somnia
games.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a horror adventure in the same vein as survival horror classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil, but transferred to a retro 2D environment more typical of the N.E.S. or Famicom.

You will struggle to survive by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

The secret ingredient of the game is its cinematics. When you reach certain key points you will see sequences with a completely different aesthetic, made in live action with real actors and created by a professional film crew.

games.name: Wilderings: The Lost Spring
games.summary: Wilderings is an open-world action roguelite with creature collection and metroidvania-like progression that tells an emotionally impactful story about friendship, family, responsibility, and restoration.

events.name: MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026
events.description:
Discover some of the best games coming out in 2026 and beyond!

Your hosts Phil Dickens, Ash Millman and Will Penkeyman are ready to take you on another dark, scare-filled journey through deep caves filled with new titles, exclusive trailers and thrilling gameplay reveals. 100+ games will be covered, with 50+ world premiere trailers in over two hours of upcoming horrors, so there’s plenty to keep you busy and set your wishlists overflowing!

games.name: Baptiste
games.summary:
Submerge yourself in a first-hand experience that will make you feel each chill as if it were real. The line between the game and reality blurs further with each step you take.

Explore a mansion where horror awaits in every shadow. The masterful dubbing and sound track will drag you to the depths of a nightmare. Darkness will become your most feared enemy, putting your bravery to the test in each corner.

Play as Tom, a young man still suffering from the tragedy. After the loss of his father, he accompanies his mother Sara on what ought to be a new beginning. However, the ghosts of the past threaten to consume him. Can you keep control against the siege of his inner demons?

Disentangle the gruesome secrets that impregnate each floorboard and each crack on the walls. Each discovery will reveal a story of pain and horror that beggars belief.

Submerge yourself into a world where beauty and terror coexist in a macabre dance. The visual design will transport you to a kingdom where the grotesque is fascinating.

Each objective, each note and each whisper contribute towards weaving the plot. Your perseverance in the face of fear will be rewarded with chilling revelations that will keep you on edge until the very end.

games.name: End of Ember
games.summary: Explore a gory Hell in this twin-stick shooter that pays homage to badass horror franchises. Kill demons, upgrade items, and fight weird and gross bosses until they explode in piles of gore. Who is Ember? What is reality?

games.name: Forest Escape: Last Train
games.summary: Forest Escape: Last Train is a co-op horror exploration game for 1-4 players in the mysterious forest. Repair your locomotive, solve the insane Warden’s eerie puzzles, and outrun the stuff of nightmares as you try to escape this twisted realm.

games.name: Dreadline Express
games.summary:
Investigative odyssey into the minds of fading passengers facing the end of the world aboard the last human train.

An adventure game that doesn't set specific goals. It naturally encourages you to make your own decisions and draw your own conclusions, providing a highly immersive experience with a fair amount of story branching.

games.name: Sisters of Solitude
games.summary: Explore a haunted convent with your EMF detector, tape recorder, and camera. Uncover the fate of four ghostly sisters and the mystery behind the murder they commited. Every room hides a clue, every shadow a warning, and the truth waits for those who dare to seek it.

games.name: Silvanis
games.summary: A psychological thriller, story-driven experience. Venture into the mysterious forest to find your missing daughter; unsolved puzzles, a dark atmosphere filled with whispers, and unsettling sounds await you...

games.name: The Victor Initiative
games.summary: The Victor Initiative is an atmospheric horror game about exploring an abandoned government facility that lost contact with the rest of the world 60 years ago.

games.name: House of Saturn
games.summary: Exorcize the demonic in this psychological horror game set in 1920s England. Navigate a haunted university by solving puzzles and hiding from a demon that can phase through walls. The gates of hell shall not prevail.

games.name: Donut Panic
games.summary: Order up! Donut Panic is an anomaly horror game with a cooking sim twist. Take customer orders. Prepare and serve up delicious donuts. But when the hallucinations appear, run for your life. Your panic room is there for a reason...

games.name: In Hope Voiden
games.summary: A forbidden warzone. Twelve soldiers. One life each. In this first person survival horror, death is permanent and the world remembers. Explore a surreal, trench-ridden hellscape where every action matters - and every death uncovers a new piece of a haunting mystery.

games.name: Dead Watch
games.summary: You're stuck in a time loop. Whenever you find a dead body, you go back to the past. The only way to escape the loop is to cheat destiny & change the future. Explore the castle and uncover its dark secrets to prevent the next killing

games.name: Ultrasound
games.summary: A sci-fi horror 3D point&click game. Use an ultrasound machine to diagnose and do surgery on a grotesque infection spreading aboard a space freighter. Craft meds, upgrade your machine, find new surgical tools, and restore ship systems before you collide with a star. Soon, something will be born.

games.name: Inherited Shadows
games.summary: Inspired by the classics of the genre, Inherited Shadows weaves a gripping tale about Amanda, a young adult struggling to lead a normal life while haunted by the trauma of her mother's absence, but on an ordinary morning in 1999, everything will change for her forever.

games.name: Eternal Haunt
games.summary: Eternal Haunt is a first-person atmospheric survival horror game. Explore the claustrophobic labyrinth of Yuki-Onna's home. Solve dynamic puzzles, scavenge for items, experience haunting scares that shift and evolve. Can you endure the relentless cold and escape the chilling embrace of death?

games.name: Last Chance Market
