Unleash deadly abilities and an arsenal of devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid hordes. Hold at bay the horrors of the galaxy in epic battles on far-flung planets. Uncover dark secrets and drive back the everlasting night to prove your ultimate loyalty to humanity.

games.name: Observer: System Redux
games.summary:
The year is 2084.
In a dark cyberpunk world shattered by plagues and wars, become a neural detective and hack into the minds of others.

Rebuilt and augmented for the next-generation, Observer: System Redux is the definitive vision of one of the most acclaimed cyberpunk stories in games.

games.name: DayZ
games.summary: DayZ is a hardcore open-world survival game with only one rule: stay alive, no matter what. How long can you survive a post-apocalyptic world? A land overrun with an infected "zombie" population, where you compete with other survivors for limited resources. Will you team up with strangers and stay strong together? Or play as a lone wolf to avoid betrayal? This is DayZ, this is your story.

games.name: Metal Gear Solid Master Collection: Volume 2
games.summary: This second installment to the collection features “Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots” and “Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version),” and also a digital soundtrack and "Metal Gear: Ghost Babel" as bonus content.

games.name: Rise of the Tomb Raider: 20 Year Celebration
games.summary: Rise of the Tomb Raider: 20 Year Celebration includes the critically acclaimed Rise of the Tomb Raider. With over 50 hours of gameplay and all-new content created to celebrate 20 years of the iconic Lara Croft. In the critically acclaimed Tomb Raider, Lara Croft was forged into a true survivor, but she glimpsed a deeper, secret world.

games.name: Tales of Eternia: Remastered
games.summary: Tales of Eternia returns as a remastered edition! As the threat of world destruction looms, an epic journey begins to determine the fate of two worlds: Inferia and Celestia.

games.name: SnowRunner
games.summary:
SnowRunner is an off-road driving simulation game that focuses on navigating challenging terrain using a variety of heavy vehicles. Players complete contracts and objectives across open environments, transporting cargo while overcoming mud, snow, rivers, and other natural obstacles.
The game emphasizes realistic physics, vehicle customization, and route planning, with progression tied to upgrading equipment and expanding a fleet suited for different conditions.

games.name: Fitness Boxing 3: Your Personal Trainer - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
games.summary: A workout that works for you – now enhanced for Nintendo Switch 2!

games.name: Everbloom
games.summary: Everbloom is a cute and cozy farming social sim set in a world of whimsy - grow buckets of popcorn right on the plant and make chocolate milk by feeding your cows candy bars. Grow, care, build, decorate, and explore the world of Everbloom solo or with your friends.

games.name: Final Fantasy XIV Online
games.summary:
Take part in an epic and ever-changing Final Fantasy as you adventure and explore with friends from around the world. Final Fantasy XIV Online is the 2013 relaunch of the massively multiplayer online role-playing game that takes the wonder of the FF legacy and expands it, allowing you to explore the realm of Eorzea like never before in a Final Fantasy game.

Forge friendships, mount chocobos, and board airships as you and your companions create your own unique stories in Eorzea. Adventure alone or join up with friends to undertake epic quests, battle familiar Final Fantasy monsters, and acquire unique abilities and equipment. All the classic elements from the series that you have come to know and love are waiting! Embark of the adventure of a lifetime to help reforge the fate of Eorzea!

games.name: Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 + 2.5 Remix
games.summary: Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 + 2.5 Remix is an HD remastered collection of 6 unforgettable Kingdom Hearts experiences. Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 + 2.5 Remix is the perfect opportunity to start wielding your Keyblade to save the Disney worlds from darkness.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue
games.summary:
Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue is a compilation that brings the popular Kingdom Hearts [Dream Drop Distance] to the PlayStation4 computer entertainment system platform remastered in high definition.

Originally released in 2012, Kingdom Hearts [Dream Drop Distance] HD is a full-HD remastered version of Kingdom Hearts 3D [Dream Drop Distance]. Series protagonists Sora and Riku take on the Mark of Mastery exam in preparation for coming threats. The signature action of the Kingdom Hearts series has evolved, allowing players to experience faster-paced battles and exploration at a blistering pace.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts III + Re Mind
games.summary: KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC) brings one chapter of the series to a close. Travel to exciting new Disney and Pixar worlds, and prepare for the final showdown.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Collection [I-III]
games.summary: Play Kingdom Hearts I–III together in one unforgettable collection. A value‑packed bundle featuring three collections: Kingdom Hearts -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-, Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue, and Kingdom Hearts III + Re Mind (DLC).

games.name: Kingdom Hearts IV
games.summary: Kingdom Hearts IV follows protagonist Sora and some familiar characters as they journey through the mysterious city of Quadratum. Sora will once again journey to various worlds, where new figures cross his path and new powers awaken in this next chapter.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
games.summary: A remake of the 1998 Nintendo 64 title for the Nintendo Switch 2 system.

games.name: Earth Defense Force 5
games.summary: Stand and fight for humanity. This arcade shooter takes place in the year 2022, as the Earth Defense Force fends off an all-out attack by unknown life forms. Become an EDF soldier, battle against endless hordes of immense enemies, and restore peace to the earth.

games.name: Earth Defense Force 6
games.summary: Earth Defense Force 6 is the sixth main entry in the Earth Defense Force series and the direct sequel to Earth Defense Force 5, picking up three years after that game left off. EDF 6 is set on a dying Earth where the alien Primer civilization invades once again.

games.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
games.summary: Dodge the barrage, defeat enemies, and brave the Scarlet Mist incident. The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil returns with fresh music and graphics.You control the shrine maiden Reimu and the magician Marisa, dodge barrages and shoot at enemies. The background music features complete rearrangements by ZUN.

games.name: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales
games.summary:
The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales is an action RPG set in the world of Philabieldia - a beautiful but savage land dominated by warring beast tribes. Humanity’s last bastion is the Kingdom of Huther, protected by its tall walls and Princess Heuria’s powerful magic.

When a mysterious set of ruins is discovered, a young adventurer named Elliot and his fairy companion Faie are sent off on a journey to investigate. What seems like a simple, if dangerous, mission soon becomes a grand saga that will be woven across time and space.

games.name: Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok
games.summary: Known for its dynamic combat, ensemble of versatile characters, and thrilling online cooperative play, Relink returns with expanded solo and multiplayer content, bringing endless adventure to skyfarers both new and old.

games.name: Digimon Story: Time Stranger
games.summary: The latest in the Digimon Story series is finally here! In this RPG, unravel a mystery that spans across the human world and the Digital World, collecting and raising a wide variety of Digimon to save the world.

games.name: Culdcept Begins
games.summary:
Led by dice. Ruled by cards.

A hidden classic that fuses board and card games, Culdcept features a unique, innovative system that has captivated fans since its debut. Players become Cepters, wielding cards in intense battles where luck and strategy collide. After ten years, a brand-new story begins once again.

games.name: Kyoto Xanadu: The Blooming Phantom
games.summary: Set in an alternate reality where Kyoto is the capital of Japan, Kyoto Xanadu players take on monsters and mysteries coming from the great labyrinth known as Xanadu. As a student, players will challenge the labyrinth and grow through their battles within Xanadu while also deepening bonds with various people during your daily life. Uncover the truth hidden both in the labyrinth and Kyoto itself.

games.name: Ratatan
games.summary: Ratata Arts and TVT have announced Ratatan, a new rhythm action game from the creator of Patapon previously teased as Project JabberWocky.

games.name: Tamagotchi Plaza: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
games.summary:
The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of Tamagotchi Plaza adds three exclusive shops that can be played with mouse controls.

Become a shopkeeper in Tamahiko Town. Engage with more than 100 Tamagotchi as they open, customize and grow more than a dozen different shops and improve your reputation with them in town.

games.name: Denshattack!
games.summary: Flip, trick and grind your train in a fast-paced, off-the-rails ride through a colourful Japanese dystopia. Outmatch rival gangs, wreck a shady megacorp, and take back the tracks with nothing but skill, speed, and style.

games.name: The Prince of Tennis: Sweet School Festival 0-40 and more…
games.summary: Originally released on PlayStation 2, the Prince of Tennis game where you play as a high school student preparing for the school festival is being remastered in celebration of its 20th anniversary.

games.name: The Prince of Tennis: Doki Doki Survival - Eternal Passion! Tie Break Game
games.summary: Originally released on PlayStation 2 as two separate games and later combined into one on Nintendo DS, the Prince of Tennis game where you find yourself stranded on an island on the way to the National Middle School Tennis Championship is being remastered for modern platforms.

games.name: Village in the Shade
games.summary: Enjoy quiet, countryside living in a Japanese village in this brand new farming sim! Just make sure you follow the rules—or else!

games.name: Steins;Gate Re:Boot
games.summary: STEINS;GATE returns! Rebooted for the modern era! Featuring fully updated visuals, UI, and an all-new story that breathes new life into the streets of Akihabara.

games.name: Brigandine Abyss
games.summary: The king of Solginat is dead, and a new would-be emperor stands over the corpse. Confront the dark in one of six different storylines as you manage resources, rally your monsters, and stand against the empire

games.name: Another Eden Begins
games.summary: Embark on a time-traveling RPG adventure featuring command battles presented by Masato Kato, creator of numerous RPG classics. With New Game+, embark on a new adventure with your upgraded characters and discover more than 10 different endings.

games.name: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter
games.summary: A remake of the second installment in the main Trails series, serving as a direct sequel of Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter. The game follows Estelle as she sets out on a new adventure following the events of the previous game, where she will be joined by comrades both old and new.

games.name: Guardians Planetfall
games.summary: From the creators of Guardians Frontline, Guardians Planetfall drops you into a galaxy-wide war for the fate of humanity. Fight assembled into squads of up to 4 soldiers in fast, tactical VR combat across space and dangerous planets filled with aliens, Void soldiers, and massive war machines.

games.name: Bootstrap Island
games.summary: Stranded in the 17th century after a brutal shipwreck, you awaken alone on a deadly tropical island. To survive, you’ll need to learn fast - facing wild beasts, nature’s wrath, and uncovering secrets hidden deep in the jungle. Every step is a fight for your life.

games.name: Board of the Future
games.summary: Is it a board? Is it a plane? Is it the coolest, fastest piece of alien technology from the future that you and your friends have ever been riding?

games.name: Sol Protocol
games.summary: Sol Protocol is a VR coop Action Roguelike that allows you to physically pilot and manage a spaceship through dangerous stellar systems.

games.name: Salmon Man
games.summary: Salmon Man is not a game; it's an experience, a test, a gift... to be sent to a certain kind of person, the one you hate from the deepest part of your soul.

games.name: C.A.B.A.
games.summary:
C.A.B.A. (Center of Anomalies of Buenos Aires) is Hypnos Team's interpretation of the subway level in the Backrooms universe, a short, first-person survival horror set on a ghost station that doesn't appear on any map. Presented as found footage, with retro game references and lighting that shouldn't work this well.
You can't fight what's down here. You can only try to escape. Inspired by genre classics like PT, Outlast, and Amnesia, C.A.B.A. focuses on stealth, exploration, and environmental puzzles. Includes full VR mode on Steam VR, Meta Quest, and PS VR2. Approximately 30 minutes long, with multiple endings.

games.name: The Magician VR: The Cursed Wand
Detective VR
games.summary: Step into a thrilling narrative investigation in Virtual Reality! In DETECTIVE VR, you control time, collect crucial clues, and interview witnesses to unravel the plot.

games.name: Lanesplit
games.summary: Push performance bikes to the absolute limit, and weave through traffic where one wrong move can spell disaster.

games.name: Pedal Rebel VR
games.summary: Pedal Rebel VR is a adrenaline-pumping cyberpunk motorbike street racing game that completely transforms any exercise bike and any VR headset into an immersive racing experience!

games.name: Heroes Together VR
games.summary: Gather your friends and dive into a world of magic and adventure in Heroes Together VR, a roguelite VR dungeon crawler. Choose your hero, explore ever-changing biomes, battle magical monsters, and master your skills together as a team in this epic co-op quest.

games.name: Cards of Destiny
games.summary: Cards of Destiny is a VR puzzle game that brings the tabletop experience to a unique interactive environment! Turn your inner child into a god as you draw one-time-use cards that can save or condemn the tiny humans on your desk – and the aliens chasing them. Adapt to different levels and situations as your randomized deck, ticking clock and looming alien threats all keep you on your feet!

games.name: Walkabout Mini Golf: Homestar Runner Distraction Pack
games.summary:
Everybody! Everybody! It’s just like, one minute, you’re thinking about miniature golf…and the next minute, you ARE miniature golf!

This DLC, unlike previous releases, is not a course, but a takeover of Walkabout by Strong Bad and friends featuring designs, in-game character appearances, voice-acting, and much more directly from The Brothers Chaps. It contains unique cosmetics, never-before-seen mini-games, and locations/nods to the most iconic Homestar Runner bits of all time.

games.name: Color-A-Cube
games.summary: Dive into a relaxing, color-filled escape with Color A Cube. This immersive coloring experience lets you explore and bring voxel worlds to life, one cube at a time. Unwind and tap into your creative flow as each brushstroke reveals vibrant, voxel-based environments and characters.

games.name: The Obsessive Shadow: Chapter 2
games.summary: Something sinister stirs on Old Diamond Drive. 16 year old Justin, armed only with a flashlight and camcorder, takes a dare to spend the night. As shadows close in, he realizes escape isn't possible, and he's not alone. Witness the horrors of the past as you explore the ruins of what once thrived...

games.name: Interlocked: Puzzle Islands
games.summary: Solve tactile three-dimensional burr puzzles on cozy Puzzle Islands. Twist, pull and dismantle handcrafted puzzles in immersive VR or with mouse & keyboard… alongside one curious little bird friend.

games.name: Hyperlane Highway
games.summary:
Hyperlane Highway is a VR roguelike arcade shooter where your body is the controller. You physically lean to surf a hoverboard through neon faster-than-light transit tunnels. No thumbstick needed, no motion sickness, nothing between your intention and the lane. Kill enemies, build combo, go faster. Die, come back stronger.

You are a Way Rider: a sponsored celebrity operative clearing rogue AI constructs from the galaxy's collapsed FTL network. Every run is a live broadcast. Every death is a media event. Between runs you spend Sponsorship Credits on permanent upgrades in your Ship Hub, ensuring the next ride starts stronger.

Strategic depth comes from a deep roguelike build system. Dual-wield energy weapons and shape each run using 40+ randomised Sponsor Mod cards, stacking synergies like chain lightning, explosive rounds and shield reflection. Mid-run slow-motion Pitstops let you buy, sell or recycle upgrades via rival corporate faction vendors before re-entering the chaos. Killing enemies builds a heat combo that physically increases your travel speed. Skill directly controls pace, rewarding aggression without punishing casual play.

games.name: Already Dead
games.summary: Classic 90's style survival horror, reimagined for VR.

games.name: Voxel Playground
games.summary: Voxel Playground is a physics-based voxel sandbox VR game

games.name: Dark Trip
games.summary:
Dark Trip is a psychedelic VR escape room where the hero is forced to use drugs investigating a sadomasochistic lab.

The game of Escape Room genre features Lavcraftian setting, Psychedelic Trips gameplay mechanics and the goals to collect and investigate evidences. Some event in the game are inspired by David Lynch's and Terry Gilliam's movies.

- Experiences Psychedelic Trips. Use VR to immerse yourself into psychedelic experiences not possible on any other gaming platform.

- Investigate the Sadomasochistic Laboratory. Solve twisted riddles in surrealistic setting of physical and mental torture.

- Collect the Pieces of Horrible Truth. Search for clues, artifacts and diary pieces in each location to discover the dark story behind the events.

games.name: Bomb the Hill
games.summary: BOMB THE HILL is a cinematic VR downhill skateboarding experience inspired by the outlaw spirit of 70s freeride culture. Race through dangerous mountain roads, slide through traffic at insane speeds, discover hidden shortcuts, and survive brutal crashes

games.name: Rustmourne
games.summary: Rustmourne is a Survival Sci-fi Horror with detailed, VR-designed interactions. Traverse the corridors of an ancient, derelict structure, and face the tortured beings in it: hide, run, or cut off their limbs to survive. Will you be able to understand the purpose of your awakening and get out alive?

games.name: Cave Crave: Tham Luang Cave VR

events.name: Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 – June 20, 2026
events.description:
Welcome to the second edition of 2026 of the Mundo Gamer Showcase!
This marks our third showcase overall, continuing our mission to highlight amazing indie games from around the world.
Get ready for trailers, gameplay, and exciting announcements from indie titles available on Steam.
Discover new games, support indie developers, and add your favorites to your wishlist!

games.name: Void Crew
games.summary: Void Crew is a Chaotic, Co-op Roguelite game for 1 to 4 players: Outfit your spaceship and crew for thrilling quests, brave fierce enemies in Space Battles... and try not to panic!

games.name: Cosmo Cargo
games.summary: Cosmo Cargo is an inventory autobattler roguelite game where you fight to preserve the chaos of the galaxy. Collect and combine items in your ship to gain powerful effects and defeat the Administrators.

games.name: Nothing Strange Here
games.summary:
Nothing Strange Here is a single-player open-world adventure game with mystery and slice-of-life elements. Set in the small town of Larcenest Gap, players take on the role of a reporter exploring the community, documenting strange events, and interacting with townsfolk.

The game combines narrative discovery with photography and journaling mechanics. Players can photograph scenes, collect evidence, and publish their findings in a customizable in-game journal. NPCs follow daily routines, and the world changes based on the player's actions and the time of day. Additional features include hidden collectibles, such as stickers and gnomes, and dynamic events that encourage exploration and investigation.

games.name: Dino Pet Walker
games.summary: Dino Pet Walker is a Fantasy Casual Game where you realize your childhood dream and play with your dinosaur pet. On this adventure, be ready for solve puzzles and have fun with your and another dino's in a voxel art enviroment, inspired by brazillians biomes.

games.name: Prelude Dark Pain
games.summary: Prelude Dark Pain is a Tactical RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Assume the role of a local blacksmith named Soren, lead an uprising against the Order of the Ash Crusade and save a world ravaged by war.

games.name: The Last Good Boy
games.summary: A Cozy idle RPG inspired by my real-life dog called Ramon, the goodest boy in the world. Gather, craft, unlock new lands, enchant your gear, and battle monsters on a quest to find out where all the other good boys have gone.

games.name: Kitman
games.summary: KITMAN is a 1-4 player sports management simulator set in the backrooms of a stadium. Run the team by running the locker room. Clean the team’s boots, patch jerseys, mop floors, and when no-one is looking… sneak into the gaffer’s office and fix the game plan!

games.name: Hivaneph: The Legend of Elles
games.summary: Hivaneph: The Legend of Elles is an action-adventure game where every character holds a unique perspective, revealing a world that is distinct to their own eyes.

games.name: Ornament Tower
games.summary: After getting transformed by a curse for approaching the Ornament Tower, Azulin and Guaraná decide to climb it together in order to recover their original bodies. Solve puzzles, defeat enemies and reach out to each other's heart in this Action-Puzzle adventure.

games.name: Everything Is Gun!
games.summary: Dominate in a brutal, lightning-fast old-school FPS. Modify yourself into the perfect weapon, unleash mass destruction, conquer runs, invade others, and ascend to global supremacy. Prisoner #11 18 1978, you now belong to A1KTRZ. Your survival is broadcast to billions. What will remain of your soul?

games.name: Hollow Mire: Shadow of Breken House
games.summary: A war hero returns to a shattered England, searching for his missing family while confronting nightmares that defy reality. A choice-driven, narrative thriller with 8 unique endings.

games.name: Unyverse
games.summary: Unyverse is a sci-fi, action role-playing game (ARPG) created by Afrime Studios. Unyverse delivers an immersive, story-driven gameplay experience for single and co-op players enriched by a deep Afro-Futuristic aesthetic.

games.name: FishOmatic
games.summary: Build your dream ocean island fish factory! This is an automation game for beginners or experts that would like to chill while automating their fish factory. Scout ocean for new fishing locations, send your robots to get a haul of fish, then automate the processing of them into a cozy empire.

games.name: Mercy Incore
games.summary: Solo indie hack-and-slash. You are a medieval knight with jet booster and transforming sword. Fight your way through a techno-void. Leech enemies’ lives to survive. Escape — or become a techno-vampire.

games.name: Bravo, Gaspar!
games.summary: "Survive my sadistic show. An action roguelike where your performance with collectible creatures serves only to feed me. On my stage, the rule is simple: entertain or die!"

games.name: Foxy Dumplings
games.summary: In Foxy Dumplings, you’ll run your own food truck and make friends along the way. Cook dumplings from all over the world, take good care of your clients, and discover how a meal can mend more than just hunger in this cozy cooking sim. Rise to the top of Foxtagram, one heartfelt dish at a time.

games.name: Hariti
games.summary: "Hariti" is a first-person psychological horror game. You will play as a mother searching for her missing daughter in a crisis-ridden hospital. Experience an atmosphere of extreme dread within the halls of this abandoned Chinese-style medical facility.

games.name: Mazestalker: The Veil of Silenos
games.summary:
In Mazestalker, players take on the role of Yve Allard, a treasure hunter who stumbles upon the long-isolated kingdom of Ebuzond. A world full of genuine mysteries, in stark contrast to the staged adventures of her homeland. What begins as a search for forgotten enigmas soon develops into a journey shaped by the intrigues of gods, archaeological puzzles, and the witty bottled god Wotton, whom she accidentally picks up along the way.

The game is designed as a homage to the japanese 16-bit era of action RPGs and features:

A relaxed yet gripping combat system at its core
A colorful, handcrafted overworld in the style of classic 2D Zelda games
An expansive labyrinth with Metroidvania-like exploration
Challenging dungeon levels that drive the story forward

games.name: Reports from Vera Cruz
games.summary: Investigate the country of Vera Cruz in this journalistic first-person adventure! Solve puzzles, take photos of clues and report news exposing the horrific truths behind General Galba and his bizarre government!

games.name: Spirit Talk
games.summary: Cozy visual novel about a lovely witch who’s able to talk to spirits in a fantasy setting. Using her powers, Julia helps her neighbors in their daily whereabouts. Craft potions, find the right time to use them and get to know both spirits and clients to find their peace.

games.name: DreamEcho
games.summary: Dream Echo is an RogueLite ARPG game where players can explore the world of Dreams and acquire various Concepts to engage in nearly completely free-form combination battles. Additionally, you can gather Memories upon waking, allowing you to bring some Concepts into your next dream adventure...

games.name: Hans in the Internetz
games.summary: Hans is a first-person adventure game that doesn’t take itself too seriously. Each level offers unique mechanics, with a strong focus on platforming (jump and run) and puzzle-solving elements. As you journey through the internet, expect plenty of meme-inspired humor and references along the way!

games.name: Mafate
games.summary: In MAFATE, play as a mail carrier in the remote Cirque de Mafate in the Indian Ocean. Take photos and deliver letters while exploring this picturesque spot. Help Luna, sent back in time as a camera, touch the locals' lives and uncover the area's charm.

games.name: Where Dolls Hang
games.summary: Where Dolls Hang is a survival psychological horror game where you investigate a place plagued by strange and unsettling events filled with hanging dolls. Explore dangerous locations, gather evidence, uncover hidden secrets, and use your boat to confront the unknown as you search for answers.

games.name: Galactic Economy
games.summary: Can you become a leader in the Galactic Economy? Buy spaceships and spacestations on you way to get some additional income. Roll the dice and see what you can achieve in this board game.

games.name: Barkour
games.summary: Step into the paws of a brave, four-legged special agent! In BARKOUR, you work for a secret organization where all agents are exceptionally skilled animals brought together by one goal: to save the world from the forces of evil (and mischievous cats)!

games.name: Lost Legions
games.summary: Lost in the Teutoburg Forest after a historical catastrophic defeat, survive as a Roman soldier in a world filled with danger. Craft, build, explore and fight in this story-rich open-world adventure. Unearth secrets of a forgotten time, alone or with up to 3 friends, in a land where history lingers.

games.name: Ultra Maze
games.summary: This is the ultimate Maze Game. The mazes are procedurally generated, and so are always unique. There are plenty of options to create an experience to your likings.

games.name: Darts VR2: Bullseye
games.summary: Darts VR2: Bullseye is the most true to life Darts experience in VR which offers 16 player esports mode with league and voice support including single player fun. The game also features Around The World and Killstreak completely reimagined as rhythm games. There's no party without Darts and there can't be a dart game without Party where there's no wait to join the party. If it's a game, it has to have zombies so we bring in Zombie hunting using Darts for some casual fun.

games.name: My Little Cafe Nightmare
games.summary: Brew otherworldly coffee for ghostly patrons in a dark, cozy first-person café. Upgrade your shop, manage supplies, and turn a haunted café into a sanctuary amidst nightmares.

games.name: Keep Watering
games.summary: Keep Watering is an incremental game with a cozy, hypnotic loop where every drop of water grows into something extraordinary.

games.name: Voidface
games.summary: Face off in a challenging bullet-hell arena shooter to try and clear bite-sized boss rush challenges. Learn to dodge their attacks, cast spells to gain an upper hand, and kill everything that gets in your way.

games.name: Slay Goblins
games.summary: Slay Goblins is an arena roguelite where you play a knight fighting off hordes of goblins. Choose from a variety of perks, weapons and items to create unique builds and defend your castle.

games.name: Shear Heaven
games.summary: Shear fluffy sheep to build a rope back home. Explore floating sky islands, tropical beaches, and underwater worlds. A sky full of surprises and very dramatic sheep.

games.name: Master Lemon: The Quest for Iceland
games.summary: MASTER LEMON is a narrative adventure game inspired by a true story. Players solve puzzles and face challenges on a journey where freedom and dreams clash with tough choices. Join Lemon as he seeks to save a distant land from a memory-eating plague threatening world history and languages.

games.name: Whispers in the Fog
games.summary: Whispers in the fog is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a mysterious forest with haunted locations that will give you a terrifying experience. With realistic atmosphere, scary encounters and only a flashlight to light your way, unravel the mystery that is beyond the forest.

games.name: Cat Me If You Can
games.summary: Cat Me If You Can is a charming and cozy game where you explore beautifully handcrafted black-and-white worlds, searching for hidden cats to photograph and bring their colours back into the world.

games.name: Moss: The Forgotten Relic
games.summary: Moss: The Forgotten Relic is an enhanced compilation of Moss and Moss: Book II that replaces the use of virtual reality in those games with a new cinematic camera system. The game is an emotional and atmospheric adventure set in the pages of a living storybook, brimming with myth and ancient magic. Guide a tiny but determined hero on a heartfelt journey of challenge, courage, and connection.

games.name: Damon and Baby
games.summary: An exciting new style of action adventure fusing shooting action with exploration.

games.name: Dear me, I was…
games.summary:
Dear me, I was… is an interactive adventure that lets you enjoy a story woven with beautiful visuals, fusing the vibrant watercolor style of Taisuke Kanasaki with rotoscoping technology.

In this story, you will relive the life of a certain woman. Experience joy, sorrow, and growth through her ordinary and humble life. Witness the story she weaves in a life interconnected with others.

games.name: Goritaire
games.summary:
Goritaire is a solo card-based survival game centered on building a troop of seven or more gorillas. The deck consists only of Gorillas and Bananas, demanding strategic balance.

Bananas are essential for survival; if the supply fails, the troop scatters, resulting in defeat.

Strategically master diverse actions unique to each stage, expand the troop, and secure the necessary resources to reign as the master of the jungle!

games.name: Guilty Gear: Strive - Season Pass 5
games.summary:
An exciting season pass that includes 4 additional playable characters, a stage and season 5 pass bonus character colors as additional DLC for the Guilty Gear -Strive- game.

Guilty Gear: Strive - Season Pass 5 Content
・DLC Additional Character #18 Jam Kuradoberi
・DLC Additional Character #19 Robo-Ky (Available Summer 2026)
・DLC Additional Character #20 ??? (Available Winter 2026)
・DLC Additional Character #21 ??? (Available Spring 2027)

games.name: River City Saga: Journey to the West
games.summary: River City Saga: Journey to the West is a roguelike action brawler that reimagines the classic Chinese novel with River City characters, casting Kunio as Sun Wukong and other familiar faces as legendary figures. In the turbulent Tang Dynasty, you embark on a pilgrimage to retrieve Buddhist scriptures, fighting through waves of demons and bosses with intuitive, satisfying combat. Every run features different layouts, enemies, and skills, encouraging repeated playthroughs as you grow stronger with each attempt.

games.name: Double Dragon Revive
games.summary: Double Dragon Revive faithfully reproduces the thrill of old school side-scrolling action games, with updated controls and difficulty settings for the modern era, and utilizing Arc System Works’ fighting game development experience. Jimmy Lee, Billy Lee, Roper, Abobo, and more will appear in stylish 3D.

games.name: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 18 - Jam Kuradoberi
games.summary: Adds Jam Kuradoberi to the roster of playable characters and 9 colors (No.1~6, 13~15) for the character.

games.name: Qliphah in Providence's Shadow
games.summary: Set against the backdrop of a distorted Shibuya—where supernatural anomalies have begun bleeding into reality—the story follows two dual protagonists. Both harbor these very anomalies within themselves as they embark on a dark quest to uncover the truth behind the city's eerie phenomena.

games.name: Donutal
games.summary:
You awaken from a cold sleep and suddenly find yourself in the year 2206. What you once knew as the International Space Station is now the International Space Port—a gateway for aliens coming to Earth. Crushed by a massive, unexplained debt, you’re forced into a job you never asked for: Chief Xeno Inspector.

Seems simple enough, just wave in the friendly aliens and turn away the dangerous ones. However, make the wrong call and Earth could be destroyed. No pressure though, right?

games.name: Demons' Night Fever
games.summary:
Misdeed, Theft, Abduction, Plunder. This is a tale of “Evil,” where anything goes.
Where the hero is a dull boy named Kyoshiro, who hates the world. And a self-proclaimed evil god having lost his powers appears to him. Team up with the evil god and go beyond the limits of evil! Steal! Abduct! Terminate! Let your evil show!

games.name: Absolum
games.summary: Crafted with passion by the dream team that redefined side-scrolling beat 'em ups, Absolum mixes top-of-the-class combat action with modern roguelite elements, bringing all the vibes of the fantasy arcade hits of the past into an immersive adventure set in the original world of Talamh.

games.name: Dave the Diver
games.summary: Dave the Diver is an action-adventure and management simulation game developed by Mintrocket. In the game, players control Dave, who spends his days diving into underwater environments to catch fish and gather resources, and his nights managing a sushi restaurant. The gameplay combines real-time underwater exploration and combat with restaurant management mechanics.

games.name: Under Night In-Birth II Sys:Celes
games.summary:
The first in the series to include rollback netcode, prepare for blistering online matches.
New moves and new battle systems have been added to further evolve the battle.
Experience high-octane battles with ultra high definition pixel graphics.

The tale of the Hollow Night is about to reach its climax...!

games.name: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
games.summary:
Assemble your team of legendary Marvel characters in the ultimate 4v4 tag team fighter from PlayStation Studios, Arc System Works and Marvel Games.
Immerse yourself in the Marvel universe like never before with an iconic roster of heroes and villains, authentic stages, and intuitive gameplay mechanics. Experience the thrill of fast-paced over the top action with stunning anime-inspired visuals, where every battle is a unique and exciting team VS battle experience.

games.name: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 19 - Robo-Ky
games.summary: Adds Robo-Ky to the roster of playable characters and 9 colors (No.1~6, 13~15) for the character.

games.name: BlazBlue: Central Fiction
games.summary: BlazBlue: Central Fiction is a 2D fighting game developed by Arc System Works. It is the fourth game to the BlazBlue series, and is set after the events of BlazBlue: Chrono Phantasma. The game adds Naoto Kurogane and Hibiki Kohaku as playable characters. BlazBlue: Central Fiction marks the conclusion of the story surrounding protagonist Ragna the Bloodedge.

games.name: Resident Evil Requiem
games.summary: Resident Evil Requiem is the ninth entry in the Resident Evil series. Experience terrifying survival horror with FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, and dive into pulse-pounding action with legendary agent Leon S. Kennedy. Both of their journeys and unique gameplay styles intertwine into a heart-stopping, emotional experience that will chill you to your core.

games.name: Mega Man Star Force: Legacy Collection
games.summary: The Mega Man Star Force series, which expanded into an anime, is back in the Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection! This collection includes seven games and additional features like a gallery of illustrations and music! Online play is also supported!

games.name: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection
games.summary: Twin Rathalos, born in a twist of fate. Two centuries after a conflict that divided neighboring kingdoms, the drums of war are reignited as twin Rathalos—long thought extinct—hatch from a single egg: an omen of destruction. Is there hope beyond the northern border?

games.name: Pragmata
games.summary: Pragmata is a sci-fi action-adventure game set in the near future. The story follows Hugh and his android companion Diana as they navigate a Lunar research station. Gameplay incorporates action elements alongside mechanics involving interaction with systems within the environment.

games.name: Dragon's Dogma II: Dark Arisen
games.summary: This is a bundle containing both Dragon's Dogma II and the Dragon's Dogma II: Dark Arisen Expansion.

games.name: Dragon's Dogma II: Dark Arisen Expansion
games.summary:
Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen enriches the dynamic fantasy world and expansive adventures of Dragon's Dogma 2 with unforgettable new tales and thrilling encounters.

Based on feedback we received after the initial release of Dragon's Dogma 2, we established three goals for ourselves when we set out to update and expand the game:
Enhanced gameplay. Expanded adventures. Enticing value.

games.name: Resident Evil Requiem: Leon Must Die Forever
games.summary:
Leon Must Die Forever is a minigame for Resident Evil Requiem. It was released as a free update DLC on May 8, 2026 on the PlayStation 5, PC and Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2.

The mini-game can be found in Extra Games, once the player finished Requiem's main campaign.

games.name: Resident Evil Veronica
games.summary: Claire Redfield returns to the forefront in this remake of the title originally released on the Dreamcast in 2000 and the following year on PlayStation 2. This new version preserves the essence of the original game while introducing modernized gameplay, a reimagined storyline, and vividly detailed graphics.

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance
games.summary: Massive expansion, Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance has been announced!

games.name: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Additional Side Story: Rudy
Street Fighter 6: Year 4 - Yasmine
games.summary: Hailing from the Philippines, Yasmine seeks to slice and dice her opponents in Eskrima, the national martial art of the country.

games.name: Devil May Cry 5: Devil Hunter Edition
games.summary: Devil May Cry 5 Devil Hunter Edition comes packed with the Vergil playable character downloadable content in addition to robust bonus content including costume colours, taunts, and battle tracks that you can enjoy anytime, anywhere in a smooth 60 frames-per-second across both TV and handheld modes.

games.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
games.summary:
Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice.
With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.
Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.
Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

games.name: Dear me, I was…
games.summary:
Dear me, I was… is an interactive adventure that lets you enjoy a story woven with beautiful visuals, fusing the vibrant watercolor style of Taisuke Kanasaki with rotoscoping technology.

In this story, you will relive the life of a certain woman. Experience joy, sorrow, and growth through her ordinary and humble life. Witness the story she weaves in a life interconnected with others.

games.name: Double Dragon Revive
games.summary: Double Dragon Revive faithfully reproduces the thrill of old school side-scrolling action games, with updated controls and difficulty settings for the modern era, and utilizing Arc System Works’ fighting game development experience. Jimmy Lee, Billy Lee, Roper, Abobo, and more will appear in stylish 3D.

games.name: Absolum
games.summary: Crafted with passion by the dream team that redefined side-scrolling beat 'em ups, Absolum mixes top-of-the-class combat action with modern roguelite elements, bringing all the vibes of the fantasy arcade hits of the past into an immersive adventure set in the original world of Talamh.

games.name: Demons' Night Fever
games.summary:
Misdeed, Theft, Abduction, Plunder. This is a tale of “Evil,” where anything goes.
Where the hero is a dull boy named Kyoshiro, who hates the world. And a self-proclaimed evil god having lost his powers appears to him. Team up with the evil god and go beyond the limits of evil! Steal! Abduct! Terminate! Let your evil show!

games.name: Bubble Bobble: Sugar Dungeons
games.summary: Adventure again and again! Get stronger! The first step-up Bubble Bobble in the series! Go on an adventure through strange dungeons that change every time you step inside!

games.name: Hunter x Hunter: Nen x Impact
games.summary:
Hunter x Hunter: Nen x Impact is a Hunter x Hunter fighting game,
Published by Bushiroad Games.

Choose your favorite Nen User characters for the 3V3 Team Battle!
The compatibility and order of the teammates are the keys to victory!
Build the strongest team and battle for victory!

games.name: Under Night In-Birth II Sys:Celes
games.summary:
The first in the series to include rollback netcode, prepare for blistering online matches.
New moves and new battle systems have been added to further evolve the battle.
Experience high-octane battles with ultra high definition pixel graphics.

The tale of the Hollow Night is about to reach its climax...!

games.name: Damon and Baby
games.summary: An exciting new style of action adventure fusing shooting action with exploration.

events.name: The Indie Premier Game Showcase 2026
events.description:
We are incredibly proud to reveal the official titles for #TheIndiePremier Game Showcase 2026! We’ve scanned the global gaming landscape to separate the signal from the noise, handpicking the absolute best in independent design, bold storytelling, and uncompromising creative vision.

This year’s lineup features your next favorite obsession, whether you’re hunting for massive, genre-defying RPGs, intense psychological horror, or cozy, zen-like simulations.

games.name: HMUR
games.summary: HMUR is a fast-paced retro-FPS, in the original setting, that merges Soviet aesthetics with whacky madness and frantic dynamics of iconic 90s shooters. Survive a disaster at a classified Soviet facility as you blast your way through crowds of enemies. Speed is your key to survival.

games.name: Shadow Sacrament: The Roots of Evil
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a grim survival horror game where you investigate the secrets of an ancient monastery, solve intricate puzzles, and face terrifying nightmares that haunt its shadowy halls. Hunt the Haunt.

games.name: Project ReMind
games.summary: "Welcome to the end. My end" Manipulate machinery, open secret passages and bypass computers to remember your life, from your first discovery to your own death bed. In this first-person narrative puzzle game investigate a mysterious presence looking for the answer that haunted you since THAT day.

games.name: 13Z
games.summary: Embark on a quest to become the 13th Zodiac in this frantic hack-and-slash roguelike action adventure. Take on a celestial trial of grit, speed and power, and rise stronger after each fall as you upgrade your skills. Your trial awaits!

games.name: Croak
games.summary: Croak is a nimble -and challenging- precision platformer featuring an innovative grapple mechanic. Use the prince’s tongue to dash and bounce around through hundreds of hand-crafted rooms. Manipulate the environment as you traverse distinct biomes, each with unique gameplay mechanics and bosses.

games.name: Hoarder
games.summary: Clean. Possess. Control. Hoarder begins as a mundane cleaning simulator which spirals into a submerged nightmare. Pilot a submarine, recover what shouldn’t be found, and uncover the secrets of your new home by night.

games.name: Hope in the City
games.summary: 17-year-old Hope Song returns home from school to find her parents missing. Use Hope’s observant eye as an artist to investigate, piece together clues, and uncover a dark world beneath the surface of her peaceful life in this non-linear narrative mystery game.

games.name: Vivarium
games.summary: You wake up and find yourself in an enormous terrarium. Explore, meet characters, and grow your escape - and along the way, uncover the mysteries of the terrarium as well. Vivarium is an adventure game about finding where you belong while surviving in a familiar yet alien environment.

games.name: Appulse
games.summary: Discover pinball like never before with Appulse! The game is a roguelite shooter, where you protect a Galactic Federation ship! Upgrade your ball, your weapons and your ship to pushback waves of unwavering robots.

games.name: Into The Unwell
games.summary: Dive into The Unwell as one of several flawed and heavily medicated misfits in this delightfully despondent third-person roguelite game, playing alone or with up to two friends.

games.name: Nocturne
games.summary: The afterlife is now digital. Discover that eternal life comes with sacrifice in a genre-defying RPG with unique rhythm combat.

games.name: Pixel Washer
games.summary: Pixel Washer is a cozy, zen-like game where you play as a cute piggy power washing beautiful pixelated worlds. Wash sprites, upgrade your power washer, and find hidden secrets.

games.name: Super Yooka-Laylee Kart
games.summary: The most skilful, expressive and explosive racer built around mastery, rivalry, and revenge-fuelled comebacks. Race through a solo campaign, compete against rivals online, or create your own custom race setups and challenge your friends.

games.name: Bel's Fanfare
games.summary: Bel's Fanfare is an RPG with rich deep exploration and expressive combat. You play as Bel, the new aura cleaner of the once-luxurious vessel The Witch of the Sea.

games.name: Catechesis
games.summary: Embrace the darkness as a demon-possessed altar boy in this Horror RPG. Explore the city, battle demons, upgrade your weapons, and embark on an unforgettable journey with unique characters and anime-style cutscenes.

games.name: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
games.summary: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.

games.name: We Were Here Tomorrow
games.summary: You and your partner are taken to a mysterious facility where communication and cooperation are your lifelines. This asymmetrical co-op adventure will have you uncover secrets that will shape the fate of Tomorrow…

games.name: The Dark West
games.summary: The Dark West is a grim ARPG reimagining the genre with deep player agency, innovative systems, and and a fresh take on player progression. We're crafting an experience that blends cutting-edge gameplay within an engaging and immersive world.

games.name: Time To Wake Up
games.summary: Time To Wake Up is an atmospheric psychological thriller where one night you find yourself stuck in a dream. No worries, though. You are not alone. You hear a voice, in need of your eyes and willing to help you out.

games.name: SacriFire
games.summary: A modern JRPG-inspired game with a unique battle system, rich story, fantastic visuals and music by Motoi Sakuraba.

games.name: Hapervil
games.summary: Play as Amaya and Will, navigating a forsaken orphanage where secrets lurk in the dark. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden truths, and survive a psychological horror tale where innocence twists into nightmare and shadows patiently wait to strike.

games.name: Book Nook
games.summary: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.

games.name: RockBeasts
games.summary:
Lead a band of misfits on a roller-coaster ride to stardom in the age of MTV, rock anthems, and bad haircuts. ROCKBEASTS is a story-driven, role-playing management game that puts you in the shoes of a manager of an up-and-coming rock band.

Rock ‘n’ Roll Band Manager: This band has real potential, but they need your help to live up to it. Their tunes can revolutionize the music industry and redefine genres - but what good is a great song if no one hears it? It’s your job to land your clients a record deal and negotiate the terms on their behalf. Will you help them fight for their creative freedom, or sell them out to the industry bigwigs?

Coffee and Cigarettes for Breakfast: Sex, drugs, and rock ’n’ roll can only get you so far. Somebody has to make sure the band is in shape to play the next gig. This is where you come in. Make sure they eat a half-decent meal every now and again, fix their gear, get them to rehearse… Hope you like herding cats!

Don’t Stop Me Now: It’s your job to book the venue, finalize the setlist and ensure the gig goes according to the plan. Each successful performance is a step toward fame and glory. Sure, that “club” was just a grimy basement, and the audience barely outnumbered the band - but even rock legends have to start somewhere, right?

games.name: Neo Junk City
games.summary: Dive into Neo Junk City, a cyberpunk adventure where you’re an android detective unraveling your own murky past. Navigate neon streets, engage with unique characters, and race through the rain-soaked city. Uncover secrets in this twist on point-and-click gameplay.

games.name: Lazy River
games.summary: A co-op adventure at the galaxy's most unregulated waterpark. Some guy peed in the pool, and the pee mixed with the space water and turned everybody into zombies… Except you and your friends. Build a raft, ride down the Lazy River, and escape before you run out of hot dogs!

games.name: Moss: The Forgotten Relic
games.summary: Moss: The Forgotten Relic is an enhanced compilation of Moss and Moss: Book II that replaces the use of virtual reality in those games with a new cinematic camera system. The game is an emotional and atmospheric adventure set in the pages of a living storybook, brimming with myth and ancient magic. Guide a tiny but determined hero on a heartfelt journey of challenge, courage, and connection.

games.name: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2
games.summary: An FMV game where YOU are a psychiatrist trying to solve a double murder whilst treating the unusual patients of the recently deceased Doctor Dekker. Ask questions and link answers to determine their fates, and your own!

games.name: Schrödinger's Call
games.summary: I am Mary. The last person in the world you'll ever talk to. Schrodinger's Call" is an adventure game that uses a mysterious phone to connect with souls who cannot die. The main character, Mary, wakes up in a strange room with no memory. The player, along with the bewildered Mary, will save souls.

games.name: Worming from Home
games.summary: Be the Worm of Wall Street in this silly simulation game about working a remote finance job. Throw your spineless body around the keyboard to invest in the stock market and earn obscene amounts of money. Buy upgrades, train skills, and worm your way up to the promotion you've always dreamed of!

games.name: Toxic Crusaders
games.summary: The Toxic Crusaders return for an all-new, all-action beat 'em up for one to four players! Grab your mop, tutu and attitude, and get ready to clean up the mean streets of Tromaville, one radioactive goon at a time!

games.name: Mayak
games.summary: Hard-sci-fi side-scrolling VN about first contact, love, and a prime-number countdown. You are a young astronomer researching a newly received signal from a distant star. Unravel an alien mystery — and fight to save the one you love.

games.name: Mutter
games.summary: In the midst of war, a far more personal horror takes root at home. Your mother is becoming a monster. Survive, uncover the truth, and navigate a heartbreaking bond in this unique stop-motion narrative horror adventure.

games.name: Voidface
games.summary: Face off in a challenging bullet-hell arena shooter to try and clear bite-sized boss rush challenges. Learn to dodge their attacks, cast spells to gain an upper hand, and kill everything that gets in your way.

games.name: The Dungeon Experience
games.summary: Put your real world responsibilities on hold with a visit to The Dungeon Experience, a fantasy theme park phenomenon. Adventure awaits, for anyone and everyone! If you've already visited, please come back, we fixed that smell.

games.name: Woodo
games.summary: Woodo is a 3D puzzle game. The player immerses in a calm and peaceful world where time stopped at the happy moment. With imaginary friend Woodo, player build bit by bit this tiny world. Woodo tells the player stories and makes the player feel not lonely while playing. The game looks like a wooden kit from childhood.

games.name: Cassette Beasts 2002
games.summary: Jump back into the world of beasts in Cassette Beasts 2002, coming to Xbox Series S | X, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC! A follow-up to the critically-acclaimed creature collector, Cassette Beasts, this new journey will have players fuse with over 240 beasts - any two beasts can be combined into over 50,000 combinations, all fully animated!

games.name: General Practice
games.summary: Diagnose and (mis)treat patients to meet tight deadlines and high expectations in this wacky medical co-op adventure. Wear many hats, master numerous tools, multitask, manage the chaos: all while trying to do no harm! Play solo or enjoy the tomfoolery with up to 4 players, locally or online.

games.name: Barkour
games.summary: Step into the paws of a brave, four-legged special agent! In BARKOUR, you work for a secret organization where all agents are exceptionally skilled animals brought together by one goal: to save the world from the forces of evil (and mischievous cats)!

games.name: Carnival Hunt
games.summary: Carnival Hunt is an asymmetric multiplayer horror game set inside a living, ever-shifting mechanical carnival designed by the Puppetmaster. One player becomes the Carnival Monster, while others play as puppet Bunnies struggling to survive, ascend, and escape the hunt.

games.name: Hayaku! Island of Darkness
games.summary: Explore a mysterious island full of dangers and uncover the secrets behind the anomalous creatures that inhabit it in this retro-style metroidvania.

games.name: ShelfLife: Art School Detective
games.summary: ShelfLife: Art School Detective is a Mystery Adventure featuring a cast of loveable weirdos! Befriend and investigate 7 potential suspects. Use psychic powers to astral project into their artwork and learn their secrets. Unmask the mysterious ART KILLER that’s terrorising your campus!

games.name: Splash Divers
games.summary: Immerse yourself in an unforgettable diving vacation! Break free from the limits of air supply and dive into the beauty of the ocean and its incredible marine life. Build your own personalized ocean encyclopedia, make friends with a diverse cast of dive buddies, and savor these moments of leisure.

games.name: Trainwatch
games.summary: Meet Troy, the new Gatekeeper. His job is simple - close the gates at a desolate railway crossing for one month. This is his last chance to earn back his wife's trust. To prove he can stay sober. To become a better man. Join him at the Tower in the middle of nowhere. Help Troy fix his life.

games.name: Silent Planet: Elegy of a Dying World
games.summary: Silent Planet is an exploration-focused, dark action side-scroller rooted in Cosmic horror. Explore the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a dead civilization.

games.name: Void Martyrs
games.summary: A grimdark survival horror about a nun in a space suit. Scavenge amongst drifting space cathedrals, balance your faith with survival, and craft the tools of your salvation.

games.name: Kidbash: Super Legend
games.summary: Kidbash: Super Legend is an exciting 2D platformer that blends classic gaming with a modern touch. You'll go on a thrilling adventure through two different phases - the Mountain and the Village. Your goal is to defeat Tao Shen Long, and begin the journey to becoming a Super Legendary Hero.

games.name: Holstin
games.summary: A psychological survival horror game set in an eerie, isolated 90s Polish town consumed by an ominous presence. You’ve come looking for answers, but everyone seems possessed by something foul. Explore the festering town, interrogate locals and fight ungodly manifestations to get to the truth.

games.name: Shade Protocol
games.summary: Shade Protocol is a 2D cyber-fantasy Metroidvania where music, code, and combat collide. Swap between DAWN and SHADE forms to unleash devastating abilities, wield Instruments as weapons, and rewrite reality itself in a world on the brink of annihilation by the Shade Protocol.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
games.summary: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with more enemies, more weapons, and new ways to purge!

games.name: Sol: Shogunate
games.summary: Paint the stars with the blood of your enemies in this Space-Samurai Action RPG set in an alt-future solar system ruled by the sword. A pulse-pounding soundtrack drives your gravity-defying, blood-soaked path of revenge as Yuzuki the “Shattered Heir” to a massacred clan who becomes an outlaw ronin.

games.name: Wilderdark
games.summary: Something dangerous is lurking in the wilderness. Wilderdark is a first-person survival horror game where you must navigate a strange island inhabited by ectoparasitic dinosaurs and organisms. You must remain vigilant to stealthily obtain evidence, samples, and craft tools to survive.

games.name: Everwind
games.summary: Everwind is a novel take on RPG and Sandbox Survival genre in First-Person-Perspective. Embark on the adventure with your friends - Build a base on a flying island-ship, gather resources, craft, loot, and fight while you rise above the clouds to uncover the mysteries of this world!

games.name: Graft
games.summary: GRAFT splices together tense survival horror with a dark RPG experience in a thrilling new adventure from the developers of BATTLETECH and the Shadowrun Trilogy. Explore a dying world haunted by darkly fascinating characters and nightmarish monsters as you delve into the mysteries of the Arc. Tear pieces from your enemies to transform yourself into something new—something capable of surviving the horrors that prowl around you. Every Graft brings with it some piece of its previous owner’s identity, changing more than just your physical body.

games.name: Cathedral: Crow's Curse
games.summary: Set in the same universe as Cathedral, but with its own story and style, Cathedral: Crow's Curse is an action-adventure with tight combat and a focus on exploration. Parry, dodge and fight your way through numerous enemies in a rich detailed world as you uncover the events leading up to Cathedral.

games.name: Cosmo Tales
games.summary: Cosmo Tales is a third person, action adventure inspired by the '70s retro sci-fi aesthetic mixed with modern looks and gameplay. Use the dimension shifting ability to change between realities as you fight your way through the outer space.

games.name: Kitman
games.summary: KITMAN is a 1-4 player sports management simulator set in the backrooms of a stadium. Run the team by running the locker room. Clean the team’s boots, patch jerseys, mop floors, and when no-one is looking… sneak into the gaffer’s office and fix the game plan!

games.name: Echobreaker
games.summary: A lightning-fast precision speedrunner where you pilot an armoured rig that can manipulate time itself. Every second matters, and going faster means risking everything.

games.name: Imprinted
games.summary: Looking for a forensic specialist to restore damaged audio tapes (late 1970s). Warning: The artist was involved in the occult; she disappeared under suspicious circumstances. The nature of the recordings may be distressing. Mental clarity and resilience are a must. QUOTE REQUESTED.

games.name: MTB Mavrix
games.summary: The ultimate multiplayer open world designed by Pro riders. Discover mountains and trails with limitless control and build your own career. Pull huge tricks or race through the global rankings! Nail challenges to secure sponsorship deals with real world brands. Are you ready?

games.name: Goblin Cleanup
games.summary: A co-op cleaning game where you have to clean and rearrange a dungeon before the next adventurers come to complete it again.

games.name: Grobnopolis | Last Days
games.summary: You haven't been outside in quite a while. The sky was enveloped by a strange layer of clouds that's been blocking the sunlight for months. Something’s brewing in the air… and now it has found its way into your apartment.

games.name: Petunia's Purgatory
games.summary: Petunia’s Purgatory is a creepy-cute, idle-farming game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Plant seeds that grow into horrifying crops, sacrifice animals for blood, and summon assistants to help you run your farm. Manage your sanity while you try to appease the Elder God!

games.name: RetroSpace
games.summary: A space station has been swallowed by a black hole, mutants roaming the corridors, and everything seems to have gone mad around you. Be sneaky or blast your way through the station and find a way home, all in a disco-punk atmosphere, as if you were the hero of a 70s B-movie that never existed...

games.name: Kick
games.summary: Kick It is a Jump'n Run with a soccer ball. Navigate your ball with skill and finesse through a happy adventure.

games.name: Brigador Killers
games.summary: Isometric insurgent simulator. Fight on foot and in vehicles, build and steal a private arsenal and bring the war home to the businessmen who started it all in this continuation of the Brigador saga.

games.name: Lost in the Roots
games.summary: A 2D adventure with a twisted story about guilt, where a girl is kidnapped and held in an attic somewhere in the countryside. Why and who took the girl to this godforsaken place? What to do when there is nowhere to run?

games.name: Expendabots
games.summary: Expendabots is a 4-player CO-OP horror-extraction game where you and your friends explore ever-changing islands full of danger and secrets. Run, hide, loot abandoned facilities, and extract with your squad before the island is lost.

games.name: John Gleep
games.summary: John Gleep is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.

games.name: Ultrapool
games.summary: The pool bar is always open! Ultrapool is a colorful roguelike about playing pool with a bunch of wacky balls with crazy effects. Carefully craft a perfect build and get the craziest trickshots!

games.name: Glasshouse
games.summary: Feudalpunk CRPG, with Turn-based combat, set in a lockdown apartment block at the dawn of a world war. Investigate the mysterious triple murder next door, fight the Political Conspiracy, and make terrible choices before the flatmates do it for you!

games.name: DayZ: Badlands
games.summary: DayZ Badlands throws you into the troubled territories of Nasdara Province—267km² of arid expanse. Uncover its secrets, battle for control, forge fragile alliances and rebuild from the ashes of past wars. Survival here isn't just measured in drops of water saved, but in bullets spared.

games.name: The Mermaid Mask
games.summary: Magnus Mortuga has been killed. The captain of the world's strangest submarine, he was found in a locked room with an ancient stone cauldron - unsealed and opened for the first time. How did he die? Was it a curse? Perhaps one of his eccentric crew? Or does the bizarre truth run even deeper...

games.name: Imagine Sisyphus Happy
games.summary:
Sisyphus, king of Corinth, has tricked the Gods and Death. To punish him, the Gods condemned him to push a boulder uphill forever, only for it to roll back each time.
But Sisyphus didn't give up. He decided to livestream it.

Imagine Sisyphus Happy is a Steamer Sim, Clicker and QTE mix game about life, spectacle, and finding meaning in repetition. Roll your boulder, pull off stunts, and try to make the eternal grind worth living.

Push the boulder. Do tricks. Go live.

Progressing from Greek myth to the modern day, the story asks two simple questions:
- Aren’t you a Sisyphus too?
- Can you Imagine Sisyphus Happy?

games.name: Sated
games.summary: Gurgling messes of flesh live beneath. They seek to be sated. Your cursed fridge beckons: spin the wheel and choose revolting ingredients in this rougelike-inspired cooking course from the very depths of hell. Leave your customers satisfied or become the meal yourself.

games.name: Duskfade
games.summary: Duskfade is a colorful adventure in a world where the torments of the past haunt you. Battle against your memories in a dizzying dance to fade the shadows of the dusk.

games.name: The Subminer
games.summary: An atmospheric underwater drilling roguelite beneath the icy crust of Enceladus. Pilot your submarine, explore the depths, mine resources through procedural caves and upgrade your base. Each dive is darker and more dangerous, and you must face the terrors lurking in the shadows. Live. Dive. Repeat.

games.name: Nailcrown
games.summary: Nailcrown is a savage dark-fantasy boomer shooter packed with high-velocity gunplay, brutal melee action, and a dynamic gore system. Explore the dark environments and wield a deadly arsenal, while taking down a horde of accursed enemies. Fast, violent, and unapologetically old-school.

games.name: Dupery: A Game of Solo Deduction
games.summary: A terrible syndicate has infiltrated society, explore cases, listen to what the citizens have to say, and use that information to route out the good from the evil in this roguelike 'clock-like' deduction game. Can you uncover the head of the syndicate? Or will you be duped like the rest?

games.name: Code: 9
games.summary: Deduce evidence using your own words in crime investigations against the fascist regime of Aeterna. Prove yourself in real debates where every word matters. Johann Richter discovers Klara, a mysterious speaking artificial intelligence. Where does she come from? What is her mission?

games.name: Remote Control
games.summary: Remote-control human proxies to explore a derelict spaceship. Type your commands, manage risk and decide how disposable a life really is.

games.name: Wildaria
games.summary: Wildaria is an Action-Adventure RPG Pet Collector set in an Infinite Fantasy World. Explore diverse open-world biomes as you collect and train unique pets to aid in your quest to conquer dungeons, slay gods, or defend the natural world from the kingdom.

games.name: Wreck Runners
games.summary: Wreck Runners is a 1-4 player online co-op extraction game set in a haunted and ever-changing Bermuda Triangle. Hired by the suspiciously cheerful Trustwell Corporation, your crew of runners is sent in to recover valuable salvage. We expect you may find far more than sunken wrecks waiting in the Fog.

games.name: Mayak
games.summary: Hard-sci-fi side-scrolling VN about first contact, love, and a prime-number countdown. You are a young astronomer researching a newly received signal from a distant star. Unravel an alien mystery — and fight to save the one you love.

games.name: Steam to Electric
games.summary: Build and optimize your railway network in this elegant voxel rail tycoon. Transport passengers and goods, unlock crazy-but-real historical train inventions, and evolve from steam to electric. Easy to start, deep to master. From the creators of Station to Station and Town to City.

games.name: Glory On Pluto
games.summary: Bring prestige back to Earth by building your engines and finding Glory on Pluto in this offbeat and unique deckbuilding rougelike.

games.name: Hack '95
games.summary: Time travel to 1995 in this card-based computer hacking voyage. Take down an evil tech startup and shadowy government agency to become a god to the freaks and geeks of cyberspace. All while being helped by an incontinent virtual pug.

games.name: Whisk
games.summary: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.

games.name: Welcome to Elderfield
games.summary: Welcome to Elderfield is a spooky farming RPG. You can farm, fish, mine, cook, craft, befriend townsfolk, beseech the old gods, investigate mysteries, watch unsettling news programs, get lost in the dead mall, die in your sleep and more. There's lots to do in Elderfield!

games.name: Meaningless Random Numbers
games.summary: Meaningless Random Numbers is an Incremental Horror Game about earning cash through Random Number Generators but be cautious, God is Watching.

games.name: Being & Becoming
games.summary: Being & Becoming is a dark, atmospheric metroidvania set in a kingdom consumed by a Collective Dream. Play as a Lucid Dreamer, able to possess the corrupted, absorb their spirits, and wield them as weapons to break the world free from its endless slumber.

games.name: Bandwagon
games.summary: Assemble a band of music-playing animals and roam the land to help grumpy creatures rediscover their joy. Each run features unique, procedurally generated music based on the bandmates you choose, as you complete quests and meet quirky characters along the way.

games.name: Shipping Store Simulator 2037
games.summary: Run the logistics center of the future! Hire robots, deliver packages via drone, drop off urgent shipments in your truck, and become the biggest package pickup place in sunny Cranelock.

games.name: HellSlave II: Judgment of the Archon
games.summary: The Heavens are done waiting. In this dark fantasy dungeon crawler RPG, the Archon descends to end the demon war once and for all. Make your stand in HellSlave II, more immersive, brutal, and customizable than ever. The reckoning begins now.

games.name: Silver Pines
games.summary: Silver Pines is a Survival Horror set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

games.name: Planted!
games.summary: What do you get when you combine gardening and extreme sports? A head-to-head ‘horticultural combat’ game for 1-4 players, where gardens are arenas and players battle for resources to Sow, Grow and Throw as much produce as they can at goals (and each other!!).

events.name: The Secret Sauce Showcase 2026
events.description: Welcome to the SECRET SAUCE SHOWCASE! Expect 40+ brand new trailers for some of the coolest, cutest, weirdest, and [redacted] games ever. Plus, tune in to see exclusive behind-the-scenes dev diaries sharing some extra info on the talented devs behind some of the featured games.

games.name: Roman Sands RE:Build
games.summary: Washed up on the shores of a timeless luxury retreat, you find yourself acquainted with its unhinged inhabitants. They await the day that the Sun will swallow the world. You are obligated to serve their whims. There's more to this place than meets the eye. Can you uncover your exit?

games.name: SacriFire
games.summary: A modern JRPG-inspired game with a unique battle system, rich story, fantastic visuals and music by Motoi Sakuraba.

games.name: Sprkls.exe
games.summary: sprkls.exe is a cute, melancholic story-driven adventure that unfolds entirely on your desktop.

games.name: Appulse
games.summary: Discover pinball like never before with Appulse! The game is a roguelite shooter, where you protect a Galactic Federation ship! Upgrade your ball, your weapons and your ship to pushback waves of unwavering robots.

games.name: Beat, Heart, Beat
games.summary: Beat, Heart, Beat is an autoscrolling rhythm-platformer centered around slashing through enemies to the music to maintain your momentum and traverse your way towards your own heart. There are three directions to slash - up, down and right in front of you. Slash in the correct direction to aim your attacks at enemies and dash into them. Performing a series of slashes to the correct rhythmic pattern is the key to reaching the end of the stage and advancing onwards to your heart.

games.name: Boost Vector EX
games.summary: RUN FAST. Faster than any other. Take control of a Vector Master and sprint in uncompromising pure parkour racing. Hone your style with responsive, flowing controls and break limits in the Premier Vector World Cup. The race, your friends, and victory beckon your arrival... Did I mention it was fast?

games.name: Taste of Heaven
games.summary: Become a cook in the realm of spirits. Taste of Heaven is a cooking game with hints of RPG and a nice pinch of quirky humor. In this HD 2D handcrafted game, you will have to manage your customers’ mood and appetite in real time. Discover unique recipes and items in the world where worlds are made.

games.name: Sovereign Tower
games.summary: Play as the Sovereign of a magical tower in this story-rich, Round Table management RPG. Recruit eccentric Knights, assign quests and balance egos whilst carving out your kingdom's destiny. If destiny doesn’t go your way, keep turning back time, uncover secrets and rewrite fate again and again.

games.name: Kill your Darlings
games.summary: The kingdom has imprisoned you in the dungeon! Manage your day-to-day life, date your fellow inmates (who are monsters) and fight by their side to escape in this innovative time-management dating-sim RPG where every choice matters and every playthrough is different.

games.name: Shade Protocol
games.summary: Shade Protocol is a 2D cyber-fantasy Metroidvania where music, code, and combat collide. Swap between DAWN and SHADE forms to unleash devastating abilities, wield Instruments as weapons, and rewrite reality itself in a world on the brink of annihilation by the Shade Protocol.

games.name: Black Well Devil
games.summary: Ascend from the depths of hell in Black Well Devil, the stylish high-stakes platformer. Flick yourself into the air to reach higher heights, fall again and again, fight challenging bosses, and mayhaps fall in love.

games.name: Woodo
games.summary: Woodo is a 3D puzzle game. The player immerses in a calm and peaceful world where time stopped at the happy moment. With imaginary friend Woodo, player build bit by bit this tiny world. Woodo tells the player stories and makes the player feel not lonely while playing. The game looks like a wooden kit from childhood.

games.name: Worming from Home
games.summary: Be the Worm of Wall Street in this silly simulation game about working a remote finance job. Throw your spineless body around the keyboard to invest in the stock market and earn obscene amounts of money. Buy upgrades, train skills, and worm your way up to the promotion you've always dreamed of!

games.name: Deadly Days: Roadtrip
games.summary:
Deadly Days: Roadtrip is an exciting action roguelite, that combines reverse bullet hell gameplay with strategic inventory management.

Start your road trip through the zombie apocalypse! Fight your way through, gain experience and collect items to assemble an epic inventory.

Craft more effective weapons and find out what items you can combine to withstand the ever-increasing waves of zombies.

games.name: Ant Colony: Wild Forest
games.summary: You play as the queen of ants, managing an anthill. Ants cannot be controlled directly, but you can create the necessary types of ants; improve them; organize raids, build a dungeon! The goal of each level is to destroy all enemy bases.

games.name: Unshine Arcade
games.summary: An arcade full of secrets, a sentient virtual pet in the prize cabinet, a stealth shooter roguelite arcade machine and one way to escape: win tickets.

games.name: Chained Beasts
games.summary: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelite. Fight chaotic battles in the Colosseum while chained to your friends. Brave physical and mental injuries that change how you play. Entertain the blood-thirsty crowd by unleashing your inner beast.

games.name: Memoirium
games.summary: Traverse a chaotic and crumbling realm of dreams composed of liminal spaces. Adapt to the world’s odd rules as a Dreamer, and defy others like you to escape the strange and eclectic subconscious landscape.

games.name: Please, Watch the Artwork
games.summary: Night surveillance at the museum but the paintings are alive. A lonely clown roams the canvases. Watch, listen and report any changes. Paranoia-inducing. Weird. Melancholic. Relaxing? No jump scares or monsters, but the game can feel oppressive at times.

games.name: Remote Control
