games.summary: High On Life VR drops you into a hilarious first-person action adventure where humanity's fate hangs on your outrageous talking guns. Battle bizarre aliens, explore vibrant worlds, and uncover hidden secrets, now rebuilt for immersive virtual reality.

games.name: System Shock VR
games.summary: A virtual reality port of Nightdive Studios’ remake of the classic 1994 immersive sim. Rebuilt for Meta Quest, PlayStation VR2, and SteamVR, the game brings the atmospheric corridors of Citadel Station into VR, allowing players to experience its exploration, combat, puzzles, and cyberpunk horror from an immersive first-person perspective while facing the rogue AI SHODAN and her mutated and cybernetic forces.

events.name: Daedalic Days - Late at Night
events.description:
On August 13 at 9PM CEST / 12PM PST, we'll be going live with Daedalic Days - Late at Night, our biggest showcase dedicated to everything coming next from us and our development partners.

Expect brand-new announcements, exclusive reveals, fresh gameplay, updates on highly anticipated projects, and a few surprises along the way.

games.name: Barotrauma: Home & Harbor
games.summary: Home & Harbor is the upcoming expansion for Barotrauma. Introducing outpost ownership, building and management and a mysterious new faction: The Descendants, which will shake up the world of Europa's merry sailors.

games.name: Hordeguard: Winds of the North
games.summary: Gather resources, fortify your village, recruit your warband, and defend against waves of monsters. With the clock ticking, every decision counts – strategize quickly and act swiftly to ensure the survival of your village. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op mode.

games.name: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown
games.summary: Star Trek Voyager: Across the Unknown is a story-driven survival strategy game in which the fate of the iconic starship is in your hands. Take the helm, manage the ship and resources, and make difficult decisions. Will you be able to bring home the ship and its crew?

games.name: Curse of the Crimson Stag
games.summary: Curse of the Crimson Stag is a story-driven mystery thriller in which you explore a blurred line between supernatural occurrences and past tragedy. Uncover what led to the abandoning of the once luxurious Whiteroot Hotel. Local myth tells of a wrathful spirit known as the Crimson Stag…

games.name: Ghost Haunting
games.summary: GHOST HAUNTING is a humorous 2D point-and-click adventure in wonderfully low resolution. A loving tribute to the graphic adventures of the 90s - with the best of then and the comfort of today. Grinsemuskelkater guaranteed (no liability for permanent damage)!

games.name: Woodo
games.summary: Woodo is a 3D puzzle game. The player immerses in a calm and peaceful world where time stopped at the happy moment. With imaginary friend Woodo, player build bit by bit this tiny world. Woodo tells the player stories and makes the player feel not lonely while playing. The game looks like a wooden kit from childhood.

games.name: Surviving Deponia
games.summary: Explore, craft, build and fight your way through the harsh landscape of Deponia. Meet allies and make enemies while surviving the perils of the junk planet. It might be garbage - but it’s your garbage!

events.name: Ukrainian Games Festival 2026
events.description: Ukrainian Games Festival 2026 is sponsored by Ternox Games, The Future Entertainment Company, Nitro Games, NOT A CAT Studio, and KIB Games.

games.name: Sarco
games.summary: Sarco is a first-person horror game built around constant tension instead of jump scares. Maintain visual contact with the sarcophagus to keep it closed and the primordial being contained. But beware: it will adapt. Explore an abandoned complex and find a way to stop the being before it breaks free.

games.name: Steel Core
games.summary: STEEL CORE is a tactical turn-based strategy about giant mechs defending mining outposts on hostile worlds. Build each mech from parts, fortify your base, and survive an escalating roguelite campaign against an overwhelming alien enemy. Frontier work pays well, for those who survive it.

games.name: Tukoni: Forest Keepers
games.summary: Tukoni: Forest Keepers is a cute and cozy puzzle adventure, based on a series of award-winning books by the Ukrainian artist Oksana Bula. Play as the forest spirit Tukoni as you meet unique characters, solve captivating puzzles, brew fragrant tea and explore a magical world filled with kindness.

games.name: DDoD
games.summary: DDoD is a single-player and co-op tactical roguelite shooter set in the near future, deep inside an abandoned industrial zone. Explore, fight, and mutate your way to the source of a semi-sentient biological AI anomaly.

games.name: Saturn 94
games.summary: You are the keeper of Orbita, a Soviet station orbiting Saturn. Keep the failing station alive, assemble cargo rockets, and supply the colonies. Supplies run short, and something aboard never made it into the reports. Obey orders, or defy the Party? Lives depend on you.

games.name: The Sinking City 2
games.summary: The Sinking City 2 is a terrifying Lovecraftian journey, powered by Unreal Engine 5. Experience a heart-pounding survival horror as you explore the flooded city of Arkham and fight eldritch monsters beyond human comprehension.

games.name: Sealbreakers
games.summary: A top-down 3D roguelite brawler where a disgraced warrior fights immortal tyrants in a collapsing reality. Break the world back with nothing but fists.

games.name: Tulpa the Unseen Lover
games.summary: Create yourself a perfect friend in this choice-driven visual novel. Love her, hate her, don't let her turn your life into a living hell.

games.name: Brain Runner: Dreamcore Movement Shooter
games.summary: Your time is running out. Kill to take it back. Sprint, wall-run, and shoot through shifting dream worlds in a fast-paced movement-shooter roguelite as Aina fights to wake humanity from the perfect dream.

games.name: Floralis
games.summary: In the cruel and dangerous world of carnivorous plants, on the ruins of human civilization, our heroine is born. A child of trees and primitive genetic engineering. She will have to fight for her life, unravel the mysteries of the past and try to become something more.

games.name: Wolf Commando
games.summary: An explosive 80s-inspired top-down military shooter where skill, guts, and firepower decide everything. Choose your route and fight for the highest score.

games.name: Last Pirates: Die Together
games.summary: Last Pirates: Die Together is a cooperative pirate-themed horror game designed for up to 4 players. Join a loyal crew of scallywags on a high-stakes mission to scavenge mysterious islands and make your old captain rich.

games.name: Dreamfear
games.summary: Escape the nightmare filled with your own fears using various weapons and upgrades in a fast-paced, surreal roguelite. Can you survive in your own mind?

games.name: Magic Shop Chaos
games.summary: A fun co-op organization simulator for 1-4 players. Team up as witches to bring order to a chaotic shop by sorting 6,000+ magical items back to their rightful places. Serve incoming customers, level up unique magical skills, and transform magical chaos into perfect order!

games.name: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock
games.summary: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock is a survival horror game. Monitor corridors and rooms through surveillance cameras to counter vengeful ghosts. Keep the lights on, the generator charged, and fuses replaced… and don’t get caught!

games.name: Warfactory
games.summary: Warfactory fuses planet-scale automation with real-time strategy and lite 4X elements. Build sprawling factories, design modular robot armies, and lead thousands of units into battle. Conquer a galaxy with a supply chain — one conveyor belt at a time.

games.name: I'm not a Psycho Invader
games.summary: You've seized the university! Every floor is full of obstacles. Each hostage is valuable, dangerous, or a waste of time. Kill, search, or interrogate: everything costs time, and panic raises the price. Reach the roof before time runs out.

games.name: Chumaky
games.summary: Chumaky is a game about traveling, trading, farming, and building your own homestead. Discover mysterious locations and enjoy atmospheric landscapes.

games.name: Unguided
games.summary: Escape a digital prison, upload yourself back into the real world, and get revenge on the ones who framed you in this fast-paced challenging roguelike slasher

games.name: Stunt Paradise 2
games.summary: Stunt Paradise 2 - more speed, more explosions, more madness! Jump over ramps, dodge lasers, buzzsaws, and rockets while performing insane stunts. With new traps, improved graphics, and pure arcade chaos - get ready for the ultimate stunt challenge!

games.name: Hear My Light
games.summary: A short narrative puzzle-shooter about bringing your brother home through a contaminated combat zone by guiding him with drones. He and the enemy are blind and catatonic, responding only to your drones' sounds — so every signal to shoot has to be your tactical decision. Especially when the dead rise

games.name: Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare
games.summary:
Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare is a desktop-like adventure game about exploration of the Deep Internet, a sequel to Project DeepWeb. Inspired by Internet lore and real netstalking experience, it tells a story of a person who got stuck in the wrong place at the wrong time.

The Show’s over. Time to wake up.

games.name: Polystrike
games.summary: POLYSTRIKE is a competitive top-down tactical shooter where every angle, every utility and every decision can change the outcome of the round. Coordinate with your team, master tactical combat and outplay your opponents in intense 5v5 objective-based battles.

games.name: Balls & Gamble
games.summary: Balls & Gamble is a casino-inspired incremental game where you shoot a LOT of balls, earn money, buy upgrades, gamble, unlock new balls, and eventually break reality itself.

games.name: Dice Looter
games.summary: Roll the dice to collect loot, combine your gear, and discover powerful builds. Dice Looter is a roguelike autobattler where your hero enters battle to become the greatest warrior among mortals.

games.name: Karting Core
games.summary: A single-player kart racing game focused on skill-based driving. Race across 10+ tracks, unlock 3 kart tiers, compete in 5 tournaments, customize your garage and camera, and master races, time trials, and drift challenges.

games.name: I Hear the Forest
games.summary: A slow-burn folk horror. You play as a forest ranger who finds himself surrounded by talking trees, flying witches' heads, and cursed dryads. You'll be very lucky if you make it out of the forest alive.

games.name: Cargo Protocol: Cyberpunk Trains
games.summary: Build a logistics empire in a grim cyberpunk world: lay tracks, optimize production and delivery chains, research technologies, and expand your influence. Corporations are the new gods, and the Market decides who survives.

games.name: We are Eva
games.summary: Play the game in multiple dimensions at the same time, traveling between them whenever you like! Doesn't it sound fun? My name is Eva, by the way, I'm the main protagonist of the game you're looking at, and I promise we'll have fun. If you add me to your wishlist, of course. *wink wink*

games.name: Rhythmkill
games.summary: Rhythmkill is a super-fast rhythm action game where your every kill strikes on the beat. Wall-run, dash, slide, and chain lightning-fast katana kills through neon-drenched arenas. Master the rhythm, maintain your momentum, and fight your way to the boss who imprisoned you.

games.name: Sal Terrae: in search of SALT
games.summary: Post-apocalyptic Mythpunk in Ukraine. Lead a chumak caravan on a perilous journey to Crimea for salt. Guide indirect dialogues as 12-year-old Oleksa and use Neuro-Tune to read and alter people's minds. A world of Ukrainian legends, tech artifacts, and tough choices awaits!

games.name: Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator
games.summary: Step into the role of a technomaster in Valkyrie Iteration, a sci-fi visual novel. Train and guide Lana, a young pilot, and her sentient mech, the Valkyrie, as they prepare for high-stakes battles against otherworldly foes.

games.name: Hourturn: Echoes of Time
games.summary: Hourturn is an atmospheric game that begins inside a large, constantly turning hourglass. You are a tiny grain of sand within it, striving to stop it and escape, but what awaits the grain of sand outside? Is this the only way to measure time?

games.name: White Clouds
games.summary: White Clouds is a cozy first-person game. An old house is waiting for someone to come back. You tend to repair old furniture, clean lakes, plant flowers, brew tea, and write haiku about what you see. Travellers climb up to visit. Find your peace above the clouds.

games.name: Fracture Point
games.summary: After years in prison, you return to a dark megacity ruled by a ruthless corporation. The only way forward is up—through countless floors of a heavily guarded skyscraper—to reach the corporation's leader and take your revenge.

games.name: Job Burnout
games.summary: Psychological horror game about your lovely work. Absurd humor, incompetent management, pointless tasks, weird coworkers, and monsters that show up in the office after the workday ends.

games.name: Gutted: Infested Crypts
games.summary: Descend into infested crypts beneath a cursed cemetery in this visceral action-horror FPS. Fight through rotting horrors with heavy gunplay, brutal dismemberment, and only a dying flashlight between you and the darkness.

games.name: Her Last Wish
games.summary: «Her Last Wish» is a physics based 2D puzzle game made in a vintage, cardboard style. After his wife's death, the main character is left alone with her final request: care for a strange creature that lives deep in a cave near their home.

games.name: Moorko
games.summary: A quiet village engulfed in a mysterious fog. The animals have turned into aggressive beasts with glowing demonic eyes, and all the people have disappeared. Only a brave cat stands against the darkness!

games.name: Remote Reaper: FPV Drone
games.summary: FPV drone simulator. Destroy enemy vehicles with high-precision strikes. Simulation of electronic warfare and realistic armor model.

games.name: Jaden Industries
games.summary: Jaden Industries is a relaxing factory-building puzzle game about managing compact crafting chains across floating islands.

games.name: Just Another Guild Day
games.summary: Run a guild in a small village bordering the Demon King’s lands. Assign quests, train adventurers, manage loot, brew potions, gather intelligence, and prepare your people to survive the next monster attack.

games.name: Touge: JDM Dealership Simulator
games.summary: An economic simulator set in an alternative Japan. See a car that everyone has written off, read it with your bare eye, haggle with a salesman who remembers every deal, and grow from a single parking space to a corporation to keep it when the country runs out of money in 1990.

games.name: Our Freedom
games.summary: Our Freedom is a medieval colony sim with action RPG adventures. Build a village, lead your people, produce food and materials, forge powerful weapons, recruit an army to protect your village in epic battles and castle sieges. Stand up for your people and help them defend their freedom!

games.name: Ministry of Truth: False Memory
games.summary: Ministry of Truth: False Memory is a story-driven simulator in a totalitarian society. Become an official, manipulate facts, rewrite history, and provide the ‘truth’ to the public. Choose: obey or fight against the regime. The Great Father is watching you!

games.name: Nocthra
games.summary: Nocthra is a grim retro-style game where you play as a necromancer defending waves of attackers by raising hordes of minions from fallen enemies' corpses. Protect your graveyard from relentless assaults, and dive into a perk system that offers endless skill combinations for infinite replayability.

games.name: Missi
games.summary: Missi is a cozy point & click game in a watercolor hand-drawn world. Find hidden objects and solve puzzles using clues in sketches of past adventures. Try to trick the Mushroom Spider and the Crow King by collecting all medicinal herbs for the sick little mouse.

games.name: Agecraft
games.summary: Agecraft is a historical strategy and city-building game where players guide a civilization from the Stone Age to the space age. The game combines settlement building, resource management, and technological progression. Players construct cities, manage the economy, provide for their people, and expand across different eras, unlocking new buildings, production chains, and methods of transportation as history advances.

games.name: Ground Drone Operator: Ground Robotic System Simulator
games.summary: Co-op combat UGV simulator. One drone - several operators. Configure your ground drone for the mission and split roles between platform, weapon station, and equipment. Run robotic assaults, escorts, supply runs, evacuations and raids behind enemy lines.

games.name: Mutate! Fight! Purr!
games.summary: A roguelike deck-builder set in a twisted biblical world, where a lone cat mutates to survive the trials of heaven and the pit.

games.name: Radar Line
games.summary: Command a radar-guided air-defense network against drones, cruise missiles, and ballistic threats. Buy intelligence, deploy radars and launchers, manage a limited stock of interceptors, then investigate every breach before the next attack begins.

games.name: PROFITS 2167: Planetary Resource Optimization & Freight Infrastructure Technician Simulator
games.summary: Arcade train driving game about collecting, managing, and delivering resources with survivors-like and TD-like elements. Manage, upgrade, and defend mining stations, drive your train through the network of underground caves, grow numbers and multiply profits in a dark neocapitalistic future.

games.name: Invasia
games.summary: Invasia is a project for those who miss Sci-Fi horror games, but featuring cutting-edge visuals. You wake up alone to the distant wail of sirens. The bright corridors of the space station are gone, replaced by claustrophobic darkness. Something has gone dreadfully wrong.

games.name: VOID PRIEST
games.summary: You are the Void Priest, bound to an Elder God against your will. Guided only by relics, symbols, and light, solve eldritch mysteries and perform forbidden rituals. Survive long enough to choose whether you stay faithful or betray.

games.name: Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest
games.summary: Angelo and Deemon are back in this point-and-click adventure! Angelo’s quest for viral fame leads him to Heaven, where divine mysteries and celestial puzzles await. Join him and Deemon as they meet heavenly beings and tackle divine dilemmas.

games.name: Zaibaly
games.summary: Horror-comedy boomer shooter, fantastic reimagining of a real-life experience of living under the constant threat of aerial assault

games.name: Lucid Falls
games.summary: Manipulate gravity, space and time, and survive terrifying nightmares in a deeply atmospheric lucid dream. Facing terrifying creatures, and solving challenges that bend reality, every moment reveals more of the dark truth behind Lucid Falls.

games.name: No Signal: Chornobyl
games.summary: No Signal is a strictly online co-op psychological horror game set in the abandoned Chornobyl Exclusion Zone. Explore decaying towns, solve tasks together, and question everything—because you and your partner may not be seeing the same reality.

games.name: Fog'n'Silence
games.summary: Lead a group of vagrants through the surreal open world of the afterlife. Observe their journey through the eyes of a drone operator. Hide from blind monsters. Avoid malicious fog. Embrace the cycle. Survive. Escape.

games.name: Walk Hero
games.summary: Go forward. Kill enemies. Collect loot. Get stronger. And again. An unusual mix of genres will allow you to focus solely on the choice of equipment and upgrades.

events.name: Trailer Tuesday Show: Summer 2026
events.description: The premiere of Trailer Tuesday Show, featuring launch-day trailers, worldwide reveals, and plenty of other awesome surprises from the best indie games around the world

games.name: The Sinking City 2
games.summary: The Sinking City 2 is a terrifying Lovecraftian journey, powered by Unreal Engine 5. Experience a heart-pounding survival horror as you explore the flooded city of Arkham and fight eldritch monsters beyond human comprehension.

games.name: Walk Around the World
games.summary: A cozy desktop companion where BilBil explores the world while you work or stream. Talk, click, and help your tiny traveler visit real countries, unlock charming outfits, and take every step of the journey.

games.name: Unhinged
games.summary: Hunger won’t kill you, but losing your mind will. Explore, craft, and build machines to survive an open-world corporate death game in this brutal sanity-first survival craft simulator.

games.name: Trash Goblin
games.summary: A cosy and moreish fantasy shop sim where you uncover, clean, upcycle and sell a vast variety of trinkets - both invaluable and unlovable - to a diverse cast of fascinating customers across a colourful fantasy city. Think Potionomics meets PowerWash Simulator, with a unique protagonist!

games.name: Trash Goblin: The Artist of Brimhaven
games.summary:
The Artist of Brimhaven is the first official expansion for cosy shopkeeping game Trash Goblin. This expansion adds a whole new district to visit, and brand new ways to interact with it.

Use your recolouring tool - plus all your old tricks of the trade - to bring life back to an abandoned slice of Silver City, and change lives in the process.

games.name: Glasshouse
games.summary: Feudalpunk CRPG, with Turn-based combat, set in a lockdown apartment block at the dawn of a world war. Investigate the mysterious triple murder next door, fight the Political Conspiracy, and make terrible choices before the flatmates do it for you!

games.name: Leafy Corner
games.summary: Run a cute little plant shop in this cozy and relaxing game. Grow, sell, and care for a variety of real-life plants, help customers find their dream plants, complete orders, and customize your cozy shop just the way you like!

games.name: Autonomica
games.summary: Autonomica is an open-world survival game inspired by solarpunk aesthetics driven by farming and automation, exploration, and futuristic tech. Build automated farms, craft advanced machinery, and explore islands filled with mysteries, ghosts, challenges and time-bending adventures.

games.name: Salvation: Echoes of War
games.summary: Explore a haunting purgatory in this third-person stealth adventure. Injured and trapped in a nightmare after war, solve puzzles, outsmart enemies, and rely on your loyal companion to find a way back to life. Can you escape your past and survive the echoes of war?

games.name: Mr.Mag: The Dark Side Within
games.summary: A hero, but alone, A magnet doll finds himself drawn into THE DARK SIDE WITHIN. Mr. Mag is a puzzle-adventure. Use magnetic power not to conquer, but to survive. To search. To remember what it means to be pulled—by something more than instinct.

games.name: Killa
games.summary: Killa is a 3D adventure mystery with multiple endings. Valhalla, our protagonist, seeks the killer of her mentor, a mentor she treasures like family, venturing to an unknown island. Discover the culprit on this enigmatic island and embark on a journey of revenge.

games.name: Last Pirates: Die Together
games.summary: Last Pirates: Die Together is a cooperative pirate-themed horror game designed for up to 4 players. Join a loyal crew of scallywags on a high-stakes mission to scavenge mysterious islands and make your old captain rich.

games.name: Wobble Bros
games.summary: Carry a ragdoll patient through chaotic physics rescue courses as wobbly doctors in 2–4 player co-op. Control your floppy bodies, coordinate with your team, and reach the evac point without dropping the patient.

games.name: Carnival Hunt
games.summary: Carnival Hunt is an asymmetric multiplayer horror game set inside a living, ever-shifting mechanical carnival designed by the Puppetmaster. One player becomes the Carnival Monster, while others play as puppet Bunnies struggling to survive, ascend, and escape the hunt.

games.name: Restore Your Island
games.summary: Heal a scarred island, rebuild habitats, play with your dog, design your sanctuary, and relax by the fire. Turn this broken, trash-filled island into a thriving sanctuary — one clean sweep at a time.

games.name: Inferius
games.summary: Descend into the underworld of "INFERIUS," a first-person, card-based game inspired by The Divine Comedy. Solve puzzles, battle creatures, and reclaim your soul in an ever-draining health race. Unleash strategic card combat and descend through 9 haunting levels on a journey of redemption.

games.name: Deserter
games.summary: In this stealth RPG, you play as a deserter who is forced to become a thief in a grim, war-torn town. You'll have access to a rich arsenal of tools and devices: from lock picks and crowbars to grappling hooks and dynamite. Additionally, take advantage of your surroundings: find or create alternate routes, stick to the shadows, stay quiet, or use loud noises to cause distraction.

games.name: Imagine Sisyphus Happy
games.summary:
Sisyphus, king of Corinth, has tricked the Gods and Death. To punish him, the Gods condemned him to push a boulder uphill forever, only for it to roll back each time.
But Sisyphus didn't give up. He decided to livestream it.

Imagine Sisyphus Happy is a Steamer Sim, Clicker and QTE mix game about life, spectacle, and finding meaning in repetition. Roll your boulder, pull off stunts, and try to make the eternal grind worth living.

Push the boulder. Do tricks. Go live.

Progressing from Greek myth to the modern day, the story asks two simple questions:
- Aren’t you a Sisyphus too?
- Can you Imagine Sisyphus Happy?

games.name: Liar’s Line
games.summary: A monster is hunting you from the phone line. A tense detective mystery. Listen to each caller, compare their stories, and expose the liar before you give away your location. One wrong judgment, and it comes to your door.

games.name: Silent Planet: Elegy of a Dying World
games.summary: Silent Planet is an exploration-focused, dark action side-scroller rooted in Cosmic horror. Explore the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a dead civilization.

games.name: Weeny Wise
games.summary: Embark your adventure with your companion in Weeny Wise. Invite a friend to join you for free in the magical world of Weeny Wises with Friend’s Pass and continue the story of Anneli and Hugo.

games.name: Eddie’s Last Shift
games.summary: Run a late-night burger shop during a deadly outbreak. Cook orders, identify infected customers, and stop the Silent Plague before your town is lost.

games.name: Realm of Fame
games.summary: A myth-inspired roguelike with intense fast-paced wrestling combat. Explore a cursed Byzantine citadel where dungeons change every run, face legendary heroes twisted by dark winds, and uncover mythological mysteries as you seek redemption.

games.name: They Are Here: Alien Abduction Horror
games.summary: They Are Here is a first-person horror story about a journalist who witnessed an alien abduction at the Grayswood farm. Explore the area armed with a flashlight. Take photos of evidence of aliens presence and get to the bottom of the horrifying truth.

games.name: Void Dungeon
games.summary: Void Dungeon brings you a 2D Action RPG with intense hack & slash combat, deep character options, and unyielding enemies, which you can face solo or with up to 4 friends. Oh, and quirky costumes. Because it’s better to look good when the void consumes you.

games.name: Color Fear
games.summary: Today on the Color Fun Coloring Show they want Viewers to Help them Find out Who is Breaking into Their House.

games.name: Deep Pixel Melancholy
games.summary: Deep Pixel Melancholy is a visual novel about being stuck in a time loop inside a gray, soulless city. Unravel the mystery, and decide whether escaping is really worth it.

games.name: Kloa: Child of the Forest
games.summary: Consumed by a mysterious curse, restore a once lush forest and its inhabitants to their natural state in this action adventure tale. Experience fast-paced combat, puzzles, and the beauty of nature captured in handcrafted pixel art.

games.name: Escape From Mystwood Mansion
games.summary: In this first-person puzzle escape room game, you are trapped in the mysterious Mystwood mansion. Explore corridors and find hidden rooms while solving puzzles and deciphering codes to find a way out. Will you escape or linger to uncover the mansion's final secret?

games.name: Packing Life
games.summary: A cozy and satisfying puzzle-simulation game where you step into the role of a warehouse worker with a knack for perfectly organizing and packing orders. With charming visuals, relaxing gameplay, and a lighthearted story, experience the joy of transforming everyday tasks into a fulfilling adventure.

games.name: Your Cozy Unboxing
games.summary: A cozy unboxing simulator where you peel tape, slice cardboard, unscrew, clean and break seals on mystery boxes as a rising content creator, turning every item into both décor for your room and content for your social feeds.

games.name: Silent Wounds - The Doll
games.summary: Silent Wounds is an episodic psychological horror anthology. Each episode offers a compact and intense narrative experience. In this first episode, a man returns home and trades reality for the dangerous, silent obsession with a perfect doll.

games.name: Fragments
games.summary: Your mind is shattered. Step into a first-person psychological horror where you must relive your deepest trauma, uncover fragments of your past, piece them back together and face the tormentors that haunt your mind.

games.name: Deck of Memories
games.summary: Deck of Memories is a nostalgic deckbuilding adventure about the stories your grandfather left behind. Explore fragments of his life as a lighthouse keeper, manifested inside atmospheric dioramas. Craft and combine cards to restore these memories and discover the secrets they hold.

games.name: Cathedral: Crow's Curse
games.summary: Set in the same universe as Cathedral, but with its own story and style, Cathedral: Crow's Curse is an action-adventure with tight combat and a focus on exploration. Parry, dodge and fight your way through numerous enemies in a rich detailed world as you uncover the events leading up to Cathedral.

games.name: Aikyam
games.summary: Dazzle the hearts of disgruntled villagers with extravagant turn-based battles and rally them against demons in this Bollywood-inspired fantasy RPG!

games.name: Don't Wake the Beast
games.summary: In Don't Wake the Beast, a roguelite stealth game, you’ll sneak through ever-changing dungeons to steal precious treasures guarded by deadly beasts. Use your trusty grappling hook to evade traps, outsmart enemies, and solve puzzles. But beware—each treasure you claim makes escaping more dangerous!

games.name: Arms of God
games.summary: Gear up for a battle through hell in this next-gen autoshooter with Doom-inspired gore vibes, metal music, roguelite mechanics, and a satisfying combat feel. Wield five weapons at once, upgrade and merge them to forge indestructible builds, and bring divine justice to a world on the brink of chaos.

games.name: Escape the Riddlerock Ruins
games.summary: Explore the ancient Riddlerock Ruins with your loyal dog in this first-person escape room game. Solve puzzles, decipher ancient inscriptions, uncover hidden passages, and master ancient mechanisms left by a lost civilization.

games.name: Broken Shell
games.summary: Broken Shell is a cute and cozy adventure game filled with love and courage. Join Mr. and Mrs. Hermit, an adorable couple, as they navigate through a charming world filled with puzzles, challenges, and heartwarming moments on their heartfelt journey to a better life.

games.name: The Deep Waits
games.summary: You have one minute to live. Eat, explore, fight, and craft your way off a cursed island before the deep takes you.

games.name: Synchro
games.summary: Uncover the corporate lies! Assemble your underground roguelite team and rise to the top in the cyberpunk world of Synchro. Use telepathy to read the thoughts of citizens and the plans of your enemies to outsmart them in tactical, turn-based combat.

games.name: Mops & Mobs: A Sweeping Dungeon Adventure
games.summary: Mops & Mobs is a humorous dungeon adventure, spicing up storytelling with decoration quests and card-based battles. Befriend eccentric monsters and solve problems as the dungeon’s janitor. Clean, decorate, investigate, and eventually uncover dangers threatening the dungeon.

games.name: Ripple Park
games.summary: A meticulously crafted Metroidbrainia game. You find yourself lost in a vast maze filled with pools, where secrets lie beneath their calm and gentle surfaces. Various traps and mechanisms hinder your progress, and unknown entities instill fear in your heart. Search for specific items and leverage the behaviors of unknown creatures. You will unravel the puzzles, uncover your past, and ultimately make your escape. Inspired by poolcore.

games.name: Vale's Echo
games.summary:
2D cozy horror adventure that blends dark comedy, psychological storytelling, and surreal art.

In Vale’s Echo, death isn’t the end — it’s your last chance. Players take on the role of Vale, a sarcastic and troubled soul who wakes up on a mysterious train to nowhere. No pulse. No past. No clue. Her only company? Echo — a floating skull full of secrets, charm, and just the right amount of mischief.

As Vale and Echo journey through the underworld to confront Death and uncover Vale’s past, players will meet a bizarre and unforgettable cast of characters — from chatty fish-human hybrids to leech merchants and morally dubious spirits. Each encounter challenges not just Vale’s choices, but also the player’s empathy, humor, and sense of right and wrong.

Gameplay in Vale’s Echo revolves around dialogue choices, unsettling puzzles, and branching narratives that shape Vale’s relationships, memories, and ultimate fate.

Beneath its eerie charm lies a deeply emotional story connecting the surreal with the human — all wrapped in cinematic visuals, melancholic music, and darkly witty writing.

games.name: One Less Choice
games.summary: A Russian Roulette duel twisted with Cards and Rock–Paper–Scissors.

games.name: Cozy Potions
games.summary: Find comfort in bubbling cauldrons and blooming gardens. Craft potions, nurture plants, unlock new recipes, upgrade your tools, and sip your own brews for cozy buffs as your tiny alchemist’s shop becomes the town’s favourite haven.

games.name: Muri: Wildwoods
games.summary: Explore the mysterious creature-filled Wildwoods as a Muri. Find secrets, solve puzzles, befriend creatures, and clean away the corruption. Restore the world's beauty in this cozy adventure!

games.name: Truckful
games.summary: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

games.name: Escape By Spoon
games.summary: Escape by Spoon is a prison escape game with action and digging mechanics, featuring a 1930s rubber hose animation art style.

games.name: Eastern Dream
games.summary: Build the city, then step inside your own story. Solve handcrafted building puzzles, meet unforgettable characters, and uncover the forgotten tale hidden within your city.

games.name: Delverium
games.summary: Explore, Build, Farm, Craft and Fight in this vast procedurally generated survival adventure for up to 4 players. What you do is up to you, but the deeper you delve, the more you uncover the hidden truth. Could you be the hero to restore stability to the land and put an end to the invading "Faults"?

games.name: The Greenening
games.summary: The Greenening is a short and wholesome incremental journey about exploring and reawakening a forgotten world. Wash away the ashes to discover the secrets hidden beneath, upgrade your versatile watering abilities, and grow your own cozy space garden.

games.name: Speechless
games.summary: Speechless is an Escape the Loop experience. Every "loop" consists of different puzzle(s) solutions and actions you have to perform to escape the building.

games.name: Fallosophy
games.summary: Use just two buttons to climb a colossal pinball table spanning the history of western philosophy. Fallosophy is a minimalist game that turns pinball into a quiet struggle against gravity. No score. No tilts. No savers. Falling down means climbing back up again. Why climb? What does it all mean?

games.name: Aether & Iron
games.summary: Immerse yourself in this narrative RPG set in an alternate 1930s where anti-gravitational technology has taken cars, roads, and even New York City into the sky. Muster a crew, master tactical, turn-based combat, and unravel the dark secrets lurking beneath the floating metropolis.

games.name: Zitifono
games.summary: After a storm, your boat breaks down, but relax! The quirky inhabitants of Zitifono will help you to repair it. Embark on an adventure, swim, sail and discover all the secrets of the mysterious and colorful islands.

games.name: Unbox the Room
games.summary: Unbox the Room is a relaxing puzzle game where you unpack and arrange items and furniture in your new home. Create a cozy space by placing everything just right, from the smallest cup to the largest sofa.

games.name: DearMyFriend
games.summary: Set off to the unknown world Stargather Land now. The shadow of chaos is shrouding here for so long, a girl from another world shoulders the responsibility of saving this land. Travel with the power of elements until the end of destiny, only fight will lead her to the finish.

games.name: Black Lake
games.summary: Black Lake is a first-person survival horror game set in an abandoned orphanage beside an endless black ocean. Search for your missing sister, survive what the children became, and uncover the ritual beneath the lake.

games.name: Riot Riders
games.summary: Swing from a chopper while your bro pilots in a co-op physics-driven aerial bullet hell, using a wild “Swing-to-Aim” system to unleash BIG guns, pull off absurd stunts, chase high scores, and prevent another WORLD WAR.

games.name: Them
games.summary: You just want to play a video game in an old game club, but time passes quickly, and strange noises draw you into a dark nightmare! A nightmare that begins with an old video game... Are you ready to experience a 2d platformer game within the heart of a first person psychological creepy game?

games.name: Whirlight: No Time To Trip
games.summary: In the heart of Verice Bay, a brilliant idea takes shape in the hands of an eccentric inventor and an eclectic artist. Follow Margaret and Hector in a point-and-click graphic adventure that will take you to the edge of space and time to help them avert imminent danger.

games.name: Trawler's Wake
games.summary: A cheap trip to a paradise harbor lands you in a rotten fishing town full of mutants, anomalies, and fish worth a fortune. Fish by day, sell your catch, upgrade your old trawler, dig up the story, and try not to kick the bucket after dark.

games.name: Fallen Tear: The Ascension
games.summary: Fallen Tear: The Ascension is an epic adventure set in a vast magical world where you’ll fight dangerous beasts, defy corrupt gods, and face many challenges, all in an attempt to bring balance back to your world.​Embark on this journey with Hira, a mysterious young boy who seeks the truth about his forgotten past. Along the way, bond with many fully-voiced characters to unlock new skills and abilities that will aid you in your battle through environments that constantly change and react to your choices - all in classic, hand-drawn animation.

games.name: Super Zoo Story
games.summary: Super Zoo Story is an open world zoo simulator with RPG elements in pixel art style.

games.name: Olga: Episode 1
games.summary: Relive Olga's childhood memories as she visits her grandparents' home in Belovodica, a secluded mountain village where some discoveries last a lifetime.

games.name: Firva Strings of Fate
games.summary: Join Firva in a dark and fantastical medieval realm as she embarks on a perilous quest to save her mother and sister. Explore a world filled with breathtaking landscapes and daunting challenges that will test your wits and bravery.

games.name: Mini Airways
games.summary: Mini Airways is a real-time management game where you play the role of an air traffic controller. Clear your aircraft to take off & land, direct them to the destination...and most of all don't let them crash!! London, Tokyo, Shanghai... Test your ATC skills in distinctive maps around the globe!

games.name: Throne & Conquest: King Arthur
games.summary: Rule as King Arthur and unite a fractured kingdom. Make difficult decisions, conquer rival lands, and balance your kingdom in this strategy adventure.

events.name: GamingUp Showcase 2026
events.description: Created as a dedicated stage for the DACH games industry, the GamingUp Showcase brings together independent developers, established studios and publishers, including Ivy Juice Games, Assemble Entertainment and astragon Entertainment, in one digital presentation. Viewers can expect World Premieres, exclusive gameplay, release date reveals, developer insights and further announcements throughout the show.

games.name: Schrott
games.summary: SCHROTT - the roguelite driving game: Pull off insane stunts, collect valuable loot, and customize your absurd vehicle.

games.name: Ikuma: The Frozen Compass
games.summary: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

games.name: Slay Goblins
games.summary: Slay Goblins is an arena roguelite where you play a knight fighting off hordes of goblins. Choose from a variety of perks, weapons and items to create unique builds and defend your castle.

games.name: Staged
games.summary: Staged is a co-op first-person physics party game for 1–4 players. Play mischievous goblins, rebuild stage sets from reference photos, haul oversized props through tight backstage spaces, and get every placement right before the curtain rises.

games.name: Night Errand
games.summary: Night Errand is a 2D detective adventure where you play as Sage & Nur, an unlikely detective duo solving murder and mixing coffee in the quiet town Morrowpines. Collect clues, piece together contrasting perspectives, uncover the truth — and don't forget to mix a cup of coffee while you're at it.

games.name: Rootknot
games.summary: Defeat demons not with swords, but with juggling skills, in a combat mechanic never seen before! Challenge your reaction time in a deckbuilding roguelite, fighting mysterious creatures. Rescue your performance troupe and perform at the long-awaited king's wedding with the help of the Wak Wak tree.

games.name: My Dear Emma
games.summary: Exploring beautiful landscapes and local wildlife. Become part of Emma’s story, a young biologist and nature photographer who has decided to start a new life far from the big city. A narrative-driven adventure to relax, feel, and slow down.

games.name: Echoes of Mora
games.summary: Embark on a mysterious journey, filled with intriguing interactions and meaningful encounters, as you explore a sunken village and travel through time to help Mora find her lost brother. Playable in VR and non-VR on PC.

games.name: Mica King
games.summary: Mica King is an original top down action adventure game. Travel as an adventurer of variety skills to the once great and magical kingdom of Virrdale. Uncover the power of Mica and face the dark forces behind the bitter downfall of the king.

games.name: Mazestalker: The Veil of Silenos
games.summary:
In Mazestalker, players take on the role of Yve Allard, a treasure hunter who stumbles upon the long-isolated kingdom of Ebuzond. A world full of genuine mysteries, in stark contrast to the staged adventures of her homeland. What begins as a search for forgotten enigmas soon develops into a journey shaped by the intrigues of gods, archaeological puzzles, and the witty bottled god Wotton, whom she accidentally picks up along the way.

The game is designed as a homage to the japanese 16-bit era of action RPGs and features:

A relaxed yet gripping combat system at its core
A colorful, handcrafted overworld in the style of classic 2D Zelda games
An expansive labyrinth with Metroidvania-like exploration
Challenging dungeon levels that drive the story forward

games.name: Valkyrie Rising: Hordes of Ragnarök
games.summary: Battle the End of the World in this Norse horde-survivor roguelite. Unleash godlike powers, collect powerful runes, and build insane combos. Survive endless waves, crush epic bosses, and fight to save Asgard from the Hordes of Ragnarök.

games.name: Burning Bridges
games.summary: You discover a suspicious box on your parents attic. Uncover a long hidden family secret by rummaging through old homevideo and letters.

games.name: Drift Stage
games.summary: Drift Stage is an upcoming arcade racer with a late 80's art style. It will feature a selection of cars inspired by the 70's, 80's and 90's. Like the name suggests, the drifting is a big part of the driving gameplay and is described by the developers as "easy to learn, hard to master".

games.name: Tiny Capsule Collector
games.summary: Run a cozy capsule shop at the bottom of your screen. Attract cute animal customers, collect charming capsule toys, and build a relaxing, ambient world in this idle sim bringing you small moments of joy while you work. Make your desktop a place you’d rather be.

games.name: Plant Everywhere
games.summary: Paint your city with plants! In this cosy guerilla gardening game, turn harmful areas into gardens that everyone can use. Use freeform planting to customise your city, and get to know the local residents and their stories.

games.name: Forefeathers
games.summary: Forefeathers is an atmospheric story-adventure with puzzle elements! Experience a heartfelt story as the little penguin Bokki and his ghostly Grandma work together to solve light puzzles and rekindle the memories of her past.

games.name: Wizzo PopOut
games.summary: Wizzo Popout is a fast-paced, 3D top-down arena shooter for up to 4 players. Play as an arcane wizzo riding a bouncing magic bubble! Cast cool spells, dodge enemy blasts, and knock your rivals out of the arena in hilariously chaotic battles.

games.name: Triple Realms
games.summary: A small relaxing roguelike puzzle city builder where you place tiles to grow small towns, gather resources, and expand your capital. Discover new buildings, unlock powerful upgrades, and shape your own evolving landscape.

games.name: Construction Simulator: Evolution
games.summary: Dig into the next exciting evolution of the Construction Simulator series and experience the biggest construction playground ever. Control numerous licensed machines, take on manual labor, and master both construction and demolition.

games.name: Seafarer: The Ship Sim
games.summary: Embark on the ultimate maritime experience with Seafarer: The Ship Sim. Choose between careers, take the helm of a variety of ships, and expand your fleet. Navigate a vast open world and become immersed in the beautiful expanses and rolling waves.

games.name: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite
games.summary: Face unpredictable dangers, fight perilous fires with your crew, and save lives in Firefighting Simulator: Ignite. Step into the boots of a U.S. firefighter and play with up to 3 friends or with the help of your NPC controlled crew members.

games.name: Kerogen
games.summary: Dredge up corpses from an oil-drenched nightmare. Lost at sea, the small crew of the Atlas calls for aid. Elmsfire dances in the clouds above while black beasts stir in the waves beneath. Take your meds. Hold your breath. The black sea won't let go.

games.name: In Hope Voiden
games.summary: A forbidden warzone. Twelve soldiers. One life each. In this first person survival horror, death is permanent and the world remembers. Explore a surreal, trench-ridden hellscape where every action matters - and every death uncovers a new piece of a haunting mystery.

games.name: Fluff's Adventure: A Tale of Fur and Steel
games.summary: Fluff's Adventure: A Tale of Fur and Steel is a 3D third-person puzzle game with platforming elements. The game is focusing on non-textual storytelling, exploration and puzzles centered around fluffy furballs called "Fluffs". It creates a wholesome atmosphere in a stylized and colorful environment.

games.name: Caaahr!
games.summary: Your voice is the engine. Literally. One player screams to make the car go faster, the other somehow tries to steer it through chaos. A coop friendship test about communication, panic and losing your voice at 2 AM.

games.name: Petty Ungodliness
games.summary: The gods lost their power and took retail jobs. A single-player roguelite deckbuilder where relationships shape your deck and every battle plays out across three tactical lanes. Rebuild your bond with them to reclaim their power.

games.name: Code: 9
games.summary: Deduce evidence using your own words in crime investigations against the fascist regime of Aeterna. Prove yourself in real debates where every word matters. Johann Richter discovers Klara, a mysterious speaking artificial intelligence. Where does she come from? What is her mission?

games.name: Ayna: Shattered Truth
games.summary: Become water. Be shapeless, be formless, be fluid. All living things are from water and you can transform water into what it needs to be. Dive into this newly crafted fairytale and take on the journey of finding your place in this Metroidvania fantasy world.

games.name: Media Circus
games.summary: Launch your newspaper and sway the masses in a unique animal world! Direct reporters, plan stories, blow up Headlines for Impact and throw in Ads for Profit. With every faction gunning for a piece of your front page, how far will you go to keep your paper in print, and yourself out of trouble?

games.name: The Medieval Journey
games.summary: The Medieval Journey is a living medieval MMORPG where generations shape the world. Build relationships, marry, raise children and continue your family's legacy through the ages. Master professions, create thriving businesses, trade across authentic historical cities and forge a dynasty.

games.name: Dawn of Defense
games.summary: Dawn of Defense blends RTS, Tower Defense, and Roguelite progression. In a last defense, lead your tribe against the Empire: Command warriors in battle, fortify defenses, and build an economy as you fight to reclaim your ancestral homeland.

games.name: OfMiceAndMechs
games.summary: Fight, survive, subjugate and destroy. Build and fortify a base, establish production chains that turn raw scrap into finished steel, and command your workers to keep it all running. Your brain implant knows the way. The rest is up to you.

games.name: Everguest: The Veiled Inn
games.summary: Everguest: The Veiled Inn is a dark fantasy roguelite strategy RPG with turn-based tactical combat, active dodge timing, and powerful relic and mod builds. Choose your path, manage Mana and Overflow, and survive the cursed inn’s deadly loop.

games.name: Babushka
games.summary: A Cozy Roguelite set in a mystical Slavic forest starring Vesna, a quest-completing babushka that thrashes mutated creatures and malicious forest spirits in Turn-Based Combat. An exciting genre mix of Farming simulation, Roguelite, and Narrative.

games.name: Cat Me If You Can
games.summary: Cat Me If You Can is a charming and cozy game where you explore beautifully handcrafted black-and-white worlds, searching for hidden cats to photograph and bring their colours back into the world.

games.name: My Little Cafe Nightmare
games.summary: Brew otherworldly coffee for ghostly patrons in a dark, cozy first-person café. Upgrade your shop, manage supplies, and turn a haunted café into a sanctuary amidst nightmares.

games.name: Asterfel
games.summary: Asterfel is a third-person Action-RPG. You find yourself shipwrecked on an island nation, where greed and magical mining rouse an old god from it’s slumber. Encounter three factions, discover forgotten history, and shape the island’s future. Will you thrive, survive, or witness the end of an era?

games.name: Press: Authorized Disposal
games.summary: Manage a trash disposal factory. Press, Burn, and Sort each load. Complete your contracts. Upgrade your operation. Keep the pit empty. Don't ask about the content!

games.name: Beeing Hive
games.summary: Beeing Hive is a relaxed hive-building simulation with clicker elements. Design the inside of your beehive, click for resources, optimize comb layouts and bee roles, and protect your colony from wasps, moths, a woodpecker, and a hungry bear.

events.name: Pixel Arcadia: The Future of Retro
events.description: Bringing retro titans together for an unforgettable show packed with reveals and exclusives!

games.name: Gemini X
games.summary: The Heretechs have seized Gemini Colony! Explore, upgrade, and blast your way to victory in Gemini X: a Metroidvania built for fans of classic 32-bit run-and-gun platformers.

games.name: Astro Burn
games.summary: A retro-inspired, side-scrolling bullet hell shoot-’em-up, where you play as a feline space pilot blasting through waves of strange machines to uncover Earth’s mysterious downfall.

games.name: Blasterbug: Last Bug Standing
games.summary: Bzz bzz! Hop in chaotic bomb-fueled battles inspired by arcade action classics we all love! Blaster up to 8 players locally with ant-astics Pome-grenades in this bomb-em-up party game and bee the last bug standing!

games.name: Terranigma
games.summary: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay. Terranigma had it all... except a modern re-release. Now, the beloved action JRPG classic is back for the first time since 1995!

games.name: Ninja JajaMaru Yokai Night Parade
games.summary: Ninja JaJaMaru-kun returns in a yokai-filled hack-and-slash action game! Stray into a dungeon party, defeat dancing yokai, master flashy Ninpo, and amass an arsenal of ninja gear! Clear special "Yokai Night Parade" rules for loot, decorate your base for stat boosts and save Princess Sakura!

games.name: Knuckle Paradise
games.summary: A pixel-powered, combo-packed character action game starring Jane (a retired boxer) and her sidekick, Cocotte (a warrior… chicken?). Fight everybody. Learn combos from a pirate. Fight harder. Level up your chicken. Find your kidnappers. Teach them a lesson.

games.name: Ninja Baseball League-Man: Bases Loaded
games.summary:
Ninja Baseball League-Man: Bases Loaded is an arcade-style beat ’em up that combines baseball and martial arts, this action game has players battling through side-scrolling stages with pitches, swings, grabs, throws, combos, and special attacks. Up to four players can team up in shared-screen co-op to reclaim a stolen trophy.

Expanding on the original arcade release, the game adds a playable character, new stages, an arranged mode with revised enemy layouts, minigames, and newly arranged music alongside the original soundtrack.

games.name: Petal Runner
games.summary: Hop on your bike and join Cali & Kira as they explore the sun-soaked city of Sapphire Valley and train to become Petal Runners! Make deliveries, meet new friends, play minigames, and discover a wholesome slice-of-life story about growing up and letting go.

games.name: Bobls
games.summary: Bobls is a precise and bouncy 2D retro platformer. Complete the story through the single player or unique two-player campaign, create and play levels made by the community through the level editor used by the developers themselves.

games.name: Aggelos 2
games.summary: With the gods of light about to lose the great battle against the gods of darkness, you must master two powerful forms. Dive into a challenging Metroidvania set across contrasting worlds filled with secrets, puzzles, and intense 2D combat in this action-packed sequel

games.name: Project Neon
games.summary: Project Neon is a new, vertical / TATE style Shoot 'Em Up (shmup), developed for the original Neo Geo MVS / AES platform. It features a 1-2 player mode, with all the bells and whistles of a classic shoot 'em up that you would expect, spiced up with some modern and unique concepts and game mechanics.

games.name: Overserved: Food Fighters!
games.summary: Overserved: Food Fighters is a fast-paced multiplayer party brawler for 1–8 players. Pick an adorable critter, dash through chaotic arenas, and hurl food-themed projectiles at your rivals in frantic matches with full cross-play across every platform.

games.name: Phantom Gear
games.summary: Gear up in your battle armor and take on the sinister Ocular Force! Become Josephine and put a stop to the power-mad cult and the mysterious phantom force behind their spree of carnage!

games.name: Echoes of the Unread
games.summary: Jump and sing to unlock the secrets of the library. Singing will change the world around you and your abilities improve as you explore.

games.name: Lethal Wedding
games.summary: Say “I do” to Lethal Wedding, a top-down RPG shooter where the wedding is off, and vengeance is on. When criminal clowns kidnap the groom, the Bride and Mother-in-Law must fight through circus freaks and mafia thugs in this gritty 16-bit experience of bullets and blood.

games.name: Roguecraft DX
games.summary: The modern Amiga hit, winner of the Retro World Award at the 2025 Debug Indie Game Awards, comes to Evercade in an all-new expanded, enhanced form!

games.name: HyperYuki: Snowboard Syndicate
games.summary: Welcome to the Snowboard Syndicate! Race, Compete, and Explore the slopes as a colorful cast of unique characters! But what’s snowboarding without a little bit of drip? Through exploring and racing, you can unlock cosmetics such as designs for your snowboard and clothes to make sure you shine the brightest while shredding.

games.name: Tossdown
games.summary: Run, jump and dash through chaos, dodging hazards and enemies as you deliver packages. Fight back with wacky power-ups and choose from a variety of perks to improve your chances of survival. It’s Crazy taxi meets Jet Set Radio!

games.name: Talaka
games.summary: Welcome to Talaka! A fast-paced, combat-driven roguelite that brings Afro-Brazilian mythology to life in a vivid, hand-painted world.

games.name: Ground Zero Hero
games.summary: Kill mutants. Absorb their remains. Mutate into something stronger every run. Stack insane power combos and survive overwhelming hordes in this fast, chaotic, highly replayable action roguelite bullet hell.

games.name: Sanitarium Enhanced
games.summary: The timeless psychological horror point-and-click adventure Sanitarium returns with new enhancements. Originally released in 1998 and named Adventure Game of the Year, Sanitarium Enhanced adds full controller support, quality of life improvements, and never-before-seen bonus materials.

games.name: Hazard Pay
games.summary: In this dark and mysterious block-pushing puzzler, you'll navigate through a secret, hazardous laboratory complex. Discover creative methods to destroy evidence and cover up the crimes of your employer.

games.name: Rolla
games.summary: Play as the monster from the movie series that never existed, ROLLA. ROLL. EAT. REPEAT. Fast paced arcade game with chunky old school 3d graphics: eat people, destroy whole cities and battle with cops, army and government agents! Uncover the secrets of what ROLLA is and where it is from.

games.name: Ecstatica II
games.summary: Ecstatica II is a dark fantasy action-adventure built from a one-of-a-kind ellipsoid world. Return as a prince to a kingdom sacked by demons under a blood-red sky. Cast spells and trade blows to restore the shattered Elder Sign and free the sorceress Ecstatica.

games.name: The Transylvania Adventure of Simon Quest
games.summary:
The Transylvania Adventure of Simon Quest is a parody/homage to NES ClassicVania and other NES titles from the era.

The titular hero, Simon Quest, has just arrived in Transylvania only to discover his vampire hunting rival, Stan Helsing, has already slain the evil Count Dracula. In order to reclaim the glory that should be his, he journeys across Wallachia to gather what he needs to resurrect the dark count piece by piece and kick his ass himself!

games.name: Exobrave
games.summary: Exobrave is a 2D action-platformer that features a highly engaging combat system. Fight your way through the many branching paths of a futuristic colony infested by demon-possessed automatons - in a solo or co-op adventure!

games.name: Project Sentinel: Zero Tolerance
games.summary: Project Sentinel is a 16-bit inspired run-and-gun platformer that blends arcade action with dystopian law enforcement. Intimidate suspects into compliance with a cybernetic roar, make arrests, rescue civilians, or enforce order through overwhelming firepower.

games.name: Toxic Crusaders
games.summary: The Toxic Crusaders return for an all-new, all-action beat 'em up for one to four players! Grab your mop, tutu and attitude, and get ready to clean up the mean streets of Tromaville, one radioactive goon at a time!

games.name: Cosmi: Forbidden Forest & Beyond
games.summary: A celebration of pioneering 1980s games, this new-and-old collection of classic C64 games originally published by Cosmi includes a special remaster of Forbidden Forest with all new graphics and audio, new comic book stories and remade box art, plus a trove of archival bonus material!

games.name: Hyper Sentinel Fusion
games.summary: An intense shoot-em-up + roguelite fusion. Pilot your fighter to destroy the defences of procedurally-generated space titans, then land, infiltrate and plunder the depths with your droid. Spend your bounty on epic upgrades & explore the moon base hub to interact with characters & unlock secrets.

games.name: Carrier Command 2
games.summary: Carrier Command 2 is Strategy, Planning and Teamwork on a scale that is both engaging and manageable. True to MicroProse's heritage and the debut title of the development company Geometa , Carrier Command 2 is all about meaningful decisions.

games.name: Silent Planet: Elegy of a Dying World
games.summary: Silent Planet is an exploration-focused, dark action side-scroller rooted in Cosmic horror. Explore the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a dead civilization.

games.name: Heavy Metal Death Can
games.summary: Heavy Metal Death Can is a Retro-Inspired Survival-Horror game set on a submarine in an alternate late-70s Swedish setting. Trapped beneath the ocean, you must fight against the terrifying Sludge which has turned your crew into Zombies. Look for survivors and uncover the truth behind the madness.

games.name: Cathedral: Crow's Curse
games.summary: Set in the same universe as Cathedral, but with its own story and style, Cathedral: Crow's Curse is an action-adventure with tight combat and a focus on exploration. Parry, dodge and fight your way through numerous enemies in a rich detailed world as you uncover the events leading up to Cathedral.

games.name: Infested DX
games.summary: Escape a space nightmare as the sole survivor of an alien infestation. Search for clues and solve puzzles as you avoid deadly encounters with zombies, mutants, robots and unseen alien pathogens. Find a cure and a way home in this retro point and click adventure!

games.name: Penguin Colony
games.summary: Narrative adventure game based on H.P Lovecraft's At the Mountains of Madness. Swim, Slide and Explore open ended levels as multiple penguin types with different abilities and challenges.

games.name: Dungeon Lurker
games.summary: Fight your way into the depths of a cursed dungeon in Dungeon Lurker, a retro action roguelike with a dark twist. Uncover a sinister secret connected to your past as you plunge into a world of dark horror and brutal combat.

games.name: Mad King Redemption
games.summary: Mad King Redemption is a unique blend of a traditional beat'em'up game with strong roguelite progression, mixed in a pixelated graphic style in a 2.5D world. Relieve the king from his madness while beating up corrupted enemies, in a fresh way at every run!

games.name: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
games.summary: Eternia’s favorite heroes including He-Man, Teela, Man-At-Arms and more in a two-player, retro-inspired 2D magic-brawler, drawn in beautiful pixel-art and featuring huge, highly-detailed sprites, designed to do justice to Eternia’s favorite peace-keepers.

games.name: Alien Breed 35th Anniversary
games.summary: THE BREED IS BACK! Celebrate 35 years of Alien Breed with the definitive collection. Featuring 6 classic games, interactive archives, modern controls, visual enhancements, co-op multiplayer, Online Rush Mode and Horde Mode, bringing the complete sci-fi horror legacy back to your screens.

games.name: Ecstatica
games.summary: Ecstatica is a pioneering survival-horror adventure set in the demon-cursed medieval village of Tirich. Explore a world rendered entirely from ellipsoids, sneak past or fight off nightmarish creatures, solve puzzles, and lift the curse.

games.name: Theocracy
games.summary: The prophecy is clear: you have one hundred years to unite the Aztec tribes and prepare for the Spanish invasion. Theocracy is a unique blend of RTS, grand strategy and city building. Develop towns, raise armies, cast spells and conquer provinces - build an empire that can change history.

events.name: gamescom Opening Night Live 2026
events.description: Show de abertura da gamescom 2026, com anúncios, trailers, novidades e apresentações de jogos.

games.name: Like or Die
games.summary: A team-based survival FPS where streamers clash in a fierce battle for survival. Cosmic platform "Quaya Stream" broadcasts your every moment live. Reshape the battlefield with blocks and create new twists. In a world where wins and deaths become content, the survival stream is about to begin.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Revelation
games.summary:
As the world teeters on the brink of annihilation, the final battle against Sephiroth begins.
A meteor mars the sky, monstrous planetary guardians wreak havoc across the globe, and the fires of war rage. Now, Cloud and his companions must stand against this chaos to not only decide the planet's fate, but bring a legendary conflict to its conclusion.

In the final chapter of the FINAL FANTASY VII remake project, the scale has never been larger and the stakes have never been higher. Take to the skies and explore a boundless world, fight alongside a fully assembled party, master strategic and dynamic combat, and prepare yourself for the climactic finale.

A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

games.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered
games.summary:
Coming on September 29, this is the definitive way to experience Geralt of Rivia’s legendary adventure. The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered features an array of improvements, bringing upgrades to visuals, gameplay, and more.

Remastered is a free upgrade for players who own The Witcher 3 on GOG, Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S, and includes both Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine expansions. It is also available for pre-purchase on Battle.net and Nintendo Switch 2.

games.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past
games.summary:
Songs of the Past is a brand-new full-fledged expansion to The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, one of the most acclaimed role-playing games of all time.

Created in partnership with Fool’s Theory, a team comprising veteran The Witcher 3 developers, players can once again take on the role of Geralt of Rivia and embark on a brand-new adventure before heading out on the Path as Ciri in the upcoming The Witcher 4.

games.name: Worms Galactic Tactics
games.summary: Worms makes an explosive leap into tactical roguelike combat! Battle across destructible arenas, mod classic weapons and unleash devastating strategic combos as you fight for survival, riches and glory!

games.name: Worms
games.summary: Newest addition to the worms franchise. Currently in development

games.name: RollerCoaster Tycoon Wonderworks
games.summary: It’s the grand opening of a new RollerCoaster Tycoon, featuring new levels of chaos and wonder as you do whatever it takes to keep guests happy (and injury-free). Customize rides, manage guests, and build wild roller coasters in your theme parks as you boost profits and expand your empire.

games.name: Train Sim World 7
games.summary: Live life on the tracks and discover the joy of train simulation. Whether looking for a relaxing run on the rails or seeking the thrill of mastering your virtual train driver career, find your way in Train Sim World 7.

games.name: Acornia: Mirror Worlds
games.summary: Acornia: Mirror Worlds is a bake-and-brawl management adventure game! Run your shop in one dimension, fight angry spirits in the other. Your special skill? Stuffing your bottomless cheek pouches with treats - to plate up or shoot up enemies!

games.name: Perceptum
games.summary: A psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. Explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls.

games.name: Genigods: Nezha
games.summary: Genigods: Nezha is an ARPG rooted in the chaos of ancient Chinese creation mythology. Play as Spirit Pearl, the first being forged by the Goddess of Creation Nüwa. Dive into iconic Chinese genesis tales, battle Colossal Gods, and experience the unique combat of Chinese-style celestial showdowns.

games.name: Aniimo
games.summary: Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!

games.name: Murals
games.summary: These are not the tales you were told. Express yourself through stylized combat in the hand-painted worlds of Murals, a twisted isometric action-adventure where fairytales have gone spectacularly wrong.

games.name: TankRat
games.summary: A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are. Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.

games.name: Valor Mortis
games.summary: Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.

games.name: Humankind II
games.summary: Build a civilization that spans the ages in this historical turn-based strategy game. Combine evolving cultures, raise cities, command armies and expand your empire as a changing climate reshapes the world and your path through history.

games.name: Age Twisters
games.summary: Age Twisters is a 2-player co-op narrative adventure game that allows you to send a free invite to friends via the Friend’s Pass. Play as a grandfather and granddaughter to solve puzzles by freely changing your age and reveal the dark secrets hidden beneath a facade of lies.

games.name: Elta: Defy All Gods
games.summary: Brawl your way out of corrupted worlds alongside your dragon-god companion in an adrenaline-fueled action-platformer blending free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration. Become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.

games.name: Mariachi Legends
games.summary: Mariachi Legends is an action-packed mystery Metroidvania game. In Mariachi Legends, Join fantastical festivities at the Day of the Dead carnival alongside Detective Pablo Cruz, currently masquerading as a mariachi player to investigate an evil curse looming over the serene town of Santa Mascota.

games.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
games.summary:
Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice.
With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.
Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.
Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

games.name: Tom Clancy's Rainbow 6 Tactics
games.summary: Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Tactics is a turn-based tactical game set in the R6 universe. Command operator squads in tense battles, execute synchronized breaches, exploit destruction, and unravel a conspiracy.

games.name: Tides of Annihilation
games.summary: Tides of Annihilation is a fantasy action-adventure inspired by Arthurian legend. Uncover the mystery of an otherworldly invasion in a shattered modern London, unleashing hordes of enemies. As Gwendolyn, fight alongside spectral knights to save your family and piece a broken world back together.

games.name: Sea of Remnants
games.summary: Sea of Remnants is an original ocean adventure RPG developed by Joker Studio. Your journey begins as a puppetfolk sailor who has lost their memory. Alongside a mysterious girl, you’ll set sail on a chaotic and colorful voyage—one filled with treasure, conflict, dreams, and unexpected companions. As the seas stretch endlessly before you, an epic world of myth and history slowly unfolds. But beware, Captain: fall overboard, and your mind may be swallowed by the very thing this ocean was named for—forgetting.

games.name: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
games.summary: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Asobo Studio and published by Focus Entertainment. Set 15 years before A Plague Tale: Requiem, it follows Sophia, a young plunderer, as she travels to Minotaur’s Island and searches for answers about her past. The game is described as an original story set in the A Plague Tale universe, featuring combat, puzzles, and mythological elements tied to the series’ wider history.

games.name: Silent Hill: Townfall
games.summary:
Silent Hill: Townfall is a full-length, self-contained psychological horror set against the cold, isolated backdrop of Scotland, 1996.

Players can explore St. Amelia, where fog-soaked streets, abandoned communities, and forgotten corners tell their story through atmosphere and history. Reality and delusion subtly intertwine to lure players into the depths of St. Amelia's grounded, tangible world.

games.name: Ananta
games.summary: Take on the role of an elite Agent within the A.C.D. (Anti-Chaos Directorate) embarking on an exhilarating adventure through a world that breaks all the rules. Meet a variety of interesting characters, jump into exciting combat, solve challenges and safeguard the balance by overcoming threats to humanity, all while enjoying unparalleled freedom to traverse and discover Nova City on a journey to find out who you really are.

games.name: Gears of War: E-Day
games.summary:
Experience the brutal horror of Emergence Day through the eyes of Marcus Fenix in the origin story of one of gaming's most acclaimed sagas.​
Fourteen years before Gears of War, war heroes Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago return home to face a new nightmare: the Locust Horde. These subterranean monsters, grotesque and relentless, erupt from below, laying siege on humanity itself. ​
Built from the ground up with Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers unprecedented graphical fidelity.

games.name: Pragmata
games.summary: Pragmata is a sci-fi action-adventure game set in the near future. The story follows Hugh and his android companion Diana as they navigate a Lunar research station. Gameplay incorporates action elements alongside mechanics involving interaction with systems within the environment.

games.name: Mega Man: Dual Override
games.summary: Mega Man returns in 2027 with a brand-new entry in the classic action platforming series! Override challenges and blast down legions of robots while springboarding across a new array of futuristic frontiers!

games.name: Lofsöng
games.summary: Explore, listen, and unravel a hidden language buried in stone and sound. An exploration puzzle adventure set across vast brutalist landscapes shaped by deep time ages.

games.name: Rayman Legends Retold
games.summary: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

games.name: PUBG Ded.Net
games.summary: PUBG: DED.NET is a multi-player FPS with roguelite elements set in 1990’s Cascadia.

games.name: Control Resonant
games.summary: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.

games.name: Once Human
games.summary: Once Human is a multiplayer open-world survival game set in a strange, post-apocalyptic future. Unite with friends to fight monstrous enemies, uncover secret plots, compete for resources, and build your own territory. Once, you were merely human. Now, you have the power to remake the world.

games.name: Crimson Desert Enhanced
games.summary:
The Greymane's Journey, Enhanced. Discover an enhanced Crimson Desert, featuring new story moments and expanded voice-over and language support.
Begin the adventure loved by millions, refined since launch with a wealth of updates, including new content, mounts, pets, customization options, various quality-of-life improvements, and more.
Crimson Desert Enhanced is a free update for all owners of the base game.

games.name: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros
games.summary: Classic real-time strategy in the world of Westeros. Conquer the Seven Kingdoms solo, or in treacherous free-for-all multiplayer. Command the Great Houses, rally iconic heroes, and rewrite the fate of the realm. Do you have the strength to seize the Iron Throne?

games.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
games.summary: The Blood of Dawnwalker is an open-world dark fantasy action RPG set in 14th-century Europe. You play as Coen, human by day and vampire by night, fighting to save your family in a story shaped by your actions and the secrets you uncover.

games.name: Dust Origins
